name: United Academy
description: United Academy (UA), located in Kumaripati, Lalitpur, stands as a distinguished +2 Secondary School established in 1997 AD and affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB), Nepal. Over the past twenty-five years, UA has emerged as one of the most esteemed schools in the Kathmandu valley, presenting courses in Science, Management, Humanities, and Law.Expanding its educational endeavors, UA has introduced two junior wings, United School and United Universal School, catering to education up to the Secondary Education Examination (SEE) level, alongside a senior wing, United College.UA delivers a comprehensive education, utilizing state-of-the-art scientific teaching methodologies and fostering an environment conducive to academic achievement. Emphasizing efficiency and a supportive learning atmosphere, UA annually releases its academic calendar at the commencement of each new session.Central to UA's ethos is discipline, encapsulated in its motto "Clean the Country through the Classroom (CCC)." The institution places a strong emphasis on moral values, recognizing the interconnection between quality education, character formation, and discipline.UA is dedicated to nurturing the unique potential of each student, fostering a secure and positive environment for cultural, disciplinary, and social development. The school community, comprising administrators, educators, support staff, parents/guardians, and students, takes pride in being part of the United Community, viewing the institution's physical and intellectual assets as their own.

name: Global School of Science
description: Global School of Science (GSS) is a sister concern of Global College of Management under Professional Educators Limited, is an excellent center for education which prepares every individual to grow with science and technology as valuable knowledge assets of life within the emerging fast-paced scientific cultures. GSS operates secondary science in a tie with most reputable and respected national and international academic benchmarks that disseminate science education fully pertinent with Nepal's national goals in pair with international curricula and consistently updated syllabus allowing innovation in teaching-learning approaches, patterns, and systems. An exclusive center of Science Global School of Science (GSS) offers Ten Plus Two (10+2) in Science under the affiliation of National Examination Board (NEB).Modeled for quality in science, Global School of Science (GSS) conducts overall pedagogy with academic approaches in a learning environment that encourage students for outstanding performance in science not merely to perform in exams but also for practices leading to new discoveries of thought, knowledge, ideas, skills as idealized to developing 21st-century scholarship.The GSS learning environment is well coordinated in providing learners with an exposure to changing perspectives as essential for today's and future generations to surge into tomorrow's local and global contexts.GSS academic approaches are student-centered based on a principle of constructivism with practices that encourage learners to understand science as a significant discipline to combat and successfully cope with 21st-century technology-induced changes and challenges that enable communities of school learners to invent scientific acumen for living through.Global School of Science (GSS) is framed to offer each of its incumbents an immensely experimental and real-life integrated learning who can look forward to a comprehensive and seamless educational experience within the science program and beyond.

name: Kathmandu Model Secondary School
description: Kathmandu Model Secondary School (KMSS) stands as a prestigious educational institution, establishing itself as a premier academic hub for students aspiring to receive top-notch higher education in Nepal. Since its inception in the year 2000 A.D., KMSS has carved out a distinguished reputation as one of the best +2 schools in the country.Over the course of nearly two decades, KMSS has earned a position of pride and prominence for its exceptional academic standards throughout the nation. The school consistently renovates and upgrades its facilities, fostering a technologically advanced and welcoming academic environment conducive to effective teaching and learning. The continuous pursuit of excellence in professional education has played a pivotal role in shaping its current standing within the academic sphere.KMSS proudly holds the ISO 9001:2015 certification, further highlighting its commitment to redefining modern education while upholding a rich historical legacy of academic excellence. The school aims to instill discipline, cultivate ethical values, and ignite a passion for learning within its students. To accomplish this, KMSS provides an appropriate ambiance of intellectual vigor through its state-of-the-art infrastructure, cutting-edge laboratories, and a faculty team comprising experienced professionals from various industries. The school endeavors to go beyond classroom learning, creating a unique pool of talent and turning students’ dreams into reality.One of KMSS’s notable achievements is its consistent and outstanding performance in the National Examination Board (NEB) exams, with a record of achieving 100% pass rates every year. This remarkable success can be attributed to the dedicated faculty members who possess extensive professional expertise and tirelessly guide and support the students throughout their educational journey.In summary, KMSS is an esteemed educational institution that combines modern education practices with a strong emphasis on academic excellence. With its exceptional infrastructure, experienced faculty, and unwavering commitment to student success, KMSS continues to strive for higher achievements in the field of education.KMSS remains abreast of modern educational trends, catering to competent modern education in resonance with the values of life, and remains committed to pursuing its goal of 'Academic Excellence through Quality Education.'Every year, more than 10,000 students take the entrance examination to enroll at the +2 level in KMSS, a solid testimony to the faith and belief parents and guardians have in the school. KMSS boasts of its holistic approach to enriching students’ learning experiences by reinforcing practical and student-centered teaching-learning pedagogy, which is modern, resourceful, innovative, and enterprising.KMSS aims at unfolding students’ innate potential, encouraging initiative, fostering a futuristic outlook, and cultivating cultural consciousness, thus preparing foundations for highly qualified human resources needed for the global market of the 21st century. Ethos, team spirit, and community service are strongly imbibed in students through assorted trident-driven activities. The school does its utmost not only for the academic development of students but also for their physical, mental, and emotional growth through various co-curricular and extra-curricular activities. KMSS caters to the holistic development of students, advocates academic eminence, and assures quality education at an affordable cost. Recognizing that strategies of today may become obsolete tomorrow, KMSS inexorably presumes to guide the avenues for the future of today’s generation by nurturing intellectual dynamism and moral rectitude.Goals of KMSSTo impart sound professional training and knowledge to students and to inculcate in them time-testedvalues and responsibilities as good citizens of the country.To strengthen students’ capacity to cope with all kinds of challenging situations.To foster round development of students through curricular and extracurricular programs.To motivate students to become self-reliant and promote harmonious relations through unity and interaction among multi-cultural, multi-religious, multi-lingual, and multi-ethnic groups.To motivate students to strive for and attain academic and professional excellence.Achievements of KMSSKMC has been honored with the Educational Award 2074 by the Ministry of Education for its outstanding results.KMC students have secured positions in grades XI & XII science including board top.Nationwide outstanding results at +2 levels in Science, Management, and Law (up to 4 GPA)An institution with a difference in maintaining discipline and academic standards for the last twenty-two years.A visionary plan to get converted into a university (an institution running classes from Play Group to Master’s Degree).KMC is only one private college that produces such students who secured their place at CEE, IOE, and other reputed institutions with prestigious scholarships.

name: The New Summit Secondary School
description: The New Summit Secondary School focuses not only on teaching but also on inspiring students to reach their full potential. Offering a progressive education from Playgroup to Grade 8, the school combines the National Curriculum of Nepal with the UK National Curriculum, creating a dynamic learning environment that fosters curiosity, creativity, and critical thinking.The school prioritizes each child’s individual growth, ensuring that learning is fun, engaging, and hands-on. With a dedicated team of educators and a curriculum designed to spark curiosity, students develop the skills they need to succeed academically and personally.The school is also committed to providing quality education that prepares the students for academic success and a meaningful future. At New Summit, learning is not just a task; it’s an exciting journey of growth and discovery.MissionProvide affordable, quality education while equipping students with knowledge, skills, and values in their chosen programs.Develop future leaders, scientists, managers, entrepreneurs, IT developers, and technical experts through innovative, creative, value-based, and research-oriented teaching-learning activities.Instill a sense of social responsibility in the new generation through social services.Empower students’ hearts and minds to prepare a successful workforce and job creators.GoalsKnown as a college of academic excellence in teaching-learning and extra-curricular activities in the fields of Management and IT.Structurally support and value collaboration, research, interdisciplinarity, and curricular flexibility.Become a model for student success, engagement, and well-being by helping students develop their potential.Increase enrollment, student retention, and job placement.Enhance infrastructure to meet the needs of the college and workforce development.Core ValuesStudent Success: The college offers students many opportunities to excel. Optimize student supportDevelop efficient and innovative processes that promote retention and learning.Assist in recruitment and retention of high-quality faculty, staff, and students.Provide a technological mechanism as needed.Service: The college’s purpose is to benefit our students and society through knowledge and social servicesProvide exemplary customer service.Create an environment that fosters employee growth.Promote financial sustainability, expand revenue sources, and promote cost-saving measures.Innovation: The college consistently seeks a better way by embracing challenges Enhance the administrative structure that supports research activitiesDevelop strategies that allow collaboration, diversity, and Inclusion:Everyone is respected, included, and allowed to excel.A culture that promotes diversity and inclusion is built. Accountability: Integrity, transparency, excellence and the highest standards govern everything we do.Promote transparency and efficiency across all processes and procedures within and outside the college.Promote excellence in all processes and procedures to provide quality services.Collaboration: The college seeks partnerships both within and beyond the college to enhance its actions and outcomes. Promote employee participation in the community, college units, and different organizations.Maximize opportunities offered through local, regional, and international professional organizations.BriefsThe positive energy that a person possesses can benefit the individual and the community.The balance of a friendly and disciplined environment always brings out the full potential of the people engaged.The honesty and ownership of actions taken by individuals help the community and the environment thrive.Every student is important and possesses special talent and knowledge, which encourages teaching-learning activities to make a progression leap.Diversified students enrich the cultural values of the college and provide an ocean of experiences and resources.As a home to hundreds of graduates, the school must prepare students to face the challenges of this era and succeed in life.The premise and the whole environment must encourage an atmosphere of academic excellence, intellectual inquiry, and critical reasoning.

name: IST Secondary School
description: IST Secondary School aims at developing practical, managerial, and excellent communication skills by providing each individual student with the know-how for a successful career in the hospitality industry. It is a center for excellence in hospitality education providing an enterprising and stimulating environment in which students can learn and develop their full potential. The structure of the academic program achieves this by combining management theory with practical experiences ensuring an international approach to teaching.IST Secondary School offers a 10+2 Management program with a specialization in Hotel Management. As part of the course, Grade 12 students are provided with a valuable opportunity to gain hands-on experience through a three-month internship at well-established 3 to 4-star hotels.In addition to Hotel Management, students at IST can also choose to specialize in Computer Science, Tourism Management, or General Management, allowing them to align their studies to their career interests.ObjectivesTo enhance students’ critical thinking and develop their basic analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills.To offer a comprehensive study of the departments and functions of hospitality outlets including instruction of basic operating principles and concepts.To provide students with a broad understanding of the fundamental principles and theories of the basic areas of business relating to the fundamentals of management within the hospitality industry.To provide the skills necessary for entry level positions in all types in the travel, tourism and hotel management fields.To provide a solid academic, technical and intellectual background that will enable students to pursue higher studies in Hotel / Tourism Management or other related fields.VisionTo be a center for excellence in hospitality education in Nepal providing an enterprising and stimulating environment in which students can learn and develop their full potential.MissionProduce the world class human resource to cater to the overwhelming need of the hospitality industries by offering various academic degrees by providing an educational environment that emphasizes critical thinking and decision making, reflection and creativity.Cultivate and nurture a learning environment that fosters an ethical, respectful, and culturally competent approach to customer service and with other hospitality partners. Respond to community needs through a variety of means, including collaboration with organizations and businesses.Develop practical, managerial and excellent communication skills by providing each individual student with the know how of a successful career in hospitality industry.GoalTo achieve its vision and mission by combining management theory with practical experiences in the field of tourism and hospitality ensuring an international teaching approach.

name: Gyanshree School
description: Gyanshree School is a forward-thinking academic institution established through the collaboration of two respected educational names: Kathmandu Model Secondary School (KMC), Bagbazar, and Euro School Chhauni. With convenient locations in Baneshwor and Balkumari, the school offers classes from Nursery to Grade 9, providing a strong and high-quality foundation for young learners. It is designed to meet the evolving needs of the 21st century by combining the best of local excellence and global perspectives.The school uniquely integrates the progressive, internationally aligned teaching approach of Euro School with the strong academic rigor and proven results-driven culture of KMC Bagbazar. This powerful combination creates a balanced and well-rounded learning environment that prepares students for future success. It is an ecosystem where strong academics meet modern, forward-thinking skills.VisionThe vision of Gyanshree School is to nurture confident, compassionate, and competent learners who are ready to compete and collaborate on a global level. The school aims to shape students who are not only academically strong but also remain grounded in strong ethical values. It strives to develop individuals who can make a positive impact anywhere in the world.MissionThe mission of Gyanshree School is built on several key commitments to its students and their families. These include providing a safe, secure, and supportive learning environment where every child can thrive. The school is dedicated to blending national academic standards with global teaching practices, while also fostering holistic development through academics, extracurricular activities, and essential life skills. A strong partnership between the school and parents is actively cultivated to support each child's overall growth and success.Academic PhilosophyGyanshree School believes that early education should focus on more than just academic performance; it must also develop character, curiosity, creativity, and confidence. The school follows the national curriculum, which is thoughtfully strengthened with Cambridge International Pedagogy (Cambridge University Curriculum License Applied). This blended approach ensures that students are academically prepared for local requirements while also developing global competencies like critical thinking, problem-solving, and collaboration.Infrastructure & Learning EnvironmentGyanshree School provides a modern, state-of-the-art infrastructure that is specifically designed to inspire and support learning. Students learn in spacious, well-lit classrooms with abundant natural light, all within a fully air-conditioned and secure campus environment. The vibrant, child-friendly interiors and the provision of nutritious meals reflect the school's deep commitment to student comfort, safety, and overall well-being.Holistic & Future-Ready EducationBeyond the classroom, Gyanshree School places a strong emphasis on providing a holistic education that prepares students for the future. The curriculum includes a wide range of activities focused on leadership, communication, creativity, and teamwork. By integrating ethical values and character building into daily learning, the school's objective is not just to prepare students for exams, but to equip them with the adaptability and skills needed for life and leadership in a competitive global landscape.

name: Triton SS/College
description: Triton SS/College is located at Seti Opi Marga (Jhulunge Pool), Koteshwor-32, Kathmandu, near Balkumari Bridge. Established by a group of experienced teaching experts, academicians, and professionals with national and international exposure in education, the college is committed to providing quality education suited to the needs of the 21st century while preserving traditional culture and values.The college offers Play Group to Plus 2 with Science, Management, and Law programs in +2, focusing on academic excellence, practical learning, and the overall development of students. It aims to guide learners toward becoming responsible individuals capable of contributing positively to society.More importantly, Triton SS/College is a sister concern of the DV Education Network, a well-established educational umbrella organization with a highly competent and professional team dedicated to implementing best practices and creating a conducive learning environment for balanced student growth.VisionTo be the ultimate benchmark institution for Science, Management, and Humanities education and the most preferred choice among students and teaching faculty in Nepal.MissionTo provide a conducive learning environment with quality infrastructure, experienced faculty, innovation, skills-based education, and career opportunities within a fun, connected, and sustainable ecosystem.Core ValuesDynamic learning environmentCare and support for students and associatesAccessibility and encouragementRegular staff training and professional growthAccountability and responsibilityAppreciation and recognitionUpdated knowledge and expertiseContinuous developmentBalanced academic and non-academic growth

name: Modern School/College
description: Modern School and College was established in 2050 B.S. (1993 A.D.) with the vision of providing world-class education that nurtures academically sound, highly disciplined, and socially responsible individuals. Over the past thirty years, the institution has grown from a boarding secondary school into a full-fledged educational hub offering programmes from Early Childhood Development through secondary level, serving students from Bhaktapur and the wider Kathmandu Valley.The modern school offers +2 in management and +2 in law, affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB).Modern made history in 2065 B.S. by launching the first-ever +2 Management programme in Bhaktapur district, opening the doors of higher secondary management education for thousands of local students. In 2074 B.S., it broke new ground again by introducing the first +2 Law programme in Bhaktapur, in academic collaboration with the prestigious Kathmandu School of Law, located in nearby Dadhikot, Bhaktapur.The +2 Management programme follows the NEB curriculum and goes beyond traditional classroom instruction by incorporating projects, case study presentations, industrial visits, internships, entrepreneurship practice, and advertisement creation. Students can choose optional subjects including Hotel Management, Travel and Tourism, and Computer Science, giving them a competitive edge in the professional world.The +2 Law programme is designed to provide students with a strong foundation in legal knowledge and practical courtroom skills. Core subjects include Jurisprudence, Constitutional Law, Procedural Law, the Nepalese Legal System, Civil and Criminal Law and Justice, and Legal Drafting. Students benefit from an active annual programme that includes moot court competitions, field visits to courts and detention centres, panel discussions, legal mobile clinic programmes, debate and speech competitions, and expert guest lectures.At the heart of Modern's academic identity is the philosophy of "Learning by Doing." Faculty members adopt student-centric, practical-oriented teaching methods, integrating group work, field visits, project-based learning, and audio-visual tools into every course. The institution's commitment to excellence has been recognized through multiple prestigious National and International awards, including the "Nepal Award Rising School of the Year," validating its transformative impact on education in Bhaktapur and beyond.

name: Premier International IB Continuum School
description: After successfully making history in Nepali education Premier has yet again taken a forward-thinking step to redefine +2 experience through the implementation of the new national curriculum in an international standard. The one of a kind program which allows the students to build their own degree is designed with the learner and the future in mind. The future is no longer limited by the borders of a country or the availability of jobs. The future is about finding one’s passion, understanding the needs of the society and being resourceful enough to think beyond the boundaries of set subjects to create something of value to the society. Therefore, the unique individualized program of Premier School allows the students of today the freedom to explore their passion and address real life situations without the limitations of traditional rigid grouping of subjects. The educational framework of Premier International IB Continuum School is divided into:Early YearsPrimary YearsMiddle YearsSenior High School - IB Diploma Programme (IBDP)Senior High School - National Education BoardBeing a part of Premier is being a part of an ever growing, forward-thinking community of caring leaders who are driven by the passion to bring a positive change in the society. Thus, the whole school community i.e., administration, faculty, students, and their parents are committed to learning about the changing needs of the society, questioning the status quo, and finding creative ways to serve the global society. This value deeply reflects in the schools' culture, the learning experiences, and character refinement of the students.Early YearsThe Early Years program prepares the students intellectually, emotionally, socially and physically for a smooth transition into formal education in Grade I through play based fun learning themes included in the IB Early Years Programme.Students are provided with a balanced curriculum to develop enquiry, decision-making, problem solving and mathematical abilities, and early literacy skills- all of which are necessary for successful formal education. Throughout Preschool, learning is enhanced through active participation in Physical Education, Music and Movement, Arts, Craft and Dance.Students are taught in a mixed age group setting, allowing students to develop important skills and attitude such as empathy, social skills, decision making, collaboration and communication skills.Premier is also a sister concern organization of Nepal’s first professional Montessori teacher’s training center, Nepal Montessori Training Center, giving the advantage of integrating the Montessori method of teaching within the IB PYP curriculum framework.Primary YearsThe IB PYP is an international curriculum framework for children between the ages 3 and 12 years. This program believes that each child has their own interest areas, personality, learning style and combination of intelligence types. Being a student in the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP) means that each child is given an opportunity to explore his/her interest areas through a balanced curriculum.Students develop international mindedness and global citizenship through the incorporation of local and global issues into the curriculum by focusing on the six globally significant IB transdisciplinary themes.Middle YearsThe Middle School integrates the National Curriculum within the IB MYP curriculum framework to develop socially responsible global citizens. Our Middle School program builds upon our strong Primary School program to successfully complete the IB MYP and the National Education Board exams in the 8th grade and 10th grade.Student centered inquiry-based units, in the MYP, allow authentic opportunities to develop 21st century skills to adapt to the changing needs of the society. The units of study are set in real life global contexts so the students explore subject-specific knowledge, ATL skills, concepts to make practical connection between their study and the real world.Senior High School - IB Diploma Programme (IBDP)The International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme (IBDP) programme is a two-year academically challenging and balanced programme for students between the ages of 16-19 years. The IBDP programme has gained recognition and respect from the world’s leading universities for its ability to prepare students for success at university and life beyond.Students in the IBDP gain a balanced and future ready education through a wide range of subject choice and through their engagement in the core Diploma programme, The Extended Essay (EE), Theory of Knowledge(ToK) and Creativity, action, service (CAS). The extended essay requires students to engage in independent research, finishing with a 4,000 word paper, giving them an early university experience. The Creativity, Action, Service programme scaffolds students to grow both personally and socially through meaningful engagement in creative thinking, physical activity and community service activity alongside their academic studies. Theory of Knowledge develops critical thinkers as the programme requires the students to critically evaluate knowledge claims and judgements. Senior High School - National Education Board (NEB)Our unique take on the NEB curriculum is designed with the learner and the future in mind. The future is about finding one’s passion, understanding the needs of the society and being resourceful enough to think outside the box. Our unique individualized program allows the students of today, the freedom to explore their passion and address real life situations without the limitations of traditional rigid grouping of subjects. Therefore, our one-of-a-kind program offers a flexible course of study that gives the students the freedom to choose subjects that are right for them to ‘build your own degree.’MissionPremier International IB Continuum School believes in working towards developing global citizens who have a sense of understanding and compassion for others, and the courage to act on their beliefs. The school strives to foster a challenging learning environment that encourages critical thinkers, problem solvers, independent individuals and life- long learners providing the skill necessary to succeed in an ever-changing society.Find Premier International School on YouTube:Redefining Plus 2 ExperienceNurturing World Class LeadersJoin Premier For Academic Session 2077AHA! and the OH NO! Moments While Building Family RelationshipSchool Support in COVID-19 Conversation with Karkhana

name: Galaxy Public Secondary School
description: Galaxy Public Secondary School is located at Radhe Marg, Gyaneshwor, Kathmandu. Established in 1986 AD, the school offers education up to the higher secondary level, providing +2 Science programs in Biology and Computer Science, as well as +2 Management programs in Business Studies, Hotel Management, and Computer Science. The school is committed to delivering quality education in a safe and supportive environment, ensuring that every student receives the guidance and resources needed to succeed.The school provides advanced academic facilities that encourage innovation, practical learning, and focused student development. Smart classrooms make lessons more interactive and engaging, helping students understand concepts more easily. Well-equipped science labs allow learners to conduct experiments and explore scientific ideas in depth, while modern computer labs provide access to technology that prepares students for the digital world. Digital learning tools and a well-stocked library further support student research and academic growth. The library offers a quiet space for reading and self-learning, and digital resources make it easier for students to access educational content beyond their textbooks.In addition to academics, Galaxy Public Secondary School offers a variety of sports facilities to help students build physical strength, confidence, and teamwork skills. The school has a basketball court, a futsal ground, and multiple table tennis tables. A wide range of indoor games is also available for students to enjoy during break times. An auditorium is provided for school events, cultural programs, and gatherings. These activities help students develop coordination, agility, and social skills while promoting a healthy and active lifestyle.MissionTo provide world-class education that empowers students with the skills, knowledge, and mindset required to excel in the modern world.VisionTo be a leading educational institution recognized for innovation, academic excellence, and the development of future-ready leaders.

name: Texas International Secondary School
description: Texas International Secondary School under the umbrella of Texas Int'l Education Network, is a dynamic educational institution. Texas has been founded with a set of academicians and entrepreneurs to meet the rising demand for qualified and skilled manpower in the field of Management, Hotel Management, and Science and Technology. Its principal motto is 'Education for a complete human being' and it commits to provide 'quality education at affordable fee'.Since its very inception, Texas International Secondary School remains as an invitation to learning by both theory and practice. Texas International Secondary School is ideally situated at Mitrapark, Chabahil, Kathmandu, one of the prime location of Kathmandu Valley.Texas International Secondary School offers outstanding academic programs (+2 Level) in Science, Management and Humanities faculties with the the affiliation from National Examinations Board (NEB).Texas Int'l Education Network has also been running BBS, BSc (CSIT) programs with the affiliation from Tribhuvan University and BBA, BIT, MBA and BHM with the affiliation from Lincoln University (Malaysia). to meet the demands in the field of Management, Hospitality and Information Technology.There are visiting professors, readers, lecturers and scholars in their respective fields who are attending the +2 and bachelor level classes with their up-dated knowledge.Vision:To be the leading source for education, workforce training, partnerships, and economic developmentMission:The mission of Texas is to integrate spiritual intelligence, expertise, and dedication to learning, fostering the development of well-rounded individuals.Policy: Texas is committed to providing socially conscious education with the goal of developing students into capable professionals. Through continuous supervision and evaluation, the college’s Quality Management System strives to enhance the learning environment and foster ongoing academic development.Core values:Texas International Secondary School engages in a process of self and community reflection that would lead it to recognize and heighten awareness of the core values its institution has already practiced and articulated, to seek agreement about those values, and to develop an institutional culture that holds itself accountable to those values.

name: Xavier Academy
description: Established in 1997, Xavier Academy has grown into one of Kathmandu’s most respected +2 institutions, located in the bustling area of Lazimpat. The academy occupies its own well-designed six-story building just north of Hotel Radisson, providing a modern and spacious campus for students to thrive.From the very beginning, Xavier Academy has been dedicated to creating an academic environment that supports the overall physical and mental development of its students. The institution offers comprehensive +2 programs in Science and Management, combining rigorous academics with practical learning experiences to prepare students for future success.Xavier Academy takes pride in its strong infrastructure, well-equipped science laboratories, advanced audio-visual resources, and well-maintained sports facilities — all designed to enrich the learning experience. Alongside these physical resources, the academy boasts a highly qualified and experienced faculty committed to delivering quality education and personalized attention in small class settings.Beyond academics, Xavier Academy promotes students' overall growth through counseling services, regular parent-teacher interactions, community service, and a variety of extracurricular activities. These initiatives help students develop leadership skills, social responsibility, and emotional resilience.Over the years, the academy’s unwavering focus on quality and student success has earned it consistent recognition as one of Nepal’s top ten +2 colleges. This continued excellence reflects Xavier Academy’s mission to foster well-rounded individuals ready to excel in higher education and beyond.Why Choose Xavier Academy?Over 25 years of academic excellence since its establishment in 1997Consistently ranked among the top ten +2 institutions in NepalCentrally located in Lazimpat, Kathmandu, with a modern six-storied academic complexLegacy of producing high-performing graduates across diverse fieldsStrong alumni network in national and international universities and careersStudent-centered academic and administrative philosophyValue-based education focused on integrity, discipline, and responsibilityLeadership and public speaking development through platforms like XAMUNActive Parents Teachers Association (PTA) ensuring parent involvement and feedbackSupportive and motivating environment fostering independent thinking and creativityVision: To be one of the best quality-focused and ethics-driven education institution in the country and the region..Mission:To produce graduates, who are thoughtful, analytical, enquiring, innovative, proactive and responsibleMotto:Academic excellence and total personality development.

name: Swostishree Gurukul IB Continuum School
description: Swostishree Gurukul, established in Sanobharyang, Kathmandu has been created to provide modern methods of learning by using the latest state-of-the-art facilities and research-based teaching methods. The philosophy of teaching is progressive, child-centered, and active. The school has an experienced, trained, and highly dedicated team that works hard to promote a variety of choices of teaching-learning activities which are designed to encourage physical skills, cognitive learning, literacy acquisition, problem-solving, and independent thought to the little ones. The school provides education from PG to Grade 10. Swostishree Gurukul as an IB World School has divided the education framework into 4 categories:Primary Years Programme Early YearsPrimary Years ProgrammeMiddle Years ProgrammeSenior High SchoolMission of SwostishreeSwostishree supports inspired learning through dedicated teaching, caring relationships, a challenging curriculum, and community service. Our mission is to provide the best possible education to every individual child. We value each student’s effort, imagination, and positive contribution to the community. We celebrate being inclusive and value the partnership between family and school.Vision of SwostishreeSwostishree Gurukul IB World School envisages generations of life-long learners striving towards academic excellence, social responsibility, nation-building, and global fraternization. As a center of educational excellence in Nepal and beyond Swostishree will prepare national and global leaders by providing a liberal and diverse environment for students that nurtures creativity and helps them to realize their full potential. Core Values of SwostishreeThe motto of Swostishree Gurukul is "LEARNING TODAY, LEADING TOMORROW".We are on a mission to prepare 21st -century capable and responsible citizens. Our core values are developed with the combination of the TEN IB LEARNER PROFILE. We expect our students to exhibit the following traits: knowledgeable, inquirer. caring, principled, balanced, courageous. communicator, open-minded, thinker and reflective.Education, Philosophy and Curriculum of SwostishreeSwostishree Gurukul is an IB World School authorized to offer Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP). There are 5700+ schools all over the world following common IB philosophy, standards, practices and world-class teaching pedagogy and we are a part of this global community of IB schools creating global citizens who sthrive to change the world. We follow the IB framework and pedagogy which is blended with the National Curriculum. The school was established with the vision of being an IB Continuum school to provide world-class education within the country.Swostishree's Approach to TeachingBased on InquiryFocused on Agency (Student's Ownership of Learning)Focused on conceptual understandingTransdisciplinary & Interdisciplinary Learning through local & global contextFocused on effective teamwork and collaborationA Differentiated approach to meet the needs of all learnersContinuous assessment and reflectionSwostishree's Approach to LearningSelf Management SkillsCommunication SkillsSocial SkillsThinking SkillsResearch SkillsAt Swostishree Gurukul IB World School, students have opportunities to establish and pursue sustained inquiries. In this way they gain knowledge, conceptual understandings, skills and dispositions to contribute to, and make a difference in their own lives, their communities and the wider world. Approaches to learning (ATL) are an integral part of an IB education, offering up an array of lenses for students to promulgate their inquiries. The ATL are crucial for exploring knowledge within the transdisciplinary themes or global context: they help students think, research, communicate, socialize and manage themselves effectively. All teachers foster and support the development of the ATL by providing opportunities embedded in authentic learning experiences.Primary Years Programme Early YearsSwostishree Gurukul IB World School is an authorized IB PYP institution offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) for learners aged 3 to 12 years, covering PG to Grade 5. The early years program follows the same inquiry-based teaching and learning approach as the IB PYP, incorporating play-based learning and the Reggio Emilia approach. This methodology provides young learners with a real-world environment where they can engage, interact, and explore.The early years program emphasizes stimulating and supportive interactions between peers and teachers and effective curricula use. The PYP framework caters to young learners by fostering an environment encouraging curiosity, exploration, and relationship-building. Recognizing that children grow and learn at different rates, the program integrates socio-emotional, physical, and cognitive development through play and meaningful interactions with teachers, peers, families, and the community.Swostishree Gurukul's early years block has spacious and resourceful classrooms, an attractive outdoor play area with greenery, and various facilities, including a playroom, nap room, garden, sand pit, mini dining hall, AV room, and child-friendly washrooms. The school ensures a nurturing environment with trained early years educators who receive regular international and in-house IB training.Primary Years ProgrammeThe Primary Years Programme (PYP) is a student-centered educational framework designed for children aged 3-12. It is based on the belief that students are active participants in their own learning and collaborative partners in the educational process. The framework prioritizes relationships and community-building to foster a strong learning environment. PYP students take initiative, assume responsibility for their learning, and engage in inquiry-based learning and reflection to develop knowledge, conceptual understanding, skills, and attributes aligned with the International Baccalaureate (IB) learner profile. This approach empowers students to make a meaningful impact on their own lives, communities, and beyond.The PYP framework is structured around the principle of agency, which influences three core aspects of school life: the learner, learning and teaching, and the learning community. The IB learner profile embodies a range of intellectual, personal, emotional, and social attributes that contribute to holistic growth. Demonstrating these attributes is central to the IB's vision of international-mindedness, and all members of the learning community, including students, educators, parents, and school leaders, are encouraged to uphold and model these qualities.Guided by the learner profile, an IB education emphasizes four key aspects:A student-centered approach that fosters healthy relationships, ethical responsibility, and personal growth.The development of effective learning and teaching strategies that equip students with the skills necessary for academic and personal success.A global perspective that enhances cultural awareness and engagement with globally significant issues.A broad, balanced, and conceptually driven curriculum that connects learning across disciplines.The PYP is designed to support the development of the whole child as an inquirer, both in and beyond the classroom. It follows six transdisciplinary themes of global significance, integrating knowledge and skills from six subject areas: language, social studies, mathematics, arts, science, and personal, social, and physical education. The program is flexible, allowing it to align with national or local curricula while providing strong preparation for the IB Middle Years Programme (MYP).The PYP recognizes the importance of student agency and self-efficacy, promoting independence and responsibility in learning. It addresses students' academic, social, and emotional well-being while encouraging them to develop a strong understanding of the world. Additionally, it supports the establishment of personal values that serve as a foundation for international-mindedness and offers opportunities for students to learn more than one language from the age of seven.Transdisciplinary learning in the PYP emphasizes connections across subjects and real-world relevance. Through the six transdisciplinary themes, students integrate knowledge, conceptual understanding, skills, and personal attributes, allowing them to reflect on the significance of their learning and take meaningful action in their communities. This process cultivates competent, self-motivated learners who are equipped with the cognitive, social, and emotional tools needed for lifelong learning.Middle Years ProgrammeThe Middle Years Programme (MYP) is designed for students aged 11 to 16, providing a structured learning framework that promotes creativity, critical thinking, and reflection. It emphasizes intellectual challenge by encouraging students to connect their academic studies with real-world applications. The program fosters essential skills such as communication, intercultural understanding, and global engagement, preparing students to become future leaders.Flexible in nature, the MYP can be adapted to meet national and local curriculum requirements. It builds on the foundation established by the IB Primary Years Programme (PYP) and equips students with the necessary knowledge and skills to transition into the IB Diploma Programme (DP) or the IB Career-related Programme (CP).The MYP supports students' holistic development, addressing their intellectual, social, emotional, and physical well-being. It provides opportunities for students to develop essential skills to navigate complexity and take responsible actions for the future. The program ensures both breadth and depth of understanding by incorporating eight subject groups and requires students to study at least two languages to enhance cultural awareness. Additionally, the MYP encourages community service, helping students develop a sense of social responsibility and preparing them for higher education, careers, and lifelong learning.The curriculum includes eight subject groups: language acquisition, language and literature, individuals and societies, sciences, mathematics, arts, physical and health education, and design. Each subject group requires a minimum of 50 hours of instruction annually. In the final two years, students may choose courses from six of the eight subject groups, allowing for greater flexibility.The MYP takes a unique and globally relevant approach by focusing on students' personal development and sense of responsibility within their communities. Teachers design the curriculum with an emphasis on:Teaching and learning in context – Learning experiences are connected to students' lives and global issues, fostering an understanding of identity and international-mindedness.Conceptual understanding – Students explore significant concepts across disciplines, using them to inquire into personal, local, and global issues.Approaches to learning (ATL) – A foundational element of all subjects, these strategies encourage independent learning and the application of skills in diverse situations.Service as action – Community service is a key component, with students applying their learning to real-life scenarios to make a positive impact. The MYP community project emphasizes service as a central part of the program.Language and identity – Students are required to learn at least two languages, reinforcing communication skills and intercultural understanding while shaping their personal identity.Overall, the MYP provides a comprehensive and flexible education that prepares students for academic challenges, personal growth, and active global citizenship.Senior High SchoolSwostishree Gurukul has been a pioneering private institution offering the 10+2 qualification under the National Examination Board since 2020. It provides academically driven students with an opportunity to pursue a prestigious national high school qualification, laying a strong foundation for securing acceptances and scholarships at renowned universities and programs worldwide.Situated in the heart of the capital, the institution is fully co-educational and prides itself on its experienced faculty, small class sizes, and a supportive, student-centered approach. Its educational philosophy emphasizes discipline and careful monitoring of each student's progress, fostering strong academic foundations, outstanding examination results, and a mature, independent mindset essential for future success.The college adopts a student-centric approach, offering world-class services, facilities, and resources that set a national benchmark. Committed to shaping future leaders, it ensures a nurturing, engaging, and inclusive learning environment where no student is overlooked. Each applicant undergoes an interview process to align their expectations with the college’s offerings. With an average class size of about 20 students, faculty members can provide personalized attention and direct engagement.Lessons are structured to make course materials engaging, with an emphasis on interactive learning and guided self-exploration. The teaching style is designed to be positive, encouraging, and responsive to student challenges. This examination-oriented approach has consistently yielded top academic results. Faculty members, known for their passion and enthusiasm, deliver comprehensive courses that thoroughly cover every aspect of the syllabus without assuming prior knowledge or cutting corners.Swostishree Gurukul offers a dynamic and interactive learning experience, transforming the way students think. Its 10+2 program fosters an entrepreneurial mindset, encouraging students to challenge assumptions and develop strategies for their future success. A rigorous academic curriculum, coupled with experienced faculty and career counselors, provides both theoretical knowledge and practical tools for academic and professional growth.The institution integrates various learning methodologies, including case studies, lectures, experiential learning, guest speakers, and small group discussions. Every aspect of the program is designed to facilitate idea-sharing, peer interaction, and interdisciplinary knowledge development, ensuring a well-rounded and forward-thinking educational experience.

name: Brihaspati Vidyasadan
description: The school has world-class infrastructure at the heart of Kathmandu city including recreational areas i.e, futsal ground, basketball court, swimming pool, cafeteria, etc.Brihaspati Vidyasadan has a friendly school atmosphere that probes students to ask more meaningful questions and engage in healthy discussions. As the students are exposed to different perspectives during the learning process, they are able to develop the character that nurtures in them a sense of affinity with the world.Academics at BVSAt Brihaspati, students are equipped with tools, resources, and opportunities to cultivate independence in learning. They are encouraged to adopt a positive and cheerful attitude, show respect for themselves and others, and develop the capacity for making thoughtful and wise decisions in their lives.Junior SchoolAt Brihaspati, Junior school students are nurtured to embrace independence in their learning journey from the outset. The curriculum is designed to facilitate their ongoing growth and individual development. The institution places significant importance on fostering strong reading skills and promoting resilience as fundamental behavioral attributes among its students.Primary SchoolThe Primary School program at Brihaspati serves as a transitional phase between the exploratory and creative early years and the academic demands of later education. It offers a wide array of extracurricular and co-curricular activities to enrich student experiences. Teachers in the primary grades prioritize the socio-emotional development of their students right from the planning stages, collaborating with fellow staff members and parents to foster a secure and inclusive environment.Middle SchoolThe middle school students at Brihaspati are embraced within a close-knit community of enthusiastic learners, engaging in a dynamic curriculum comprising stimulating classes, educational excursions, and hands-on learning experiences. Outside of formal lessons, they participate in a diverse range of activities including sports, theater, roller skating, wall-climbing, arts, music, STEM, and various others. Brihaspati's middle school program endeavors to establish a solid educational groundwork for students, laying the foundation for their future success.Secondary SchoolBrihaspati's Secondary School maintains a commitment to excellence in academics, while also fostering the growth of students outside traditional classroom settings. Equipped with cutting-edge laboratories tailored for Science and STEAM programs, students have the opportunity to translate theoretical concepts into tangible, hands-on learning experiences.Vision of BVSImparting quality education and nurturing human values. Mission of BVSWe explore the potential of individual students and promote excellence in all walks of life. Values of BVSEngagement Understand and connect: Students participate actively in things that matter to them. By being engaged, they understand the context and issues more effectively, thereby venturing into responsible actions. Respect Honor others and self: Students know and accept who they are as they are. With this self-esteem, they respect the diversity around them. They know to appreciate differences while seeking a congenial solution. Integrity Honest and ethical in all interactions: Students say what they do and do what they say, not anything otherwise. They have a sense of regulating themselves whether or not they are being supervised. Ethics is at the core of what they do. Student Centric Student first approach in everything we do: Everything that’s thought for and done at school is primarily for the sake of students. Students have a sense of not only their intellectual mind but also several other facets of them such as creativity, technological skills, communication, etiquette, social skills, sports, arts, music, leadership etc most aspects of which they work to develop for themselves and support others in developing the same. Humanistic Promote human values among us all: Students have a sense of compassion and extend their responsibility to a larger community. They seek welfare of humans by their service attitude.

name: Samriddhi School
description: Samriddhi School has been offering K-12 education that serves as a model for the learning community. The school values diversity and acknowledges that every young student is distinct and should be treated as an individual with unique qualities.The school strives continuously to assist every child in realizing their complete potential and exploring new avenues for learning. Its dedication lies in creating an exceptional learning atmosphere for students, empowering them to prosper in an intricate and ever-evolving world, becoming increasingly interconnected with each passing day.Samriddhi School has divided the education framework into five categories:Pre-School (Kindergarten)Primary School (grade I-V)Middle School (grade VI-VIII)High School (grade IX-X)Plus 2 (grade XI-XII)The school implements phonic-based learning and progressive pedagogy for the children in preschool. It lays a strong educational foundation considering the fact that each one enters the formal education system with a different level of readiness. Similarly, the middle school program encourages students aged 12 to 15 to explore the connections between academic subjects and the real world through learning projects that build critical thinking skills. The high school curriculum emphasizes student's intellectual, social, emotional, and physical well-being while encouraging their participation in a rapidly evolving and increasingly global society. The school's grade XI/XII management provides in-depth knowledge of management at its level to equip students with sufficient foundational grounding to pursue further studies in the same stream.Samriddhi School fosters creativity, treating children as individuals rather than automatons, thereby making each child feel unique and valued. The school believes in limitless learning and always encourages the exploration of new concepts. It is a 21st-century institution where learning is enjoyable and enduring.The school is dedicated to inspiring and motivating students to attain the highest standards of intellectual development and personal growth by means of a comprehensive and stimulating educational program. The school focuses on Science, Technology, English, Mathematics, the Arts, and other essential areas. By incorporating technology in education, Samriddhi School optimizes the efficiency and effectiveness of both teachers and students.VisionSamriddhi School envisions itself as a dynamic and inspiring educational institution that sets an example for the learning community. It is committed to provide an outstanding learning environment to it's students, to enable them to excel and thrive in a complex, constantly changing world, getting more interconnected by the day.MissionThe mission of Samriddhi School is to produce lifelong learners with a value system that turns them into good human beings. Honesty, integrity, and sincerity are values that form the strong foundation on which the school builds an educational process, culminating in academic and personal success of students. It makes use of the best educational practices and a rich curriculum. It plans on collaborating with all stakeholders including students, parents, families, business houses, civic organizations, higher education institutions and the community at large. Core ValuesBuilding quality lives and a strong culture through:CompassionRespectServiceExcellenceResponsibilityTeamworkIntegrityEmpowermentBeliefsBased on the school's Core Values of strong culture, compassion, excellence, integrity, respect, responsibility, service, and teamwork, Samridhhi School believes students learn best and become contributing, productive members of society through:Highly engaging, rigorous and relevant instructionVaried and rewarding educational experiencesAn environment that prompts them to grow academically, socially, and personallyBeing part of a safe, invigorating school environmentInvolving students’ families & communities in the process of education, thereby enhancing learning & academic achievement

name: ​National Creative Co-educational School (NCCS)
description: The National Creative Co-educational School (NCCS) is a distinguished educational institution committed to providing students with a quality education. NCCS focuses on delivering excellent academic foundations across various disciplines, ensuring students acquire a strong knowledge base and essential skills. With a team of experienced and dedicated faculty members, NCCS follows a student-centered approach that recognizes individual strengths, needs, and learning styles, providing personalized support to help students reach their full potential.NCCS has divided it's education framework into 3 categories.NCCS Pre-SchoolBasic School EducationSecondary Studies (Plus 2)NCCS values a well-rounded education that extends beyond academics. The school offers a diverse range of extracurricular activities, including sports, arts, music, dance, and various co-curricular endeavors, fostering physical, social, emotional, and creative development in students.Creating a supportive learning environment is paramount at NCCS. The school strives to cultivate a safe, inclusive, and encouraging atmosphere, empowering students to express their ideas and opinions. Positive relationships, collaboration, and teamwork are actively promoted among students, teachers, and staff.Character development holds great significance at NCCS. Alongside academic achievements, the school emphasizes instilling positive character traits such as integrity, empathy, resilience, and leadership. NCCS aims to impart values, ethical behavior, and a sense of social responsibility in students.NCCS is dedicated to continuous improvement, regularly staying updated with current educational research and best practices. The school consistently assesses its programs, curriculum, and teaching methods to ensure they remain effective and relevant.As a School of Excellence, NCCS invites students to embark on a transformative educational journey, unlocking their full potential in a nurturing and supportive environment.Vision & MissionEducation offers wide knowledge & a healthy base for children. A hassle free educational back up is needed in this current era to mould the child as a best achiever, all-rounder, & a top level success personality. Education is not merely a means for earning a living or an instrument for the acquisition of wealth. It is an initiation into life of spirit, a training of the human soul in the pursuit of truth and the practice of virtue. Keeping this goal in mind and with valuable cooperation from parents and well-wishers, the NCCS Team will continue its Quest towards Excellence.NCCS Pre-SchoolThe pre-school wing at NCCS is a recent addition, introduced in the academic session of 2078 and located within the school's premises. Currently, it accommodates 31 young learners who eagerly attend school each day, excited to learn and explore.The curriculum at Pre-School integrates both play-based and academic activities. Play-based learning nurtures curiosity and enthusiasm, making education enjoyable, while academic activities instill discipline and prepare children for primary education. The program also includes lessons on seasonal festivals, cultural traditions, and community values. Additionally, dance and music classes are offered to enhance confidence, creativity, and language skills.Teachers at Pre-School are trained in early childhood education and recognize that while all children follow similar developmental stages, they progress at different rates. Beyond implementing a structured curriculum, teachers build strong relationships with students and their families, ensuring an age-appropriate and supportive learning environment.Parents and young learners are encouraged to visit the school to experience its safe and nurturing atmosphere and to meet the dedicated and passionate teaching staff.Basic School EducationNCCS provides education across three levels: Basic Level Junior (grades 1-4), Basic Level Senior (grades 5-8), and Secondary Level (grades 9-10). At the Basic Level Junior, class teachers take responsibility for students, focusing on building a strong educational foundation. As students advance to higher grades, specialized subject teachers deliver lessons based on a well-structured educational plan.The school prioritizes practical education and ensures that students have access to essential teaching materials and modern equipment. With state-of-the-art facilities, NCCS fosters a progressive learning environment that supports academic excellence and continuous improvement. This commitment reflects the institution's dedication to providing a nurturing atmosphere for both academic and personal growth.By offering a comprehensive education across different grade levels, NCCS prepares students for future challenges, equipping them with the skills and knowledge necessary for success.Secondary StudiesNCCS is a progressive institution committed to excellence in education, personal development, and readiness for scientific advancements. By fostering a nurturing yet challenging learning environment, the school aims to equip students with the skills and values needed to become competent, compassionate, and successful individuals.At the Plus 2 level, NCCS offers programs in Management at its Paknajol and Chandol campuses, along with Science at the Chandol campus. These programs are designed to provide students with a strong academic foundation while preparing them for higher education and future career opportunities.

name: Imperial World School
description: Imperial World School is an International School in Kathmandu dedicated to providing world-class education through innovative teaching methods, modern learning facilities, and a student-centered approach. Located in Nepal, the school offers a nurturing environment where students are encouraged to develop academically, socially, and emotionally.With a strong focus on academic excellence, creativity, leadership, and global citizenship, Imperial World School prepares students for success in an increasingly interconnected world. The school's curriculum is designed to foster critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and lifelong learning while ensuring students receive a balanced education.As a trusted International School in Kathmandu, Imperial World School combines experienced educators, technology-enabled classrooms, extracurricular opportunities, and holistic development programs to help every student reach their full potential.Vision A holistic learning center to produce well-informed and responsible citizens who can represent and establish themselves globally.MissionThe mission of the school is to provide a world-class academic and social foundation for children at the appropriate stages of their development, encouraging a lifelong love of learning and academic service.By combining two of the world's best research-based curricula - the International Primary Curriculum and the International Middle Years Curriculum - with Nepal's National Curriculum, IWS offers students an international learning experience without disconnecting them from their homeland. In addition to offering an excellent learning environment, IWS's infrastructure, facilities, and well-qualified academic staff help students make the most of their school years.Core Values of Imperial World SchoolResponsibilityExcellenceIntegrityCompassionAdaptabilityRespectLearner Profile at Imperial World SchoolInnovative – Solving problems with fresh, creative ideasGlobal Citizen – Embracing diversity and worldwide awarenessBalanced – Harmonizing academics, activities, and well-beingResilient – Turning setbacks into opportunities for growthPrincipled – Acting with integrity, fairness, and strong valuesCommunicator – Expressing clearly and collaborating effectivelyGlobal Citizenship EducationIWS follows UNESCO's Global Citizenship Education framework through four key pillars:Global awareness through real-world problem solving and critical thinkingGlobally transferable social skills like: communication, empathy, and collaborationDiversity, Inclusion, Equity & Justice (DIEJ), including weekly sign language sessions with a Deaf instructorIntegration of the UN's 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) across the curriculum

name: Knowledge & Wisdom Academy
description: Knowledge and Wisdom Academy Secondary School is located at New Baneshwor, Kathmandu. The school is running excellently under the Management of K and K Educational Foundation It is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers Ten plus two (10+2) programs in Management and Humanities streams. It has been successfully imparting insightful education since 2002 A.D. and has been bringing about a distinct change in every student through the process of personal grooming with the virtues of knowledge and wise decision making.Knowledge and Wisdom Academy Secondary School embarks on individual attention and problem solving to ensure complete academic and personal development. The goal of the school is to validate personal touch for optimum enhancement.The school caters to the demand of parents and students in the higher secondary level by providing quality education and guaranteeing top class graduates. It has a mission to promote education and research to foster excellence in higher secondary level programs, to recruit the best teachers and to enhance the quality of the students experience.Knowledge and Wisdom Academy Secondary School offers advanced equipment and state of the art facilities paired with a team of highly competitive faculty members. It develops the students as global citizens with strong interpersonal skills who will interact positively with people from all cultural backgrounds and adapt to ever-changing international conditions.Through a rigorous, immersive, curriculum, Knowledge and Wisdom Academy Secondary School nurtures the students’ critical thinking skills and pique their intellectual curiosity, preparing them for personal and academic success at the school and beyond. It inspires all students to become independent thinkers and to develop their confidence by expanding minds and broadening perspectives.

name: Kakshalaya Kindergarten School
description: Kakshalaya Kindergarten School operates under the philosophy of "A Classroom Where Learning Meets Play." The school believes early childhood education should be characterized by warmth, creativity, and the freedom to explore and grow. Inspired by Montessori and Reggio Emilia approaches and combined with the Play Way method, Kakshalaya provides a nurturing, child-centered environment where learning is driven by curiosity, hands-on experiences, and play.The school understands that children up to six thrive in a cozy, home-like setting where they feel safe, loved, and free to move. Their open classrooms allow children to choose activities, interact with peers of different ages, and engage in meaningful learning experiences rather than being confined to a single space.Kakshalaya focuses on the holistic development of each child, ensuring they grow intellectually, socially, and emotionally. Their approach includes Montessori and Reggio Emilia-inspired learning, mixed-age classrooms, the Play Way method, an open and homely environment, value-based learning, practical and interactive learning, and building strong foundations for primary grades.Kakshalaya offers evening care services to support working parents. It provides a safe and nurturing environment with structured yet relaxed activities. The company also provides fresh, home-cooked meals that are nutritious and delicious, supporting children’s growth and well-being.The school's programs are structured to provide age-appropriate learning experiences, including Preschool, Nursery, Lower Kindergarten (LKG), and Upper Kindergarten (UKG).Why Choose Kakshalaya Kindergarten School?Child-Centered Learning – Focusing on individual strengths, interests, and learning styles.Experienced & Passionate Educators – A multi-generational teaching team, including educators with 20+ years of experience.Safe & Engaging Environment – A second home where children feel happy, confident, and secure.Innovative Teaching Methods – Blending structured learning with creative play.Building Strong Foundations for Primary Grades: Ensure children develop the necessary skills to transition smoothly to formal schooling.Flexible School Hours & Evening Care – Supporting working parents with extended childcare options.The school strives to create a joyful, engaging, and meaningful early learning experience, building a community where children build friendships, develop essential life skills, and create lifelong memories.

name: Valley View School
description: Valley View School is located at Mid-Baneshwor, Kathmandu, Nepal. It is an ‘A’ grade school and public incorporation run by Professional Educators Limited with the philosophy ‘Education for Personality Development’. The school places great emphasis on helping children to grow into thoughtful, responsible adults with a strong sense of right and wrong.The children at Valley View are at the center of everything that the school does and the school's aim is to give them the best opportunities that they possibly can. The school believe that parents value the outstanding care, guidance and support the children receive. School's high standards are a credit to the hard work of the children, staff and parental support.Valley View School educates every child to the best of his or her ability. Equality of opportunity is fundamental to school ethos. The school has a skilled and dedicated team who are committed to providing the best education for every child. The teaching methods used are varied and flexible, depending on the planned activity and the children's needs. There is a balance of whole class teaching, group work, and individual work. The children also have the chance to plan their own learning, to make decisions and to take responsibility. Valley View School commits to equal opportunities, to ensure that all children have equal access to the curriculum and that they develop a positive image of themselves.VisionThe school envisions itself as a distinct and progressive academic institute, with participatory learning, focused knowledge, skill, and character development, guided by inspiring faculty towards excellence with social awareness.MissionThe mission of Valley View School is to serve society with perfection, producing compassionate, self-motivated, and well-educated individuals capable of independent thinking and innovative ideas.ProgramsThe school operates the Montessori, Primary, and Secondary programs at full capacity, incorporating the international curriculum in line with the curriculum prescribed by the Curriculum Division of the Ministry of Education, Government of Nepal.Montessori KindergartenValley View School (VVS) embraces the Montessori system to nurture young learners from two-and-a-half years old, fostering independence and self-reliance in a secure and supportive environment. This educational approach, developed by Dr. Maria Montessori over a century ago, is rooted in observing children's natural learning tendencies across diverse cultures.At VVS, the Montessori program introduces beginners to their first social experiences beyond the family, helping them acquire skills to "do things by oneself." The specially designed "prepared environments" feature "Materials for development" that encourage children to engage in self-chosen learning activities. These materials are invitingly arranged on low, open shelves, offering a rich array of solid geometric forms, puzzle maps, colored beads, and various manipulative tools designed to isolate specific learning qualities.The VVS Montessori program emphasizes sensory experiences, the exploration of logical and mathematical reasoning, language coordination, and muscle development. A vibrant atmosphere of oral language is fostered through storytelling, reading aloud, and songs. The program focuses on sharpening attitudes by allowing children to work on activities of their choice at their own pace, fostering a blend of freedom and self-discipline in a calm, ordered space. This environment is specifically designed to meet children's developmental needs with a full understanding of core Montessori concepts.Central to the Montessori philosophy at VVS is the "Process of Normalization," which cultivates characteristics such as a love of order, work, spontaneous concentration, attachment to reality, and spontaneous self-discipline. Through this holistic approach, VVS aims to instill independence, initiative, and a joy for learning in every child.Primary and Secondary ProgramsAt Valley View School, Students in primary and secondary programs undertake a demanding curriculum intended to prepare them for pursuing higher studies, which uniquely combines the curriculum in line with the government of Nepal and special learning experiences. Teachers are always on the lookout to help students during and after class. The special learning experiences include a variety of activities to be pursued according to individual choices.Curricular activities at Valley View School play a key role in developing children's academic and intellectual abilities, enabling them to compete in national and international examinations for further study and career. The model of conducting academic activities to achieve the main objectives of the school includes the following features:Teaching FacultyVVS applauds the most dignified position, given the highly competent and professional faculty who work full-time to ensure they remain among the best, ranked among the few. The school's teaching force is highly effective in equipping our learning scholars with the requisite skills and knowledge, as well as the values and attitudes, to ensure their survival and success as individuals, members of the community, and citizens of our nation.Teaching ApproachThe teaching approach at Valley View is child-centered. The school provides ‘A’ grade-education based on a standard curriculum, consistent with the individual academic capabilities and personal and social needs of each student. Periodic exams, assignments, and subject-wise project works are conducted regularly to ensure required progress under the strict supervision of trained faculty. Field trips, educational excursions, and lab work that combine academic activities with real-life learning experiences and opportunities for personal growth make up a special learning experience at VVS.Evaluation and AssessmentSummative evaluation is used to decide student class promotion, and term and unit evaluations are administered as part of formative evaluation to diagnose problems. Each child’s profile is maintained and shared with parents after all the mentioned tests. Monthly tests are administered and reported to guardians, including details of performance and academic advice needed for their wards. Question papers are designed in both subjective and objective sets. Creative works and presentations are endorsed as supplementary aspects of evaluation.DisciplineStudents are expected to maintain the school code of conduct. Violation of school rules may result in disciplinary action. The “Behavior Referral Form” is to be signed by parents or guardians and returned to the school. The purpose of disciplinary action is to reform a student's character and help them become a civic member with a positive attitude.Counseling ProgramCounselors and experienced teachers meet individually with students facing emotional problems to help them identify their problems and work towards finding solutions.School/Home CommunicationThe most effective form of communication is the parent-teacher meeting. Such meetings are regularly held on various occasions during the academic year.
