In addition, parents can contact the school at least a day in advance and arrange a special meeting with the faculty, coordinators, vice principal, or principal to discuss exam results, students’ progress in studies, and other general concerns.

name: Shivapuri Secondary School
description: Shivapuri Secondary School, located in Maharajgunj-2, Kathmandu, began its educational journey in 2005 B.S. Operating under the guiding principle of “Education for all, Education for life,” the institution focuses on a student-centered approach to teaching. Lessons are delivered through well-planned instructional activities, practical work, and project-based assignments to ensure that students understand core concepts effectively.The school prioritizes technology and digital literacy, serving as an ICT hub among community schools. Every classroom is equipped with smart boards to facilitate visual learning, and all teachers are provided with laptops to integrate information technology into their lessons. For students interested in technical fields, a Computer Engineering program is available from Grade 9 to 12, while foundational computer studies begin in Grade 4. A dedicated school app is also utilized to share information and support the learning process.Facilities at the school include specialized laboratories for Science, Mathematics, and ICT, as well as Electronics, Digital, and STEAM labs. A Maintenance Lab provides hands-on experience for technical students. Other resources include a well-stocked library, an assembly hall for programs, and a dedicated playing station for Early Childhood Development (ECD) students. To ensure student welfare, the school maintains a health room staffed by a nurse and has installed CCTV throughout the premises for safety.The academic system includes monthly unit examinations and trimester evaluations to monitor student progress. Beyond regular academics, the "Book Free Friday" initiative allows students to engage in creative and skill-based activities.

name: ASIA PACIFIC SCHOOL
description: Asia Pacific School (APS) provides an inspiring, inclusive, and challenging learning environment while celebrating academic excellence. The school encourages and supports its students to become successful, global-minded, and enthusiastic lifelong learners who confidently take advantage of future opportunities and strive to make a difference.In collaboration with teachers, staff, and parents, APS supports students in fully developing their potential within a motivating, multilingual, and international learning environment. The institution fosters a learning culture in which all learners are fully engaged in holistic, meaningful, and innovative experiences within a caring, collaborative community, bolstered by active partnerships with families.The school’s emphasis is on providing value-based education in an intellectually stimulating environment, imparted by professionals trained in progressive teaching-learning approaches. APS helps transform young learners into knowledgeable, confident, responsible, and proactive individuals with international-mindedness and a passion for continuous growth.Ultimately, the school aims to prepare individuals to face the challenges of a complex and interconnected global community, rooted in the belief that learning is essential for developing life skills. Its future-focused, integrated approach emphasizes a wide range of content-specific knowledge, drawing on Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics (STEAM) as access points for guiding student inquiry, dialogue, and critical thinking. This project-based methodology allows students to gain a broader knowledge base across STEAM subjects through a transdisciplinary approach.Asia Pacific School (APS) provides a comprehensive educational framework from Grade I to XII based on the National Curriculum of Nepal. To ensure effective pedagogical delivery and student monitoring, the institution’s academic programs are divided into five specialized wings:Pre-school: Play Group to Senior KindergartenBasic School (Elementary): Grade 1 to 5Basic School (Upper Elementary): Grade 6 to 8High School: Grade 9 to 10High School: Grade 11 to 12Each wing is managed by a competent academic administrator under the supervision of the Vice Principal, Academic Head, and Principal.Pre-school (Kindergarten)The Kindergarten program follows a Montessori and Creative Problem Solving (CPS) based system. The curriculum is designed to help children develop social, linguistic, and interactive skills through natural learning and structured, hands-on activities. The mission of this wing is to nurture each child's potential in a supportive environment, ensuring they are well-prepared for the transition to elementary education.Elementary and Upper Elementary SchoolIn alignment with the Education Act of Nepal, basic education spans from Grade I to VIII. APS bifurcates this level into the Elementary wing (Grades I–V) and the Upper Elementary wing (Grades VI–VIII) to provide developmentally appropriate instruction.The Elementary program follows the National Curriculum, enriched by international standards. Teaching methods include collaborative group work, individual tasks, and whole-class discussions. While core subjects include English, Nepali, and Mathematics, a thematic approach integrates Science, Social Studies, Computer Studies, Physical Education, and the Arts. In the Upper Elementary level, the curriculum expands to include Occupation, Business, and Technological Education (OBTE), Moral Studies, and Health and Hygiene.Key Highlights of the Elementary Program:Daily practice of language and mathematical skills.A thematic approach to Social Studies and Science.Collaborative and team-teaching models.Integration of international learning perspectives.Community service initiatives starting from Grade III.Secondary SchoolThe Secondary School encompasses Grades 9-12. Students prepare for the Secondary Education Examination (SEE) at the end of Grade 10, as conducted by the National Examination Board. In Grades 9 and 10, the school offers the government-stipulated curriculum alongside two optional subjects. Additionally, APS provides foreign language electives in Spanish, French, and Mandarin.VisionThe vision of Asia Pacific School is to prepare dynamic, caring, world-class citizens of tomorrow to meet the challenges of global society while retaining their good traditional values via a vibrant teaching and learning environment.MissionTo be a centre of excellence in education with a rich heritage of Nepal, will stress the simultaneous development of body, mind, and spirit, and will endeavour to cultivate compassionate, responsible, and innovative global citizens committed to the development of Nepal and the world.ValuesThe Asia Pacific School respects the dignity and merit of each child in its care, believing that all children can be nurtured to achieve their full potential within a school environment that is both caring and challenging. Students are expected to be respectful and responsible, rising to meet the various challenges of life. To support this growth, the school upholds the following core values:AccountabilityThe school encourages learners to take responsibility for their own intellectual, social, personal, and emotional development, as well as their overall physical well-being.SincerityHonesty and kindness are prioritized within the school community. Members express gratitude for their opportunities and strive to support those who are less fortunate or facing difficult circumstances.IntegrityThe institution believes in the importance of hard work grounded in morality, determination, and commitment. It aims to ensure that learners develop positive attitudes and make informed choices regarding their personal and social responsibilities.AdmirationRespect is extended toward the community, the environment, and the self. The school values individual differences and promotes acceptance without prejudice. Learners are encouraged to take pride in their school and community while understanding, appreciating, and respecting diversity and the significance of various cultures, traditions, and perspectives.The school embraces change to adapt to an ever-evolving environment. It believes in the power of inquiry driven by curiosity, which serves as a foundation for lifelong learning. By fostering these traits, the institution prepares learners to become effective problem-solvers who are deeply engaged with the world around them. Throughout this journey, learners are consistently supported and challenged to reach their full potential.

name: REHDON College & School
description: REHDON College and School, located in Samakhushi, Kathmandu, is a highly acclaimed institution for secondary level education as one of the best colleges in Kathmandu for Science, Management, and Humanities education. With a clear vision that education plays a pivotal role in shaping individuals, communities, and the nation, REHDON has continually set new standards in academic excellence and holistic development.REHDON College embraces a supportive, inclusive, and collaborative learning environment, empowering students to excel academically while nurturing their critical thinking, leadership, and social responsibility. The institution has consistently been recognized and awarded for its outstanding contributions to education over the past two decades, making it a top choice for students pursuing quality +2 and BBS programs in Nepal.REHDON features a team of highly qualified, experienced, and dedicated teaching faculty who are committed to delivering innovative, student-centric instruction. The college is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including modern classrooms, well-equipped science laboratories, a resource-rich library, and advanced computer labs. These facilities are designed to enhance academic performance and support experiential learning.To ensure overall student well-being, REHDON offers welfare and counseling services that guide students in both academic and personal matters. Regular meetings and interactive sessions with parents and guardians are held to monitor and review student progress, building a strong partnership in the educational journey.REHDON emphasizes co-curricular and extracurricular engagement, offering students access to a range of activities that promote creativity, teamwork, and leadership. The college also provides convenient facilities such as a hygienic cafeteria, comfortable accommodation, and reliable transportation, ensuring a safe and conducive environment for learning and personal growth.VISION REHDON as an organization will strive to become a nationally and internationally known institution of learning that will be a leader in bringing about quality in the life of our people through quality education.MISSION The mission of REHDON is to provide innovative educational environments and hand on experiences that enable individuals to meet the challenges of this century and prosper in our increasingly divers and ever changing global complex society.

name: Nava Jyoti SS/College
description: Nava Jyoti Secondary School/College was established in 2038 B.S. (1981 A.D.) and is located at Basukimarg, Koteshwor-32, Kathmandu. For over four decades, the institution has provided education from Play Group (PG) to Grade 12. For students in Grades 11 and 12, the school offers Science and Management streams in affiliation with the National Examinations Board (NEB). The school operates with the guiding philosophy that "Education is not an object but an objective," focusing on purposeful learning and student development.The school is recognized for its consistent academic performance in both SEE and NEB examinations, with many students achieving high grades. The management and faculty prioritize a result-oriented approach, focusing on clearing subject concepts rather than encouraging rote learning.This method is designed to help students build a strong foundation of knowledge and develop their individual potential. Well-trained and experienced teachers work to create a disciplined yet supportive atmosphere where students are encouraged to be creative and productive.VisionTo become a front runner in developing the learning ability of the next generation, fostering individual excellence and participation of our students in the full range of academic, social and physical activities, making them sociable all-rounders.MissionTo foster quality education and academic approaches by the esteemed academicians and trainers.To architect morally sound citizen,dynamic and skilled manpower to cope up with the global competence.To create inclusive and equitable environment for the proportional access of the nationwide students.To make an academical platform with reliability, recommendation and trust among the civil societies.ObjectivesThe school upholds integrity, excellence, respect, and innovation as our core values. These principles guide our commitment to providing quality education, fostering character development, and creating an inclusive learning environment where every student can thrive and reach their full potential.

name: Liverpool Secondary School
description: Liverpool Secondary School was established to address the dearth of an educational institution capable of offering quality education to deserving students in the country. Hence, the Liverpool International Education Network emphasizes the use of technology in higher education as an important teaching tool and promotes a friendly teaching environment. By exposing students to experts in different fields. Liverpool International Education Network claims to be preparing job creators rather than job seekers.Liverpool Secondary School is the first institute to introduce the concept of Maths Laboratory. LEN has a separate information center with up-to-date records of each student. This information is available on the web with high-security options and accessible only to the respective parents. The college has also adapted individual smart card systems to record attendance and enable students to use the library. Along with a well-stocked library, e-library facilities, and internet access. It has laboratories equipped with multi-media projectors.The Liverpool International Education faculty comprises highly qualified and experienced personnel with proven educational backgrounds from renowned colleges and universities. Liverpool International Education Network claims that its faculty keeps abreast of modern pedagogies and delivers lectures using multimedia and visual aids, as well as whiteboards in classrooms.School MottoThe school is guided by the motto of providing holistic education that nurtures students academically, socially, and personally. At the same time, Liverpool Secondary School believes in offering realistic and affordable fees, ensuring that quality education remains accessible to deserving students from all backgrounds.VISIONDeliver unparalleled education in Nepal by integrating cutting-edge technology with affordable tuition fees, empowering individuals to maximize their potential to the fullest extent.MISSIONThe mission of Liverpool Secondary School is to connect students with top mentors globally, ensuring hands-on learning that fosters real-world application and a growth mindset for global success.

name: Aksharaa School
description: Established in 2011, Aksharaa School is a co-educational day school that offers classes from Kindergarten through Grade 10. The school is situated on 23 ropanis of land and operates from three earthquake-resistant academic and administrative blocks. Its advanced infrastructure includes modern classrooms and facilities designed to provide a safe, technology-enabled learning environment that meets international standards.Aksharaa School is recognized for its innovative teaching methodologies in technology-enhanced classrooms. The child-friendly facilities create a supportive learning atmosphere that encourages students to engage deeply during their study hours. The school is dedicated to fostering a physically, mentally, and intellectually stimulating environment that promotes the holistic development of young children.Aksharaa School delivers an enriching educational experience through a combination of modern facilities and innovative teaching methods. The expansive campus features large buildings and full-sized playgrounds, offering a holistic learning environment that extends beyond traditional classrooms.The school is committed to integrating technology into its curriculum. Classrooms are equipped with computers, laptops, projectors, and other advanced tools to support interactive, project-based learning. These resources enable students to conduct research, create multimedia presentations, and collaborate effectively on group projects.Aksharaa School promotes critical thinking and problem-solving skills through hands-on experiences. Students participate in various enriching activities, including educational field trips, guest lectures, and international tours. These experiences are designed to broaden their perspectives and help them apply classroom knowledge to real-world situations.The school's approach to education combines intellectual mentoring with practical application. Students are encouraged to explore, discuss, and apply their knowledge through role plays, group work, and virtual learning. This integration of theory and practice enhances their understanding and equips them with the confidence and adaptability to meet future challenges.Aksharaa School is committed to nurturing well-rounded individuals who are prepared to make meaningful contributions to society. The focus on holistic development ensures that students graduate not only with academic excellence but also with the skills and experiences necessary to succeed in an ever-evolving world.Learning Approach at Aksharaa SchoolAksharaa School embraces a student-centered and constructivist philosophy that promotes autonomous learning. This approach emphasizes awareness, autonomy, and authenticity for every student. The school caters to diverse intelligences and supports holistic growth through a balanced education system.The school utilizes a Learning-Reinforcement-Practice-Application (LRPA) module. This method enhances cognitive abilities by combining fun and curiosity with structured learning. It encourages students to develop critical thinking, collaboration, creativity, and problem-solving skills, preparing them to become responsible global citizens.Aksharaa School values respect and diversity. It integrates traditional values with modern technology to create a well-rounded learning experience. By celebrating national festivals and organizing educational trips, the school instills a sense of patriotism and global awareness in its students. The goal is to nurture well-rounded, globally competent citizens who are ready to contribute meaningfully to society.Why Choose Aksharaa School?Modern Infrastructure: Earthquake-resistant buildings and state-of-the-art facilities ensure a safe, advanced learning environment.Technologically Advanced Classrooms: Integration of Information Communication Technology (ICT) and Learning Management Systems (LMS) to enhance learning.Holistic Development: Focus on physical, mental, and intellectual growth through our innovative Learning-by-Practice Reinforcement Approach (LPRA).Experienced Faculty: Dedicated and skilled educators committed to nurturing each child's potential.Inclusive Learning Environment: Child-friendly facilities that support a well-rounded education.Through a Learning-Reinforcement-Practice-Application (LRPA) approach that incorporates creative teaching techniques, ongoing reinforcement, practical experience, and real-world application, Aksharaa strives to achieve integrated child development. Our institutional setup, combined with modern technologies, ensures a comprehensive educational experience that supports and enhances student learning.

name: Kathmandu Vidya Kunja Secondary School
description: Kathmandu Vidya Kunja Secondary School was established in the year 2065 B.S. by a team of academic experts with the sole aim of providing quality education by shaping and sharpening the holistic personality in all the spheres of life, such as physical, mental, social, psychological, emotional, and moral development, which ultimately enables our children to overcome future global challenges.The school is located in a convenient site, just 1.5 km north of Samakhusi Chowk, on the way to Tokha. It provides conducive, resource-rich instructional tools to help students develop their talents and personalities to a high level.With the motto of shaping and sharpening the personality, the school focuses on the overall growth of each child, including their academic and behavioral aspects. The goal of Kathmandu Vidya Kunja Secondary School is to provide a safe and intellectually challenging environment that will empower students to become innovative thinkers, creative problem solvers, and inspired learners prepared to thrive in the twenty-first century. VisionKathmandu Vidya Kunja Secondary School aims to establish an inspiring and stimulating learning environment where students can grow holistically and become 21st-century global citizens with a strong sense of values.MissionKathmandu Vidya Kunja Secondary School recognizes that each child possesses unique strengths and creativity. The school is dedicated to fostering a safe, orderly, and nurturing environment that ensures its success.With this in mind, the school focuses on building a positive school culture that empowers the multifaceted development of everyone in the school community. This is achieved by providing necessary support and opportunities for all to grow together.The school shapes young individuals to become successful members of society with a well-founded sense of responsibility, equity, and community. Students also develop strong personal, social, moral, and national values.Core ValuesRespectEmbracing diversity and treating everyone with dignity, empathy, and consideration, creating an inclusive and harmonious environment for learning and collaboration.DutyInstilling a sense of accountability and environmental consciousness among our students and staff, promoting a commitment to social responsibility and sustainability.CollaborationFostering a collaborative and supportive community where teamwork, open communication, and shared goals contribute to the collective success of our students and the school as a whole.IntegrityUpholding honesty, transparency, and ethical behavior in all our interactions, fostering trust and credibility within our educational community.InnovationEncouraging a culture of creativity and adaptability, where new ideas and approaches are welcomed, driving continuous improvement and a forward-thinking mindset.

name: Godawari Residential School
description: Established in 2072 B.S., Godawari Residential School is located in the peaceful area of Godawari, Lalitpur. The school offers education from Grade 1 to Grade 12, providing a complete academic pathway in a calm and supportive learning environment.At the foundational level, the school follows the International Primary Curriculum (IPC) under the International Curriculum Association, helping students develop inquiry-based learning habits from an early stage. At the +2 level, the school offers Computer Science and Hotel Management, giving students options that combine academic knowledge with practical skills relevant to future careers.Alongside academics, Godawari Residential School is known for its residential facility, GRS Residence, which is designed as a “home away from home.” The residence provides a safe, structured, and caring environment where students can grow beyond the classroom. It focuses not only on academic support but also on each student's mental, emotional, and social development.Students living in the residence learn important life skills such as independence, responsibility, and decision-making. A disciplined daily routine helps them develop time management and a strong work ethic. The close bond between students and teachers, along with a sense of brotherhood among students, creates a supportive community that contributes to both personal and academic growth. The diverse residential environment also encourages cultural exchange, allowing students from different parts of the country to learn from one another.The residential facilities include spacious and well-designed dormitories with essential amenities. Students are under the care of dedicated hostel wardens and caretakers and are provided with balanced, nutritious meals. Regular activities such as games, sports, swimming, and hiking keep students actively engaged. Study hours and additional academic support are also part of the residential routine, along with access to school computer and internet facilities.To ensure discipline and a smooth residential life, the residence follows structured guidelines. Parents are required to submit written leave requests in advance for any social events or home visits. Students are encouraged to avoid unnecessary social functions, especially during examination periods. Upon return from long illness, a fitness certificate from a doctor is required. Students must return to residence on time after vacations or home visits.Communication with students is allowed during designated hours and only through approved channels. Parents are requested to limit calls to essential matters, and the use of digital messaging platforms is not encouraged for regular communication. In case of emergency, contact should be made through the school office.Parents may visit students on Saturdays between 1 PM and 5 PM in the reception area with prior information to the residence in charge, except during examination days. Visitors must carry valid identification, and unauthorized entry is not permitted.Students are responsible for the safety of their personal belongings. Any damage to school property or maintenance issues must be reported promptly. Maintaining cleanliness and respect for shared spaces is expected at all times.Parents are advised not to send cash, expensive gifts, or outside food items to students. Night-outs are not permitted unless parents themselves are present and the student stays with them. Any items for students must be delivered directly to the residence or authorized person only.The residential program follows a structured schedule in which students stay at the residence during the week and return home periodically, helping to maintain a balance between school life and family connections. New residential students undergo an orientation to become familiar with school rules, facilities, and daily routines before beginning their stay.With its combination of academics, residential life, and a supportive environment, Godawari Residential School aims to provide students with a well-rounded educational experience that prepares them for higher studies and future responsibilities.Vision Godawari Residential School aims to be a premier residential institution that imparts world-class education capable of meeting the challenges posed by the increased pace of scientific, economic, and social advancement in the 21st century. The school celebrates a culture of excellence and values.Mission The members of Godawari Residential School, inspired by the concept of a happy school and guided by its motto "Raising the Next Generation," aspire to impart world-class education and encourage students to harness their talents. Students are guided to restructure their future to become self-confident, self-disciplined, and self-reliant through service to the nation in a safe, secure, and friendly environment. While mentoring students, the school focuses on three philosophies: time management, positive discipline, and hard work. The aspiration to impart education for sustainable development is realized by inculcating value education in students, equipping them with the necessary knowledge, skills, and understanding.

name: Kathmandu Shikshalaya Lalitpur
description: Kathmandu Shikshalaya Lalitpur is located in Imadol, Mahalaxmi-4, Lalitpur. The school is a caring and nurturing institution committed to the holistic development of young children. With the guidance of passionate and experienced teachers, every child is supported in growing socially, emotionally, and intellectually at their own pace.The school runs programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Secondary Level. Primary, Lower Secondary, and Secondary levels are available to provide continuous education for growing children. ECAs (Extracurricular Activities) and CCAs (Co-Curricular Activities) are important parts of school life, alongside digital learning and technology integration, to prepare students for the modern world.The school places strong emphasis on moral, social, cultural, and behavioral values. Students are taught to be honest, respectful, and responsible towards themselves and others. These values help shape them into good human beings and responsible members of society.The school offers play-based learning that makes education fun and natural for young children. Child-focused teaching ensures that lessons are designed around the needs and interests of each student. Creative and social development activities help children express themselves and build healthy relationships with peers. A supportive classroom environment encourages students to ask questions, explore new ideas, and learn with confidence.VisionEmpowering every student to reach their full potential and become lifelong learners, fostering a culture of excellence, innovation, and compassion where every student thrives academically, socially, and emotionally.What Kathmandu Shikshalaya OffersPlay-Based LearningChild-Focused TeachingCreative & Social DevelopmentSupportive Classroom EnvironmentSchool ValuesMoral ValuesSocial ValuesCultural ValuesBehavioral ValuesUniversal ValuesDigital Values

name: URBANA SCHOOL
description: Urbana School operates at two locations: Kandaghari in Kathmandu and Lokanthali in Bhaktapur. It was founded by a team of academic professionals who are dedicated to upholding educational culture and tradition. This team brings significant expertise, commitment, and experience from both Nepal and abroad.Urbana has established itself as a recognized name in pre-school education within its operating areas. This success is attributed to visionary leadership, a qualified and hardworking team of teaching and non-teaching staff, and the strong cooperation, positive attitude, and support from its esteemed parents.The school has upgraded its Kandaghari branch to provide high-quality primary education to its students. This marks the beginning of its long-term commitment to delivering quality education, both within and outside Kathmandu.School Time: Preschool- 9 am to 2:30 pmPrimary- 9 am to 3:30 pm A Holistic Learning EnvironmentThe school’s infrastructure is thoughtfully designed to facilitate both academic and personal growth. With spacious premises and child-friendly classrooms, the physical environment encourages curiosity, movement, and a love for learning. The institution is powered by a team of highly qualified teaching faculties who bring both expertise and passion to the classroom, ensuring that every child receives personalized attention.Comprehensive Student Support & FacilitiesKathmandu Urbana School goes beyond the standard curriculum by offering a wide array of features designed for the modern student and busy parents:Holistic Development: The school provides ample opportunities for Extra-Curricular Activities (ECA) and Co-Curricular Activities (CCA), ensuring students develop physical, social, and creative skills alongside their studies.Safety and Nutrition: A safe and reliable transportation system ensures a secure commute for all students, while the school’s commitment to serving hygienic food promotes healthy growth and well-being.Parental Support: Understanding the needs of working families, the school offers an "Extra Time Facility" that provides a supervised, productive space for students beyond regular school hours.Vision:Urbana School's vision is to look to the future and establish an institution where creative energy flows continuously, contributing to Nepal's glory.Mission:Its mission is to provide child-centered quality education, in partnership with the community, to support the mental, physical, spiritual, and overall development of children as part of the nation's progress.ValuesInculcating a strong sense of responsibility in growing children toward the family, society, and the nation.Promote human qualities, such as compassion, through practical education.Build a sense of respect for elders, historical figures, and cultures.Develop qualities such as integrity through value-based education.Offer experiences both inside and outside the classroom that equip the valued personality to compete in the globalizing work culture.

name: Gautam High School
description: Founded in 1976 A.D, in Lagantole, Kathmandu, Gautam High School has served as a cornerstone of education and community development for nearly five decades. The school is committed to providing quality education that is both accessible and affordable for local families.It was established by Shanti Maya Shrestha, a visionary educator and Nepali immigrant who returned from Burma. She began her career as a pre-school teacher at EPS. Coming from humble beginnings, Shanti Maya understood the transformative power of education and the challenges many families face in accessing it. This understanding inspired her to create a school where children from ordinary families could receive the same high-quality education as anyone else.Through her dedication, compassion, and tireless efforts, she built more than just an institution—she created a community of learning, opportunity, and hope. At Gautam High School, education goes beyond textbooks and classrooms. The school believes in nurturing students academically and personally, helping them develop confidence, discipline, creativity, and the practical skills needed for success in life.Serving students from early childhood through Grade 10, Gautam High School has proudly educated generations of children from Lagantole and surrounding communities, with programs focused on holistic development to ensure that students grow intellectually, socially, and emotionally.Guided by a strong commitment to community upliftment and rooted in solid values, Gautam High School continues to evolve while remaining true to its founding principle: quality education should be available to everyone, not just a privileged few. Today, Shanti Maya Shrestha's legacy lives on through the students, teachers, and families associated with the school. The institution remains focused on her original vision: to uplift society by empowering children through education, creating an environment where every child has the opportunity to learn, grow, and build a stable future.Mission StatementAt Gautam High School, the mission is to nurture children not just as students, but as responsible individuals. While the school provides a strong academic foundation aligned with national standards, it believes that education goes beyond textbooks, grades, and examinations. Inspired by the vision of founder Shanti Maya Shrestha, Gautam High School aims to create an environment where every child has the opportunity to grow, explore, and discover their potential, regardless of whether they are straight-A students or not.The goal is to guide children toward becoming kind sons and daughters, thoughtful friends, and meaningful contributors to their communities. By focusing on education, character development, creativity, and real-life learning, the school helps students build the values, confidence, and resilience they need to lead fulfilling lives. At Gautam High School, it is believed that true education shapes both the mind and the heart.Vision StatementThe vision of Gautam High School is to create a school community where children develop into compassionate, capable, and responsible individuals, prepared for both academic success and life itself. The school strives to be a place where every child feels valued, supported, and empowered; where curiosity is encouraged, talents are discovered, and personal growth is prioritized alongside academic achievement. By honoring the founder's legacy and upholding the values passed down through generations, Gautam High School aims to foster a learning environment that teaches students that education is only one aspect of becoming fully human. Through a commitment to balance, opportunity, and guidance, the school aspires to nurture young people who will lead with integrity, uplift their communities, and embody compassion and responsibility throughout their lives.

name: Sampada School
description: Sampada School located in Chobhar, Kirtipur-6, Lalitpur is committed to fostering a dynamic learning environment that facilitates comprehensive student development. Recognizing the innate curiosity of modern students, the school emphasizes inquiry-based learning, hands-on experiences, and observation. Through this contemporary approach, students are empowered to explore, discover, and comprehend the foundations of scientific knowledge. The school's ethos prioritizes support and motivation over imposition, ensuring that teachers are readily available to address student inquiries and facilitate understanding. Sampada School aims to cultivate joy in creative expression and knowledge acquisition, encouraging students to draw inspiration from the natural world.In addition to academic pursuits, Sampada School endeavors to impart a deep appreciation for India's rich heritage of tradition and culture. By instilling a sense of pride and respect for the nation's cultural treasures, the school aims to foster a patriotic atmosphere. Through collaboration among students, parents, and teachers, Sampada School creates a supportive community dedicated to student success. This collaborative approach, combined with a blend of Eastern values and Western scientific knowledge, forms the foundation of Sampada School's holistic educational philosophy. The school has two locations, and they are as follows:Sampada School, Senior CampusSampada SchoolMissionSampada School's mission is to provide excellent education through participation, observation, assistance and create a learning environment where staff, students and parents work together to shape a confident, compassionate and cultured individual.VisionSampada School's vision is to raise and support, sensible and reasonable young individuals who are empathetic, expressive, emotionally intelligent and exceptional.

name: Sahara Rastriya Vidhyalaya
description: Sahara Rastriya Vidhyalaya (SRV) is located in Madhyapur Thimi–1, Lokanthali. Established in 2075 B.S., the school offers quality education from Playgroup (PG) to Grade 8, along with food and transportation facilities.At SRV, the focus is on nurturing confident, caring, and reflective learners through positive relationships and a supportive environment. Each day begins with a mindful moment to help students and teachers connect emotionally and mentally.The school provides a broad, balanced, and theme-based curriculum that integrates national and international standards with co-curricular activities. Well-equipped classrooms promote interactive, participatory, and experiential learning, ensuring holistic development.SRV strives to create a happy, inclusive, and respectful learning community, preparing students to become responsible global citizens with strong moral values and a lifelong love for learning.Mission StatementTo provide a welcoming, exciting, and caring environment where all students can be happy, confident, and motivated.To encourage our students to take pride in themselves, their school, and their Nation.To help our students develop Critical thinking, creativity, collaboration, communication, leadership, technology and media literacy, initiative, and social skills. These skills are intended to help students keep up with the lightning pace of today’s modern world. Each skill is unique in how it helps students, but they all have one quality in common: they encourage a positive attitude and help students develop into competent, good citizens.Vision StatementSahara Rastriya Vidhyalaya was established to meet the highly complex and competitive needs of the 21st century. Our programs, both academic and co-curricular, have been designed to address these needs.

name: Shristi Academy
description: Shristi Academy is an educational institution located in Mid-Baneshwor, Kathmandu. Established in 2016, the school offers academic programs ranging from Playgroup to Grade 10. It focuses on creating a nurturing and inclusive learning environment, where students can develop both academically and socially.The academy’s educational philosophy is centered on a child-focused approach that emphasizes intellectual, emotional, and social growth. By employing interactive and evidence-based teaching methods, the school delivers a well-rounded curriculum. Core subjects such as English, Nepali, Mathematics, and Science are supplemented with Computer Studies, Music, and Art to ensure a balanced educational experience. The school aims to foster integrity and compassion while encouraging a lifelong love of learning.In addition to classroom instruction, Shristi Academy places a strong emphasis on student well-being. The school provides nutritious meals and snacks and incorporates professionally led physical activities into its regular programming. Various events and programs are organized throughout the year, allowing students to participate in co-curricular activities and showcase their talents. Through these initiatives, Shristi Academy maintains a supportive atmosphere that helps students become confident and capable individuals. Shristi Academy is an educational institution located in Mid-Baneshwor, Kathmandu. Established in 2016 A.D., the school provides academic programs from the Playgroup level through to Grade 10. The institution focuses on creating a nurturing and inclusive learning environment where students can develop both academically and socially.The academy’s academic philosophy is rooted in a child-centered approach that emphasizes intellectual, emotional, and social growth. By utilizing interactive and evidence-based teaching methods, the school delivers a comprehensive curriculum. Core subjects such as English, Nepali, Mathematics, and Science are integrated with Computer Studies, Music, and Art to ensure a balanced educational experience. The school aims to foster integrity and compassion while encouraging a lifelong interest in learning.Beyond classroom instruction, Shristi Academy places a strong emphasis on student well-being. The school provides nutritious meals and snacks and incorporates professional-led physical activities into its regular programming. Furthermore, the school organizes various events and programs throughout the year, allowing students to participate in co-curricular activities and showcase their talents. Through these initiatives, Shristi Academy maintains a supportive atmosphere that helps students become confident and capable individuals.VisionShristi Academy’s purpose is to provide a safe, loving, and learning environment where all children thrive, are valued, respected, and nurtured. The academy strives to grow its students into sound, grounded, and empathetic individuals who give back to the community and carry on the torch of: learn and serve.

name: Malpi International School
description: Established in June 1999, Malpi International School is a co-educational residential institution located in the Malpi area of Panauti, Nepal. It was founded by a group of 50 multi-ethnic, like-minded visionaries from Nepal, all committed to improving the quality of school education to prepare children for the demands of the 21st century.Throughout its journey, Malpi International School has built a strong foundation for delivering high-quality education. The school has consistently set and achieved new goals and dreams, perpetually striving for excellence. From its inception, Malpi International School has been guided by core values that serve as the pillars of inquiry, endeavor, and excellence for its students.Vision and Mission StatementMalpi International School, with its well-rounded academic program, aims to dispel the darkness caused by ignorance and disseminate knowledge and information, the basis of true power, and thus help to lead its students into the light.Malpi International School is a co-ed residential school with a difference. To ensure child-centered learning, the School limits the number of students in a class to a minimum. Learning is a pleasure at Malpi International School, with a teacher-to-pupil ratio of less than 1:12 and progressive, liberal teaching methodologies.Malpi International School endeavors to:Elevate Education to New HeightsAt Malpi International School, it delivers the highest standard of formal education through a broad and balanced curriculum, ensuring that students not only meet but exceed academic expectations.Inspire a Love for LearningThe school cultivates a genuine passion for learning, making both work and play enjoyable, enriching experiences that students find fulfilling and rewarding.Nurture Excellence in Every EndeavorIts school environment encourages students to excel in every pursuit—be it academics, arts, sports, or leadership—fostering a culture of achievement and personal growth.Build a Safe and Happy Residential CommunityMalpi provides a secure, disciplined, and happy residential setting where students build strong friendships, enjoy a sense of belonging, and find personal fulfillment.Promote Healthy Co-Educational InteractionAs a co-educational institution, it instills in students a healthy, respectful attitude toward the opposite sex, preparing them for meaningful relationships in the wider world.Celebrate Diversity and IndividualityThe school prides itself on fostering a tolerant, multi-ethnic, and multinational community where individuality and differences are celebrated, creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for all.Instill Strong Moral ValuesIts students are guided by a strong moral compass, learning to distinguish right from wrong and developing a deep sense of integrity that shapes their character.Prepare for the Challenges of TomorrowThe school equips its students with the qualities of flexibility, adaptability, and resilience, ensuring they are well-prepared for the ever-changing demands of the modern world.Foster Patriotism and ServiceMalpi nurtures a profound love and loyalty for Nepal, inspiring students to give back to their country and contribute meaningfully to society with the knowledge and values they’ve gained at school.What sets Malpi International School apartA Balanced Approach to EducationMalpi International School combines academic excellence with personal growth, equipping students with the skills and values needed for success in the modern world.Co-Educational Residential EnvironmentAs a co-ed residential school, Malpi fosters independence, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, helping students thrive both academically and socially in a close-knit community.Emphasis on Core ValuesBuilt on pillars of integrity, respect, and perseverance, Malpi instills values that guide students toward becoming responsible, empathetic, and principled individuals.Controlled Use of TechnologyRecognizing the importance of balance, the school carefully limits and manages students' use of electronic gadgets, encouraging focus on learning, creativity, and personal interaction.Experiential and Diverse LearningMalpi’s diverse community and hands-on learning approach promote critical thinking, creativity, and global citizenship, preparing students for leadership name: KinderPillar Pre School
description: Located in Bakhundole, Sanepa Height, Lalitpur, Kinderpillar Pre School provides an early childhood education program based on an American-format curriculum. The institution emphasizes brain-based learning techniques that nurture young minds in a caring, supportive environment. With a focus on school readiness, the school uses established methods to help children realize their potential and prepare for their transition to primary education.The curriculum at Kinderpillar Pre School includes a diverse range of academic and creative activities. Students engage in foundational subjects such as English Basic, General Science, and Digital Mathematics. To ensure a well-rounded development, the school also integrates Practical Classes, Arts & Drawing, and Yoga into its weekly routine. Physical development is further supported through regular physical exercises and organized sports activities.In addition to its academic offerings, the school provides a range of facilities and extracurricular programs to enhance the student experience. These include outdoor games, social events, and parties, alongside a focus on health through the provision of nutritious foods. Kinderpillar Pre School has been operating for over three years, maintaining a consistent focus on student progress. The school remains open from Sunday to Friday, between 09:00 am and 05:00 pm.MissionKinderpillar PreSchool is a trusted early childhood education provider whose mission is to support the emotional, social, physical, and intellectual development of infants, toddlers, and preschoolers around the world, to help them reach their full learning potential in a safe, world-class, nurturing environment.VisionTo be a global leader in the provision of early childhood education by designing, developing, and implementing the best curriculum and teaching practices while using state-of-the-art learning aids. To use the strengths of our awarded brand, systems, and people, to achieve significant positive outcomes for children and maintain a caring approach to their families while increasing stakeholder value.Toddler ProgramThe Toddler Program at Kinderpillar Preschool focuses on a child’s natural desire to explore and discover new things. Caring teachers guide children through a variety of activities that help develop their thinking, language, and social skills. The goal is to help toddlers become independent and confident as they take their first steps into a learning environment. These lessons are designed to be fun and are planned to meet the specific needs of every young learner.Play GroupThe Play Group at Kinderpillar Preschool provides a warm and encouraging space where young children begin their journey of growth. Through hands-on activities and guided play, the school encourages children to be curious and creative. Teachers support each child in learning to communicate more effectively, move their bodies with coordination, and bond with their peers. This stage focuses on making sure children enjoy their time at school while building a strong foundation for their future. Nursery ProgramThe Nursery program at Kinderpillar Preschool is designed to create a steady foundation for a child's education. It uses a mix of planned activities and free play to help children improve their speaking, thinking, and physical skills. Teachers at Kinderpillar Preschool focus on helping children learn through exploration and hands-on experiences. By balancing basic lessons with fun activities, the program helps children develop a love for learning and prepares them for the next level of their education.Junior KG (Jr. KG)In Junior KG, Kinderpillar Preschool shifts the focus to building specific skills such as early reading, writing, and basic math. The curriculum is designed to help children think for themselves and learn to solve small challenges independently. Teachers use interactive methods to ensure lessons in logic and social skills remain engaging. By using teaching methods that match how different children learn, Kinderpillar Preschool ensures that every student gets the right guidance to grow.Senior KG (Sr. KG)The Senior KG program at Kinderpillar Preschool is designed to get children ready for primary school. It focuses on strengthening reading, writing, and math skills through an engaging curriculum. Children are encouraged to ask questions and build confidence in their own abilities. Kinderpillar Preschool aims to develop emotional strength and social skills so that the transition into a formal school setting is smooth and successful for every student.

name: Maria Montessori House
description: Established in 2005 A.D., Maria Montessori House is an early childhood educational institution located in Sanepa-02, Lalitpur. Guided by its founding motto, “Education in harmony with life,” the preschool has spent nearly two decades dedicated to delivering structured foundational learning. The institution focuses on nurturing natural curiosity, creativity, and an enduring interest in learning, helping build a strong academic and personal foundation for young children during their critical early years of growth.Maria Montessori House's instructional pedagogy approaches early childhood teaching as a practical science rather than a theoretical philosophy. Set in a secure, homely, and well-managed environment, the preschool is equipped with specially designed educational materials that encourage children to explore their surroundings independently. These resources help young learners develop essential cognitive abilities and critical problem-solving skills at their own pace. Additionally, purposeful daily activities are integrated into the routine to support both fine and gross motor skills, promoting balanced physical coordination and steady physical development.Language acquisition, clear communication, and emotional well-being are central elements of the school's holistic curriculum. Maria Montessori House creates a supportive setting where children participate in positive social interactions, master fundamental self-help routines, and establish positive early learning habits. By addressing intellectual, emotional, and social development at the same time, the preschool provides comprehensive care and preparation, ensuring young learners are well equipped for a smooth, confident transition into primary school.

name: Kids Garden Montessori School
description: Kids Garden Montessori School is a leading early childhood education center that combines Nepal’s national curriculum with the true essence of Montessori teaching. The school offers a warm, caring environment where children are free to learn at their own pace, building confidence, independence, and a genuine love for learning.Each child at Kids Garden Montessori is seen as a unique individual. The teaching approach encourages self-respect, empathy, responsibility, and good decision-making skills. Mixed-age classrooms allow students to learn from each other, develop leadership qualities, and build strong social connections. Through hands-on Montessori materials, children explore and understand new concepts in a practical and meaningful way.The curriculum focuses on supporting the overall development of every child. Children take part in everyday activities that help them develop fine motor skills, independence, and responsibility. Carefully designed learning materials sharpen their senses and improve their ability to observe, classify, and understand the world. Language skills grow naturally as they read, write, tell stories, and build vocabulary, while interactive activities make learning math fun and easy to grasp.Beyond academics, children explore geography, history, science, and world cultures, fostering curiosity and global awareness. Creative activities such as art, music, dance, and sports also play a significant role in supporting their emotional well-being and self-expression.With caring teachers, personalized attention, and a safe, well-equipped environment, Kids Garden Montessori gives children a strong academic foundation and the life skills they need to succeed both in school and in life.Mission:Kids Garden Montessori School's mission is to provide a nurturing, child-centered learning environment that embraces the Montessori philosophy. The school is committed to fostering each child’s natural curiosity, creativity, and independence through hands-on, experiential learning. By encouraging respect, responsibility, and compassion, Kids Garden Montessori School aims to cultivate confident learners who are prepared for academic and life success.Vision:Kids Garden Montessori School's vision is to be a leading early childhood institution that empowers children to become thoughtful, well-rounded individuals. The school strives to inspire lifelong learning by combining the Montessori method with innovative approaches, creating a space where every child feels valued, supported, and capable of reaching their full potential, both as learners and as compassionate members of society.

name: Holy Vision Technical Campus
description: Holy Vision Technical Campus was established in 2002 A.D. with the mission to produce skilled middle-level health professionals ready for employment upon completing their education and training. The campus currently offers two main programs: the 3-year General Medicine (Health Assistant) and Diploma in Pharmacy courses, as well as a 3-month Caregiver Training, all following curricula prescribed by CTEVT and approved by relevant professional councils, including the Nepal Professional Health Council and the Nepal Pharmacy Council.The campus emphasizes practical and community experience as a core part of its training. Students gain hands-on exposure through the dedicated Everest Hospital, which provides services across multiple medical specialties and diagnostic facilities. Additionally, students have clinical rotations in various reputed hospitals and primary health care centers, ensuring comprehensive real-world learning. Pharmacy students also receive industry experience at pharmaceutical companies and related institutions.Graduates from Holy Vision Technical Campus are well-prepared to deliver quality health care, particularly to rural populations, providing preventive, promotive, curative, drug management, and rehabilitative services.

name: Himalayan Ayurveda Medical Science College
description: Himalayan Ayurveda Medical Science College (HAMSC) was established in 2011 AD. The college is operating a Diploma in Ayurveda & General Medicine under the affiliation of CTEVT. It is located in the heart of Kathmandu Valley, in Buddhanagar, New Baneshwor. HAMS College is a joint venture with Grace International Group, which focuses on connecting life & learning. Regular classes with experienced and dedicated teaching faculty (more than 10 years in the field of Ayurveda in both Nepal & India), peaceful reading environment, skill-based teaching, and practical classes are the reasons to choose HAMS College as the first option in Ayurveda diploma level.Benefits of Studying at Himalayan Ayurved:Peaceful learning environment.Daily classes are conducted.Taught by experienced instructors.Practical training sessions are held.IELTS and PTE coaching available.Free English classes for students.Scholarships are offered to diligent and deserving students.Career and Further Study Opportunities:Eligibility for government health service positions (through the Public Service Commission).Ability to open recognized pharmacies.Opportunity to cultivate medicinal plants.Employment in the Ayurvedic pharmaceutical industry.Can become yoga instructors.Can work as therapists in massage, Panchakarma, and wellness centers (nationally and internationally).Eligible for higher education in degrees such as BAMS, BPharm (Ayurveda), and BPH.Can pursue short-term (6-month) conversion courses for MBBS, BSc Nursing, BDS, and other related fields.

name: Kathmandu Shiksha Sadan
description: Kathmandu Shiksha Sadan is located in LMC-29, Harisiddhi, Lalitpur. Established in 2002 AD, the school is a caring and nurturing institution committed to the holistic development of young children. With the guidance of passionate and experienced teachers, every child is supported in growing socially, emotionally, and intellectually at their own pace.The school offers programs ranging from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to the Secondary Level. It provides continuous education for children at the Primary, Lower Secondary, and Secondary levels. Extracurricular Activities (ECAs) and Co-Curricular Activities (CCAs) are essential components of school life, alongside the integration of digital learning and technology to prepare students for the modern world.Kathmandu Shiksha Sadan employs play-based learning, making education enjoyable and natural for young children. Child-focused teaching ensures that lessons are tailored to the needs and interests of each student. Creative and social development activities help children express themselves and build healthy relationships with their peers. A supportive classroom environment encourages students to ask questions, explore new ideas, and learn with confidence.VisionEmpowering every student to reach their full potential and become lifelong learners, fostering a culture of excellence, innovation, and compassion where every student thrives academically, socially, and emotionally.What Kathmandu Shiksha Sadan OffersPlay-Based LearningChild-Focused TeachingCreative & Social DevelopmentSupportive Classroom EnvironmentSchool ValuesMoral ValuesSocial ValuesCultural ValuesBehavioral ValuesUniversal ValuesDigital Values

name: Reliance International Academy
description: Established in 2050 BS, Reliance International Academy (+2 Wing) is a premier coeducational institution and a top-ranked choice among 10+2 colleges in Kathmandu. Affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB) of the Government of Nepal, our NEB +2 programs in Science and Management have consistently set benchmarks for academic success since 2060 BS.Ranked among the Top 3 plus-two colleges in Nepal, RIA is frequently cited as the best science college in Kathmandu. The academy empowers students not just for board excellence, but for competitive entrance exams and global academic pursuits. With state-of-the-art labs and a Wi-Fi-enabled campus, it remains the best +2 college in Kathmandu for students seeking a future-ready education.MissionTo impart 21st-century skills to its students and to maintain a delicate balance between traditional values and modern ethos.VisionTo be a center of excellence in education, in keeping with the rich heritage of Nepal.To strive for the simultaneous development of body, mind, and spirit.To create compassionate, responsible, and innovative global citizens, committed to the development of humanity.To provide quality education that is affordable to a large section of society.ValuesCooperation: Sharing and learning together. The Academy fosters a spirit of cooperation, where students work together in teams, contributing and sharing in a helpful manner.Achievement: "Persist and try your best." Achievement is defined as striving to attain personal goals, persisting through challenges, and giving one’s best effort.Respect: "Respect each other and our environment." Respect involves taking responsibility for one another, speaking and interacting courteously, and being honest, reliable, and trustworthy.Empathy: "Treat others with care and compassion." Empathy means encouraging students to understand others’ views and feelings, and to be supportive and caring toward them.Objectives:To produce students of above-average abilitiesTo develop the moral character, self-esteem, and sense of responsibility in the studentsTo encourage the blossoming of utmost originality, innovation,n and creativity in the performance of the products of RIATo provide well-qualified and dedicated teachers who inspire a joy of learning for its own sakeTo provide a rigorous core curriculumTo provide excellent programs in foreign languages, computers, art, music, and athleticsTo prepare the students to build their career with greater confidence for their glorious futureTo encourage children to act on free will and exhibit what they feel without any hesitationTo create a conducive and cozy environment for each child, i.e., one or more ways to help them grow in the best possible waysFor more information, visit the academy.

name: NAMI International School
description: After years of meticulous planning and extensive research, NAMI International School proudly announces the establishment of its primary school component in 2024. This strategic expansion complements the existing 10+2 level education that has been serving students since 2013. The school is excited to open its gates to a new generation of students who are well-prepared to embark on their educational journey. Registered under the Ministry of Education in Nepal, the institution stands as a testament to its commitment to national educational standards.NAMI International School is dedicated to providing holistic education, emphasizing not only academic excellence but also the social, emotional, and creative development of its students. With a focus on global citizenship, innovative teaching methods, and community engagement, the school actively instills a sense of responsibility and social consciousness in its students. The institution's inclusive environment fosters a sense of belonging, contributing to a positive school culture where students are valued and motivated to excel. The school strives to prepare students for lifelong learning, equipping them with the skills and values needed for success in their future endeavors.Vision Statement for EVERYONE:Our vision is to offer access to world-class education within Nepal, fostering human capital development among the youth and empowering them to become responsible individuals contributing to society, both locally and globally.Mission Statement for NAMI International SchoolTo empower individuals with fundamental academic knowledge, life skills, and values that foster a genuine love for learning, and prepare them to impact their own lives and the lives of others positively.Goal of NAMIOur goal at NAMI International School is to help each student find their own unique way to make a positive impact on the world by instilling in them a love of service that will last a lifetime. Coordination, leadership, and effective communication are some of the abilities that students learn, along with techniques for achieving their service goals. Students develop, launch, and finish their initiatives under the supervision of adults. Students are required to document their project progress through reflective essays, diaries, and journals. The end goal is for the youngsters to grow up to be loving, compassionate people who can see the good in every situation, find creative ways to solve problems and answer the call to action when they see one.Tag Line“Nurturing minds, shaping tomorrow together”

name: Liberty Secondary School
description: Established in 1992 in Basundhara, Kathmandu, Liberty Secondary School offers education from Playgroup to Grade 10. Guided by the vision "Empowering Minds, Shaping Futures," the institution maintains a safe, child-friendly, and disciplined environment. The academic journey transitions from play-based learning in the pre-primary years to concept-driven instruction at the primary level, culminating in focused preparation for the SEE examinations.The school features a modern, earthquake-resistant campus equipped with smart classrooms, advanced science and ICT labs, a dedicated STEM corner, and a language lab. Beyond core academics, Liberty emphasizes sports, leadership, and moral values to support holistic development. Qualified faculty provide personalized mentorship, while regular parent-teacher collaboration and career counseling ensure student growth. By offering merit and need-based scholarships, the school remains committed to making quality education accessible, nurturing innovative and responsible citizens prepared for the challenges of the 21st century.MissionThe mission of the school is to provide a transformative learning experience by: Delivering Quality Education: Providing a rigorous academic environment that blends traditional values with modern pedagogical approaches. Cultivating Character: Encouraging integrity, self-discipline, and empathy to help students develop a strong moral compass. Promoting Innovation: Integrating technology and creative thinking into the classroom to prepare students for the digital age. Empowering Potential: Recognizing the unique talents of every student and providing the resources and mentorship they need to excel.Our Vision"To become a center of educational excellence that nurtures innovative, socially responsible, and globally competitive individuals who are prepared to lead in an ever-evolving world."Promise to ParentsLiberty Secondary School treats every child as its responsibility and every parent's trust as its honor. The school promises individual attention to every child, transparent communication with parents, and continuous academic and personal growth. With a focus on holistic development and future-ready education, Liberty Secondary School continues to serve as a trusted institution for families in Kathmandu, where learning begins with blessings.

name: Gyan Ganga International Public School
address: Murali Chowk, Opposite to Provincial Election Office, Janakpurdham-4, Dhanusha
description: Gyan Ganga International Public School, established in 2074 and located at Murali Chowk, opposite the Provincial Election Office, Janakpurdham-4, Dhanusha, offers education from PlayGroup (PG) to Grade 8. The institution provides a structured and supportive learning environment. It employs qualified, experienced, and dedicated teachers. These educators utilize modern, interactive teaching methods to foster critical thinking. To prepare students for a digital future, the school integrates computer and digital learning resources into daily lessons.Character building, moral values, and personality development receive strong emphasis within the curriculum. Students utilize a well-stocked library for self-study and research. Additionally, various sports and extra-curricular activities promote physical fitness and teamwork. The campus remains clean, safe, and disciplined. Reliable transportation services cover major routes, and hygienic hostel facilities accommodate residential students. Regular educational events and co-curricular programs further support balanced student development.VisionAims to be one of the most preferred learning hub in the Country. We believe that every child is unique to us.MissionThe school's major focus is to imbibe our students with a sense of academic superiority, self-confidence, and domain-specific professional competency so that they can achieve their dreams and lead a successful professional life.

name: Bijeswori Secondary School
description: Bijeswori Secondary School (BSS) was founded in 1981. Over three decades since its humble beginnings, a small school run by a handful of dedicated teachers and staff has grown into a full-fledged higher secondary institution. We feel our growth reflects the trust and confidence that the parents, students, and the community have placed in us. Their trust in us assures that we have been serving them satisfactorily. It is this trust that drives us to continue meeting the expectations that people have of us.Established through a private initiative, Bijeswori School is an independent, non-governmental institution. It is being developed as an institution of higher learning and is dedicated to maintaining high standards of academic excellence. Bijeswori School takes pride in its consistently outstanding academic results, which reflect the support, trust, and cooperation of students, parents, and our well-wishers.The school, in line with its mission and policy, operates by establishing different levels, each of which functions autonomously under the school's aegis. Each level operates under the supervision of the Academic Council. Subject committees at each level recommend and oversee program curricula and changes.Adequate legal provisions were in place when Bijeswori School was established, authorizing the school to formulate and amend its own rules and regulations, covering organizational, administrative, personal, and academic matters as and when deemed necessary.VISIONBijeswori Secondary School envisions its students developing qualities that enable them to meet the challenges of the modern world. The school focuses on holistic development to help students become individuals with a deep sense of responsibility to their society and country.The school's vision is to be a leading educational institution in Nepal that provides intellectual, social, and ethical growth to students, empowering them to achieve their full potential and contribute meaningfully to society.BSS works to expose students to diverse possibilities and provides experiences that help develop not only their academic potential but also their intellectual, professional, ethical, and spiritual growth.MISSIONBijeswori Secondary School's mission is to nurture students' talent so they can fulfill their potential. The school provides numerous opportunities for students to hone their positive instincts. Every day, BSS works to inspire students with core values such as integrity, resilience, respect, and responsibility, which form the foundation of their growth and success.The school's mission is to provide a holistic and inclusive education that empowers students with knowledge, skills, and values, enabling them to excel academically, develop strong character, and become responsible global citizens.The school is dedicated to delivering quality education that meets national and international standards while encouraging critical thinking, creativity, and lifelong learning.Core ValuesExcellence in Education: The school strives for academic rigor and innovation in teaching and learning.Character Building: Emphasis is placed on moral values, discipline, and social responsibility.Inclusivity: Students from diverse backgrounds are welcome and provided with equal opportunities.Community Engagement: Students are encouraged to contribute positively to their communities and society.AchievementBijeswori Secondary School measures its success through the accomplishments of its students. The school believes that achievement is not limited to winning awards or securing top scores. It also includes participation in events that support students' intellectual and emotional growth.The school focuses on more than academic excellence. It equally values success in extracurricular activities. Talent, regardless of the field, is recognized and nurtured with equal care and dedication. Whether a student shows promise in the classroom or on the sports field, the school provides the same level of support and encouragement to help them reach their full potential.This commitment to helping students achieve their goals has led the school to success in many areas in recent years.Class Size: 35 Students in one classSession Timing: Morning 6:00 am to Afternoon 12:00 pmAcademic AchievementSince its establishment in 2061 BS, Bijeswori Secondary School has consistently achieved 100% pass rates in the SLC/SEE examinations. Within a short period of offering Plus Two programs, the school has maintained a 100 percent pass rate with distinctions each year. Many former students are now working in various national and international organizations.Non-AcademicTime and again, students are involved in non-academic events, such as quiz contests and volunteering at art exhibitions. Some of the events our students participated in include the All Nepal Peace Quiz Contest, NTV Participation in School Essay Contest, Ncell Kalajatra, an art event, Appearance of Light, an art exhibition, etc.Furthermore, fine arts students regularly attend studio visits with renowned artists to deepen their understanding of the philosophical and technical aspects of the arts. Because art today is not merely about creation, it is also about articulating it after its creation. Moreover, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of how to create, articulate, and promote the arts. Scholars and experts in art and culture will be invited to serve as visiting lecturers at the school for lectures and presentations.Encouraging students to participate in such events will help develop art skills and ideas, which in turn will support their understanding of the synthesis of Nepalese art. Furthermore, students will develop the skills to interact with a range of individuals, including artists, media professionals, and scholars. Therefore, these non-academic activities can serve as a survival kit for students.Teaching MethodologyThe Bijeswori School believes that all students have the right to quality educational opportunities that develop their potential as individuals and citizens in a democratic society. Thus, careful thought has been given to adopting up-to-date teaching methodologies.Class LecturesGroup DiscussionsCase StudiesPresentationPractical ExercisesLaboratory WorksProject WorksField Trips

name: Buds Montessori Pre School
description: Established in 2010, Buds Montessori Pre-School is located in Nakkhu, Lalitpur-18. The institution is dedicated to providing a meaningful learning journey for young children through a blend of progressive pedagogies. Set in a homely environment, the school serves as a hub for innovative learning where exploration and experimentation are encouraged.The school operates with the motto "Experience Excellence in Education" and is dedicated to providing an exceptional learning journey through a proven Montessori approach. It is designed to feel like a home away from home, offering a safe, holistic environment where qualified teachers focus on each student's individual growth.The school’s philosophy is built on the belief that every child is intelligent and deserves careful nurturing. By fostering a love for exploration and independence, the teachers aim to make a significant difference in each child's life. This commitment to quality has earned the school more than 15 awards and made it a trusted choice for families, serving over 7,000 students each year. The curriculum is carefully crafted to promote hands-on learning, ensuring that children build a solid foundation for lifelong success.Buds Montessori offers several classes for children from Play Group to Upper Kindergarten.
