The school has carefully planned each program to match the age and needs of every child.MissionThe mission of Buds Montessori Pre-School is to nurture every child individually and independently, fostering optimism and social-emotional adaptability to create a foundation for a lifelong love of learning.Educational ApproachThe school’s curriculum is thoughtfully designed to support holistic development, integrating three key methodologies:Montessori Education: Focuses on independence, concentration, and hands-on, self-paced activities in a prepared environment.Play-Way Method: Encourages learning through joyful discovery and creative expression, developing essential life skills.STEAM-Based Curriculum: Integrates Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics into daily lessons to promote critical thinking and problem-solving.From Grade 1 onward, the school transitions to a fully Integrated Curriculum that aligns with national standards while continuing to use STEAM-based lessons for deeper understanding and collaboration.Programs and Class LevelsBuds Montessori offers specific classes tailored to the developmental needs of different age groups from Sunday to Friday:Day Care: 8 months to 6 yearsPlay Group: 18 months to 2.5 years (9:00 AM – 2:30 PM)Nursery: 2.5 years to 3.5 years (9:00 AM – 3:30 PM)L.K.G: 3.5 years to 5 years (9:00 AM – 3:30 PM)U.K.G: 5 years to 6.5 years (9:00 AM – 3:30 PM)The administrative office and an "Extra Time" facility are available until 5:00 PM to assist parents.ECA Club and CelebrationsThe school operates an ECA Club to nurture unique talents beyond the classroom. Activities include Music, Dance, Art & Craft, Martial Arts, and Swimming. These are designed to build confidence, improve coordination, and develop discipline.Throughout the year, the school organizes various functions and celebrations, such as Grandparents’ Day, Graduation Day, Sports Day, Rhymes Recitation, World Music Day, and World Environment Day, as well as inter-preschool performances in dance and handwriting

name: New Dream World Academy
description: New Dream World Academy, situated in Adarsa Tole, Imadol, Lalitpur, offers an Early Childhood Education (ECE) program designed to support the developmental needs of young learners. The school focuses on creating a positive learning environment through the guidance of qualified and experienced teachers. The institution emphasizes a teaching approach grounded in child development, aiming to provide educational opportunities that foster both academic and personal growth.The school implements a curriculum tailored to its community and students' specific needs. This framework is designed to be broad and balanced, offering a range of learning experiences that encourage children to explore different subjects. By providing depth of knowledge and helping students connect various areas of learning, the academy seeks to prepare them for future educational stages and instill a sustained interest in learning.New Dream World Academy provides classes across four levels: Play Group (ages 2–3), Nursery (ages 3–5), LKG (ages 4–6), and UKG (ages 5–6). Each level maintains a class size of approximately 18 to 20 students, ensuring a structured social environment for peer interaction. The academy operates to complement the home environment to support the holistic development of every child within its care.Mission:New Dream World Academy is dedicated to inspiring a love of learning and helping all children achieve their personal goals, now and in the future.Vision:New Dream World Academy envisions its children educated for real life, extending beyond just reading and writing to encompass a broader, more practical understanding of the world.Core ValuesGratitudeIntegrityCreativityCollaborationWell-beingHard – workExcellenceGoalHolistic Development of each ChildCognitive DevelopmentSocial and Emotional DevelopmentSpiritual DevelopmentLanguage DevelopmentMontessori Curriculum:The Montessori curriculum is an integrated thematic approach that connects various disciplines through studies of the physical universe, the natural world, and the human experience. This method allows one lesson to lead into many others.Pedagogy:Pedagogy refers to the methods and practices used in teaching students. It encompasses both the theoretical and practical aspects of education, connecting learning techniques to students' cultural context. The goal of pedagogy is to enhance learners' skills and attitudes. We strongly advocate a student-centered pedagogical approach that encourages children to think independently and satisfy their curiosity during the learning process.Co-curricular Activities of the schoolDrawing/ColouringRhymesDanceReading/LibrarySpelling/PhonicsHand writingArt and CraftSpecial ActivitiesDEAR – TimeMass – PTEnglish ClubComputer class/Coding ClassMusic

name: Batsalya Montessori and Elementary School
description: Batsalya Montessori School is located in Nilopul, Kapan, Kathmandu. The school focuses on a child's overall development, which includes their mind, body, and social skills. The teaching method encourages children to think independently, analyze information, and develop their own ideas, helping them prepare for the future. A key goal is to help each child become an independent reader from an early age.The school operates from a modern, earthquake-resistant building. It has specialized facilities, including a Montessori lab for hands-on learning, a garden, and a playground for physical activities.The school provides an evening care service for children from 3:30 PM to 7:00 PM. This extended care includes a balanced schedule of activities. The session begins with pickup and a group gathering, followed by snacks and free playtime. The afternoon includes various activities such as arts and crafts, music, drama, and games that develop critical thinking skills. The day concludes with dedicated academic support from teachers to assist with learning needs.The school also provides a weekly menu of healthy snacks and meals, prepared with a focus on cleanliness and with options for different dietary needs.Batsalya Montessori School aims to bring out each child's unique qualities and cultural values. It emphasizes creating a supportive learning environment where children can think, explore, and grow confidently throughout the day.Vision StatementBatsalya Montessori and Elementary School is a child-centered, inclusive learning community dedicated to nurturing every learner’s unique potential. Rooted in strong educational values and inspired by Montessori principles, the school provides a safe, respectful, and joyful environment for children from diverse backgrounds. School envisions nurturing kind, confident, and visionary learners who think critically, lead with empathy, and develop a lifelong love for learning.Mission StatementThe mission is to offer an integrated, progressive learning experience grounded in real-world learning, enriched with national and international perspectives, and focused on developing kind, curious, and lifelong learners.Beyond the Classroom: A Holistic EducationA Batsalya education extends far beyond academics. Our extra-curricular program is designed to nurture the whole child:Gymnastics – building strength, flexibility, and disciplineSwimming – promoting fitness, safety, and confidenceDrama – enhancing expression, empathy, and communicationDance – celebrating culture, rhythm, and coordinationMusic – nurturing creativity, listening, and emotional expressionThese activities provide joyful avenues for self-discovery, talent development, and holistic well-being.Teachers: Guides, Designers & MentorsBatsalya’s educators are facilitators of discovery. Teachers carefully observe each child and design environments and experiences that spark curiosity, critical thinking, and independent learning.They serve as mentors for social-emotional growth, creating a safe, nurturing classroom community where every student feels valued. By integrating real-world contexts and global perspectives, they help learners become thoughtful, engaged citizens.Above all, teachers model lifelong learning, inspiring students with their own curiosity, integrity, and passion for growth.Developing Leaders & Lifelong LearnersAt Batsalya Montessori and Elementary School, the development of leaders and lifelong learners is a foundational commitment. The school’s philosophy empowers students through meaningful, age-appropriate responsibilities, with roles in both classroom and school-wide activities that build initiative, decision-making skills, and personal accountability.Confidence is cultivated in a supportive environment where presentations, performances, and collaborative projects are integral to the learning experience. Students also participate in structured community service and social impact projects, which foster empathy, mutual respect, and a lasting sense of civic commitment.Through consistent reflection and intentional goal-setting, students at Batsalya develop strong self-awareness and a resilient growth mindset, learning to embrace challenges as valuable opportunities for personal and intellectual development.

name: Uniglobe Premier College
description: Uniglobe Premier College is a leading educational institution operated by Uniglobe College Pvt. Ltd. and accredited by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Nepal (2025). The institution is dedicated to providing quality education while promoting academic excellence, innovation, discipline, and the overall development of students, continuing the strong educational legacy of Uniglobe College, affiliated with Pokhara University.The school believes that education should extend beyond classroom textbooks and focus on developing well-rounded individuals. With a team of experienced educators and mentors, Uniglobe Premier School/College creates a motivating and supportive learning environment where students are encouraged to explore creativity, curiosity, and critical thinking. By combining traditional educational values with modern teaching methodologies, the institution helps students build strong academic foundations along with essential future-ready skills.The institution follows a student-centered learning approach and continuously adopts innovative teaching practices to enhance the educational experience. Modern classrooms equipped with advanced technology provide interactive and engaging learning opportunities that prepare students for today’s rapidly evolving digital world.Alongside academic achievement, the school strongly emphasizes the holistic growth of every student by fostering emotional, social, ethical, and leadership qualities. Through academics, co-curricular activities, leadership programs, and character-development initiatives, Uniglobe Premier School/College aims to produce confident, responsible, and globally conscious individuals ready to contribute positively to society.PhilosophyThe philosophy of Uniglobe Premier School/College is grounded in whole-child development, where learning extends beyond textbooks and academics. The institution believes in enhancing creativity, collaboration, morality, emotional well-being, social responsibility, and environmental awareness among young learners. It focuses on providing an education that harmonizes with nature and culture, guiding children toward becoming thoughtful, compassionate, and responsible global citizens who contribute positively to society.At Uniglobe Premier School/College, meaningful education is believed to require more than a conventional classroom approach. The institution strives to create a learning environment where every child is known, guided, and inspired to reach their full potential. As a sister institution of Uniglobe College, the school builds upon a strong academic legacy while incorporating modern educational practices suited for the 21st century.VisionThe vision of Uniglobe Premier School/College is to nurture holistic, responsible, and lifelong learners for a better and more sustainable world.MissionThe mission of Uniglobe Premier School/College is to deliver holistic, authentic, and meaningful education that nurtures responsible, innovative, and dynamic learners who are prepared to contribute to a sustainable and evolving world.

name: Montessori Phoolbari
description: Established in 2011, Montessori Phoolbari is a dedicated early childhood educational institution located in the heart of Dhobighat, Lalitpur. Operating under the motto "Where Every Child is Gifted," the school is recognized as a highly encouraging environment for children during their most formative years, specifically catering to students from 18 months to 6 years of age.Montessori Phoolbari School is committed to meeting the social, emotional, physical and intellectual needs of the child. It is our desire that within the framework of the Montessori principles and philosophy, the school shall provide each child the opportunity to develop their potential to the best of their ability; within a safe and affirming environment. With the above in mind, the following goals are considered as an integral part of its community and curriculum:To provide and maintain a happy, safe, and healthy learning environmentTo encourage and support the full development of each childTo provide a setting which nurtures the individual’s self-esteem as an independent learnerTo extend the child’s awareness of their world and community, and assist in the development of social valuesTo cooperate fully with the parent(s) in achieving these goalsTo uphold and defend the rights of the individual and universal child.

name: Caribbean Secondary School
description: Caribbean Secondary School is located in Mahalaxmistan, Lalitpur. It offers courses in +2 in two streams: Management and Science, with affiliation from NEB.It is one of the best colleges in town which offers a supportive environment for the students. The Secondary School takes the students in a voyage through the sea of knowledge and wisdom facing challenges as they making the journey to their mission in life as fruitful and adventurous as possible. Caribbean Secondary School is a space where the best innovative, practical and visionary teaching and learning come together within a beautiful setting that caters to achieve these goals. It strives to maintain progressive, disciplinary and dynamic yet friendly, liberal and approachable; a dream college for today's young generation. The Secondary School offers vibrant and stimulating environment for academics and an equally dynamic environment outside the classroom to have an all-round development of the mind and body of a student. It is concentrated on supporting students create their individual goals and work hard to achieve them. Students in Caribbean Secondary School belong to diverse culture and ethnicity holding a gender equilibrium. It has a team of highly qualified and experienced teaching faculties which is evident through the record-breaking results.Caribbean Secondary School, in order to develop students' skills, to learn to take leadership responsibilities and to study and work in different environments, it provides various non-credit courses such as sports activities, other co-curricular activities, guest lectures, field trips, tours, social service, skill enhancement classes, and many more. VisionTo create a community of successful learners and leaders who will be able to access information through the appropriate use of written, oral and technological resources to contribute to the nation's development.MissionProvides an environment in which every student discovers and realizes his/her full potential and meet the academic, social, technological and emotional needs required to prepare him/her for success in a rapidly changing world.GoalsTo create excellent learning environment.To provide quality education with skilled and experienced faculty with adequate teaching resources.To focus on overall growth and the all round development of the students.To make the students aware of the global environment.

name: United Technical School
address: Kumaripati, Mahalaxmisthan Lokeyswor Galli 2, Kathmandu, Lalitpur
description: United Technical School, known as UTS, helps students build a career in food, coffee and hotel work. It is part of United Academy Group, which has run schools and colleges in Lalitpur since 1997. That background means UTS follows the same standard of teaching and support that the group is known for across Nepal.All the courses offered by UTS are certified by CTEVT (Government body for technical and vocational education). Hence the certificate you get is accepted by both the employers in Nepal and many in the outside world. Classes are hands-on and small. They have all experienced teaching in actual kitchens, cafes and hotels and take that experience into each session.Students do not need any past experience to join. Whether you just finished SEE or +2, want to switch careers, or simply love food and coffee, UTS accepts you where you are and builds your skills from there. Courses run on flexible morning, day and evening batches, so working students and full-time learners can both fit training into their routine.Beyond the classroom, UTS connects students to internships and job openings through its industry network. Many graduates move directly into cafes, bakeries, restaurants and hotels across Kathmandu Valley soon after finishing their course.UTS also runs shorter programs for people who want a quicker start. There is a One Day Latte Art Master Class for a fast introduction to coffee art. There is also a Barista with IELTS/PTE bundle course, built together with HUB International. For students who want to specialize further after Bakery, a dedicated Cake Making course is available too.UTS also sits within the wider United Academy Group network in Kumaripati, close to United College and United School. That gives students access to a bigger campus community than a standalone training center usually offers.VisionProvide practical and industry-oriented training to every student according to employer requirements.Create a culture of discipline, innovation, and integrity among all students.MissionProvide practical training to students rather than theoretical knowledge.Bridge the difference between education and industry expectations.Help students who wish to establish cafes, bakeries, and food businesses on their own.Contribute towards the development of Nepal's hospitality industry through job-ready graduates.Course Overview1. BaristaThe Barista course provides practical training in coffee preparation, espresso extraction, milk frothing, and latte art. It is designed to develop essential skills for working in cafés and the coffee industry. Our Barista course can be completed within 18 days.2. General Cook The General Cook course provides practical training in food preparation, kitchen safety, and cooking techniques. The General Cook course provides practical training in food preparation, kitchen safety, and cooking techniques. It covers a range of Nepali and international cuisines, helping students build essential culinary skills for professional kitchen environments. The course is available in both 1-month and 3-month durations, offering a combination of theoretical knowledge and practical training.3. Bakery The Bakery course provides practical training in preparing breads, pastries, cakes, and other bakery products. It focuses on professional baking techniques, food hygiene, presentation, consistency, and hands-on practice. The course is available in both 1-month and 3-month durations, offering a combination of theoretical knowledge and practical training.4. Hotel Assistant The Hotel Assistant course provides practical training across front office, housekeeping, and food service through mock hotel setups. It helps students develop essential skills for entry-level roles in the hospitality industry.5. Cake Making CourseThe Cake Making Course provides practical training in cake preparation, frosting, piping, decoration, and finishing techniques. It focuses on creating a variety of themed, customized, and professionally finished cakes through hands-on practice.6. One Day Latte Art Master ClassThe One-Day Latte Art Master Class provides intensive, hands-on training in milk texturing, pouring techniques, and latte art. Participants learn to create popular patterns such as hearts, tulips, and rosettas while developing greater precision and consistency in latte art.7. Barista with IELTS/PTE BundleThis course is designed in collaboration with HUB International and combines CTEVT-affiliated barista courses with IELTS/PTE preparation classes. It is best for individuals looking for employment/study opportunities in countries such as Australia, UAE, Japan, Korea, or places like them. In such a case, the visa process will require that you provide a valid certificate along with your English proficiency test scores.

name: Vinayak College of Health Science
description: Vinayak College of Health Science (VCOHS), located in Gaushala, Battisputali-9, Kathmandu, offers a range of courses such as Diploma in Physiotherapy, PCL in General Medicine-Health Assistant, Certificate in Medical Laboratory Technology, and Diploma in Pharmacy. The institution is built on a foundation of quality education, practical training, and ethical professional development. Students at VCOHS benefit from an academic environment supported by experienced faculty members drawn from reputed government and private medical institutions. The college is equipped with functional laboratories, a resourceful library, and dedicated student learning centers to facilitate a comprehensive educational experience.The college adopts a problem-based, evidence-driven learning approach, ensuring that students are academically prepared to address real-world health challenges. To bridge the gap between classroom theory and professional practice, VCOHS maintains strong affiliations with various hospitals across the Kathmandu Valley and beyond. These partnerships provide students with diverse clinical training environments, allowing them to gain essential hands-on experience in healthcare.VisionThe vision of the college is to deliver health education of the highest quality to meet the needs of individuals, academic institutions, health institutions and the nation as a whole through widening participation and by raising the intellectual, academic, and practical achievements of young people and adults in Nepal, by providing skills, knowledge, and qualification as well as by facilitating the ethical norms and so1cial responsibilities.Mission Regarding health professionals are extremely important in the process of creating a healthy nation, the college's mission is to produce technically competent and socially responsible health personnel, those are:Able to face the 21st-century challenges in the health profession.Possess a strong sense of social responsibility.Loving and caring with compassion.Willing to continue lifelong learning.Good team players.MotoSkillAttitudeHumanityDisciplinePunctualityProfessionalismKnowledgeResponsibilityCourse DurationAll programs: 3 academic yearsEach academic year: up to 39 weeksEach academic week: up to 40 hours (excluding evaluation periods)

name: Aksharaa Kindergarten
description: Aksharaa Kindergarten is an educational institution located in Lalitpur. It was established in 2017 through a partnership between Aksharaa School and the Knic Education Foundation. The school is situated in a convenient area, just 100 meters away from Jawalakhel Chowk on Shanti Bagaicha Road. Aksharaa Kindergarten has a large campus with spacious school buildings and full-sized playgrounds where children can participate in various sports and physical activities.As the sister organization of Aksharaa School in Kandaghari, which started in 2011, Aksharaa Kindergarten follows the same values and educational principles. The school focuses on helping children become responsible individuals through self-discovery and hands-on learning. While the main school in Kandaghari serves students from Grade 1 to Grade 10, the Jawalakhel branch focuses on early childhood education.Aksharaa Kindergarten offers specific programs tailored to the developmental needs of children at different ages:Day Care: 1.5 to 2.5 YearsPre ECD (Pre Early Childhood Development): 2.5 to 3.5 YearsECD I (Early Childhood Development I): 3.5 to 4.5 YearsECD II (Early Childhood Development II): 4.5 to 5.5 YearsAksharaa Kindergarten uses a child-centered approach to help with the overall development of every student. The school uses modern teaching methods and technology-enhanced classrooms to make learning more interesting. The facilities at Aksharaa Kindergarten are designed to be child-friendly and safe, creating a comfortable environment where students can balance their study time with physical play.The educational philosophy at Aksharaa Kindergarten is built on the belief that every child is intelligent in their own way. To support this, the school follows a "Balanced Education System." This system includes activities that support a child’s thinking skills and their physical, emotional, and social growth. To achieve this, Aksharaa Kindergarten uses a specific teaching model known as LRPA, which stands for Learning, Reinforcement, Practice, and Application.At Aksharaa Kindergarten, children are encouraged to learn through a "Touch-Explore-Learn-Enjoy" process. This method is designed to spark children's curiosity and help them enjoy the learning process from a young age. Since the first six years of a child's life are crucial for brain development, Aksharaa Kindergarten provides a warm environment where children can interact with the world around them. This helps them build the confidence they need to become successful learners.The teachers at Aksharaa Kindergarten treat every child as a unique individual. They pay close attention to each child's mental and physical growth. The school’s curriculum is theme-based and includes many fun activities such as music, art, dance, and field trips. Aksharaa Kindergarten also ensures that all equipment and toys are safe and non-toxic for children.One of the unique features of Aksharaa Kindergarten is how they check student progress. Instead of making small children sit for formal written tests, the school uses "on-the-spot" assessment. This means teachers watch how children participate in daily activities and use that information to understand their progress. This continuous, individualized assessment helps Aksharaa Kindergarten update its teaching methods to better meet the needs of each student.By focusing on a mix of play-way methods and real-life activities, Aksharaa Kindergarten aims to create a strong foundation for every child. The school also maintains a close relationship with parents to ensure that both the home and school environments work together to support the child’s growth. VisionThe vision of Aksharaa Kindergarten is to build a culture of lifelong learning, where children develop the skills, knowledge, and character traits needed to become compassionate, creative, and resilient individuals. Through a dedication to continuous improvement, Aksharaa Kindergarten strives to empower the next generation of leaders and thinkers to contribute positively to society and help shape a brighter future for the world. MissionThe mission of Aksharaa Kindergarten focuses on the overall development of young children during their important early years. The school provides a nurturing and inclusive learning environment where every child feels valued, respected, and encouraged to reach their full potential. Aksharaa Kindergarten works to encourage a love for learning and creativity while building a strong foundation of social, emotional, and academic skills. By working closely with families and the community, the school is dedicated to inspiring a passion for discovery and growth in every child.

name: National Institute of Science & Technology (NIST आयुर्वेदिक कलेज)
description: The National Institute of Science & Technology (NIST College) is an educational institution dedicated to the study of Ayurveda. Established in 2056 BS (1999 AD), the college is situated in the heart of Bharatpur Valley at Omshanti Chowk, behind Maiyadevi Girls' College. It operates under the affiliation of CTEVT and conducts a Diploma/PCL program in General Ayurveda medicine/AHA. NIST College prides itself on having experienced and dedicated teaching faculties with over two decades of experience in the field of Ayurveda in both Nepal and India. The institution emphasizes skill-based teaching and practical classes within a peaceful learning environment, presenting itself as a premier option for students pursuing an Ayurveda diploma.Why Ayurveda?Global Attraction: Ayurveda is increasingly gaining recognition and popularity worldwide as a science of life.Pandemic Response: The rise of pandemics and other health crises has led people to seek natural and sustainable ways of living and healing, making Ayurveda a preferred choice for many.Mind-Body Connection: It emphasizes the connection between the mind, body, and spirit, fostering a balanced and harmonious life.Foundational Health Skills: It teaches fundamental skills for living a healthy and happy life, including personalized care through diet, lifestyle management, and detoxification therapy.Cultural Heritage: Ayurveda is rooted in a rich cultural and historical tradition, offering a deep understanding of natural and holistic healing methods.Individualized Treatment: Ayurveda offers personalized treatments tailored to the unique needs of each individual, addressing the underlying causes of health issues.What happens after the Completion of the Course?Students are eligible to work in Ayurveda health centers in Nepal.Can be applied to the Government Service at the 4th & 5th levels.Can open their own Ayurveda Pharmacy.Can further study BAMS (Bachelor in Ayurveda Medicine and Surgery), B. Pharm Ayurveda, BPH.Can Even Study MBBS, BSc Nursing, BDS, etc after a short conversion course of 6 Months.Can work as a Massage Therapist, Yoga Instructor, Panchakarma therapist, and Lifestyle modification trainer.Can work as a Freelancer.Why NIST College?Regular classes in a peaceful environment.Taught by skilled and experienced teachers.Regular CME (Continuous Medical Education) is conducted.Special training by distinguished experts.OJT (On-the-job training) at the Ayurveda Hospital.Herbal field and Ayurveda industry visits.Opportunity to volunteer in health camps.The college provides financial support for business ventures after graduation.Community and educational tours.Special scholarships for outstanding students.Has its own 16-bed hospital within the college premises.

name: GoldenGate International Secondary School
description: GoldenGate International Secondary School is one of the well-known educational institutions located in Kathmandu, Nepal, which was established in the year 2007 by a group of experienced academicians with strong backgrounds in teaching and learning. From its beginning, the school has focused on providing quality education and helping students prepare for their academic and professional future. It offers 10+2 level programs in Science, Management, and Humanities under the affiliation of the National Examination Board (NEB), Nepal, which ensures that the education provided is officially recognized at the national level. The school aims to build a strong academic environment where students can develop both knowledge and practical skills needed in today’s changing world.MissionThe mission of GoldenGate International Secondary School is to become a reputed institution by delivering international-standard education with the help of experienced faculty members who have both national and international exposure. Its vision is to develop a centre of excellence in the fields of Science, Management, and Humanities, focusing on knowledge, skills, and practical applications that help students adapt to global changes. The institution also emphasizes overall student development through academic learning and personal growth opportunities.VisionThe vision of GoldenGate International Secondary School is to create and develop it as a centre with all its excellence for knowledge, skills and applications of established and emerging areas of Science, Management, Humanities and others to address the dynamism of the changing world and related sectors.CommitmentThe school follows the commitment statement, “Your Aspiration is Our Assurance,” which reflects its goal of supporting students in achieving their future dreams. It provides opportunities for students to explore their academic interests and prepare for higher studies or career paths. According to official information, the school also offers scholarship schemes based on merit, need, and talent, helping deserving students continue their education. Located in Battisputali, Kathmandu, GoldenGate has grown into a recognized institution that continues to contribute to quality education in Nepal by combining modern teaching approaches with experienced faculty and a supportive learning environment.

name: Budhanilkantha School
description: Budhanilkantha School is located on approximately 29 hectares (574 companies) of land and has first-rate physical facilities. It is a joint venture effort between the government of Nepal and the government of the United Kingdom, the school was established in 1972.The distinguished students come from all over Nepal, representing various races, ethnicities, cultures, and socioeconomic levels. Scholarships from the government are awarded to approximately one-third of the total student population. The scholarship is awarded to deserving and needy students following a highly selective entrance exam held throughout the country each year. Budhanilkantha School, in addition to high academic standards, teaches multidimensional skills and leadership through a variety of sports and extracurricular activities. The majority of graduates receive scholarships to attend prestigious colleges and universities around the world. The Public Educational Trust manages the school, with the Ministry of Education as the primary trustee. The Board is presided over by the Education Secretary.

name: Hospitality World Campus
description: The Hospitality World Campus (HWC), a leading institution in the field of Hospitality education, is led by a team of professional hospitality educators and industry experts. The institution prides itself on creating a student experience that fosters a sense of care and belonging. Moving ahead with the trends in the education system, it offers dynamic, subject-oriented, skill-based, and professional short-term courses. All short-term courses are designed with the flexibility for students to enter the industry and choose from various job opportunities or to complete their higher education in countries such as Australia, the UK, the USA, or Europe. Its diversified system sets students apart and puts them on the path to a future full of possibilities. The programs are centered around experiences relevant to future careers, emphasizing the value of bringing hands-on know-how to the classroom. This approach provides an education that blends the best of hospitality and business, enabling students to be agile, dynamic, and innovative—traits essential in the vibrant world of hospitality education. The institution strives to provide the best career opportunities for all its students.AccreditationHospitality World Campus is a unit of LCCI GQ and is validated and approved by SQA (Scottish Qualifications Authority), Scotland. This means the programs offered are assessed by SQA, a not-for-profit government-sponsored agency accountable to the Scottish Government, sitting at the heart of Scotland's world-renowned education system. With over 100 years of experience in developing qualifications and qualification systems globally, SQA ensures the highest standards. LCCI GQ is the first and only institution from Nepal to be approved by SQA.The institution is also benchmarked at The Scottish Credit and Qualifications Framework (SCQF) and the European Qualifications Framework (EQF). SCQF is a globally recognized national qualifications framework in the UK, managed by the Scottish Credit and Qualifications Framework Partnership. EQF is a European-wide qualifications framework that integrates the qualifications of different European countries. All courses at Hospitality World Campus are benchmarked against the EQF, making it easier for European employers to compare these programs against their own frameworks.MissionTo provide a world-class culinary and hospitality education that combines theoretical knowledge with practical skills, preparing our students to excel in the dynamic field of hospitality industry with the commitment of fostering creativity, professionalism, and a strong work ethic. VisionTo be recognized as the premier hospitality college in Nepal, renowned for excellence in culinary and Hospitality education, innovation and nurturing aspiring youths to become industry leaders.

name: Travel Talents School of Airline Studies
description: Travel Talents School of Airline Studies, located at Hattisar-1, Kathmandu, is an institution focused on producing skilled human resources for the travel and tourism sector. The school serves as a training hub designed to enhance the expertise of individuals aiming to enter or advance within the tourism industry. By providing accessible training opportunities to students from diverse academic backgrounds, the institution helps meet the growing demand for qualified professionals in Nepal's tourism and aviation sectors.The school offers a range of industry-specific programs, including Air Ticketing and Global Distribution System (GDS) training, the IATA Cargo Introductory Course, and Passenger Ground Service with IATA Airside Safety Training. Additionally, students can enroll in the IATA Foundation Diploma in Travel Tourism and specialized Air Ticketing Practical Training. A significant feature of the curriculum is the integration of the online Sabre Training System. This hands-on approach allows students to build proficiency in airline seat reservations, fare shopping, PNR creation, and the overall management of ticketing systems, ensuring they gain the practical confidence required for the workplace.With an annual intake of approximately 100 students for its Air Ticketing and GDS programs, Travel Talents School of Airline Studies has a track record of helping trainees secure employment at travel agencies across Nepal. To date, more than 200 of its former students are active professionals in the travel and tourism industry. The school also provides training to support self-study learners registered through IATA, many of whom have gone on to establish their own travel and tourism businesses. By focusing on practical qualifications and industry standards, the institution continues to support the career growth of aspiring aviation and tourism professionals.

name: Cosmos International College Pokhara
description: Cosmos International College is a sister organization of The British College Kathmandu and part of the British Education Group's global network. Established in 2024, the college is committed to delivering quality global education. The institution offers the Cambridge International Education A-Levels through a blend of strong academics, practical learning, and personalized support.The college is located in Khudi, Pokhara, in a peaceful, centrally located setting. The campus provides a calm environment that supports focused learning. The faculty consists of experienced teachers, many with over 15 years of experience, who guide students with care and expertise.Cosmos International College believes in personalized learning and keeps class sizes small, with approximately 20 students per class. This allows teachers to give individual attention to each student. The A-Level program focuses on studying only 3 to 4 subjects in depth over two years, helping students develop strong knowledge in their chosen areas. This qualification is widely recognized and accepted by universities worldwide, opening doors to global higher education opportunities.

name: Edusanjal
description: Edusanjal was established in 2010 A.D. by a group of students for helping all Nepali students in informed decision-making. The response and feedback received from invaluable readers and customers persuaded the team to keep going forward.Edusanjal has now become a leading educational portal for Nepal.

name: Kalika Manavgyan Secondary School
description: Kalika Manavgyan Secondary School, located in Kalikanagar, Butwal, is a model of educational excellence and transformation in Nepal’s community school sector. Established in 1961 A.D. through the dedication of local residents and ex-army personnel, the school has grown into the nation’s largest community school with over 8,000 students in ECD to grade 12.Renowned for blending academic and technical education, Kalika Manavgyan Secondary School stands out for its commitment to inclusivity, innovation, and national-level achievement, earning top honors such as the CEHRD’s No. 1 ranking, an outstanding score of 93.5, and the prestigious British Council ISA Certificate.Beginning as a primary school, Kalika was upgraded to a lower secondary level school in 2029 B.S and to a secondary level school in 2032 B.S. Today, the school stands as a leading community school in Rupandehi district. The school has played a significant role in improving the quality of education. It has been able to maintain an "A Grade School" status because of its strong management, high-quality education, and dedicated teachers. This school is an ISA-certified community school. Many students come to this school from far away. It is one of the leading government community schools. Many poor students, as well as students from remote areas, attend this school. Kalika Manavgyan Secondary School offers both General and Technical Education. In general education, the school offers classes from ECD to class 12, and in the technical stream, it offers Computer Engineering from class 9 to 12. As of the academic year 2081, the school has 8,087 students, the highest number among community schools in Nepal. It employs 252 teaching staff and 45 non-teaching staff. As part of our social responsibility, we offer free hostel accommodation to orphaned and underprivileged students.MissionThe school aims to provide excellent and affordable education to all students, ensuring equal access for everyone.Vision: To establish an excellent educational institution that develops moral, cultured, self-dependent, internationally competitive, and qualified citizens.To be a center of academic excellence, fostering innovation, leadership, and holistic development while ensuring inclusive and quality education for all.GoalDevelop future-ready students equipped with knowledge, ethics, and skills to excel nationally and internationally.Promote environmental awareness and social responsibility among students.Strengthen partnerships with local and global educational institutions.Continuously improve teaching quality through professional development for teachers.Foster a safe, inclusive, and supportive learning environment for all students.Core ValuesIntegrityUpholding honesty and ethics in every action.ExcellenceStriving for the highest standards in academics and activities.CreativityEncouraging innovative thinking and problem-solving

name: Shree Pokhariya Secondary School
description: Shree Pokhariya Secondary School is a leading community-based educational institution located in Biratnagar Metropolitan City, Ward No. 3, Morang District, Koshi Province. Established in 2016 B.S., the school has earned a strong reputation for academic excellence, discipline, and holistic student development. Recognizing its continuous efforts to improve educational standards, the school was designated as a Model School in the academic year 2077/78.The school views education as a continuous process shaped by learning experiences both inside and outside the classroom. While its physical infrastructure and accessible location attract students, the institution places greater emphasis on academic rigor, disciplined learning environments, social responsibility, and ethical conduct. Despite facing various challenges over the years, the school has sustained its growth through the collective commitment of teachers, staff, parents, and the wider community.Shree Pokhariya Secondary School introduced English-medium education in 2070 B.S., setting a benchmark for community schools in Morang District and influencing the expansion of English-medium instruction across the region. The school began its Plus Two programs in 2066 B.S. with Management and Education streams and has since expanded its academic offerings in response to growing demand. Plus Two Computer Engineering was introduced in 2075 B.S., followed by the Science stream, strengthening the school’s position as an emerging educational hub in eastern Nepal.The Plus Two Science program is managed by a team of experienced and dedicated teachers from the community school sector. The school has consistently demonstrated strong academic performance, including securing a GPA 4.0 in the SEE examination in 2074 B.S., reflecting its commitment to quality education and student achievement.Easily accessible from all parts of Biratnagar, the school provides an inclusive learning environment that values excellence, competence, dignity, and diversity. Through its expanding academic programs and student-focused approach, Shree Pokhariya Secondary School continues to guide learners toward responsible citizenship and a strong academic future.

name: Narayani Model Secondary School
description: Narayani Model Secondary School, established in 2020 B.S., is located in Bharatpur-10, Chitwan. The school offers a comprehensive academic curriculum from Nursery to Grade 12 and is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB). In Grades 11 and 12, students can choose to specialize in Science or Management. Additionally, the school provides a Diploma in Information Technology in partnership with the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT), catering to students interested in technical careers. The school also offers a provincial government-provided Pre-Diploma in IT.Narayani Model Secondary School, a government school in Nepal that has met 151 standards and received the first Model Status, provides a supportive and inspiring environment for young, curious minds to learn and grow. The school’s passion for learning ensures that it achieves more than just outstanding results. The institution strives to develop confident, creative thinkers and to deliver an education that is truly relevant to their future. It functions as a learning academy focused on social-emotional development, early literacy, and numeracy. The institution emphasizes a broad and balanced curriculum that integrates academic lessons with engaging activities. To enhance the learning experience, the school features smart boards in classrooms, making lessons more interactive and easier to comprehend. Students have access to modern science and computer laboratories for practical learning, as well as a well-stocked library that supports independent research and study.The school's environment is designed to be safe and supportive, incorporating CCTV surveillance and a team of qualified teachers who provide personalized guidance. For student well-being, a hygienic canteen offers nutritious meals, while a variety of sports and extracurricular activities promote physical fitness and teamwork. Furthermore, various student-led clubs, including the Red Cross, Scouts, and specialized ICT and Math clubs, provide opportunities for leadership development. Through educational excursions and regular school events, Narayani Model Secondary School ensures that students receive a well-rounded education, preparing them for future social and cultural experiences.

name: Durgalaxmi Model Secondary School
description: Durgalaxmi Secondary School (DLMS), established in 2030 B.S., is a renowned public school located in Attariya, Kailali, Sudurpaschim Province, Nepal. Approved by the Ministry of Education, Nepal, and affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB), DLMS offers comprehensive educational programs from Nursery to Grade 12, including the Ten Plus Two (10+2) programs. NEB has given affiliation to Durga Laxmi Secondary School to run 10+2 in the Computer Engineering program since 2015 AD. It is also offering Ten Plus two in Science, Management, Humanities, Law and Education. DLMS is dedicated to fostering an exceptional academic environment. Their outstanding faculty is committed to nurturing students' responsibility, moral integrity, and creative sensibility. Believing that today's children are tomorrow's citizens, DLMS provides a supportive environment that encourages students to realize their full potential.Durga Laxmi Secondary School offers moderate fee structures and scholarships for deserving and underprivileged students, ensuring that quality education is accessible to all. The qualified team of instructors is continuously supervised and guided by a group of academicians, social workers, and professionals from various fields. DLMS employs innovative teaching practices that prepare students to excel in a global context.The Faculty of Science at DLSS has been in existence since its establishment. The primary goal of it is to provide advanced and pragmatic in-depth knowledge of science to produce high-caliber science scholars. It aims to create a foundation for future doctors, engineers, agriculturists, forest officials, and scientists. To meet its goal, DLSS provides the best quality education, which helps to visualize the true potential of students in various fields of science. It was established by reputed and professional academicians in the field of Science who are committed to imparting a need-based quality education so as to ensure academic par excellence and attain outstanding results in the board exams. Our proficient and professional teachers deliver theory lectures along with practical demonstrations in our sophisticated and well-equipped modern laboratory to retain practical know-how for the students and strengthen their understanding.DLSS has grown significantly into an academic hub and one of the country's most prestigious science colleges, both within and outside the country. The value-driven and cultivated science scholars from DLSS are achieving unbeaten success in the global market.

name: Sajeelal Secondary School
description: Sajeelal Secondary School is an educational institution located in Sundarharaincha–6, Dulari, Morang. Established in 2022, B.S. provides academic programs from Nursery to Grade 12, offering continuous education from early childhood through the higher secondary level. The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and offers +2 programs in Science, Management, Humanities, and Education. In addition, Sajeelal Secondary School also offers a Diploma in Civil Engineering in affiliation with the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT).The school uses both English and Nepali as the medium of instruction, supporting students from diverse linguistic backgrounds. For Nursery admission, children must be at least three years old. Teaching and learning activities are planned to strengthen academic understanding, discipline, and positive learning behavior across all levels.The school organizes various academic and co-curricular events and programs throughout the academic year, encouraging student participation beyond classroom learning. Through its academic structure and technical education offerings, Sajeelal Secondary School supports students in developing the knowledge and skills required for further studies and professional pathways.Vision: To be established as a model school of the province, providing quality education in a clean, technology-friendly environment equipped with physical facilities.Mission:To be a model school capable of preparing self-reliant and skilled human resources by ensuring the effective management of modern education in a quality, technology-friendly, and clean environment.

name: Shree Secondary School
description: Shree Secondary School is located at Haklawari, Morang. It offers 10+2 programs under the affiliation of National Examination Board (NEB).

name: Shree Model Secondary School
description: Shree Model Secondary School, Baragajawa (Technical & Vocational Education), Brindaban-8, Rautahat, was established in 2004 B.S. as a community-based educational institution and is situated in Brindaban Municipality -08, Rautahat, Nepal. It is also a technical school.It is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education. It offers educational programs ranging from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to grade 10 (Secondary Education Examination, SEE), and Ten plus Two (Class 11 and 12) in the Education, Science, Arts, Management, and Civil streams. Shree Model Secondary School, Bargajawa (Technical & Vocational Education, Brindaban-08, Rautahat), offers education up to the Secondary level at moderate fees and provides scholarships for deserving students. More than 2416 students study each year.

name: Shree Jaldhar Kamaldev Model School
description: Shree Jaldhar Kamaldev Model School, located in Brahmapuri-1, Sarlahi, is an educational institution that provides instruction from the Nursery level through Grade 12. The school offers Education and Management streams in Grades 11 and 12 in affiliation with the National Examinations Board (NEB). Additionally, it provides technical training through its Diploma and Pre-Diploma programs in Computer Engineering, in affiliation with the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT).The teaching staff consists of well-trained professionals who utilize technology-based learning tools, such as projectors, to make lessons more engaging. Technical students benefit from a specialized On-the-Job Training (OJT) program that connects them with local businesses for real-world experience. The science and computer labs are fully equipped to facilitate practical experiments and enhance digital literacy, ensuring that students are prepared for both higher education and the professional world.The campus features a spacious playground for sports and various extracurricular activities, including music and dance. A well-stocked library is available for independent study and research. The school also maintains essential facilities, such as clean drinking water and separate toilets for boys, girls, and teachers, to ensure a hygienic environment. By organizing various school events and maintaining a healthy atmosphere, the institution focuses on the holistic development and well-being of every student.

name: Secondary School Tulsipur Center
description: Secondary School Tulsipur Center was established in 2027 BS (1970 AD) by local education enthusiast Narayan Prasad Rajora and others, with the support of Nand Bahadur Mall, then Regional Administrator of Rapti Anchal.Over the years, the school has seen significant upgrades. It received approval for class 8 in 2058 BS, class 9 in 2063 BS, class 10 in 2064 BS, and finally class 12 in 2073 BS. It currently offers classes up to grade 12.After a long period of underdevelopment, the school began to improve steadily in academic, physical, and managerial aspects starting from 2066 BS. Since then, it has gained increasing trust and support from parents and students.Teaching and LearningThe school offers classes from Nursery through Grade 10 in both English and Nepali. At the higher secondary level, it offers specialized programs:Grade 11-12 in Management (started in 2077 BS)Grade 9-12 in Electrical Engineering (started in 2073 BS)Grade 11-12 in ScienceTechnical and Vocational ProgramsThe school has expanded into practical education through the following CTEVT-affiliated courses:Three-Year Diploma Programs:Civil Engineering (started in 2075 BS)Architecture Engineering (started in 2079 BS)Information Technology,Geomatics Engineering,In addition to these core and technical programs, Secondary School Tulsipur Center also offers life-skills-based technical education in five other areas. In the academic year 2077/078, the school was included in Sidhi Sarkar's Chandrakala Project, and its implementation is currently underway.MissionTo prepare capable, competitive, and self-reliant citizens for building a prosperous nation based on socialist-oriented social justice.GoalTo develop into one of Nepal's leading model schools.ObjectivesTo develop a fully child-friendly school by bringing about overall improvements in the academic, physical, administrative, and managerial fields.To provide quality, life-skill-based, and employment-oriented education to the children of this region.To develop technical education and produce skilled, competent human resources with knowledge and practical abilities.

name: Janak Model Secondary School
description: Janak Model Secondary School is one of the oldest and most respected educational institutions in Gaindakot-5, Nawalpur. It is located in the beautiful Lumbini zone, near the birthplace of Gautam Buddha.The school was established in 2015 B.S. Many dedicated people, including intellectuals, head teachers, social workers, community members, and the school management committee, worked hard to start and build it. Among them, Late Surya Bhakta Adhikari (a former Member of Parliament) played a leading role. Much of the credit for founding the school goes to him and other pioneers.The school offers education in both Nepali and English, from Play Nursery to Class 12. It offers good facilities and a pleasant learning environment, making it very attractive to students and parents. The school's main goal is to provide quality education to children from all races, ethnic groups, and communities. Although it is a government school, it has earned a good reputation not only in Nepal but also beyond its borders.Janak Model Secondary School is a place where students and teachers from diverse nationalities and backgrounds study, work, and live together in a friendly, supportive atmosphere. All the teachers are highly committed to giving quality education. They perform very well in both classroom teaching and outdoor activities. The school runs its classes in a well-organized way and continues to work toward excellence in education.VisionTo spread the light of education.To provide quality education at an affordable fee.To create a sound educational environment.To create competitive, healthy manpower who can compete in their respective field.To provide free education to all classes who are deprived of gaining education due to poor economic conditions.Objectives of JMSSThe school's main motive is to provide quality education that can compete with others at the national and international levels and to produce civilized, healthy citizens for society and the nation.

name: Galkot Secondary School
description: The historical background of Shree Galkot Secondary School dates back to 2003 BS, when the first attempts to teach Sanskrit, ritual methods, and grammar of the Nepali language began in the area. Education enthusiasts, including Pandit Padma Pani Sharma, Pandit Shiva Prasad Dhakal, Pandit Ganesh Dutt Gautam, Raja Bharat Bam Malla, Mukhiya Khadga Singh Khatri, Mukhiya Vishnu Prasad Pandey, Ganesh Kumar Shrestha, and Kuldutt Upreti, took the initiative to establish "Gaumukhi Vidhyashram" under a pipal tree at Haatiya Bazaar, Ward No. 4, Rajara, as well as at the Mukhiya's residence. At that time, general Sanskrit education, ritual methods, Vedas, Chandi, Puranas, Rudri, and other subjects were taught there.In 2004 BS, following the advice of prominent figures from the "Jayatu Sanskritam" movement, such as Shri Bhadra Sharma, Rajeshwar Devkota, Kamal Raj Regmi, and Gopal Vaidya, the school was granted official status. Narishwar Sharma Upadhyay was brought from Nigalpani, Palpa, to teach Nepali grammar and serve as the head teacher, while Krishna Prasad Sharma, a writer for Raja Bharat Bam, was recruited as the mathematics teacher.In 2005 BS, with the recommendation of the Galkot Royal Palace, approval was obtained from the School Inspector Division Office in Kapilvastu, leading to the school's rebranding as "Gaumukhi Pathashala." The school was then relocated to its current site in Bohora's Thanti, where Galkot Secondary School now stands. Thus, 2005 BS is recognized as the official establishment year of the school.With support from the local community, essential materials and salaries were arranged, enabling the school to continuously improve its standards. In 2017 BS, it was upgraded to "Gaumukhi Middle School," and due to a growing interest in education among local residents, it was further elevated to "Gaumukhi High School" in 2022 BS.A merger occurred between Araniko Lower Secondary School in the neighboring village of Harichaur and Gaumukhi High School in Hatiya village. These two schools operated as "Galkot Secondary School" in Majhuwa Field, Ward No. 9 of Harichaur Village Panchayat from 2026 BS to 2027 BS. Subsequently, following guidance from the District Education Office in Baglung, Galkot Secondary School continued to operate in Hatiya, while Araniko Middle School remained in Harichaur under the name "Prithvi Namuna School."In an effort to further advance educational offerings, Galkot Secondary School received affiliation from the Higher Secondary Education Board in 2053 BS, allowing it to offer streams in Education, Humanities, and Commerce. Later, during the academic session of 2068 BS, a Science stream was also introduced.From 2060 BS, a special education program for deaf and speech-impaired students was launched, with instruction conducted in sign language; however, this program has been temporarily suspended due to various challenges.Beginning in 2070 BS, the school also started vocational and technical classes in Crop Science. Currently, instruction is provided for students from Grade 9 to Grade 12. In 2079 BS, the school launched the "Earn While You Learn" program targeting technical education.Since 2074 BS, Galkot Secondary School has been implementing the Model School Development Program. So far, seven buildings have been completed, including four academic buildings, one administrative building, and two additional structures.For educational management, classrooms, furniture, and educational and sports materials have been organized for early childhood classes. Additionally, free bus transportation has been arranged for students from the service area. Classes from Grade 1 to Grade 12 are conducted in both Nepali and English mediums.

name: Shree Surya Prakash Secondary School
description: Surya Prakash Secondary School is a community-based school located in Panchapuri, 44 km west of Birendranagar, Surkhet, in Karnali Province, Nepal. The school was founded in 2007 BS and has a long history of providing education to the local community.The school owes much of its growth to the efforts of local social workers like Mr. Yagya Bahadur BC, Lalu Shahi, Amar Bahadur Ramjali, Lilaram Chapain, along with the school's first principal, Khadga Bahadur Chand, and other staff members.Surya Prakash Secondary School was officially registered as a secondary school in 1984 AD (2041 BS). It received formal registration from the Ministry of Education in 2052 BS, allowing students to take the School Leaving Certificate (SLC) exams.Today, the school provides quality education from Nursery to Grade 12. It continues to focus on academic excellence and personal development to help shape the future of its students

name: Shree Vindhyavasini Secondary School
description: Shree Vindhyavasini Secondary School, located in Pokhara, Kaski District of Gandaki Province, was established on Bhadra 12, 2004 B.S. as a Primary School. The school was gradually upgraded to Lower Secondary in 2014 B.S., Secondary in 2018 B.S., and Higher Secondary level in 2057 B.S. Based on academic feasibility and the recommendation of the subject selection committee, Science and Management streams have been operated in Grades 11 and 12 since 2076 B.S.Guided by the school motto “Discipline and Dedication for Quality Education”, the school follows a structured and accountable management system. Clear TOR-based roles and responsibilities are assigned to the School Management Committee, teachers, and staff to ensure transparency, ownership, and effective academic and administrative operations.The school places strong emphasis on student leadership, responsibility, and holistic development. Students are encouraged to take leadership roles through organized systems, house-based activities, and participation in co-curricular and extra-curricular programs. Equal importance is given to arts, music, dance, sports, and creative activities to promote balanced growth.Academic quality enhancement remains a core focus. The school conducts regular subject-wise, class-wise, and level-wise result analysis after every examination to identify learning gaps and implement targeted improvement measures. Special academic initiatives, including Mission Mathematics, have been introduced to strengthen learning outcomes across grade levels.To support effective teaching and learning, the school has developed well-equipped learning facilities including science, computer, and mathematics laboratories, an e-library, departmental teacher rooms, a music room, and a first-aid room. Classrooms are supported with multimedia tools, and the overall learning environment is safe, organized, and student-friendly.The school also values collaboration, reflection, and shared learning. Since 2080 B.S., Shree Vindhyavasini Secondary School has welcomed educators, school leaders, and education stakeholders from across Nepal for observation and exchange of best practices, reinforcing its role as a learning-oriented and forward-looking institution.With a continued focus on discipline, quality, and inclusiveness, Shree Vindhyavasini Secondary School is steadily progressing toward its vision of becoming a model community school of Nepal.

name: Shree Padma Secondary School
description: Shree Padma Secondary School was established as Bhadgaon English School in 1981 B.S. The school is first Pioneer High School in Bhaktapur. The school is affiliated to National Examination Board (NEB) and offers ten plus two (10+2) program in Humanities, Management, Education and Civil Engineering. Shree Padma Secondary School got approval from NEB to run Ten Plus two in Civil Engineering in 2015 AD.The school has been providing quality education to the students from the lowest strata to highest strata family according to the need of time, society and nation. The school is conveniently located in the Durbar square, to the north of the white gate, of Bhaktapur.Mission and VisionShree Padma Secondary School aims to provide students with quality education instilling a sense of responsibility and self reliant in the students through modern teaching technique.Shree Padma Secondary School envisions to be the platform of learning for the students who desire to be golbally competitive.

name: Shree Rastriya Ramaniya Adarsha Secondary School
description: Shree Rastriya Ramaniya Adarsha Secondary School is located in Shivasatakshi Municipality-11, Jhapa District, in Koshi Province. The school is situated in the Dudhe Bazaar area, approximately 5 kilometers west of the Kankai River, along the East-West Highway. It offers classes from Nursery to Grade 12. In 2074 BS, the school introduced English-medium education for all grades. The school offers Plus Two programs in the Education and Management streams, affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB). Currently, around 1,300 students are enrolled. The facilities include permanent buildings, a science lab, computer resources, and clean drinking water. With the support of teachers, guardians, and the local community, the school is dedicated to providing quality education to its students from Nursery through Grade 12.Historical BackgroundThe school was established on Magh 17, 2026 BS, by local social workers and education-loving guardians who wanted to bring education to the people of this region. At that time, the area faced poverty and a lack of education. The school was first named Shree Nepal Rashtriya Ramaniya Aadarsha High School.In its early years, the school faced many difficulties. After SLC examinations were conducted twice, it was downgraded to the lower secondary level under the National Education System Plan, 2028 BS. From 2030 BS to 2037 BS, the school operated classes 4 to 7 as a lower secondary institution.During this time, the school had no land or building of its own. In 2028 BS, education lover Til Bahadur Kadariya donated 6 kaththa of land free of cost. A 5-room building was built on this land, and classes started there.With the efforts of local education advocates and social workers, the school was upgraded again. Class 8 was started in 2037 BS. On Magh 17, 2040 BS, the then Home Minister, Padma Sundar Lawati, inaugurated the secondary-level facilities at this school. Since then, thousands of students have studied up to secondary level here.In 2055 BS, Satasidham Higher Secondary School began operations in its building. In 2060 BS, this higher secondary school was merged with this school. Since then, the school has been running as Shree Rastriya Ramaniya Adarsha Secondary School. The school has also been a resource center school since 2042 BS.For many years, the school faced a shortage of proper buildings. After 2061 BS, major construction began. During the time of Head Teacher Umanath Dahal, with support from the School Management Committee, three permanent buildings with 13 rooms were built.In 2073/74 BS, under the Head Teacher, Kali Prasad Rijal, a 2-room building was added with grants of Rs. 16 lakh from the Education Department and Rs. 5 lakh from school funds. In 2078 BS, another 2-room building was built with a grant of Rs. 16 lakh. Under the President's Educational Reform Program, a 4-room building has been completed in 2079 BS. Another room is being built with school funds.

name: Shree Chandra Model Secondary School
description: Shree Chandra Model Secondary School, established in 2013 B.S., is a model community school located at the heart of Bode Barsain Municipality, Ward No. 5, Barsain Bazar, easily accessible from all parts of the municipality. The school was founded on 161 Bighas of land generously donated by the late Shatrughna Prasad Singh and named in memory of his late mother, Chandra Wati. It provides value-based education up to Class XII and began offering the 11/12 program in 2055 B.S., currently offering two streams: General and Technical. The General stream includes programs in Management, Education, Humanities, and Science, while the Technical stream offers a program in Computer Engineering.Committed to providing quality education, the school focuses on students’ academic growth and preparing them for higher education. Recently, English-medium instruction has been introduced for classes 1 to 5, making learning more accessible. The school’s vision is to foster a culture of education in science, management, and education studies while preparing skilled manpower for institutions, factories, banks, NGOs, INGOs, and other demand-driven sectors.

name: Shree Shitaladevi Community Secondary School
description: Shree Shitaladevi Community Secondary School was formerly known as Matepani Primary School until its name was changed on 19th Poush 2059 B.S. Initially, the school had a small seven-room building with tin roofs. After the Gyan Mahayagya fundraising, a two-storey building with additional classrooms was constructed. Over the years, further infrastructure was developed through community initiatives, including new classroom buildings, a water tank, a health treatment room, and the establishment of a Saraswati Temple within the school premises.In 2061 B.S., responding to community demand, the school began offering English-medium education from Nursery to Grade 3 at affordable fees. Initially staffed by a mix of government-appointed and private teachers, a new grade was added each year. By 2067 B.S., the school became part of the SLC examination system, achieving a 100% pass rate and gaining recognition as a model community school in Kaski District.Management and science streams were later introduced to further broaden academic opportunities. Admissions are based on level assessments to ensure quality education.Under the leadership of Principal Mr. Baburam Adhikari since 2072 B.S., the school has achieved numerous academic accomplishments. Alumni have gone on to pursue higher education and hold positions such as doctors, engineers, lawyers, and other roles in the Nepal Government. The school also encourages excellence through various endowment programs and awards for students pursuing higher studies.Recognition and AwardsThe school has received several awards for its good work. It was honored with the National Education Award in both 2073 BS and 2075 BS. It has also received recognition at the provincial level for its contribution to education.

name: Kanya Mandir Secondary School
description: Kanya Mandir Secondary School, established in 2003 BS, was founded on a strong belief in the value of girls' education. Its creators aimed to establish an institution that would prioritize and foster girls' empowerment through quality education. Since it opened, the school has focused on excellence, nurturing students' intellectual and personal growth. As the second girls' school in Kathmandu, it has maintained a well-deserved reputation for providing high-quality education for over 75 years. Throughout its extensive history, the school has remained committed to teaching excellence and ensuring the well-being of each student, while continually adapting to the evolving needs of contemporary society.Tragically, the school's historic building was destroyed by a massive earthquake in 2072 BS. Nevertheless, with economic grants and assistance from USAID, the school was rebuilt into a new, exemplary institution. It has since implemented innovative policies and programs to improve educational quality. Furthermore, the school has embraced new technology, including smart boards, projectors, and interactive whiteboards, in every classroom to enhance the learning experience. Kanya Mandir Secondary School is proud to announce its designation as an exemplary school by the Kathmandu Metropolitan City, a testament to its unwavering commitment to educational excellence and innovation.The school provides a child-friendly environment, supported by a team of qualified and experienced teachers. Currently, Kanya Mandir Secondary School offers classes from pre-primary (Play Group/Nursery/KG) up to grade 12. The school's educational environment is significantly enhanced by the support of numerous generous and helpful individuals. With their assistance, the school has also been able to provide scholarships for underprivileged and talented students. Kanya Mandir Secondary School also arranges periodic subject-wise visits. The school maintains ongoing communication with parents to solicit necessary support and feedback, and it hosts an excellent annual parent honors program.

name: Shree Secondary School Dudhiawa
description: Shree Secondary School is located in Dudhiawa, Fatuwa Bijaypur-10, Rautahat district, in Madhesh Province. The school serves as an important educational institution in the region, providing quality education to students from the local community and surrounding areas. Under the leadership of Principal Rabindra Prasad Sah, the school has been dedicated to mentoring students and helping them build strong academic foundations. The school is conveniently situated near several notable places, including Kolahabi, Garza, Kahariya, and Himalibas, making it accessible to students from neighboring areas. It plays a significant role in community development, especially by preparing students for the modern technological landscape through its focus on programming and engineering.Shree Secondary School offers classes from basic level up to Grade 12 and is affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB), providing Ten Plus Two programs in Science, Management, Education, Humanities, and Computer Engineering. The Computer Engineering program is open to students in grades 9 to 12 who have a strong interest in science, technology, and problem-solving. It is ideal for students who have completed the necessary prerequisites in mathematics and science and are motivated to pursue a career in engineering or related fields. This program helps students develop practical skills and prepares them for higher education and future careers in technology.With its focus on both general and technical education, Shree Secondary School continues to play a key role in fostering academic growth and technical skills in the Rautahat district. The school is committed to providing students with the knowledge and skills they need to succeed in their chosen fields. Through its dedicated faculty and supportive learning environment, the school helps students prepare for higher education and meaningful careers.

name: Resunga Secondary School
description: Shree Resunga Secondary School is a well-established community school located in Resunga Municipality Ward No. 2, Tamghas, Gulmi. Established in 2025 B.S., the school has built a strong academic legacy over the decades and currently offers education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12 through English medium instruction. Over the years, the school has steadily expanded its academic programs to meet the educational needs of students from diverse social and economic backgrounds.At the foundational level, the school operates a school-based Early Childhood Development program aimed at preparing young children for formal schooling. Conducted in a child-friendly and supportive learning environment, the program helps children develop early learning habits and social skills before entering primary education. Approximately 70 children benefit from this program each year under the guidance of a dedicated ECD facilitator.At the primary level, the school provides English medium education using teaching approaches aligned with students’ interests and learning capacities. Continuous Student Assessment practices are planned to be fully implemented to ensure regular monitoring of students’ academic progress and overall development. Due to high student enrollment, the need for additional class divisions has been identified; however, financial constraints have limited further expansion at this level. Computer education is introduced within the primary grades to support the development of basic digital literacy from an early stage.At the secondary level, the school offers education from Grade 9 to Grade 12 through English medium instruction. Teaching and learning at this level emphasize academic rigor, subject-wise improvement, and the effective use of technology in education. Analysis of past SEE results indicates that the school has consistently achieved a strong pass rate and satisfactory average academic performance, particularly at Grade 10.
