Continuous efforts are being made to further enhance subject-wise achievement in the coming years.In addition to general secondary education, the school offers technical education in Civil Engineering as part of its academic diversification strategy. As envisioned in the School Improvement Plan 2069 B.S., the Civil Engineering program was approved by the Government of Nepal and launched from Grade 9 in the academic session 2073 B.S. Approval to operate Grades 11 and 12 was subsequently granted by Resunga Municipality in 2075 B.S. The program has demonstrated strong academic outcomes, including a 100 percent pass rate in the Grade 12 examination in 2078 B.S. Currently, 98 students are enrolled in the Civil Engineering stream across Grades 9 to 12.Most students at the school come from economically disadvantaged and lower- to middle-income families. The student population represents diverse social and ethnic backgrounds, contributing to an inclusive and equitable learning environment. Parental engagement is a notable strength of the school, with approximately 75 percent of parents actively participating in school activities and school development initiatives.Geographically, the school is situated at an altitude of approximately 4,000 feet above sea level in a peaceful and academically conducive setting. Its proximity to the district headquarters, administrative offices, marketplaces, and road networks ensures convenient access for students from surrounding areas. Through its comprehensive academic offerings, technical education programs, and strong community involvement, Shree Resunga Secondary School continues to play a vital role in delivering quality and career-oriented education in Gulmi District.

name: Shree Nepal Rastriya Namuna Secondary School
description: Shree Nepal Rastriya Namuna Secondary School is listed at Tamghas, Resunga-2, Gulmi.

name: Shree Gautam Buddha Secondary School
description: Shree Gautam Buddha Secondary School is located in Gorusinge, Ward No. 2 of Buddha Bhumi Municipality, in the northern part of Kapilvastu district. The school was established in 2033 BS as a primary school through the efforts of education lovers, including the late Keshav Pratap Rana, Jhalak Bikram Shah, and Khamba Bahadur Shah. It received approval for class 1 on Magh 12, 2034 BS. At that time, the school had about 2 bigha 10 kattha of land, a two-room building, 57 students, and two teachers.The school expanded to the lower secondary level in 2037 BS, with class 6 starting that year. Full approval for the primary level was received on Asoj 2, 2039 BS, and permission to run lower secondary classes was granted on Mangsir 20, 2044 BS. After overcoming challenges, including a major fire in 2045 BS that affected the area, secondary level classes began with class 9 in 2050 BS. Permission from the Regional Education Directorate, Pokhara, was received on Poush 3, 2051 BS. In 2053 BS, the school sent its first batch of 22 students for the SLC examination, achieving a 68.15 percent pass rate.In 2064 BS, the school received approval from the Higher Secondary Education Board on Shrawan 10 to run classes 11 and 12 in Management, Education, and Humanities streams. To meet society's changing needs, the school introduced Civil Engineering as a technical stream in 2073 BS. Today, the school has a strong physical infrastructure, including a two-story building with 42 rooms and a science laboratory constructed with support from the Government of India. It continues to serve as an important educational institution in the region. Gautam Buddha Secondary School was selected as a model school under the School Sector Development Plan (2073–2080). The school was officially recognized through a notice published in Gorkhapatra on Asar 6, 2076 BS, in accordance with the decision of the Government of Nepal.

name: Saraswoti Secondary School, Vidyanagar
description: The school is committed to evolving with global educational standards, recently introducing English-medium instruction starting from Grade 6 to better prepare students for modern challenges. At the secondary level, the institution offers a diverse range of streams, including Science, Management, Education, and Humanities. The school stands out for its Technical Stream, specifically offering a specialized program in Plant Science (Agriculture) from Grade 9 students, which is regarded as one of the finest technical offerings in the province.The school's infrastructure is designed to support both academic and physical growth. The school features modern facilities, including modern computer and science laboratories. A well-stocked library serves as a resource hub for research and self-study, while a spacious playground allows for a wide array of sports and extracurricular activities. The school prides itself on maintaining a safe and disciplined environment, managed by a team of highly skilled, experienced, and dedicated educational professionals.The school maintains a strong focus on holistic development. Beyond the classroom, it emphasizes the importance of technology and transparency, utilizing digital platforms and communication systems to keep parents informed of their children's progress. Through its blend of traditional values and modern pedagogical approaches, Saraswati Secondary School continues to fulfill its mission of empowering the next generation of leaders, thinkers, and skilled professionals in the Dang district.As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Saraswoti Secondary School Vidyanagar has 1038 enrolled students.

name: Deep Narayan Aadarsh Model Secondary School
description: Deep Narayan Aadarsh Model Secondary School, located in Parsa, is a well-established educational institution founded in 2028 BS. Recognized as a model school, it offers a comprehensive learning environment for students from Nursery through Grade 12. The school is affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB) for its Plus Two programs in Education and Management. Additionally, it provides technical education through a Diploma in Civil Engineering program, which is affiliated with the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT).The school emphasizes the holistic development of its students by combining theoretical knowledge with practical application. To support this goal, the institution features well-equipped computer and science laboratories, along with a well-stocked library that serves as a resource hub for research and self-study. Also, to keep up with digital advancements, the school offers free Wi-Fi and internet access so students can use online educational resources effectively.Deep Narayan Aadarsh Model Secondary School employs modern teaching materials and innovative methods to make lessons engaging and easy to understand. Beyond the classroom, students participate in regular educational tours and observation visits. The school also offers specialized entrepreneurship training to cultivate business skills and promote a mindset of self-employment. For those in the Education faculty, specific training in preparing instructional materials is provided to equip students for future teaching careers.Student well-being is prioritized through a dedicated counseling room and well-facilitated hostel accommodations for those requiring residential services. The school fosters a vibrant atmosphere by organizing various events and celebrating diverse festivals, ensuring a balanced approach to academic and cultural growth.

name: Shree Babuji Ray Junai Thakur Secondary School Fulbariya
description: Shree Babuji Ray Junai Thakur Secondary School is located in Fulbariya, Mirchaiya-8, Siraha district. Established in 2012 BS, the school has been serving the local community for many years and currently offers classes from Nursery to Grade 12. The school provides education up to the higher secondary level with programs affiliated to the National Examinations Board (NEB), allowing students to choose from different streams based on their interests and career goals. The school offers Management and Education in grades 11 and 12.The school is equipped with modern facilities to support quality learning. Smart boards are used in classrooms to make lessons more interactive and engaging through visual presentations. A well-equipped computer lab helps students develop digital skills from an early age, preparing them for higher studies and future careers. The school also has a team of well-trained, qualified teachers dedicated to guiding students effectively in their studies.Beyond academics, the school focuses on students' overall development through a range of extracurricular activities. Quiz competitions help students test their knowledge, while football and other sports activities promote physical health and teamwork. The school also maintains a green, healthy environment, believing that clean, natural surroundings support both physical well-being and effective learning.

name: Neel Barahi Secondary School
description: Neel Barahi Secondary School (NBSS), established in 2010 BS/ 1954 A.D., has completed its glorious 70 years in the field of educational excellence. The school has started serving higher secondary level students since 2068 B.S. with an objective to produce productive, critical, creative, and morally responsible students with competitive and highly professional capabilities.The environment of Neel Bahari is quiet, in Kalimati, a convenient location well connected by Kathmandu's reliable, frequent public transport system. It is located just behind Kalimati vegetable market and next to Neel Barahi temple.Vision of NBSSThe vision is to deliver excellence in teaching and student learning, and to customize their learning.Features of NBSSICT-based teaching-learning facilities.Teaching in a friendly environment.Student-centered classroom environmentFrequent extracurricular activitiesGood results in games and sports.Scholarship scheme for meritorious, needy, and students from remote areas.Free sanitary pads are available for girls.Team of well-experienced professional teachers.

name: Jana Jagriti Secondary School, Bhiman
description: Jana Jagriti Secondary School, located in Bhiman, Kamalamai-9, Sindhuli, has served the community since its establishment in 2027 B.S. The school provides an integrated academic structure from Grade 1 through Grade 12, offering streams in Management, Humanities, and Education at the higher secondary level. This comprehensive curriculum allows students to pursue diverse academic paths within a single institution.The learning experience is supported by functional facilities such as specialized Science, Computer, and IT laboratories where students apply theoretical knowledge to practical tasks. Interactive smart boards in classrooms help simplify complex concepts through multimedia engagement, while CCTV monitoring ensures a secure and disciplined environment. These technical resources work together to uphold standards of academic integrity and safety throughout the school day.A dedicated transportation system and a cafeteria serving hygienic meals help meet students’ daily logistical needs. This structured environment extends to experiential learning through educational tours and extra-curricular activities that provide practical skills beyond the classroom. The academic experience is further balanced by school-wide programs and festival celebrations, which encourage cultural engagement and social development among the students.

name: Shree Damkada Secondary School
description: Shree Damkada Secondary School is a community school located in the peaceful surroundings of Madiphat in Tansen-09, Palpa. The school was established in 2013 B.S. and has its own land spread over approximately 80 ropanis. This spacious campus provides students with a calm and supportive environment for learning.The school was recognized as a model school from 2074 B.S. In 2018, it received ISO 21001 certification, which reflects its commitment to quality education.Damkada School offers classes from Nursery to Grade 12. At the higher secondary level, students can choose from different streams:ScienceManagementEducationFrom Grade 9 onward, students can also study Civil Engineering in the technical stream through Grade 12. Currently, around 200 students are enrolled in the +2 programs.The school is known for its integrated education for blind students, providing equal learning opportunities to all. The campus has a peaceful and friendly atmosphere that supports focused study.Modern facilities include a recording studio and ICT-friendly classrooms equipped with technology for better learning. These resources help students gain practical skills and stay up to date with modern teaching methods.The school has a strong record in sports, especially in the Presidential Cup interschool games. Most of the time, Damkada School has secured first place, underscoring the importance of both academics and extracurricular activities.With its own land, dedicated teachers, modern facilities, and focus on all-around development, Shree Damkada Secondary School continues to serve as an important educational institution in Palpa district.

name: Mahadev Secondary School
description: Mahadev Secondary School is listed at Damkada, Tansen-9, Palpa.

name: Shree Jana Jyoti Secondary School, Baddichaur
description: Shree Jana Jyoti Secondary School is a public school located in Baddichaur, Barahatal Rural Municipality-5, Surkhet district, within Karnali province.The school was established on Baisakh 30, 2029 BS, under the name "Nepal Rashtriya Primary School." Later, from 2043 BS, it started operating under its current name, Shree Jana Jyoti Secondary School.According to local intellectuals and social workers, the school was founded by the late Shri Ratna Bahadur Thapa, with Shri Rajaram Garja serving as the founding head teacher. Many other local intellectuals and social workers also played important roles in establishing the school.The school was initially started with class 1 only. Gradually, classes 2 and 3 were added. In 2032 BS, the school received approval for the primary level. From 2038 BS, lower secondary level classes began. Nine years later, in 2052 BS, the school participated in the SLC examination for the first time. From 2054 BS onward, it also began offering +2-level classes. In the technical education sector, the school has been running a 15-month Agriculture JTA (Junior Technical Assistant) program with government subsidy since 2067 BS. From 2071 BS, the 15-month Agriculture JTA was upgraded and extended to 18 months in the Plant Science/Animal Science streams. Currently, the programs are running as an 18-month Agriculture and Veterinary JTA.From 2071 BS, a 3-year Diploma in Agriculture program has also started. Since 2080 BS, earthquake-affected children have been provided with 3-year Agriculture Diploma in Plant, and from the next year, 3-year Livestock programs will also run.These programs are being implemented to further increase skilled manpower and agricultural production. Additional agriculture-related programs are also being run to make them more effective and community-oriented.VisionTo produce skilled and capable technical human resources.MissionTo provide quality technical education.To give special emphasis on practical learning.GoalsTo bring positive change in the knowledge, skills, and attitudes of trainees.To help trainees become self-employed and self-reliant.To reduce the problem of unemployment.To bring positive change in living standards by making maximum use of local resources.To change society's perception toward technical education.

name: Laxmi Secondary School Jagatpur
description: Located in the serene area of Jagatpur, approximately 19.2 km southwest of Bharatpur, Laxmi Secondary School has been serving the community since its establishment in 2025 BS. Over the years, it has evolved from a primary school into an institution offering education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) through Grade 12. The school follows the National Curriculum of Nepal and offers academic streams in Science, Management, and Education at the 10+2 level, as well as CTEVT courses.The school features highly qualified and experienced teachers who are committed to providing quality education. The goal of the school is to nurture students to become responsible, caring, and patriotic citizens with strong spiritual and moral values. Teaching methods are enhanced by audiovisual aids, and students' learning needs are met through well-equipped science and computer labs and a library.The school is situated in a peaceful location adjacent to the Kerunga River, providing a conducive environment for learning. It is built on 2 bighas, 5 kattha, and 7 dhur of registered land. The campus boasts modern facilities, including renovated classrooms, a science laboratory, an assembly hall, and a dormitory for boarding students. Additionally, the school provides clean drinking water and has a wire mesh fence around the campus for safety and security.Laxmi Secondary School provides an all-rounded education that focuses on academic excellence and character development. The school aims to empower students to excel in life and contribute positively to society.

name: Shree Sahid Jagat Prakash Jung Shah Sanskrit Secondary School
description: Shree Sahid Jagat Prakash Jung Shah Sanskrit Secondary School received official approval for its secondary curriculum in 2055 B.S. and has since evolved to offer a comprehensive education that bridges the gap between ancient wisdom and modern academic requirements.The school’s academic journey is marked by a commitment to versatile learning. Since 2060 BS, the curriculum has integrated core subjects like English, Mathematics, and Science alongside Sanskrit and Nepali. To meet contemporary global standards, the school transitioned to an English-medium instruction model from Nursery to Grade 10 in 2063 BS. Furthermore, since 2073 BS, it has provided a specialized residential program for students to master Sanskrit grammar, literature, and Karmakand (ritual studies), utilizing modern audio-visual technology and meditation to enhance the learning experience.Today, the school is home to over 750 students, providing residential facilities for those in Grades 6 to 10 to ensure educational access for children from remote regions. The school's core philosophy is built upon values-based education, blending disciplined traditional teachings with modern scientific knowledge. The school is dedicated to nurturing self-reliant, ethical, and responsible citizens who carry the pride of Nepali identity while being fully prepared for the challenges of the 21st century.

name: Laxmi Secondary School
description: Laxmi Secondary School is listed at Devighat, Bidur-5, Nuwakot.

name: Janata Secondary School, Harkapur
description: Janata Secondary School, established in 2018 B.S., is located in Gaindakot-12, Harkpur, Nawalpur. The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and offers an educational pathway from Nursery through Grade 12. It features specialized academic tracks in Hotel Management and Computer Science.The school is staffed by a team of well-qualified and trained teachers who employ modern instructional techniques. Classrooms are equipped with projectors to enhance technology-based learning, making the educational experience more visual and interactive for students. To support practical competencies, Janata Secondary School has a Computer Lab and a specialized Hotel Management Lab, which provide students with hands-on training in digital literacy, culinary arts, and hospitality operations within professional-like environments.In addition to academics, the school promotes holistic growth through various extracurricular activities and student-led organizations. A spacious playground is available for sports and outdoor learning, while clubs such as the Nepal Scouts help students develop discipline and leadership skills. For student welfare, the school offers a hygienic canteen and maintains inclusive, disability-friendly, and child-friendly sanitation facilities. Through regular assessments and a commitment to high-quality instruction, Janata Secondary School maintains a consistent academic record and frequently organizes events to foster a well-rounded learning environment.

name: Shree Himalaya Dandapani Neupane Secondary School
description: Shree Himalaya Dandapani Neupane Secondary School is a community-based educational institution situated in Champanagar, Bharatpur Metropolitan City-13, Chitwan. Located approximately 1.5 kilometers south of the Gitanagar market, the school serves the academic needs of the Champanagar, Ujjwalnagar, and Prithvinagar communities.The school provides a comprehensive academic structure from Nursery through Grade 12. At the higher secondary level, students can enroll in the Management stream. Furthermore, the school offers technical education through a Diploma in Agriculture (Plant Science) program, affiliated with the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT). To complement its formal curriculum, the school organizes various extracurricular activities and programs designed to support student engagement and development.The school’s origins date back to 2037 B.S. (1980 A.D.), emerging from a period of heightened social and educational awareness in the region. It was established through the collective initiative of local education enthusiasts, including Dandapani Neupane, Guruprasad Ghimire, Shikharnath Subedi, Shashi Kiran Regmi, and Pushparaj Jamarkattel. While initially proposed as "Trishakti Secondary School," the institution began its operations as "Sthaniya Bikash Prathamik Pathshala" on Chaitra 11, 2037 B.S. The development of the school’s infrastructure was made possible through community-led efforts and local contributions, which facilitated the acquisition of land and the establishment of facilities for primary, lower secondary, and secondary education.

name: Ambika Secondary School
description: Ambika Secondary School is listed at Aahale-8, Gorkha.

name: Shree Navajagrit Secondary School
description: Nava Jagrit Secondary School, located in Tilahar, Modi-6, Parbat, was established in 2023 B.S. The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and offers education from Nursery through Grade 12. At the higher secondary level, it provides specialized streams in Science, Management, and Education, as well as a technical program in Civil Engineering for students in Grades 9 to 12.The school emphasizes an interactive learning environment by integrating smart boards into its classrooms and maintaining dedicated Science and Computer Labs for hands-on learning experiences. These facilities are supported by experienced teachers who provide structured guidance and subject expertise. To ensure every student's success, the institution provides supplementary classes for those needing additional academic support, while a well-equipped library serves as a resource center for research and independent study.In addition to academic instruction, Nava Jagrit Secondary School promotes holistic growth through student-led organizations, including the Nepal Scouts, along with various sports and extracurricular programs. The school also offers reliable transportation to ensure safe and convenient commutes for students in the local and surrounding areas. By combining diverse academic and technical offerings with modern learning tools, the institution provides a supportive environment focused on students' overall development.

name: Shree Moti Secondary School
description: Shree Moti Secondary School is listed at Tilahar, Modi-6, Parbat.

name: Shree Narad Aadarsha Secondary School
description: Shree Narad Aadarsha Secondary School is located in Ward No. 4 of Chaudandigadhi Municipality, in the eastern region of Udayapur district. The school was established on Magh 22, 2028 BS. From its establishment to the present day, the school has overcome various challenges and has now completed 49 years of its journey. In its early days, the school struggled with shortages of students, manpower, financial resources, and physical infrastructure. With the contribution and support of local guardians, education lovers, intellectuals, and stakeholders, the school has successfully reached its current mature stage.In 2045 BS, the school began operating as a secondary school through private support. It received secondary-level approval in 2052 BS. Four years later, in 2056 BS, the school obtained affiliation from the then Higher Secondary Education Board and started running classes 11 and 12. Since 2057 BS, a residential program for the hearing impaired has also been operating.From 2073 BS, with approval from the Ministry of Education, the school started teaching Civil Engineering under the vocational and technical stream from class 9. Currently, with permission from the Education Branch of Chaudandigadhi Municipality, Beltar, one class 12 batch has been completed. The main objective of this school is to provide quality, practical, and skill-based education in a simple and accessible manner to indigenous communities, squatters, Dalits, and underprivileged children living in this area. If the various problems that arise from time to time can be resolved, the school will be able to fulfill the purpose for which it was established. Although there is a lack of adequate infrastructure to make this school an outstanding institution in the region, the goal is to improve existing facilities and make the school a center of attraction for students, as per the targets outlined in the School Improvement Plan (SIP).

name: Shree Malikarjun Secondary School
description: Shree Malikarjun Secondary School is a public educational institution located in Dhap, Mahakali Municipality-7, Darchula district. The school was established on Jestha 22, 2022 BS (1966 AD) by residents, social workers, and education enthusiasts who recognized the need for stable, accessible education in the region.The school began its journey as a middle school. In 2040 BS (1984 AD), it was upgraded to a secondary school. Later in 2065 BS, it became a higher secondary school, starting classes 11 and 12 with an Education faculty.On Ashoj 1, 2073 BS, two other local schools—Shree Malikarjun Primary School and Shree Malikarjun Higher Secondary School, both in Dhap—were merged into this institution. Since then, the school has been providing uninterrupted education from Nursery to grade 12.In 2070 BS, following the Government of Nepal's policy to establish schools with technical and vocational streams, this school was selected to offer a Diploma in Civil Engineering under the technical stream from grade 9. Currently, the school runs both general education and technical (engineering) classes from grades 9 to 12.In 2075 BS, the school was selected for the Model School Development Program by the Government of Nepal, Ministry of Education. Since then, it has been operating under the Model School Development Master Plan.VisionThe vision of Malikarjun Secondary School is to provide quality education at affordable fees for all students. The school offers both the regular stream and the civil engineering stream from class 9 to 12, preparing students for higher education and successful careers.It aims to develop students who are knowledgeable, skilled, and responsible. The school helps learners excel academically, pursue their personal goals, and make positive contributions to society.Malikarjun Secondary School aspires to be a center of learning and growth in the Darchula region. In this environment, every student gets the opportunity to discover their abilities and reach their full potential.MissionThe mission of Malikarjun Secondary School is to provide quality education that is accessible and affordable for all students. The school focuses on developing both academic knowledge and practical skills in every learner.It is dedicated to shaping well-rounded students who are knowledgeable, responsible, and confident. The school aims to help students think critically, solve problems effectively, and work toward achieving their personal goals.Malikarjun Secondary School strives to create a supportive and inspiring learning environment. In this environment, students can explore their potential, grow in all aspects of life, and learn to make positive contributions to their community and society.Motto"Learning Today, Leading Tomorrow"Encourage a lifelong pursuit of knowledge and personal growth. Inspire students to apply their learning responsibly, excel in their endeavors, and contribute positively to society and the nation’s development.

name: Janasewa Model Secondary School
description: Janasewa Model Secondary School is located in Rangsi, Paribartan-2, Rolpa. Established in 2017 BS, the school offers classes from Nursery to Grade 12. Affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB), it provides Ten Plus Two programs in Science, Management, Humanities, and Education. The school also offers technical programs under CTEVT, including a Diploma in Civil Engineering, Pre-Diploma in Computer Engineering (Computer Sub-Overseer), and a Diploma in Forestry. The school has a team of skilled, qualified, and experienced teachers from primary to secondary level, many of whom hold M.Phil degrees, who use effective methods to help students understand lessons clearly. The school operates in a new building with fresh management arrangements, providing a well-organized and comfortable learning environment. From Early Childhood Development (ECD) and KG to Grade 5, all classes are conducted in English medium, which helps young learners build strong English language skills from an early age and prepares them for higher grades. The school maintains a disciplined and child-friendly atmosphere where students feel safe, respected, and treated with kindness.Regular classroom-based extracurricular activities are organized to support physical, mental, social, and emotional development, with students participating in sports, arts, and other creative programs. Additional classes are arranged for both outstanding students and those who need extra help, ensuring that no child is left behind. The school conducts regular weekly and monthly tests to track student progress and ensure steady academic growth throughout the year. Classrooms are equipped with smart boards and projectors to make lessons more interactive and engaging, and CCTV cameras are installed in every classroom to maintain discipline and ensure student safety. The school provides spacious classrooms, a well-stocked library, a science laboratory, a computer lab, Wi-Fi internet, clean drinking water taps, a playground, a garden, and sufficient toilets. For young children from ECD, KG to Grade 5, the school provides play equipment such as swings, rings, seesaws, and chin-up bars to make learning enjoyable.Regular educational tours are organized to historical, religious, and geographical places in Nepal, helping students learn outside the classroom through real-world experiences. Through regular extracurricular activities, students have successfully won prizes and national positions in sports at the rural municipality, provincial, and national levels. Separate hostel facilities are available for boys and girls who need accommodation, providing a safe, comfortable, and supportive living environment for students from distant areas. Special scholarships are awarded based on GPA to poor, meritorious, conflict-affected, and students from outside the district, making quality education accessible to all.

name: Dahu Secondary School
description: Dahu Secondary School is a community-oriented educational institution situated in Sunapati 4, Ramechhap. Established in 2018 B.S. (1961 A.D.), the school emphasizes equitable access to education and structured learning. It provides residential facilities primarily for students from outside the local area, with a well-managed hostel that offers a safe, disciplined living environment. This arrangement allows close supervision and supports the holistic development of students from diverse socio-cultural and geographical backgrounds.The school has a strong track record of academic excellence, as evidenced by its consistent performance in the Secondary Education Examination (SEE), with an average GPA of 3.76 in SEE 2081 B.S. Previously, some students achieved a perfect 4.0 GPA. Currently, students from 24 districts across Nepal are enrolled, underscoring the school’s expanding educational reach.The academic framework incorporates technology, moral education, and cultural values into everyday lessons. A key feature of its curriculum is that the Computer Engineering course, offered from Grade 9 to Grade 12, provides students with technical expertise and prepares them for the digital age. A wide range of co-curricular activities enrich classroom learning, including book talks, general knowledge sessions, daily reflections on values, documentary screenings, and project-based learning. The school encourages students to participate in presentations, debates, public speaking, and subject-specific club activities to enhance their diverse learning abilities. Additionally, virtual classes and guest lectures supplement traditional classroom instruction.A comprehensive continuous assessment system is in place, utilizing formative evaluations, unit and terminal examinations, assignment and project-based assessments, e-portfolio documentation, and performance reviews. The school emphasizes individual mentoring, academic monitoring, regular feedback, and remedial support as part of its instructional approach.Dahu Secondary School also offers a variety of extracurricular programs, including sports activities, cultural events, leadership development initiatives, counseling sessions, and structured interaction programs. Community engagement activities and opportunities for student participation in institutional events foster social awareness and collaborative learning beyond the classroom.VisionTo provide quality rural education.

name: Amar Secondary School Bhingri
description: Amar Secondary School was introduced in 2028 B.S in Bhingri-3, of Pyuthan District. Higher Secondary Education was started from 2056 B.S. Amar Campus was introduced in 2063 B.S and now it runs 3 Yr-Bachelor in Education.Contact AddressAmar Secondary School/ Amar CampusBhingri, Pyuthan

name: Bhanu Secondary School
description: Bhanu Secondary School is listed at Upalla Bhingri, Swargadwari-3, Pyuthan.

name: Latinath Model Secondary School, Chaupata
description: Latinath Model Secondary School is a community-based educational institution located in Chaupata, Ward No. 5 of Lekam Rural Municipality, Darchula District, Sudurpashchim Province, Nepal. The school is approximately 51 kilometers southwest of the district headquarters and at an elevation of about 1,579 meters above sea level.The foundation of education in this area began in 1955 AD (2011 B.S.) with the establishment of a local learning center initiated by community members who envisioned a better future for their children. In 1958 AD (2015 B.S.), this initiative was formally developed into Malikarjun Primary School, marking the beginning of organized schooling in Chaupata.As educational awareness and demand increased, the school expanded further with the establishment of Latinath Middle School in 1968 AD (2025 B.S.). Despite geographical challenges and limited infrastructure, strong community participation and collective effort enabled the gradual development of physical facilities and academic programs. Today, the school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12, including Ten Plus Two (+2) programs in Science, Management, and Education under the National Examinations Board, as well as CTEVT programs such as Pre-Diploma in Veterinary Science and Diploma in Agriculture (Animal Science), offering students multiple pathways for academic and vocational development.In 1985 AD (2042 B.S.), the primary and lower secondary levels were merged and reorganized, strengthening the institutional structure. Continued dedication from local stakeholders ultimately led to the school’s upgrade to the secondary level in 1991 AD (2048 B.S.), fulfilling a long-held aspiration of the community.Throughout its history, Latinath Model Secondary School has been shaped by the commitment, sacrifice, and cooperation of parents, educators, and social leaders. Beyond formal education, the school has also contributed to social awareness and community transformation. Today, it stands as an important educational center in the Lekam region, committed to providing accessible and quality education while supporting the overall development of society.Awards and RecognitionsLatinath Model Secondary School, Chaupata has received numerous awards and recognitions at local, district, provincial, and national levels for its outstanding academic performance and contribution to education, particularly in remote areas.1994 (2051 B.S.): Remote Area Award for excellent S.L.C. results, NPR 50,000, awarded by the Ministry of Education2000 (2057 B.S.): Remote Area Award for outstanding S.L.C. results, NPR 50,000, Ministry of Education2006 (2063 B.S.): District-level Best S.L.C. Results and School Ranking Award, NPR 100,000, District Education Office, Darchula2007 (2064 B.S.): Sudurpashchim Shield, Flag, and NPR 50,000 for excellent S.L.C. results; Education Service Medal awarded to the School Chairperson and Principal by the Ministry of Education2009 (2066 B.S.): Best Performance Award, NPR 100,000, District Education Office2009 (2066 B.S.): School Ranking and Grade 8 Outstanding Results Award, NPR 50,000, District Education Office2012 (2069 B.S.): Best School Award, NPR 500,000, District Education Office2017 (2074 B.S.): Declared Best Community School of the Year by CTEVT on the occasion of the 38th Education Day; awarded NPR 100,000 and a certificate2019 (2076 B.S.): Education Dipjyoti Medal awarded by the President of Nepal to the school Principal for outstanding contribution to the education sector2022 (2079 B.S.): Best Science Teacher Award presented by Nepal Academy of Science and Technology (NAST), Lalitpur2024 (2081 B.S.): Academic Excellence Award – Sudurpashchim, presented by Kendrabindu.com, Kathmandu, by the Prime Minister of Sudurpashchim Province2024 (2081 B.S.): Lekam Rural Municipality-level Presidential Running Shield2025 (2082 B.S.): Lekam Rural Municipality-level Presidential Running ShieldVisionTo develop Latinath Model Secondary School into a high-quality educational hub that provides inclusive, student-centered, and skills-oriented education in the region.ObjectivesTo strengthen remedial and supportive teaching practicesTo promote student-centered teaching and learning approachesTo emphasize the development and effective use of teaching–learning materialsTo provide counseling and psychosocial support for studentsTo enhance skill-based and vocational education aligned with practical life needs

name: Adarsha Bal Secondary School
description: Established in 2013 B.S., Adarsha Bal Secondary School is located in Baretar, Sundarbazar-6, Lamjung. The school provides education from Nursery through Grade 12. At the higher secondary level, students can choose between Science, Management, and Education streams. The institution focuses on fostering a disciplined learning environment that balances core academic subjects with practical life-skills training.The school features an "Earn While You Learn" program, allowing students to gain vocational experience and understand financial responsibility while completing their studies. This initiative helps bridge the gap between academic lessons and the professional workforce. To support modern teaching, the school has integrated e-learning facilities and multimedia tools, ensuring students have access to digital resources and interactive classroom experiences.The learning environment is supported by facilities such as science and computer laboratories, a library, and CCTV surveillance in all classrooms for safety and discipline. The institution also organizes various events and extracurricular programs to encourage the personal and social development of its students. By combining traditional academic streams, technical training, and modern technology, Adarsha Bal Secondary School offers a balanced environment for its students.

name: Chautara Secondary School, Dandakharka
description: Chautara Secondary School, Dandakharka, was established in 2045 BS. This school, located in Ward No. 2 of the former Mulkharka Village Municipality, appears to have been named after the chaurtaras (resting shelters) built by the general public in the area called Dandakharka for travelers to rest and relieve fatigue. Historically, the area where the school building now stands was frequently used by porters (batuwas), who, carrying loads of salt from Katari, would set down their burdens there.The school's foundation was initiated when its founding chairperson, Dil Bahadur Khatri, donated 2 ropani of land. During the establishment phase, there was a dispute over whether to operate the school in Dandakharka or Aiselukharka. A school named Chaurtara Primary School was already running in Aiselukharka. Because having two schools with the same name in the same ward was problematic, one of them was renamed. Following this, the development of Chautara Secondary School progressed rapidly.From its founding, the school struggled but persisted. It operated classes through grade 5 until 2052 BS. Under the leadership of founder-chairperson Dil Bahadur Khatri, class 6 was introduced, eventually leading to class 8. Continuing his pioneering role in upgrading the school, Khatri's initiative led to the start of class 9 in 2065 BS and class 10 in 2066 BS.Leading in terms of educational quality, the school began class 11 in 2078 BS. It was also granted affiliation by the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT) to offer a Diploma in Computer Engineering. At the secondary level (grades 11 and 12), it offers the Science and Education streams.Through the initiative of local residents who played a leading role in the school's establishment, the school now owns more than 33 ropani of land in its own name in Ward No. 5 of Sunkoshi Gaupalika.Infrastructure and Facilities:The school comprises three earthquake-resistant buildings with a total of 13 well-equipped rooms, as well as two older buildings.Separate toilets for boys and girls, and clean drinking water are available.It houses a well-equipped library, computer, and science laboratories.To support technology-enabled teaching and learning, the school provides internet access.

name: Nepal Rastriya Secondary School
description: Nepal Rastriya Secondary School is listed at Danda Kharka, Sunkoshi-5, Okhaldhunga.

name: Gokundeshwor Secondary School
description: Gokundeshwor Secondary School is located in Siranbazar-6, Dhankuta. The school was established in 1989 BS and has a long history of serving the local community's educational needs. The school operates from Nursery to Grade 12 and follows the government-approved curriculum. From Nursery to Grade 5, the school also offers additional English-medium subjects to help students gain additional knowledge. The school has been handed over to the community for management at the primary, lower secondary, and secondary levels.Parents, intellectuals, donors, social workers, local bodies, and various other stakeholders have made significant financial, physical, and educational contributions to the school. The school considers this widespread support as the backbone of its management and success. Due to the increasing number of students and strong demand from parents, the school aimed to establish itself as a quality model higher secondary school. To achieve this goal, affiliation for grades 11 and 12 was obtained from the Higher Secondary Education Board on Ashadh 22, 2062 BS. Classes 11 and 12 began operating from Shrawan 19, 2062 BS. In Poush, 2067 BS, the Science stream was also introduced.Students from not only the Dhankuta district but also from various districts of Koshi Province come to study in grades 11 and 12 at Gokundeshwor Secondary School, reflecting the school's growing reputation. The school has set a future goal of providing even higher-quality education.In the 21st century, with growing interest in information and communication technology, the school started computer education using its own resources during the academic session 2068 BS. A computer teacher was appointed, and computer classes are being conducted up to grade 10. The school also plans to extend computer education to higher grades. The school has made necessary arrangements for teachers, staff, and security guards from its own resources. As the school's service area continues to expand, the school has been considering internal transportation arrangements. Eventually, a school bus was provided by the Indian Embassy, making the school better equipped and more convenient for students.Based on the performance evaluation conducted by the Social Development Ministry of Koshi Province through the Education Development and Coordination Unit, Dhankuta, the school was recommended and awarded as the best community school in the Dhankuta district for the year 2075/76 BS. The school received a cash prize of Rs. 500,000 and a letter of appreciation. The school aims to conduct new research, exploration, and studies in the coming years to further improve educational quality.

name: Shree Narendra Janata Secondary School
description: Shree Narendra Janata Secondary School is located in Sarangpada, Kamal Rural Municipality, Ward No. 1, Jhapa District. The school was established in 2024 BS under the leadership of Mr. Chandra Bahadur Bista, who was a member of the Talley Gaun Panchayat at that time. Other local guardians, including Mr. Dal Bahadur Karki and Mr. Bangat Bahadur Pokhrel, along with intellectuals Mr. Bhola Prasad Acharya and Mr. Rajkumar Shrestha, played important roles in establishing the school. Initially, classes were held in a thatched hut about 100 meters north of the school's current location, with Mr. Chandra Bahadur Bista serving as the chairperson and Mr. Bhola Acharya as the head teacher.Two years later, a wooden building was constructed at the current location, and more classes were added, with Mr. Rajkumar Shrestha and Mr. Hombi Soren appointed as teachers. By 2029 BS, the school had expanded up to class 5. However, according to the National Education System Plan of 2028 BS, the school was limited to classes 1, 2, and 3 only, and this situation continued for three years. In the effort to upgrade it back to the lower secondary level, funds were collected in 2034 BS through Deusi, Bhailo, and other cultural programs, and classes from grade 4 were started again. By 2037 BS, the school was running up to class 7.In 2038 BS, primary education from classes 1 to 5 became completely free, so the school had to depend only on fees from students in classes 6 and 7 to cover expenses. This financial pressure caused the school to be limited again to class 5. However, local guardians once again came forward with determination, and in 2039 BS, local social worker Mrs. Lakshmi Devi Pradhananga donated Rs 140,000 in memory of her son, the late Narendra Pradhanang. This generous donation, along with extensive community support, helped revive the school, which was then named Shree Narendra Janata Lower Secondary School and recognized by Primary Education Center No. 5, Jamu. In 2044 BS, the school was upgraded to secondary level, and in 2065 BS, classes 11 and 12 were started. The school has been operating continuously up to the present day, serving the educational needs of the local community.VisionTo be a leading community-based academic center that nurtures globally competent citizens rooted in local values, fostering critical thinking, digital literacy, and holistic development to empower every student to thrive in a rapidly changing world.

name: Shree Chandee Adarsha Saral Secondary School
description: Shree Chandee Adarsha Saral Secondary School is located in Chakupat-11, Lalitpur. The institution was established through the merger of two historic community-founded schools: Shree Chandee Vidhyashram Secondary School and Aadarsh Saral Secondary School, both of which date back to 2004 BS. This consolidation was initiated to revitalize the institution and ensure the continued provision of quality education within the local community under its present name.The school provides academic programs ranging from the Nursery level to Grade 12. For students in Grades 11 and 12, the institution offers streams in Management and Humanities in affiliation with the National Examinations Board (NEB). The school has developed its own physical infrastructure in Chakupat with the collaborative support of its founders, teachers, local government bodies, and a dedicated network of alumni.Throughout its history, the school has produced graduates who serve in various professional capacities as government officials, medical professionals, engineers, and entrepreneurs both within Nepal and abroad. The institution maintains an active relationship with its stakeholders, including parents and former students, to support its ongoing educational initiatives. In addition to formal academics, the school regularly organizes a range of programs and events to support student development and foster community engagement.Goals and VisionTo develop students into morally upright, skilled, and capable citizens.To conduct teaching through the English medium, gradually expanding from Grade 1 to higher grades.To enhance educational quality and provide students with practical knowledge, skills, and abilities.To take necessary initiatives to operate modern technical education in the school and establish it as a technical school.

name: Vidya Jyoti Secondary School
description: Vidya Jyoti Secondary School is listed at Chakupat-11, Lalitpur.

name: Janakalyan Secondary School
description: Janakalyan Secondary School is listed at Tarku, Khahare, Sundarbazar-5, Lamjung.

name: Shree Prabha Dhamkot Secondary School
description: Prabha Dhamkot Secondary School, located in Prabha, Achham, is a public educational institution established in 2010 B.S. The school provides a comprehensive educational path from Play Group to Grade 12. For its Ten Plus Two (+2) programs, the school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and offers specialized streams in Management and Education.The school maintains a structured academic environment supported by a team of trained and skilled teachers. It offers English-medium instruction from Nursery through Grade 8 and provides additional academic guidance through extra classes for students who require them.To facilitate a focused learning environment, Prabha Dhamkot Secondary School offers residential hostel facilities, including the SEE Residential Ashram. The campus is equipped with modern learning resources, including Science, Computer, Agriculture, and Language laboratories, as well as an e-library featuring digital materials.In addition to general academics, the school features an Agriculture Technical Stream for Grades 9–12. This program includes a “Learn and Earn” initiative that promotes practical skill development through hands-on experience. The institution also operates a dedicated bus service to support students' daily commutes. Through these diverse academic and technical programs, the school remains committed to the educational and practical development of its students.

name: Shree Sarbajanik Model Secondary School
description: Shree Sarbajanik Model Secondary School is a leading educational institution located in Malunga, Ward No. 1 of Galyang, Syangja district. The school has been serving the local community for many years and is well known in the area.The school received approval to operate as a secondary school in 2036 BS. At that time, it provided secondary education to students from different Village Development Committees. The school played an important role in making secondary education accessible to students from these surrounding areas.In 2060 BS, the school was upgraded to a higher secondary level. Later, in 2075 BS, it started a three-year Diploma in Agriculture (Horticulture) under CTEVT. This was an important step in providing technical education to local students. The introduction of this program helped students gain practical agricultural skills right in their own community.In 2075 BS, the school was selected as a Model School by the Government of Nepal. Since then, it has been running various long-term programs to improve the quality of education. The school is committed to providing quality technical education along with regular academic programs. It continues to move forward with dedication to serve the educational needs of the community.

name: Bhuwaneshwori Secondary School
description: Bhuwaneshwori Secondary School is listed at Malunga, Galyang-1, Syangja.

name: Himal Darshan Secondary School
description: Himal Darshan Secondary School, established in 2031 B.S., is a community-based educational institution located in Necha Batase, Nechasalyan-3, Solukhumbu. Affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB), the school offers a comprehensive academic program from Nursery through Grade 12. For students in Grades 11 and 12, specialized streams are available in Science, Management, and Education.The school emphasizes a technology-integrated learning environment, utilizing smart boards in classrooms to enhance student engagement through audio-visual methods. This modern infrastructure is supported by a team of skilled and experienced subject teachers who provide dedicated guidance and instruction. To facilitate practical learning and research, the institution maintains well-equipped science and computer laboratories, as well as a library.Beyond academics, Himal Darshan Secondary School focuses on holistic development through weekly extracurricular activities and access to sports and music equipment. Student-led organizations, including the Nepal Scouts, offer platforms for building leadership and discipline. The school also prioritizes student welfare by providing a well-regulated canteen that serves hygienic meals and ensuring a reliable supply of clean drinking water. Through these resources and programs, the school fosters a supportive environment dedicated to the academic and personal growth of its students.

name: Shree Jana Jukta Shahi Secondary School
description: Shree Jana Jukta Shahi Secondary School is in Sange, Nepaltar, Ward No. 5 of Vyas Municipality, Tanahun District, Gandaki Province. It is about 8 kilometers northwest of Damuali Bazaar, where the Vyas Municipality office is located. The school is located in Nepaltar near the meeting point of Sange Khola and Payer Khola in the middle of the Sindhu Valley.The school was established with the support of Jukta Raj Shahi, a social worker who valued education. He donated 4 ropani, 2 aana, 3 daam, 3 paisa of land and NPR 15,000 in cash to open a lower secondary school. After this, permission to run the school was given on Poush 5. Classes began on Poush 27, 2032 BS, and the school was named Shree Jukta Shahi Lower Secondary School, serving students through class 4. In 2034 BS, the school's name was changed to Shree Jana Jukta Shahi Secondary School.Over the years, the school grew step by step. On 2039/09/07, it received permission to run classes for Grades 1 to 3, and later classes were expanded to Grade 7. On 2042/11/06, the school received approval to start Grade 8 at the secondary level. On 2051/09/14, it received permanent approval at the secondary level, a significant achievement.The school celebrated its Silver Jubilee on 2056/09/27, marking 25 years of service. It continued to grow, and on 2068/04/16, it received permission to start Grade 11 under the (+2) system. On 2075/04/28, the school received CTEVT affiliation to offer a diploma program in Veterinary Studies, adding technical education to its curriculum. On 2081/09/27, the school proudly celebrated its Golden Jubilee, completing 50 years of serving students and the community.Currently, Shree Jana Jukta Shahi Secondary School offers classes from Nursery through Grade 12. The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and provides Ten Plus Two (10+2) programs in Management and Education. The school also offers a Diploma in Veterinary Science (Agriculture) under CTEVT affiliation, providing students with technical and vocational education opportunities.VisionTo establish itself as a model and exemplary school that provides high-quality, technology-enabled, skills-based education for the modern era. It aims to ensure equal access to quality education for all children, achieve the highest learning outcomes, and instill good values and discipline in students.Goal:The school will be prosperous and well-developed in academic quality, physical infrastructure, moral values, and financial resources.Objectives:To enhance capacity for technology-friendly teaching and learning.To make education life-skill oriented, practical, and of high quality.To improve learning outcomes and produce well-mannered, value-oriented students.To develop the school as an environmentally friendly and child-friendly institution.To establish the school as a learning hub that delivers practical, innovative education.To increase the active participation of students and parents in planning and implementation processes.To enhance community involvement in the overall development of the school.Good Practices Followed at Shree Jana Jukta Shahi Secondary SchoolMorning and evening prayer sessions are held daily to promote discipline among students.An academic calendar is prepared, and all teaching activities are conducted accordingly.Class teachers directly call parents if a student remains absent.Students must obtain permission from the class teacher and administration before leaving school during school hours.A card system is used for student movement: a white card for water or toilet, a red card for administrative work.Teachers prepare lesson plans and teaching plans before taking classes.Free periods are properly managed.Parents are notified by phone on the day results are published for quarterly, mid-term, and annual exams.The school provides parent education for guardians, moral education for students, and spiritual education for the community.A donation box is kept at school, and the funds are used for student welfare.School captains and assistant captains are selected through an election process to develop leadership skills.Various committees are formed, including Grievance Hearing, School-Community Relations, Sanitation and Discipline, Health, and Extracurricular Activities.A guard is appointed to monitor mobile phone use, dress code, and maintain parent records.Every Friday from 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM, students take part in extracurricular activities and sports.Students are taught practical skills, including poultry and pig farming.Students learn to make traditional leaf plates (duna and tapari).Parent gatherings and academic interactions are held separately by grade level.A suggestion box and notice board are used to share information and address feedback.A first-aid room is available, and health checkup camps are held at least once a year.Joint meetings of teachers and committees are held at least twice a year for academic counseling.Felicitation programs are organized to honor teachers, parents, and students.Scholarships are provided to poor, meritorious, differently-abled, and orphaned students.Monthly staff meetings are held to discuss shortcomings and areas for improvement.Examination results are reviewed and analyzed regularly.Home visit programs are conducted twice a year.Each teacher conducts at least one class every 10 days in the library or e-library.A School Improvement Plan (SIP) is prepared and implemented.

name: Shree Langarche Secondary School
description: Langarche Secondary School is a public school located in Ward No. 8 of Panchpokhari Thangpal Rural Municipality, Sindhupalchok district. Established in 2017 BS, the school is named after the former Langarche Village Panchayat. Initially, it began classes for grades 1 to 5 in the veranda of the founding headmaster Yagya Prasad Dhital's home, as there was no dedicated building at that time.With the collective efforts of local community members, including founding chairman Dandapani Dhital and others, a permanent building was later constructed at Mukhiyako Bari in Ward No. 7. The school gradually expanded, receiving permission to add classes 6 and 9 in 2050 BS and 2065 BS, respectively. Today, it offers education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to class 12, serving approximately 250 students from the Tamang, Chhetri, and other local communities who travel from areas such as Aage, Kotgaun, Sole, and Lapse.The school employs 16 teachers, including headmaster Rammani Dhital and five others who are former students of the institution. It operates in three permanent buildings that were reconstructed after the 2072 BS earthquake and is equipped with both science and computer laboratories. Classes 11 and 12 were introduced with funds collected during a Shrimad Bhagwat Saptah in 2073 BS, enabling local students to pursue higher secondary education without leaving their homes.

name: Shree Jamunakharka Secondary School
description: Shree Jamunakharka Secondary School is located in Beni-6, Arthunge, Myagdi district. Established in 2017 BS, the school has a long history of serving the educational needs of the local community. It began as a small primary school in a thatched shed and has grown over the years into a well-established secondary school offering classes up to Grade 12.The school was founded by local education enthusiasts led by Sher Bahadur Rana. In its early days, the school had no permanent building and moved from place to place like a traveling school. Classes were held in various locations, including a cowshed, a rice storage area, and private homes. With land donated by Narayandatt Poudel and community support, a permanent building was constructed. The school gradually expanded, receiving approval for lower secondary in 2053 BS, secondary in 2059 BS, and higher secondary in 2064 BS. Today, it provides quality education from class 1 to 12 with support from various individuals and organizations.The school is located in a geographically diverse area with a clean, temperate climate. Students come from Wards 4, 5, 6, and 9 of Beni Municipality. The local community is predominantly Brahmin and Chhetri, with small populations of other castes. Agriculture, animal husbandry, jobs, and labor are the main sources of income. Through the dedication of teachers, head teachers, School Management Committees, and community support over many years, Shree Jamunakharka Secondary School has established itself as an important educational institution in Myagdi district.

name: Shree Komin Shyamey Wangphel Secondary School
description: Shree Komin Shyamey Wangphel Secondary School is located in Syaphrubensi, Gosaikunda-5, Rasuwa. The school was established in 2024 BS and is a community-based institution recognized as a model school. It offers classes from Playgroup to Grade 12 and is affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB), providing Plus Two programs in Education and Management. The school also offers a Pre-Diploma in Electrical Engineering (Electrical Sub-overseer) under the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT).The school provides instruction through skilled, experienced teachers who use effective methods to help students understand the lessons clearly. Their dedication ensures that every student receives quality guidance and support. The school focuses on developing strong physical infrastructure, including well-maintained classrooms and facilities that create a comfortable learning environment.A well-organized library is available where students can read and borrow books on various subjects, providing a quiet space for study, research, and self-learning. The school also provides Wi-Fi internet access to support digital learning, allowing students to easily access online resources and educational materials.The school uses multimedia tools, projectors, and smart boards to make lessons more interactive and engaging. Teachers use audio-visual aids to explain concepts clearly, helping students understand and remember better. A well-equipped science laboratory is available for students to conduct experiments and learn through hands-on activities. The school also has a well-equipped computer lab where students can learn and practice digital skills, preparing them for higher studies and future careers.The school provides hostel accommodation for students who need a place to stay, offering a safe, comfortable, and supportive living environment for learners coming from distant areas. A safe and reliable school bus service is also available, covering convenient pick-up and drop-off points so children from different areas can commute easily. The school provides scholarships to students who are economically disadvantaged or academically talented, ensuring that deserving students can continue their education without financial burden. Students who have achieved grades ranging from C to A in the SEE examination are eligible for admission, enabling learners from diverse academic backgrounds to enroll.

name: Shree Jivan Jyoti Secondary School
description: Shree Jivan Jyoti Secondary School is situated in Biruwa Rural Municipality-7, Kusum Bhanjyang, Syangja. Established in 2011 BS, the school offers classes from Nursery to Grade 12 and is affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB). It provides Plus Two programs in Science, Hotel Management, and Computer Science.The school features well-equipped laboratories for chemistry, physics, and biology, where students can conduct experiments and explore scientific concepts through hands-on practice. Additionally, a dedicated hotel management lab allows students to develop hospitality skills, including food preparation, serving, and room management. The modern computer lab is equipped with up-to-date computers, and classrooms have smart boards to enhance lessons with interactive, digital tools and visual aids.For students from distant areas, the school provides hostel accommodation that ensures a safe, comfortable, and supportive living environment. Furthermore, the school implements a "learning and earning" program to help students acquire practical skills and achieve financial independence while pursuing their studies. Set in a calm, peaceful environment, Shree Jivan Jyoti Secondary School offers a focused atmosphere where students can study without interruption and enjoy their time at school.

name: Shree Sharada Secondary School
description: Shree Sharada Secondary School is listed at Kusum Bhanjyang, Biruwa-7, Syangja.

name: International Hotel Training School
description: IHTS is a renowned culinary arts academy in Kathmandu, Nepal that offers comprehensive culinary & hospitality education and professional training. With experienced faculty, modern facilities, and an international curriculum, IHTS provides students with hands-on learning opportunities to master various culinary techniques, cuisines, and management skills. The academy fosters a culture of culinary excellence and creativity, preparing students to excel in the dynamic world of culinary arts. Through practical application and industry collaborations, students gain real-world experience and build a professional network. IHTS graduates have achieved success in prestigious culinary establishments worldwide, demonstrating the academy's excellence in culinary education. The school offers the following distinctive course;S.NoName of CourseDuration1Housekeeping2 weeks and 3 months internship2Waiter Training2 weeks and 3 months internship3Diploma in Culinary Arts6 months + 6 months internship4Certificate in Culinary Arts3 months + 3 months internship5Diploma in Bakery and Pastry3 months + 6 months internship6Diploma in Hotel Management6 Months + 6 months7Basic in Continental Cuisine1 month8Basic in Indian Cuisine2 months9Basic in Chinese Cuisine3 months10Basic in Italian Cuisine4 monthsVISIONCreating a skilled based societyMISSIONTo provide the best quality cooking training with assurance of job placementGOALTo become the first choice for Culinary Arts Academy in Nepal by 2025To provide Nepal's best professional culinary and hospitality education.Providing soft and technical skills to the youth of Nepal and enable them to get employment & play an effective role in the economic growth of Nepal.

name: Kathmandu Institute of Technology
description: Kathmandu Institute of Technology Pvt. Ltd. (KIT) is located at Milan Tole, Tokha Road, Kathmandu. It is a promising institution, which was founded by an enthusiastic group of academicians in the year 2057 B.S. with the cherished goal of producing high quality manpower in the country and committed to provide excellent educational opportunity.The faculty members of the college are committed to instill knowledge, skill, responsibility, discipline and commitment, the five pillars of success. Success is possible only through hard, concerted and dedicated efforts of all; students, teachers, guardians and parents, management and the community. Kathmandu Institute Of Technology Institute proposes to carry out activities in the area of academics and technology. However, at the moment, KIT is running three-year Diploma Engineering programs such as Civil, Architecture, Electronics, Electrical and Computer affiliated with the Council For Technical education and Vocational Training (CTEVT), Sanothimi, Bhaktapur. Mission and Objectives:To produce Diploma level technicians in different streams of Engineering for addressing national demand in this categoryTo perform various research and development works and to strengthen the national engineering capability to face the engineering challengesTo offer continuing education, training and short term courses to update the knowledge and to enhance the performance of technical human resourcesVisionKathmandu Institute of Technology envisions to be a institute shaping the future of Nepal's Technical workforce in the field of Engineering and Technology through accessible, practical, and industry-aligned Diploma in Engineering Programs, empowering individuals to contribute meaningfully to national development and thrive in globalized world.Collaboration With Zhengzhou Electric Power College, ChinaKIT College has a strategic partnership and collaboration agreement with Zhengzhou Electric Power College (ZEPC), Zhengzhou, China, to train students in China. Faculties of ZEPC are coming to KIT College to take classes. The agreement between KIT College and ZEPC includes:5-8 students of KIT College studying Electrical or Electrical & Electronics Engineering are allowed to intern and practical training in ZEPC for two weeks every year, for which students only have to pay the transportation cost, and no additional fees will be charged by ZEPC.Students of KIT College studying Electrical or Electrical & Electronics Engineering are eligible to register and join ZEPC after completion of 6 semesters (3 Years) in KIT College to study 2 semesters in ZEPC to obtain Diploma in Electrical Engineering from ZEPC with following facilities.KIT Students are eligible for 100% scholarships on tuition fees charged by ZEPC.KIT Students are eligible for Scholarships up to RMB 10,000.00, which will be paid in two installments after each semester's completion.Upon successful completion of study in ZEPC, students will be awarded a Diploma in Electrical Engineering from ZEPC and are eligible for admission to an undergraduate program (Bachelor's Degree) in China. ZEPC will recommend these students for scholarships to the universities with whom it collaborates.ZEPC arranges KIT College students for internships in Chinese-funded enterprises based on their willingness every year.Arrange Chinese professional teachers and language course teachers to provide online or offline teaching.

name: Mount Strada Barista Academy
description: Mount Strada Coffee offers a vibrant and welcoming space in New Baneshwor, Kathmandu, where coffee lovers can enjoy expertly brewed beverages in a relaxed setting. The café combines modern aesthetics with a cozy atmosphere, making it a popular destination for both casual visitors and professionals.In addition to its café, Mount Strada is committed to enhancing Nepal's coffee culture through its Barista Academy, where aspiring baristas gain hands-on training in various coffee-making techniques. The academy helps equip individuals with the skills needed for the growing coffee industry.Mount Strada also supports local businesses by supplying high-quality, locally sourced coffee beans, further promoting Nepal’s coffee scene on both a local and national level.

name: Prashikshan
description: Prashikshan is an educational training, skill development, and event management service provider for individuals as well as private and public sector enterprises. In short, we are a global learning solutions company dedicated to elevating individuals and organizations. Prashikshan is a trusted partner for corporate training, seminars, workshops, conferences, educational training, professional training, and executive education programs, all of which are regularly updated. Our esteemed trainers (Prashikshak) bring a well-researched, practical, and applicable approach to learning.The training institution offers a wide range of tailor-made training programs that cater to a diverse audience, from high school students to top-level executives in organizations. The company provides a broad portfolio of learning opportunities. The institutional approach to learning focuses on developing and establishing key skills that are result-oriented and contribute to organizational excellence in every aspect. This ensures that every individual is equipped to meet the current trends in today's competitive business landscape. Furthermore, they design and deliver customized corporate training and solutions tailored to the specific needs of organizations and their respective industries.

name: Janata Model Technical Secondary School
description: Established in 2008 B.S. as a primary school, Janata Model Technical Secondary School is in Tinkoriya, Giddha Belapatti ward No. 6, Bideha Municipality, Dhanusha. It has evolved into one of the most exemplary and largest community schools in Madhesh Province.The school now offers education from ECD to Grade 12, including technical education in Animal Science initiated in 2070 B.S., and Plus Two programs since 2068 B.S. It was officially recognized as a Model School in 2074 B.S., a testament to its commitment to quality education, discipline, and holistic development.With an enrollment of over 6,175 students from Dhanusha and neighboring districts such as Siraha and Mahottari as of 2081 B.S., the school’s popularity continues to rise due to its strong academic foundation, strict discipline, and structured learning environment. Every year, more than a thousand new students compete for limited seats, prompting the school to implement admission quotas and entrance exams.The school’s remarkable success is credited to its dynamic leadership under Principal Mr. Mandal, who has implemented a system of 40 active subcommittees, including internal monitoring, counseling, discipline, and prayer committees. Regular meetings, inspections, and evaluations ensure ongoing improvement in teaching and administration. Additionally, the school uses CCTV surveillance and a control room to monitor academic activities.Teaching is entirely free from Grade 1 to 12, and there is a residential hostel for 150 students. Students up to Grade 5 benefit from the government’s midday meal program, while the school also operates a subsidized canteen. Daily prayer sessions foster discipline and moral values, incorporating the national anthem, spiritual chanting, and motivational speeches by teachers and students.The school promotes teacher leadership by appointing rotating weekly in-charge positions, with rewards for the best performers. Every Friday is dedicated to extracurricular activities like music, dance, science, technology, sports, and art, ensuring all—around development. With a reputation built on discipline, moral education, academic excellence, and dedicated teachers, Janata Namuna Secondary School stands as a benchmark for community schools in Nepal.

name: Gyanodaya Secondary School
description: The school, under the guiding motto, 'Our School, Our Future,' is distinguished by its modern, student-centric infrastructure designed to foster an ideal learning environment. It places a high premium on holistic development and academic excellence through a structured support system.The school also maintains a strong commitment to accessibility and student welfare. With a team of dedicated and experienced educators, Gyanodaya Secondary School implements a structured evaluation system, including a Continuous Assessment System (CAS) for primary levels and regular monthly progress examinations for senior students. It offers scholarship arrangements and provides free textbooks for students up to Grade 5. With a focus on technology-friendly education and practical skills, Gyanodaya Secondary School continues to be a preferred choice for families seeking a well-rounded educational experience in the Rupandehi district.As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Gyanodaya Secondary School has 829 enrolled students.

name: Oxford English Boarding Secondary School
description: Oxford English Boarding Secondary School is located in Butwal, Rupandehi. It is affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB) and offers +2 courses in Science, Management, Humanities, and Education streams.The school was established in 1991 AD. By combining the best innovative teaching techniques, a child-friendly environment, and fully digitized classrooms, it has secured its position among Nepal's reputed schools and colleges through its dedication to quality education.With student-centered learning provisions and the best teaching faculty, it has received accreditation from the Civil Unification Society in the year 2076, with graduates in every field, including youth scientists, national players, and singers, and scholars on national and international platforms. Oxford focuses its pupils on developing moral education to instill moral and ethical values in children, with practical, life-related education to ensure the overall development of the learners. It believes in stimulating students' creative and critical thinking power and heightening their moral sensitivity through curriculum implementation, value education, and extracurricular activities

name: Bagiswori Secondary School
description: Bagiswori Secondary School (BSS) is a community based academia founded by a group of social motivated people in 2015 BS as a primary school. It is dedicated to produce qualified and competent human resources.
