With the length of time BSS has been enlisted as 'Namuna Vidhyalaya' by the Nepal Government Education is the formal act of imparting knowledge, developing power of reasoning and judgement for academic maturity.The school offers ten plus two (10+2) programmes in Science, Management, Humanitites, and Education under affiliation with the National Examination Board (NEB). The school also provides Civil Sub-Overseer program and Diploma in Civil Engineering in affiliation to CTEVT.ObjectiveBagiswori Secondary School bridges opportunity and education. By offering affordable, high-quality learning, they empower students of all backgrounds. This focus extends beyond academics, nurturing graduates who are not only skilled but also socially responsible. Bagiswori equips students for success by forging a clear link between education and future careers. Their vision is to cultivate well-rounded global citizens who can lead Bhaktapur towards a bright, harmonious future.

name: Shree Trijuddha Mahabir Prasad Raghubir Ram Secondary School
description: Trijuddha Secondary School was founded through the persistent efforts of local merchant brothers Raghubir Ram and Mahabir Prasad, who sought permission from the then-Rana Prime Minister Juddha Shumsher to bring formal education to the region. Symbolizing a political balance of the era, the school was named by combining the names of King Tribhuvan and PM Juddha Shumsher. Since its inception, the institution has been a pioneer; its first building was donated in 1940, and it initially sought academic leadership from Kolkata, India, appointing Banamali Bhattacharya as its first Headmaster.Trijuddha Secondary School has long been a powerhouse of academic merit, boasting an illustrious list of SLC (now SEE) Board toppers. Between 1947 and 1974, the school produced several national champions, including Rameshwar Prasad Upadhyay, Damodar Prasad Kyal, and Suman Kumari Khanal, who topped the board in the girls' category. This tradition of excellence continues today, as the school has transitioned into a comprehensive institution offering diverse streams, including Science and Management at the Higher Secondary level (Grade 11-12) and specialized Technical Education in Civil Engineering since 2016.In a significant strategic move, the school returned to a full English medium curriculum in 2015 (2072 BS)—reverting to its original roots after having switched to Nepali medium in 1971 following the "New Education" plan. This transition has revitalized the institution, making it a formidable competitor to private schools. Parents who previously opted for expensive private education are now returning to Trijuddha, citing the high quality of instruction, strict discipline, and the school’s ability to offer a private-school standard of education within a public-school framework.Spanning across three bighas of land in Birta, Birgunj, the school currently serves approximately 4,000 students through a two-shift (Morning and Day) system. The institution is notable for its commitment to inclusive education, providing residential facilities for visually impaired students. Modern facilities include smart classrooms, a library, a large auditorium, separate canteens for boys and girls, and a science laboratory currently under construction. With a dedicated team of 115 teachers, the school maintains a low-cost model, offering free education up to Grade 10 and charging only a nominal support fee for Grades 11 and 12.Under the current leadership of Headmaster Nabin Kumar Mishra and School Management Committee Chairman Rupeshman Singh, Trijuddha is focused on continuous quality improvement and infrastructure expansion. The management remains committed to upholding the deep-rooted trust of the Birgunj community, ensuring that the school remains a beacon of affordable, high-quality, and disciplined education for future generations.

name: Shree Janata Secondary School
description: Shree Janata Secondary School is listed at Birta, Birgunj-4, Parsa.

name: Padmodaya Public Secondary School
description: Padmodaya Public Model Secondary School, Dang is both English and Nepali medium co-educational school established in 2004 BS. The School has been declared as Model Public Secondary School with well managed teaching and learning environment in 2062 BS.It runs from Nursery to Grade 12 including CTEVT Annex Program from 2059 BS. It focuses on both foundation and college level students with quality education. Understanding the importance of English language, it has both English and Nepali medium instruction in teaching. The school offers Diploma in Automobile Engineering with the affiliation from CTEVT.Vision:To provide quality technical training (Knowledge & Skill) targeted for participants in mid western region of the country.Mission:The core focus of the organization is to change the life status of people from marginalized ground and disadvantaged group through technical training.Goals/ Objectives:To increase skilled man power in Rapti zone, make organizational image in nation, decrease unemployment in nationTo increase access of dalits, women, marginalized group and disadvantaged group throughTo give employment in nation through vocational training for unskilled youths.To conduct training for unemployed youths who want to employ themselves in district or nation.To identify local resources on proper utilization for job placement.

name: Public High School Dharan
description: Dharan Public High School, located on Chatara Line in Dharan Sub-metropolitan City-12, Sunsari, Nepal, stands as a shining example of excellence among community (public) schools in eastern Nepal. Established on 23 Shrawan 2003 BS, though some sources trace its roots even earlier to 1947 as a longstanding institution in the region, the school has grown from humble beginnings: a modest building, a handful of teachers, and a small group of students into a model educational hub serving thousands of students from nursery to Grade 12.Under visionary leadership, including former principal Lekhnath Bhattarai and current principal Dr. Indra Mohan Jha, the school has shattered stereotypes about community institutions by delivering high-quality, forward-thinking education. It offers instruction in English medium up to Grade 10 and provides diverse streams at the secondary level, including science, management, humanities, education, and notably skilled technical programs such as hotel management, computer science, beautician and hairdressing, and electrical engineering, making it a pioneer in practical, job-oriented learning among public schools.The school's commitment to holistic development is evident in its impressive academic results and innovative approaches. In the 2082 BS SEE examinations, it achieved an outstanding 91.91% pass rate, securing the top position in Sunsari district. At the Class 12 level, it recorded a 74.56% regular pass rate in the technical stream, demonstrating its success in preparing students not just for exams but for real-world challenges. Beyond academics, Dharan Public High School emphasizes life skills, cultural values, and inclusivity. It integrates practical training through labs, on-the-job experiences, compulsory library sessions to foster reading, motivational classes, meditation, sports, dance, robotics, elocution, public speaking, and Nepal Scouts programs. The school creates a microcosm of society by welcoming students from diverse backgrounds; workers, farmers, businessmen, government employees, and families across income levels.With around 190 dedicated teachers and staff, modern facilities like computer and electrical labs, school buses, and a strong focus on discipline and security, Dharan Public High School continues to set new benchmarks. It produces well-rounded graduates, including notable alumni in fields like music, public service, athletics, and medicine, who carry forward the school's ethos of education as a tool for personal and societal transformation.

name: Sankat Mochan Devsaran Ramrati Secondary School
description: Sankat Mochan Devsaran Ramrati Secondary School is a renowned educational institution situated in the heart of Janakpurdham, Dhanusha, dedicated to delivering quality education with a focus on academic excellence, discipline, and holistic development. Founded in 2029 B.S. at Goyara Phulwari, Ward No. 4, under Janakpur Municipality, the school has grown into a respected center of learning, shaping generations of students with strong values and lifelong learning.With decades of commitment to education, the school offers a dynamic learning environment that nurtures intellectual, social, emotional, and physical development. The school's mission is to empower students through accessible, inclusive, and future-ready education that meets the needs of modern learners.Sankat Mochan Devsaran Ramrati Secondary School continues to play a key role in uplifting educational standards in the region with its experienced faculty, well-structured academic programs, and a supportive community. The school remains a pillar of educational progress, guiding students toward a brighter and more successful future.The educational framework of the school is categorized as Pre-school level, Basic level, and Secondary level. This secondary school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs in Science, Education, Management and Law.

name: Valmiki Shiksha Sadan
description: Valmiki Shiksha Sadan (VSS), established in 1996 A.D., is a co-educational institution located in Bharatpur, Chitwan. With the guiding motto “An Institution Where Excellence Prevails,” VSS has earned a reputation for delivering high-quality, value-based education from Play Group (PG) to Grade 12, fostering both academic excellence and personal growth. The educational curriculum of the school is divided into three categories: Pre-school level, Basic level, and Secondary level. VSS is committed to bringing about a significant change in the field of education. It currently ranks as one of the district's top higher secondary schools, with exceptional performance. The school launched a +2 level in the Science and Management stream in 2069 B.S. in response to demand from students, parents, and the general public while maintaining its fifteen years of established academic performance. Valmiki Shiksha Sadan is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and offers well-structured +2 programs in Science (Biology), Hotel Management, and Management. These programs are designed to equip students with strong theoretical foundations as well as practical skills, preparing them for success in higher education and future careers. As a trusted name in education for over two decades, VSS emphasizes a student-centered approach, combining modern teaching methodologies, qualified faculty, and a nurturing environment. The school is dedicated to holistic development, encouraging critical thinking, creativity, discipline, and leadership in every student. Valmiki Shiksha Sadan team envisions a common school environment in rural Nepal where the students irrespective of economic background, caste, religion, gender, etc. could access and enjoy the quality and scientific education to be competent global citizens.

name: Bed Secondary School
description: Bed Secondary School is located in Dhawakhola, Palpa . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.

name: Aishwarya Vidya Niketan Secondary School
description: In response to the growing demands of the local community and academic experts, AVN expanded its academic offerings to include the 10+2 Science faculty in 2052 B.S., followed by Arts, Education, and Management streams in 2053 B.S.AVN has always been proactive in adopting innovative practices in order to provide the best learning environment for its students, paving the way for other schools to follow suit. In its initial years, the school published its own textbooks and used them for classroom teaching. The school is also pioneers in introducing Computer Science as a subject, supported by a fully equipped computer lab, at the school level in the region.Since its foundation, the school has established a reputation for entrepreneurial thinking, questioning the traditional mindset when it comes to education and learning. It has consistently valued both individuality and community with the intention of expanding the possibilities an academic institution can offer. Through a culture of humanity, it encourages pupils to be the best versions of themselves. It focuses on creating an environment of kindness and inclusivity, where everyone looks out for one another, and where students are able to flourish personally, emotionally, and academically.AVN focuses on both academic success and personal growth by combining classroom learning with extracurricular activities. With more than 100 qualified teachers, the school gives each student the support they need to do well in studies, sports, and the arts.MissionThe mission of the AVN is to acquire and develop dedicated, industrious, qualified and socially renowned faculties for delivering quality education to the students. The school aims to advance the intellectual and social condition of the people of the community and country through the quality program of teaching, research and services.VisionThe school has a vision to develop itself into a renowned community-based school with exceptional and outstanding educational opportunities for students. It envisions to be a student-oriented college/School concentrating on research activities to develop academic community.ObjectiveThe school's objective is to provide quality education to the students according to the demand of society that enables the students to develop problem-solving, leadership and teamwork skills along with value of commitment to quality life, ethical behavior, society and respect for one another.

name: Janajyoti Model Secondary School
description: Janajyoti Model Secondary School Sarlahi is located in Lalbandi, Sarlahi. This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.Janajyoti Technical School is affiliated with CTEVT and is offering Diploma in Computer Engineering program and TSLC program-Junior Computer Technician.VisionTo produce skilled Technical and vocational work force.MissionTo provide quality education in the field of computer.Goal/ Objectives• To provide high quality through the use of effective teaching approaches.• To organize customized training programs in order to empower and ensure sustainable, self motivated to poor woman and disadvantaged community.

name: Monastic Secondary English Boarding School
description: Established in 1986 by Dr. Mithilesh Kumar Sah, Monastic Secondary English Boarding School embarked on a journey of providing quality education in Nepal. Initially founded in Matihani village, the school later relocated to Janakpurdham, where it flourished under Dr. Sah's leadership. With a focus on equipping students for active participation in public life, the institution expanded its offerings from kindergarten to ten plus two (10+2) levels. Over the years, the school's commitment to excellence attracted a growing number of students, reaching 2200 by 2010. Despite personal challenges, such as Dr. Sah's battle with cancer, his unwavering dedication to education remained steadfast, inspiring countless individuals within the school community. Following Dr. Sah's passing in 2014, his family continued his legacy, collectively managing the school and overseeing its development. Today, Monastic School stands as a beacon of quality education in Janakpurdham, with modern infrastructure and a focus on holistic development. The school's ethos revolves around providing a nurturing environment where students are encouraged to explore their potential through activity-based learning and scientific inquiry. With spacious classrooms, well-equipped laboratories, and a dedicated faculty, Monastic School remains committed to shaping the future leaders of Nepal, embodying Dr. Sah's vision of 'Quality education for Quality life'. Monastic Secondary English Boarding School is affiliated to National Examination Board (NEB) and offers ten plus two (10+2) programmes in Management and Science streams.

name: Dhambojhi Secondary School
description: Established in 1957 AD (2014 B.S), Dhambojhi Secondary School is a community-based academic institute located in Nepalgunj-1, Dhambojhi, Waterpark, in the Banke district of Nepal. The school was initiated by well-known academic personalities and is affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB), while being approved by the Ministry of Education. With a strong emphasis on providing excellent education, Dhambojhi Secondary School offers Ten Plus Two (10+2) programs in the streams of Science, Management, Education, and Computer Engineering. Despite being a public school, Dhambojhi Secondary School has become a favored choice for students from private schools due to recent educational reforms. It attracts not only students from Nepalgunj and Banke but also from districts outside the immediate vicinity, highlighting its growing reputation and ability to offer quality education. Previously considered a weak school in the district, Dhambojhi Secondary School has undergone a significant transformation. Through the dedication of its teaching staff and the support of parents, it has emerged as the best public school in the district over the past decade. The curriculum covers elementary school through class 12, with computer engineering taught from class 9 to 12 under the technical stream. This expansion and improvement in educational offerings have contributed to the school's rise to prominence. In addition to academic excellence, the school also provides a wide range of facilities that enrich the student experience. It features spacious and well-furnished classrooms, a science lab for practical experiments, and a modern computer lab equipped with the latest technology. Students benefit from a library stocked with academic resources, internet access for research, and multimedia tools that support interactive learning. The campus also includes a cafeteria offering hygienic meals, sports facilities for physical development, and dedicated spaces for music and dance. A conference hall is available for seminars and events, while counseling services support students' academic and emotional well-being. To encourage equal opportunity, scholarships are awarded to deserving students, and regular educational tours are organized to enhance experiential learning. These features together reflect the school’s holistic approach to education and its commitment to nurturing well-rounded individuals.

name: Gorkha International Public Secondary School
description: Gorkha International Public Secondary School (GIPSS) is a premier academic institution that has remained steadfast in its mission to pursue excellence in education. With a focus on creating an environment that nurtures the growth of knowledge, responsibility, and service to the community, GIPSS believes in offering a holistic education that balances academics, co-curricular activities, sports, and life skills learning. At GIPSS, we aim to equip our students with self-confidence, motivation, and the resilience to take on challenges. The state-of-the-art infrastructure is complemented by internationally recognized educational standards, ensuring that students receive an education that is both comprehensive and forward-thinking. Our teachers are not only experts in their fields but also role models who inspire trust, confidence, and a love for learning. The school emphasizes the development of character, instilling respect for tradition, discipline, and good manners in every student. Alongside academics, we encourage students to learn about themselves and their environment, offering support in developing decision-making and social skills. We are committed to creating a safe and supportive space for students to thrive personally, academically, and socially. With a long history of success, GIPSS continues to grow, leveraging the talents of staff, students, and parents. Our extracurricular programs, leadership opportunities, and emphasis on student well-being contribute to the overall happiness and success of each student. We invite you to join our community and look forward to partnering with you in the bright future of your child.

name: Saraswati Secondary School
description: Saraswati Secondary School is listed at Biratnagar, Morang.

name: Adhunik Rastriya Secondary School
description: Adhunik Rastriya Secondary School, located in Hetauda-4, Makwanpur, was established on 2nd Jestha 2024 B.S. Initially founded as a primary school near Bhutandevi Secondary School, it has since developed into a model educational institution within the district. Positioned in the heart of Hetauda, the school is recognized for its integration of technology, often being referred to as a "computerized school." While originally a government-owned entity, its management was officially transitioned to the community on Kartik 27, 2060 B.S.The school is notable for its international standards, being the first and only institution in Makwanpur to receive the International School Award (ISA 2020/2023) from the British Council. It provides an inclusive learning environment for students from diverse socio-economic backgrounds. The physical infrastructure comprises multiple buildings surrounded by greenery and gardens, designed to foster a peaceful atmosphere for study.Academic excellence has been a central focus since the school received permission to operate secondary-level classes in 2034 B.S. After presenting its first batch of students for the SLC examination in 2036 B.S., the institution has consistently achieved results higher than the national average. Significant milestones include a 99% pass rate in 2062 B.S. and a 100% success rate in 2067 B.S.As a pioneer in the region, the school introduced formal computer science education in 2057 B.S. and became the first in Nepal to include journalism as a subject in the SLC curriculum in 2058 B.S. For over a decade, it has maintained high rankings in the district and has been recognized as one of the top-performing schools in the Central Development Region and nationally, based on aggregate scores. The school continues to focus on academic improvement and the organization of various educational and extracurricular programs.

name: Chandra Secondary School
description: Chandra Secondary School, Siraha, established in 1914 AD (1971 BS), is a community-based educational institution in Siraha-1, Siraha, Nepal. It is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education. The school offers educational programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 10, and includes plus two programs in Management, Science, and Education streams.Chandra Secondary School provides secondary-level education with moderate fee structures and offers scholarship schemes for deserving students. It was one of the first open schools outside the Kathmandu Valley during the reign of Chandra Shamsher and was established in 1971 BS as the first historical English school outside the valley. The school operated as a secondary school from 2008 BS, supported by local efforts and donations of land. The late Mitra Lal Giri (father of former MP Pradip Giri) played a significant role in its development. In 2010 BS, two students passed the entrance exam with second-class honors.To support student growth and academic success, the school is equipped with a well-managed library, science and computer laboratories, and multimedia-enabled classrooms. It also places emphasis on extracurricular activities such as sports, dance, music, and educational tours. Counseling services are available to guide students in their academic and personal journeys, and the school regularly publishes journals to encourage creative expression. Through its scholarship program and supportive learning environment, Chandra Secondary School continues to serve as a significant educational hub in the region.

name: Mangal Prasad Secondary School
description: Mangal Prasad Secondary School is located in M P Road, Nepalgunj, Banke . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.

name: V.S. Niketan Secondary School
description: V.S. Niketan Secondary School is located in Minbhawan, Kathmandu. Established in 2038 B.S., V.S. Niketan Secondary School aims at imparting need responsive quality education for the current and future generations of students. The school has concrete foundation of senior management body and composite personalities has been a motivating center for effective learning, innovative practices and result oriented education. It prides itself on being an education of excellence by preparing students for the challenges ahead with programs and counseling that are both relevant and progressive V.S. Niketan Secondary School is deeply dedicated and committed to develop competence, conscience, compassion and commitment in the personal qualities of the students. It always promotes academically solid, socially relevant and value oriented education in the country. The school has been recognized as one of the developed and biggest institutions in the country. Over the years, it has earned sheer reputation in the field of education due to its educational excellence. All the necessary infrastructures in all terms, essential of fulfill the ever-growing demand of the society and to meet the global challenges of 21st century are found in V.S. Niketan Secondary School. Beside academic excellence, the students are exposed with modern educational tools and well equipped lab and library facilities.

name: Aroma English Secondary School
description: The education is the desire of all ages and all times. With a view to spread the fumes of rightful learning to a larger public AROMA EDUCATION FOUNDATION has come forward with an ambitious design. It is sure to add yet another milestone on the way of imparting quality education at higher levels and broaden the horizon of education in Nepal. A highly potential management body is proud to establish AROMA COLLEGE OF APPLIED SCIENCE AND MANAGEMENT in 2066 BS. Consisting of highly dynamic and qualified professionals in different faculties, Aroma is certain to add more vigor to national goal of imparting best education to our students at national and international levels respectively. It is going to make them competent enough to scale anywhere in the world keeping hand in hand with other institutions across the globe. Situated in a peaceful environment, Aroma has separate blocks for class XI and class XII. It has sophisticated library with reference books, course books, magazines, journals and newspapers, e-library facility, well equipped separate labs for class XI and class XII, better furnished class rooms, five buses for transportation and facilitated buildings. It has been conducting +2 programs in Science and Management affiliated to Higher Secondary Education Board of Nepal. In future it also aims at launching BBA,BCA, BScIT and Diploma in Engineering. Probably this is the first college in a private sector having the maximum students in +2 level. There are 700 students in +2 Science and 350 students in +2 Management. Currently, 58 teaching staffs and 19 administrative staffs are working in this institution. As Aroma has professionally experienced, skilled and committed faculty members and sonorous environment to enhance learning and focuses on individual attention to students for moral development and self discipline, it seems to have been proved as a center for excellence. The college has topped Chitwan NISSAN district in the board exam (Grade XI in Science) of 2069 B.S. The college also provides MBBS and BE entrance guideline during the +2 study. There is an adequate infrastructural set up in a location, which is easily accessible from all rounds. Vision: To establish and develop Aroma as an academic center where the blend of Science and Management stands as the bedrock in the pursuit of nation building. Mission: Aroma undertakes the mission of providing international standard education with excellent learning environment and proper individual care by a highly qualified, devoted and self motivated teaching team.

name: Ram Tulasi Secondary School
description: Ram Tulasi Secondary School, located in the scenic Kali Gandaki Valley of Darchha, Palpa, is a pioneering academic institution that has been transforming lives since 2025 B.S. As the first secondary school in eastern Palpa, the school has grown into a beacon of accessible and inclusive education, offering a full spectrum of programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12, including NEB-affiliated +2 programs in Science, Management, Education, and Humanities, as well as a CTEVT-recognized Diploma in Agriculture (Plant Science).With a mission rooted in equity and empowerment, the school is especially committed to supporting students from marginalized communities, indigenous groups, and economically disadvantaged families through scholarship schemes and residential facilities. The school provides bilingual instruction in both Nepali and English, ensuring inclusive and comprehensive learning for all.Over the course of more than 50 years, the school has evolved from humble beginnings, originally conducting classes under a tree to a modern, master-planned campus equipped with science labs, a well-stocked library, ICT-integrated classrooms, and advanced agricultural training infrastructure. Its regional impact spans across Palpa, Syangja, Tanahun, and Nawalparasi, helping bridge the rural-urban education divide.Recognized as a model community school, the school has achieved numerous milestones like hosting the region’s first SLC examination center, pioneering vocational agricultural education, and being recently shortlisted as a Nepal Model School for its commitment to quality and innovation.Surrounded by the tranquil beauty of the Kali Gandaki River and located near Bejhad Bazaar, the school’s serene setting provides an ideal environment for academic excellence and personal growth. Through its diverse academic pathways and its commitment to community upliftment, Ram Tulasi Secondary School stands as a pillar of holistic, future-ready education in western Nepal.

name: Zilla Uchchangal Ramdev Kalwar Secondary School
description: Jilla Uchangal Ramdev Kalwar Secondary School, located in Pokhariya, Parsa, is a community-based academic institution established in 1967 A.D. (2024 B.S.). The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education, offering educational programs from ECD to Grade 10, along with Ten Plus Two (10+2) in Education.Recognized as a technical school, it also provides specialized training in Sub-Electrical Engineering from Grade 9 to 12, equipping students with both academic knowledge and practical skills needed for the job market.The school maintains moderate fee structures to ensure educational access and also offers scholarship schemes for hardworking and deserving students. With a strong focus on inclusive learning and skill development, Jilla Uchangal Ramdev Kalwar Secondary School plays a key role in promoting both general and technical education in the Parsa district.By combining traditional academics with technical training, the school continues to empower students with the tools they need for further education, employment, and personal growth.

name: Shree Panchayat Secondary School
description: Located at South Buddha Chowk, one kilometer from the East-West Highway, Shree Panchayat Secondary School is easily accessible and has grown into a leading educational hub. Since it opened, the school has been committed to offering quality, practical, life-oriented education for its students.The school has been expanding its educational programs over time. It received permission for the primary level in 2040 BS, the lower secondary level in 2045 BS, the secondary level in 2052 BS, and the then higher secondary level in 2054 BS, and is currently operating programs from kindergarten to grade 12. As of 2081/82, the school has 2,649 students studying from kindergarten to grade 12.Shree Panchayat Secondary School offers both general and technical stream educational programs. Under the technical stream, civil engineering is taught from grades 9 to 12. In addition, in grades 11 and 12, students have options to study various subjects under the core group of science, law, fine arts, management, humanities and education.The school is adopting modern teaching methods by making maximum use of information technology in the teaching-learning process. Shree Panchayat Secondary School is continuously contributing to society and nation building by providing dedicated teachers and staff, quality educational environment and multifaceted opportunities with the aim of producing efficient, disciplined and responsible citizens.The school embraces a practical, skill-oriented approach to learning with updated teaching methodologies and project-based education. It features modern science and computer labs, field visits, additional coaching classes, and a student-friendly environment. With a focus on experiential learning, new-age pedagogies, and the integration of ICT, Shree Panchayat Secondary School continues to prepare students for both higher education and real-world challenges.

name: Triyuga Secondary School
description: Established in 1966 AD (2023 BS), Triyuga Secondary School Gaighat is located in Gaighat, Udayapur, Nepal. The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education. Triyuga Secondary School is the first public school in the district to teach English and has been offering English-medium classes since 10 years ago. Nepali-medium classes are also conducted from grade 6 to grade 12.The school offers education from Early Child Development (ECD) to grade 10 and ten plus two (10+2) programmes in Management, Science, Humanities, Law, Civil Engineering, and Education streams. The school has been providing affordable education with moderate fee structures and also offers scholarships to deserving students.Triyuga Secondary School Gaighat is known for its well-equipped physical infrastructure, technology-friendly classrooms, thematic laboratories, and sports facilities. The school has a team of subject-wise skilled teachers who are committed to providing quality education to the students. The school also conducts entrance exams to maintain the quality of education and handle the capacity. The School Management Committee is actively involved in developing the school plan and is working on a 22-point action plan for school improvement.

name: Gorkha Secondary School
description: Located in the peaceful surroundings of Tulsipur-6, Baruwagaun, Dang, Gorkha Secondary School is a premier educational institution established in 2011 by the Gorkha Education Group. Spread across 3 bighas of land, the school is dedicated to providing quality education for future generations. It is backed by Ex-Gurkhas (Lahures), serving armies, and local intellectuals, ensuring a disciplined and nurturing learning environment. The school serves over 2,500 students and offers +2 programs in Science and Management, affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB). To meet growing demand, both Day and Morning shifts are available. With a vision to produce creative and competent youth, the institution integrates modern teaching methodologies, interactive classrooms, and practical exposure through educational excursions, industrial visits, and banking training for Management students. Gorkha Secondary School is renowned for its highly qualified faculty, well-equipped Science and Computer labs, e-library, earthquake-resistant buildings, and student-centered learning approaches. Emphasizing discipline, career counseling, and personal development, the school ensures holistic growth for its students. With a commitment to excellence, Gorkha Secondary School continues to be the preferred learning destination, empowering students to become future leaders, innovators, and job creators.

name: Guru Jajur Secondary School
description: Guru Jajur Secondary School is recognized as a leading community school in the region, known for providing education to students with disabilities. Established on 11 Falgun 2011 BS, the school is located just three kilometers north of Tulsipur market along the Tulsipur–Salyan road.The school currently serves 2,608 students, including 1,359 girls and 1,249 boys, offering education from early childhood to Grade 12. At the higher secondary level, it offers programs in Science, Humanities, Education, and Management, as well as a Diploma in Agriculture (Plant Science). Students from various districts, including Dang, Rukum, Rolpa, Salyan, Pyuthan, Banke, Bardiya, Jumla, Dolpa, and Bajura, attend the school.Guru Jajur Secondary School emphasizes creativity and innovation, consistently improving student outcomes each year. It runs various educational programs involving parents, teachers, and students to enhance learning quality. Education at the school follows principles of inclusivity, accessibility, timeliness, and a focus on technical and vocational skills.The school ensures regular classes even during annual breaks. It provides additional support classes for struggling students, career guidance for graduating students, and has established an employment information center to promote job opportunities. Students studying plant science have built a modern, technology-integrated greenhouse, producing vegetables for both learning and local community use, enhancing practical skills and capacity development.The school also manages 23 scholarship funds, supports teachers with a conducive working environment, encourages collaborative learning, and maintains regular communication with parents regarding students’ progress and needs.The campus includes 10 buildings with 43 classrooms, a changing room for girls, a lactation room for female staff and teachers, four science laboratories, a computer lab, an agriculture lab, an e-library, a hostel for visually impaired students, and a sports ground.Guru Jajur Secondary School continues to serve as a model institution, combining inclusive education with academic excellence, practical learning, and community engagement.

name: Orchid School
description: Established in 2057, B.S. Orchid School is located at Hakim Chowk, Bharatpur, Chitwan. Since its inception, the School has offered quality education for the holistic development of the kids. The Orchid School team has envisioned making the school the dreamland of parents and one of the model schools in the country. Orchid School offers classes from Nursery to Grade 10. The school pleads you all at least visit here and us in person before you choose the pathway for your kids.

name: Sainamaina Secondary School
description: Sainamaina Secondary School, established in 2031 B.S., is a well-established community-based government school located in Sainamaina, Rupandehi, Nepal. With a long-standing history of academic service, the school has been a cornerstone of education in the region, offering classes from Nursery to Grade 12 in a supportive and inclusive learning environment. The educational curriculum of the school is divided into three categories: Pre-school level, Basic level, and Secondary level. Affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB), Kavilash Secondary School offers comprehensive Plus Two (10+2) programs in Science, Management, and Education. As a government-funded institution, Sainamaina Secondary School is committed to providing accessible and quality education to students from diverse backgrounds. The school’s mission is to empower students with strong academic foundations, life skills, and values that help them succeed in higher education and beyond. With a focus on both academic excellence and holistic development, the school fosters creativity, discipline, and social responsibility among its students.The school operates with a dedicated team of experienced and qualified teachers who use effective teaching methodologies aligned with Nepal’s national curriculum. Equipped with essential facilities and a growing focus on modern educational tools, Sainamaina Secondary School ensures that every child receives a meaningful and future-focused education.

name: Jana Jyoti Secondary School
description: Jana Jyoti Secondary School is listed at Ranibagaicha, Sainamaina-1, Rupandehi.

name: Shree Siddha Ratna Nath Model Secondary School
description: Shree Siddharatna Nath Model Secondary School is located in Narayanpur, Dang . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.

name: Satyawati Secondary School
description: Satyawati Secondary School is listed at Khalanga, Mahakali-4, Darchula.

name: Amar Singh Model Secondary School
address: Amar Singh Chowk, Ramghat, Pokhara-12, Kaski
description: Located in Ramghat, Pokhara, Kaski, Shree Amar Singh Model Secondary School (AMSS) stands as one of Nepal’s most distinguished community schools. Established in 1957 A.D. (2013 B.S.) through the Post-War Reconstruction Fund, the school has grown into an award-winning institution known for its academic excellence, inclusive values, and rich legacy.Recognized as a Model School by the Government of Nepal, the school offers NEB-affiliated +2 programs in Science, Management, Education, and Humanities. It was a pioneer in inclusivity, introducing Braille education in 1981 and English medium instruction in 1985, ensuring access to quality education for all.The school has earned numerous accolades, including:Best Community Higher Secondary School (Western Development Region – 2062, 2064, 2065 BS)Best Community Secondary School Nationwide (2063 BS)Model Higher Secondary School (Western Development Region – 2061 BS; National Recognition – 2004 AD)With a strong foundation in academic rigor and holistic development, the school has produced thousands of successful alumni across diverse professional fields, including Medicine, Engineering, Chartered Accountancy, and Public Leadership. The school continues to collaborate with federal, provincial, and local bodies to enhance educational quality and infrastructure.The school’s guiding motto, “Always Aim High,” reflects its mission to nurture ambition, discipline, leadership, and community values in every student. Its modern infrastructure, specialized classrooms, and emphasis on holistic growth through extracurricular activities and character development make the school an ideal environment for students to thrive academically, socially, and personally. With a history of producing successful alumni across various professional sectors, the school continues to set the standard for community-based education in Nepal.

name: Shree 3 Chandra Secondary School
description: Shree Teen Chandra Secondary School is located in Kalaiya, Bara . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.

name: Beni Bhola Model Secondary School
description: Beni Bhola Model Secondary School, established in 2004 B.S., is a public institution located in Godaita Municipality, Sarlahi district, within Madhesh Province. Known for its commitment to academic excellence and progressive learning practices, the school stands as a model institution in the region.The school provides education from the Early Childhood Development (ECD) level up to Grade 12, operating primarily in English medium. It follows a student-centered approach and emphasizes conceptual learning, using innovative teaching methods supported by Information and Communication Technology (ICT). With experienced and trained educators, Beni Bhola Model Secondary School integrates subject-wise lesson planning and dynamic classroom strategies tailored to students' individual learning needs.The school is equipped with essential educational resources, including well-organized subject-wise laboratories and additional classes as needed for academic reinforcement. A major strength of the institution lies in its ability to blend traditional values with modern pedagogy, thereby fostering both discipline and creativity among students.Recognized for its performance in national-level programs, the school has also earned accolades, including first place in the Level Presidential Running Attendance competition, a testament to its dedication to consistent learning and student engagement.According to the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Beni Bhola Model Secondary School has 2,187 enrolled students, reflecting its status as a prominent educational institution in the region.

This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.NEB has given affiliation to Nrisingh Secondary School to run Ten plus two in Computer Engineering program in 2015 AD.

name: Shree Sarswati Secondary School
description: Shree Sarswati Secondary School is a public school located in Durga Bhagwati Rural Municipality, Rautahat district, within Madhesh province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Shree Sarswati Secondary School has 2521 enrolled students.

name: Global Educational Academy Secondary School
description: Global Educational Academy (GEA) is one of the leading educational institutions in the eastern region, situated at the heart of Damak Municipality. Since its establishment in 2053 B.S. by a team of eminent academicians and devoted teachers, it has been accredited for its quality education in the region. The SEE and NEB results, including its extra-curricular activities and performances, highlight its reputation. The academy is especially known for its discipline, quality education, and the production of human capital to meet this competitive arena's needs. It offers +2 programs in Science, Commerce, Humanities, Law, Education, Computer Science, and Hotel Management, and aims to explore the hidden value of individuals by providing an educational environment and culture to adjust to society. Situated in a congenial academic environment, Global is rich in infrastructure. It has a well-equipped computer, physics, chemistry, and biology labs, a well-stocked library, and well-ventilated, comfortable classrooms. To develop the personality of students, the academy cares individually, monitors academic and career counseling for students in coordination with guardians. Besides these, it also emphasizes sports and cultural programs, curricular and co-curricular activities. Dance, Music, Vocal, and Fine Arts are held every Saturday. Global Educational Academy is the first school in Damak City to introduce e-learning classes in the school.

name: Bhutandevi Secondary School
description: Established in 2016 B.S., Bhutandevi Secondary School is one of the oldest and most respected community schools in Makwanpur district. Located in the heart of Hetauda Sub-Metropolitan City Ward No. 4, the school has grown from a traditional language school to a leading institution in both general and technical education.With over 2,400 students currently enrolled, Bhutandevi offers academic programs from Early Childhood Education to Grade 12 in both English and Nepali mediums. It provides Plus Two programs in Management, Education, and Civil Engineering, and proudly holds the distinction of being the first school in the district to offer a technical stream in Civil Engineering.Since 2070 B.S., the school has been running Civil Engineering classes from Grades 9 to 12, and since 2076 B.S., it has been offering a 3-year Diploma in Civil Engineering under CTEVT. It also conducts pre-diploma and skill-based training programs, including industrial trainee courses and a 24-month Early Childhood Development Facilitator training from 2081 B.S.The school boasts excellent infrastructure with 9 buildings, 61 rooms (40 used for classrooms), a large playground, and 73 rental shutters that serve as a sustainable source of income. Its facilities include science and computer labs, a well-stocked library, and free Wi-Fi. The faculty comprises 73 trained and experienced teachers and staff who regularly participate in curriculum development, assessment, and ICT training workshops.Bhutandevi Secondary School has consistently demonstrated academic excellence. In the 2080 SEE exams, it achieved a 74.54% pass rate, securing the top position in the district. Similarly, in recent municipal-level Grade 8 exams, several students scored a perfect GPA of 4.0, reaffirming its reputation as the best-performing community school in the municipality.In addition to academics, the school emphasizes co-curricular activities, technical skill development, and behavior-focused education, preparing students to be capable professionals and responsible citizens. With alumni working in government services, private consultancies, and as sub-engineers across local and provincial bodies, the school continues to contribute significantly to Nepal's technical workforce.The school is also leading an initiative to merge with a neighboring community school to form a "mega school," further expanding its capacity and impact.

name: Kanchanjunga English Secondary School
description: Kanchanjunga English Secondary School, run under a single management system, was established in 2065 BS with a view of meeting the growing demand for quality education. It is located at Birtamode-7, Jhapa, which is the centre of eastern region Nepal. Since 2068 BS, it has been running plus two program in Science and Management in affiliation with National Examination Board of Nepal. Running +2 in the district has helped many SLC graduates to pursue their dreams in the hometown itself. With the motto "to produce qualified & responsible citizens for the nation" Kanchanjunga's team of qualified and dedicated teachers offers a wide and stimulating academic environment that meets individual needs. The school has developed certain policies to maintain self-disciplined environment in the school. Kanchanjunga has established an outstanding reputation for excellence in quality education as well as discipline within a very short span of time. Since its inception, it has been trying to be an academic institution where students can get all round education and build their moral character in an articulate manner. Kanchanjunga has significant results in the examinations of SLC and plus two. It has shown its outstanding achievements in extra-curricular activities too. It has developed the infrastructure for sustainable and quality education. It has well-furnished and spacious classrooms, well-stocked library, well-equipped science laboratories, etc.

name: Sainik Awasiya Mahavidyalaya Bhaktapur
description: The Mahavidyalaya provides education for Grades VI through XII, offering compulsory boarding for male students and optional boarding for a limited number of female students. While most female students attend as day scholars, a select percentage may be granted boarding facilities based on accommodation capacity and specific student necessity, following established priority guidelines. In grade 11 & 12, it offers +2 Science, Management and Humanities. The institution operates 10 sections per grade, with approximately 40 students per section, totaling 50 sections across all levels. Each grade level is managed by a Class Coordinator, and the sections are organized into three distinct blocks: East, West, and North.The Mahavidyalaya has consistently achieved outstanding academic results in the Grade VIII Basic Level Examinations and the SEE. Its key features include a well-developed physical infrastructure, an affordable fee structure, and a highly qualified faculty supported by dedicated administrative staff. Furthermore, it provides well-equipped science and computer laboratories and a well-stocked library featuring a wide range of textbooks, reference materials, and advanced internet access.The academic program emphasizes continuous assessment of student performance. Progress is monitored through regular unit tests, homework assignments, project work, and terminal examinations, all of which are considered essential components of the institution's educational approach.

name: Amar Jyoti Model Secondary School
description: Amar Jyoti Model Secondary School was established in 1960 AD (2017 B.S.) as a publicly owned academic institution located in Birendranagar-12, Neware, Chanaute, Surkhet, in Karnali Province of Nepal. The school is affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB) and the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT) and is approved by the Ministry of Education, Nepal. It offers Ten Plus Two (10+2) programs in Science, Management, and Education, along with diploma-level programs such as Diploma in Civil Engineering and Diploma in Geomatics Engineering with an intake of 40 students in each program annually.The school has built a strong reputation for academic performance and technical education in the region. In addition to regular academic programs, Amar Jyoti Model Secondary School emphasizes practical learning, field-based activities, and extracurricular engagement. Activities such as weekly achievement tests for Grade 10 students, local observation visits for Grade 8 students under subjects like “Hami ra Hamro Birendranagar,” and various extracurricular and physical training sessions help support students’ overall development. The school also promotes reading culture among students by providing literary materials such as the children’s magazine Muna to encourage interest in literature and learning.With experienced instructors, well-managed academic programs, and opportunities for practical exposure, Amar Jyoti Model Secondary School continues to contribute to quality education and technical skill development in Surkhet.

name: Shree Janta Secondary School, Prawaha
description: Shree Janta Secondary School Samsi, Prawaha is a prominent public educational institution situated in Samsi Rural Municipality of Mahottari district, in the heart of Madhesh province. The school offers a full range of academic programs starting from Early Childhood Development (ECD) up to Grade 10, catering to the educational needs of the local community.According to the 2081 IEMIS report by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, the school has a robust enrollment of 2,958 students. This reflects its reputation as a trusted center for learning, where students receive solid academic instruction supported by a team of dedicated and approachable teachers.Shree Janta Secondary School Samsi, Prawaha is committed to creating a positive and encouraging learning environment. The school’s focus on quality education is complemented by spacious classrooms and a variety of extracurricular opportunities, enabling students to grow both academically and personally. With its strong community ties and emphasis on holistic development, the school continues to play a vital role in shaping the future of its students.

name: Omega International Secondary School
description: Omega International Secondary School has been suitably located in Lalitpur at Kumaripati in a serene and academic supportive environment over an impressive landscape. Its team is a unique creation of some of Nepal’s well-known educationists, academicians and scholars from diverse subject background required for the disciplines of Science, Management and Humanities. Such team of professionally trained and experienced teacher guides students continuously for competitive theoretical and practical knowledge. There are well equipped Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Computer Laboratories; spacious sports field and sophisticated library for acquiring knowledge and skills. Omega is a contemporary and conscientious academic institution where student purse excellence in all academic activities leading to the frontiers of knowledge. The experienced and competent hands of Omega Team nurture the individual potential of each student by encouraging intellectual integrity and social responsibility.Led by a dedicated team of reputed academics, this learning centre of excellence is going to launch Bachelor’s and Master level classes in the near future, and aims to set up an esteemed University of its own . Meanwhile, the team has decided to locate +2 programs in Kumaripati, Lalitpur upgrading, reinvigorating and redefining 23 years of glorious Shikhar Boarding Secondary School of Jawalakhel, Lalitpur.Omega has a vision for the country by cultivating responsive and responsible links of the new generation towards nations development, respect for Nepali traditions and human values along with the knowledge of global currents. Contact Address Omega International CollegeP.B. No. 286,Kumaripati,Lalitpur Nepal

name: Gautam Secondary School
description: Established in 2033 B.S., Gautam School is located in Shripur, Birgunj, Parsa. The school was founded with a clear mission—to create a supportive environment where every student can grow, learn, and thrive each day. Through a student-centered approach and a team of passionate educators, Gautam School focuses on both academic achievement and personal growth. With a strong belief that all children can learn, the school is dedicated to improving students’ foundational skills while promoting values like punctuality, discipline, and good citizenship. Gautam School fosters a secure and inclusive space that encourages curiosity, creativity, and lifelong learning—preparing students to succeed in a fast-changing, technology-driven world. Gautam School also aims to develop responsible, informed, and active members of society. Its dynamic learning environment cultivates academic excellence, personal responsibility, and a strong sense of community. Prospective families are welcome to explore the school, learn more about its enrollment process, or schedule a visit to experience the vibrant educational atmosphere Gautam School proudly offers.

description: New Environment English Secondary School (NESS), established in 2051 B.S., is a leading school located in Tilottama Municipality, Rupandehi district, within Lumbini Province. Widely recognized as one of the best schools in the region, NESS is committed to delivering quality, holistic education that goes beyond textbooks and classrooms. The school offers comprehensive education from the primary to secondary levels, nurturing academic excellence while emphasizing creativity, leadership, and social responsibility. With a student-centered and inquiry-based approach, NESS fosters curiosity, critical thinking, and innovation among learners, helping them develop into confident, responsible, and competent individuals. NESS provides a vibrant learning environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, including well-equipped classrooms, a modern library, dedicated science and computer laboratories, and sports infrastructure. The school actively promotes extracurricular and co-curricular activities such as music, arts, debate, sports, leadership programs, and cultural events to ensure the holistic development of each child. To support student well-being and safety, the school offers hygienic and nutritious meals through its canteen, a reliable transportation system, and a disciplined, child-friendly atmosphere. Regular communication with parents is maintained through meetings, progress reports, and digital platforms, ensuring transparency and collaborative growth. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, New Environment English Secondary School has a total of 2,198 enrolled students, reflecting the trust and confidence the community places in its mission and vision.

name: Shree Ratna Rajya Secondary School
description: Established on April 28, 1960 AD (Baisakh 16, 2017 BS), Ratna Rajya Secondary School is a distinguished community-based educational institution situated in Mid-Baneshwor, Kathmandu, Nepal. The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and is approved by the Ministry of Education. It offers comprehensive ten plus two (10+2) programs in Management, Science, Humanities, and Education streams. Mission and Vision Ratna Rajya Secondary School is dedicated to providing students with an exceptional academic foundation, enabling them to excel in the job market and secure admissions to their desired universities for further education. The school envisions creating strong, positive connections with students, fostering their independence, building confidence, and enhancing their academic knowledge. Goals and Objectives The primary goal of Ratna Rajya Secondary School is to prepare students for success in the 21st century by offering relevant learning opportunities that promote academic, physical, and emotional growth. The school aims to nurture individuals academically, socially, and emotionally, equipping them to tackle academic challenges and become productive members of society.

name: St. Mary's School
description: St. Mary's School is located at Jawalakhel, Lalitpur. It completed more than 50 years of dedicated service to the people of Nepal in the field of Education. Fifty years of commitment to "Education of Girls", walking on the ideals of a great pioneering woman 'Mary Ward' of the 16th century.Standing the tests of time St. Mary's has emerged as the best educational institution for girls, has earned the respect and honour not only in our country Nepal, but even on an international level.St. Mary’s High School, is open to girls of all communities, irrespective of status, caste, creed and religion. This school imparts not only academic education to girls, but also helps them to form an integrated personality by developing in them a strong character, love of truth, respect, loyalty, a sense of justice and the necessity for honest hard work. This will make them an honor to womanhood and a source of happiness and blessings to all with whom they come in contact.

name: Jeevan Jyoti School
description: Jeevan Jyoti Secondary School, established in 2071 BS, is an academic institution located in Surkhet, Nepal. Guided by its powerful motto, “Ignorance to Wisdom,” the school is committed to transforming students’ lives through quality education, leadership development, and modern teaching practices. Known for its excellent academic reputation, Jeevan Jyoti combines a strong core curriculum with a focus on character education, technology integration, and 21st-century skills. From Nursery to Grade 12, the school offers a well-rounded learning experience designed to help students grow academically, socially, and emotionally. At the +2 level, students can choose from programs in Science—including Biology and Computer Science—as well as Management, which offers subjects such as Computer Science, Business Studies, and Hotel Management. These streams aim to equip learners with both academic knowledge and real-world skills for future success. The school also places a strong emphasis on creating future-ready learners by promoting digital literacy, leadership opportunities, and values-based education. Parents are encouraged to be actively involved in the learning process, recognizing their essential role in each child’s success. With a vibrant learning community, dedicated staff, and a student-first approach, Jeevan Jyoti Secondary School stands out as a leading choice for families looking to build a better future—together, with no excuses.

name: Balmiki Education Foundation
description: Balmiki Education Foundation is a renowned private educational institution located in the heart of Birtamod Municipality, Charpane, Jhapa. Established in 2002 AD (2059 BS), the school is approved by the Ministry of Education. Balmiki Education Foundation has steadily grown in both size and quality, offering education from Nursery through Grade 12, with grade 12 programs being Science and Management. With a mission to provide accessible and high-quality education, the school maintains a moderate fee structure while also offering scholarships to deserving students. Balmiki has earned a reputation for its outstanding academic performance, particularly excelling in SEE results for five consecutive years. The school emphasizes a holistic development, ensuring students are actively involved in various co-curricular activities that complement their academic journey. Balmiki Education Foundation's commitment to excellence is reflected in its well-equipped facilities, competent staff, and supportive learning environment. The management team continues to focus on nurturing future leaders with the same dedication and energy that has characterized the institution’s growth over the years.

name: Shree Secondary School Pathara Budharam

name: Sagarmatha English Boarding Secondary School
description: Sagarmatha Secondary Boarding School is a beacon of quality education located in the peaceful area of Devdaha Municipality, Nepal. Established on 5th Poush 2051 B.S., the school is committed to providing exceptional educational opportunities in the historically significant and sacred birthplace of Mayadevi, the mother of Lord Buddha.Now in its 29th year of excellence, the school proudly reflects on its journey of achievements and milestones. The first batch of SLC graduates in 2060 B.S. achieved a remarkable 100% pass rate with ten students. The school also celebrated its silver jubilee on 7th Falgun 2075 B.S., reaffirming its long-standing dedication to academic excellence.Since 2064 B.S., Sagarmatha Secondary Boarding School has expanded its academic offerings by introducing the 10+2 Science, Management, and Humanities programs under the National Examination Board (NEB). Over the years, the school has consistently delivered outstanding results in both academics and extracurricular activities. Students have demonstrated excellence at the local, district, and provincial levels, earning recognition in various competitions.The school emphasizes a holistic approach to education, encouraging growth beyond academics. It fosters an environment where students can explore diverse experiences and develop across multiple dimensions of life. Sagarmatha Secondary Boarding School views education as a means of empowerment—helping learners navigate complexities and pursue knowledge with confidence.The success of the institution is driven by the dedication, teamwork, and creativity of its staff. Both teachers and students regard the school as more than an institution—a second home. The school maintains a strong focus on maximizing educational quality while keeping costs manageable, and believes in delivering value that goes beyond quantity. Education here is rooted in real-life relevance, nurturing practical understanding and application.Recognizing the importance of mental well-being, the school also provides professional counseling services. Qualified counselors support students inside and outside the classroom, helping them navigate personal and academic challenges.In a significant milestone, Sagarmatha Secondary Boarding School has achieved ISO 9001:2015 certification, a reflection of its commitment to continual improvement. With guidance from the ISO team, both teaching and non-teaching staff strive to enhance service quality and educational outcomes. Additionally, the recent appointment of an educational consultant brings new insights and strategic direction, enabling the school to innovate and grow further.These accomplishments highlight the school’s unwavering commitment to excellence in education. Sagarmatha Secondary Boarding School looks forward to continued progress and warmly welcomes students, parents, and the wider community to become part of its ever-evolving journey.FacilitiesAudio-Visual FacilitiesClassrooms are equipped with audio-visual tools to support interactive learning. Each class is limited to 25–30 students, enabling teachers to provide individual attention and maintain close interaction with every student.HostelThe school provides spacious and well-designed dormitories with attached bathrooms, supervised by dedicated hostel wardens. Students are served well-balanced, nutritious meals and snacks daily. Hostel facilities also include access to a computerized library with a wide selection of academic resources.Montessori BlockA separate and well-furnished Montessori block is available for early learners, featuring age-appropriate playing materials, a mini-laboratory, and even a baby swimming pool, ensuring a joyful and engaging start to learning.Basketball GroundEmphasizing the value of physical activity, the school features a spacious, well-equipped basketball court. The facility supports physical development and adds to the overall aesthetic and infrastructure of the school.TransportThe school operates a fleet of buses equipped with a bus tracking system, allowing parents to monitor the location and movement of their child’s bus in real-time for added convenience and safety.

name: Bal Ekta English Boarding School
description: Bal Ekta English Boarding School, established in 1992 A.D., is one of the most reputable and long-standing educational institutions in Kalaiya, Bara. With over 33 years of academic excellence, the school offers a comprehensive educational journey from Playgroup to Grade 12, fostering both academic and personal growth in its students. Known for its commitment to modern education, Bal Ekta features technologically advanced learning spaces, including smart classrooms, well-equipped science and computer laboratories, and modern infrastructure that supports an interactive and engaging learning experience. The school is guided by a team of qualified and supportive teachers who prioritize student well-being and academic success. With a focus on creating a safe and nurturing environment, Bal Ekta ensures every student receives the care and attention they need to thrive. Beyond academics, the school encourages holistic development through co-curricular and extracurricular programs that promote leadership, creativity, and critical thinking. Bal Ekta English Boarding School continues to uphold its mission of shaping confident, competent, and responsible citizens, solidifying its place as a leading institution in the region and a trusted name in education.

name: Siddhartha English Boarding Secondary School
description: Siddhartha English Boarding Secondary School began as a Pre-Primary School in Kalikanagar, Butwal-12, Lumbini, Nepal in BS 2036 (1979 AD). There were very few private schools in this area at the time. Siddhartha Gautama was a forerunner in this subject. However, Siddhartha English Boarding Secondary School was resurrected in BS 2050 (1993 AD). A new team was formed, consisting solely of teachers and academics. Until that time, the majority of schools were administered by people in extremely small regions. The team envisioned a school with plenty of room and all of the necessary amenities in a welcoming environment. In the year B.S. -2071, the school inaugurated the 'Plus Two' curriculum under the then HSEB (Higher Secondary Education Board) (2014 A.D.). In Grades XI and XII, it now offers a variety of science and management disciplines under the N.E.B. (National Examinations Board).

name: Panchamunidev Secondary School
description: Panchamunidev Secondary School, located in Dulegaunda-4, Shuklagandaki, Tanahun, is a community-based government institution established in 2027 BS. Over the decades, it has grown into a notable educational center in the district, producing its first SLC batch in 2048 BS and later expanding to offer higher secondary programs. The school currently serves approximately 1,680 students from Nursery to Grade 12.The institution provides a bilingual learning environment, offering English-medium classes from Nursery to Grade 12 and Nepali-medium classes from Grade 4 to Grade 12. At the plus two level, students can choose from various streams, including Science, Management, Education, Law, and Animal Science, all affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB). To ensure academic rigor, the school conducts extra classes in core subjects for grades six to twelve and organizes weekly tests for students in grades nine and ten.Beyond the classroom, Panchamunidev Secondary School emphasizes holistic development through a wide range of extra-curricular activities. Students can engage in sports, literature, music, dance, art, and meditation. The school also organizes educational tours and various competitive events to foster personal growth. Currently ranked second among community schools in the district, the institution remains dedicated to enhancing academic standards while maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for the community.Vision:To develop well-rounded, confident, and responsible individuals who aspire to achieve their full potential. School will do this by providing a welcoming, happy, safe, and supportive learning environment in which everyone is equal, and all achievements are celebrated.

name: Siddhartha Shishu Sadan Boarding Secondary School
description: Established in 2038 B.S., Siddhartha Shishu Sadan Boarding Secondary School is one of the most prestigious and progressive schools in Janakpurdham, Nepal. Operated under the management of Janakpur Education Foundation Pvt. Ltd., the school serves over 2,000 students from early childhood through secondary levels, offering a balanced and comprehensive education.With a strong focus on academic excellence, Siddhartha Shishu Sadan is supported by a team of experienced and dedicated faculty members who guide students through a well-structured curriculum. The school also offers counseling services, promoting both academic success and emotional well-being.Siddhartha Shishu Sadan Boarding Secondary School maintains a strong partnership with families through active parent-teacher interactions and prioritizes student safety with a reliable transportation system. The school also provides scholarship opportunities for deserving students, supporting access to quality education for all.

The institution also runs a Bachelors Program, affiliated with Tribhuvan University ( TU ). With over 3,000 students, the school provides a friendly and well-equipped learning environment where every child is encouraged to do their best. Along with strong academics, the school also focuses on co-curricular activities, digital learning, and personal development to help students become well-rounded individuals.The school has received many honors, including the International School Award (ISA 2019–2022) from the British Council, and various awards at district, provincial, and national levels—showing its strong commitment to quality and excellence.The school is guided by four core values: Knowledge, Skill, Social Responsibility, and Discipline—which they believe are the key to helping students succeed in life.

name: Radiant Montessori English (RME) School
description: Radiant Montessori English (RME) School, established in 2067 B.S., is a dynamic educational institution dedicated to providing a comprehensive and high-quality education. The school has been recognized twice with the prestigious International School Award (ISA) by the British Council, highlighting its commitment to enriching the curriculum and fostering global collaborations. RME School serves as a platform for students to nurture their innate talents and develop a strong sense of social responsibility towards their community, country, and the world. With a focus on holistic development, the school ensures a conducive learning environment for its students, and its graduates have achieved commendable positions both nationally and internationally, contributing to its outstanding educational reputation.
