name: Gyanodaya Model Secondary School
description: Gyanodaya Model Secondary School, located in Khajura Rural Municipality-3, Khajura Bazar, Nepalgunj, in the Banke district of Nepal, is a prominent educational institution offering classes from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. It was established in 2034 B.S. With a current enrollment of 2,108 students in year 2082, the school has seen a growing demand for admission, including 251 new enrollments from students transferring from other institutions this academic year. To accommodate the increasing student population, the school has added 43 additional classes and recruited 15 new teachers and 13 support staff through private resources. The current teacher-to-student ratio stands at 2:35.Gyanodaya has gained recognition for its outstanding academic performance, particularly in the Secondary Education Examination (SEE) and Grade 11–12 results, which surpass the performance of many other public schools in western Nepal. In the academic year, 2080, 90% of the students who took the SEE exam passed, with a notable number achieving high grades. Presently, 178 students are studying in Grade 10, and student numbers in Grades 11 and 12 remain high. The school had 563 students enrolled in its Plus Two (10+2) program last year, with a pass rate of 61% and an academic achievement score of 58.66.In line with the preferences of parents and students, Gyanodaya conducts English-medium instruction from Grades 1 to 6, and offers both English and Nepali mediums for Grades 6 to 10. Students enrolling in Grade 6 after completing Grade 5 are given the option to choose their preferred language of instruction. This bilingual approach, coupled with the school’s boarding-style uniforms and low-fee, high-quality education model, has significantly increased its popularity.The school offers free education from Grades 1 to 8. For Grades 9 and 10, tuition remains free for Nepali-medium students, while English-medium students pay a monthly fee of NPR 900 and NPR 1,000, respectively. Students using school transportation or attending coaching classes pay an additional NPR 600 per month.To improve academic outcomes, particularly for SEE candidates, the school runs annual coaching classes in English, Mathematics, and Science from Asar (June/July) to Chaitra (March/April). These sessions are tailored based on students’ proximity to the school, with coaching held in the morning and/or evening. A minimal monthly fee of NPR 600 is charged for these sessions.Recognized as a model school in 2073 B.S. (2016/17), Gyanodaya began offering technical education in civil engineering in Grade 9 and later expanded to offer science education in Grades 11 and 12 from 2076 B.S. onwards. With support from the Model Secondary School Development Program and local government funding, the school has constructed 37 classrooms, installed 100 new desk-bench sets, and built 30 toilets for students and staff. Additionally, the school has developed well-equipped science and computer labs.Gyanodaya is also committed to integrating Information and Communication Technology (ICT) into teaching. Every teacher has been provided with a laptop, and the school regularly organizes training to enhance teaching capacity. It conducts three major exams annually and requires parents to attend the result publication events to ensure active involvement in student progress.The school operates two buses funded by local government grants, enabling students from distant areas to commute easily. It also offers attractive and child-friendly classrooms for ECD and nursery-level children, with appropriate teaching aids, toys, and trained staff. Currently, 318 children are enrolled at the nursery and ECD level, where the learning achievement rate is 78%.Spanning nearly two bighas of land, the school campus comprises ten buildings with a total of 66 rooms, including fully functional science labs (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), a library, and reading corners in each classroom. Gyanodaya continues to emphasize interactive and practical learning, offering a vibrant academic environment backed by strong infrastructure and a committed team of educators.The school’s success is the result of the collective efforts of teachers, students, parents, and the school management committee. Its reputation for academic excellence, well-managed infrastructure, and quality education at affordable costs has made it a top choice among students aspiring to pursue careers in science, engineering, and other professional fields.

name: Malika Model Secondary School, Martadi

Once grappling with low enrollment, inadequate infrastructure, and conflict-era challenges—even holding classes in a hospital—the school now educates over 2,000 students and stands as a testament to perseverance, innovation, and visionary leadership under Principal Shubharaj Timilsina.Why Malika Model Secondary School?Remarkable Transformation: Evolved from a struggling institution to a model community school with modern facilities, including smart boards, CCTV-monitored classrooms, and an on-site nurse for student health.English-Medium Excellence: Introduced in 2010-11, attracting students from private schools and setting a benchmark for quality education in rural Nepal.Innovative Leadership: Principal Timilsina’s relentless advocacy and resourcefulness have secured upgrades despite limited government funding, including the establishment of Bajura Campus through school resources.Key FeaturesCutting-Edge Learning: 16 smart classrooms, technology-integrated teaching, and practical-first aid care.Community Trust: Operates transparently, free from political interference, fostering a safe, disciplined environment.Inclusive Vision: Prioritizes accessibility for all, bridging urban-rural educational gaps with affordable, English-medium education.Overcoming ChallengesTeacher Shortages: Manages with 30+ internally hired teachers alongside government staff, ensuring uninterrupted learning.Budget Constraints: Timilsina’s grassroots fundraising efforts—from Kathmandu to Dhangadhi—fuel infrastructure and program growth.A Leader’s LegacyPrincipal Shuvaraj Timilsina, a revered educational activist, has redefined community schooling through:Expert Collaborations: Regular workshops with national experts to enrich curricula.Ethical Stewardship: Unwavering integrity, earning local trust and shielding the school from corruption.National Pride: Proving that dedication transcends geography—“Wherever we are, we serve Nepal.”

name: Batahu Secondary School
description: Batahu Secondary School is a public school located in Brindaban Municipality, Rautahat district, within Madhesh province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Batahu Secondary School has 1881 enrolled students.

name: Sharada Secondary School, Balaha
description: Sharada Secondary School, established in 2014 BS , is a highly respected community-based academic institution located in Inaruwa, Sunsari, Nepal. With a long-standing commitment to quality education, the school has been nurturing young minds for decades, helping students build strong foundations for their future.Affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education, Sharada Secondary School offers classes from ECD (Early Childhood Development) to Grade 12, including Plus Two programs in Management and Education streams. The school blends traditional values with modern teaching practices, aiming to support both academic excellence and personal growth.Known for its supportive environment and dedicated staff, Sharada Secondary School continues to be a trusted choice for families in the region seeking accessible, community-driven education with a future-focused approach.

name: Janata Secondary School Sonaraniya
description: Janata Secondary School, Rautahat is a reputable community-based educational institution located in Sonarniya, Rautahat, Province No. 2, Nepal. Established with the aim of expanding access to quality education in the region, the school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education. It offers academic programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 10, along with Plus Two (Class 11 and 12) programs in various streams.In addition to its general education curriculum, the school also runs a Pre-Diploma in Civil Engineering (Civil Sub-Overseer) program with an approved intake of 40 seats. This technical program is affiliated with CTEVT and is designed to equip students with practical skills in civil engineering, preparing them for direct entry into the workforce or further technical studies.Janata Secondary School provides secondary-level education at affordable fee structures, with scholarship opportunities available for deserving students. With a dedicated teaching staff and a commitment to student success, the school promotes a balanced educational experience that supports academic learning as well as personal growth.Janata Secondary School continues to serve as a key educational hub in Rautahat, contributing to the development of skilled and educated individuals within the community.

name: Rupa Nepali Pal Secondary School
description: Rupa Nepali Pal Secondary School is located in Dhamaura, Rautahat . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.

name: Jeevan Bikas Public School
description: Jeevan Bikas Public School is a private school located in Dhanpalthan Rural Municipality, Morang district, within Koshi province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 11. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Jeevan Bikas Public School has 1875 enrolled students.

name: Saraswati Secondary School, Geta
description: Shree Sarawsati Model Secondary School is committed to academic excellence, discipline, and holistic development. The school focuses on shaping young minds with strong values and practical knowledge. It operates with a clear vision to empower students to become responsible, innovative, and global citizens through a transformative and collaborative educational approach.The school provides a comprehensive educational journey from Nursery through Grade 12, following the curriculum guided by the Curriculum Development Centre (CDC). Students are instructed in both English and Nepali mediums for the Basic Level (Grades 1-8) and Secondary Level (Grades 9-10). To ensure the overall development of its students, the academic program is balanced with a variety of co-curricular activities.The core mission of the school is to provide equitable learning opportunities while developing social, moral, and ethical values within the student body. By emphasizing academic excellence and discipline, the school strives to create a nurturing environment that encourages community engagement. This holistic focus ensures that graduates are not only academically proficient but also civilized individuals ready to contribute to society. The school has a vision to empower students to become responsible, civilized , innovative and global citizens via transformative and collaborative education.

name: Himal Academy
description: Himal Academy Dhangadhi, Krishnanagar is a private school located in Dhangadhi Sub-Metropolitan City, Kailali district, within Sudurpashchim province.The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 8. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Himal Academy Dhangadhi, Krishnanagar has 413 enrolled students.

name: Laxmi Chandi Murarka Secondary School
description: Established in 2008, Laxmi Chandi Murarka Secondary School has been committed to providing quality education that meets both national needs and global standards. The school offers a supportive learning environment backed by a team of highly experienced and qualified teachers.Key features of the school include a 24-hour e-library, access to complete study materials, hi-tech classrooms, and well-equipped computer and visual labs. The institution maintains separate sections for Pre-primary, Secondary, and Higher Secondary levels to ensure age-appropriate teaching and focused learning.Due to its strong academic environment and limited intake, the school remains a preferred choice for students seeking a well-rounded and future-oriented education. Interested students and parents are encouraged to contact the school for more information.

name: Ideal Model School
description: Ideal Model School was established in 2048 B.S. (1991 A.D.) under the able leadership of experienced and dedicated luminaries with the intention of providing an environment for the systematic, physical, mental, social and the overall personality development of students. Ever since its inception, IMS has moved forward steadily. It has been sensitive to the changes in both the attitudes of students and the demands of modern society. Thus, it has constantly endeavored to incorporate necessary changes so that the children can become a part of the emerging New World order. By becoming a part of the Little Angels family, IMS has always taken advantage of the massive infrastructure available and also share the immense material and manpower resource pool present. In addition, students passing out of IMS utilize the numerous avenues for higher studies, which the L.A. School System has already successfully operated for several years now. Further more, Ideal Model School too has successfully initiated its (+) 2 and higher education after taking into consideration the requests made by parents of the school. Philosophy We are committed to connect students with their unique futures. We offer an unparalleled education that inspires children to be creative problem-solvers, innovators, and leaders. We approach the learning experience by infusing a strong liberal arts curriculum with Multiple Intelligences Theory. Vision To provide quality, comprehensive education and raise compassionate global citizens. Mission To facilitate life-long learning beyond knowledge acquisition by providing them skills to comprehend, apply, appreciate, analyze,synthesize and evaluate. Aims and Objectives Ideal Model School has been set up with the overall objective of providing quality education to a limited number of students in a most congenial environment. The IMS motto is: ‘TO BE A LIGHT’, and it endeavors to motivate students to set and achieve objectives in life which are higher, nobler, and which helps them spread like the radiance of light where ever they may go. IMS believes that each child has an inherent ability to excel in some sphere of life. It thus aims at providing an environment where in these imbibed creative potentials are identified, exposed and nurtured. IMS also constantly strives for sustained academic growth of the student. Teachers prepare students with the aim of making them capable of shouldering the load of higher education and life with ease and confidence. At IMS, the concept of self-imposed, all round discipline is inculcated in the students so that overall development of their physical, mental and spiritual faculties are facilitated.

name: Shital Secondary School
description: Shital Secondary School is located in Chaurjahari, Rukum . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs. In 2015 AD, Shital Secondary School got approval from NEB to run Ten Plus two in Civil Engineering.

name: Anhoti Lal Secondary School
description: Anhoti Lal Secondary School is a community-based educational institution located in Basantapatti, Rautahat, Nepal. Affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education, the school offers academic programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 10, along with Plus Two (Class 11 and 12) programs in the Management and Education streams. The school is committed to providing quality education at an affordable cost. It maintains a moderate fee structure and also offers scholarship opportunities to deserving students, helping make education more accessible for all. With a focus on academic growth, discipline, and community values, Anhoti Lal Secondary School has become a trusted name in the region for those seeking a supportive and inclusive learning environment.

name: New Academy Boarding School
description: New Academy Boarding School (NABS), located in Sainamaina Municipality, Rupandehi, is a reputable educational institution dedicated to academic excellence and holistic student development. Originally established in 2061 B.S. in Bhalwari (formerly Karahiya VDC), NABS began its journey with government recognition up to Grade 5 and quickly gained approval to upgrade to Grade 10 by 2069 B.S. That same year, the school proudly saw its first batch of students appear in the SLC examination, achieving a 100% pass rate. In 2070 B.S., the school was relocated to its current premises in Sainamaina, with full support from local guardians and community leaders. Since then, NABS has consistently delivered outstanding academic results, earning a reputation as one of the leading institutions in the region. Notably, in the 2075 Basic Level Examination, the school achieved first position with a perfect GPA of 4.0, setting a benchmark in local academic history. In the following year, two students secured a GPA of 3.90, placing the school in second position municipality-wide, further continuing its legacy of excellence. NABS is guided by the powerful motto, "Shaping Creative & Value-Based Life," reflecting its mission to encourage intellectual growth, moral character, creativity, and civic responsibility among its students. With experienced teachers, a focus on academic achievement, and strong community support, New Academy Boarding School continues to be a preferred choice for parents seeking quality education in a nurturing and forward-thinking environment.

name: Janata Secondary School, Gauridanda
description: Janata Secondary School is considered one of the best in terms of quality in Madhesh Province. The main reason behind the overwhelming attraction of students and parents toward this school is its quality education. Since 2068 B.S., the school has been offering secondary-level education. From 2070 B.S., it has also introduced Animal Science as a subject from Grade 9 onwards.Another unique policy of this school is that teachers are required to enroll their own children in the same school. This policy has been in place since 2071 B.S.Education in Janata Secondary School is free up to Grade 7, while from Grade 8 to diploma level, fees are charged. However, these fees are not mandatory for all. Local students, Dalits, underprivileged, meritorious, and differently-abled students receive free education up to Grade 12. Since 2069 B.S., the school has been offering technical and vocational education, including Animal Science from Grades 9 to 12. In 2071 B.S., the Medical Science diploma program was introduced, followed by Plant Science in 2072 B.S.. The school also provides education for visually impaired students.There is a unique tradition at the school where mothers themselves cook and serve the midday meals to the students. No junk food or harmful processed food is brought in from outside. Instead, the meals are healthy and hygienic, prepared just like those they would serve their own children at home.The school’s 10-year strategy includes the vision that every student graduating from the school should possess some form of skill. Under the “Earn and Learn” program, students enrolled in technical education are trained in pig, poultry, and fish farming through school-run demonstration farms. These farms are established on school premises to facilitate hands-on practical training. The school's holistic approach emphasizing academic excellence, technical skills, inclusive policies, nutritious meals, and strong stakeholder collaboration, has positioned it not just as a school, but as a model for sustainable, community-led educational development in Nepal. With a clear 10-year strategic plan and an unwavering mission to empower every student with both knowledge and practical skills, Janata Secondary School is truly paving the way for what the future of public education in Nepal can look like.

name: Aristo English High School
description: Aristo English High School, located in the heart of Dhangadhi, is a well-established co-educational institution that has been committed to excellence in education since its establishment in 1992 A.D. The school offers a comprehensive academic program from Playgroup to Grade 12, focusing on nurturing young minds and preparing students to become confident, responsible, and capable leaders of tomorrow. Aristo English High School is known for providing a well-rounded and student-centered learning environment. The curriculum is designed to promote intellectual growth, creativity, and strong moral values. With a focus on both academic excellence and personal development, the school equips students with the knowledge and skills necessary to thrive in today’s competitive world. To support its mission of delivering quality education, the school is fully equipped with modern infrastructure and facilities. The school features well-maintained science laboratories, specialized classrooms, a fully equipped computer lab, and a rich library to foster curiosity and encourage research-based learning. In addition, arts and creative facilities are available to help students express themselves and explore their talents. Aristo English High School also places great importance on physical education and sports. With extensive sports facilities, students are encouraged to participate in a variety of athletic and recreational activities, promoting physical fitness, teamwork, and discipline. Understanding the needs of diverse learners, the school also provides hostel facilities in a secure, nurturing environment that supports students' academic and personal growth. The hostel is managed with care to ensure a home-like atmosphere that is conducive to learning. With over three decades of experience in shaping young minds, Aristo English High School continues to set the standard for quality education in Dhangadhi. The school invites prospective students and parents to join a thriving educational community dedicated to academic achievement, innovation, and holistic development.

name: Shree Madhyamik Vidyalaya, Nigaul
description: Shree Madhyamik Vidyalaya, Nigaul is a public school located in Gaushala Municipality, Mahottari district, within Madhesh province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 11. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Shree Madhyamik Vidyalaya, Nigaul has 1831 enrolled students.

name: Rosebud School
description: Rosebud School, a co-educational institution situated in the heart of Kathmandu City, was established in 1993 (2049 B.S). It caters to students from Grade 1 to Grade 12, and currently has an enrollment of approximately 1800 pupils. The school's objective is to offer a child-centric learning environment that fosters equal opportunities for every child to achieve their maximum potential, attain intellectual, physical, and emotional well-being, and prepare themselves for life in an ever-evolving world. In contrast to focusing solely on academic excellence, Rosebud School aims to facilitate the comprehensive and all-encompassing growth of each student through our Complete Schooling Program (CSP). Vision Enhance life opportunities of adolescents. Mission Develop adolescents that are creative in thinking, practical in action, emotionally mature and grounded in our values.

name: Manthali Secondary School
description: The school is dedicated to developing resourceful and relevant education, particularly in the health sciences, by fostering a favourable environment that optimizes the learning potential of every student. In response to the unique demands of globalization, MSS strives to produce highly skilled nurses and public health professionals who meet rigorous international standards.The school's vision is to deliver technical education to the youth of Ramechhap and its neighboring districts, empowering individuals and the wider community to achieve self-reliance and independence. To fulfil this mission, the school operates a 19-month Civil Sub-Overseer program under the CTEVT Annex program, addressing local needs in construction, agriculture, health, and veterinary sciences.The school's primary goal is to ensure that every household produces at least one technically proficient individual, thereby driving local income generation through both direct employment and self-employment opportunities.

name: Southzone Secondary School
description: South Zone Secondary School, established in 2066 B.S., is a reputable academic institution located in Birgunj, Parsa. Since its inception, the school has remained committed to providing quality education from Nursery to Grade 12. In 2074 B.S., it received official approval to expand its curriculum to include ten plus two programs, marking a significant milestone in its educational journey. The school is guided by the mission "A dwelling to craft all aptitude and morality," and is dedicated to nurturing students into competent, confident, and morally sound individuals. At South Zone, education is designed to shape well-rounded learners with excellent communication skills, strong ethical values, and leadership qualities. The school creates a dynamic and supportive environment where students are encouraged to enrich their wisdom, uncover their hidden talents, and realize their full potential. South Zone emphasizes real-life learning experiences, equipping students with the knowledge and resilience to face the challenges of the modern world. The philosophy is rooted in empowerment that suggests not just giving students the "fish," but teaching them how to "fish" for a lifetime. The vision of South Zone Secondary School is to awaken each student’s inner potential and fuel their intellectual, emotional, and spiritual growth. It aims to instill moral character, social responsibility, and a global perspective. Through a focus on character development, moral and spiritual education, and socio-linguistic awareness, the school aspires to mold students into innovative, creative, and entrepreneurial individuals ready to lead and reform society. South Zone Secondary School is not just an academic institution, it is a transformative space where young minds are guided to become future leaders and change-makers. With a mission deeply rooted in values and a commitment to holistic education, the school continues to be a beacon of academic and personal excellence in the region.

name: Tarun Madhyamik Vidyalaya
description: Tarun Madhyamik Vidyalaya, located in the heart of Kathmandu, is a leading government school that has set a benchmark in quality education, innovation, and inclusive learning. Running classes from Play Group (PG) to Grade 10, the school is recognized nationally for its consistent academic performance, modern teaching practices, and student-friendly environment.Established with a vision to provide accessible and skill-based education, Tarun Madhyamik Vidyalaya has been repeatedly honored with national, provincial, and regional awards, making it one of Nepal’s most celebrated public schools. Notably, it won the prestigious title of "Best School in Nepal" in 2058 B.S., and has since maintained its standing through continuous innovation and dedicated teaching.In 2023, the school earned the International School Award from the British Council, a testament to its global outlook and commitment to excellence. Moreover, Tarun Madhyamik Vidyalaya was selected under Kathmandu Metropolitan City's “One Ward, One Model School” initiative — further solidifying its role as a model for community-based education.What sets this school apart is its modern infrastructure and emphasis on practical learning. All classrooms are technology-enabled, with smart boards, and the school has implemented creative programs like “Book-Free Friday”, where students engage in hands-on skill development activities such as fashion design, agriculture, carpentry, mobile repair, cooking, yoga, dance, music, theater, and drone technology.Despite being a public school, its English-medium instruction has attracted students even from private schools, showcasing trust in its academic quality and student outcomes. The school combines theoretical learning with practical, life-skill education, helping students become confident, capable, and future-ready.With a team of committed teachers, strong leadership, and supportive learning environment, Tarun Madhyamik Vidyalaya continues to be a preferred choice for parents seeking a holistic, affordable, and high-quality education for their children in Kathmandu

name: Gorkha Model Secondary School
description: Established in 1998 in Dang, the Gorkha Group, initiated by a collective of Gurkhas (Lahures), is committed to delivering top-tier education for present and future generations. Over time, Gorkha School has evolved into the preferred learning hub catering to students from Pre-Primary to Grade XII. Gorkha Model Secondary school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and offers ten plus two (10+2) programmes in Management and Science streams. Renowned for its experienced, dedicated, and qualified faculty members, the institution upholds high standards of discipline and scholarship. Equipped with advanced facilities, Gorkha School captivates students seeking a center of academic excellence. Ensuring personalized care, counseling, and guidance from day one, the institution prioritizes student welfare. Consequently, Gorkha School has garnered national recognition for its students' exemplary performance and achievements. Mission In collaboration with students, families, and the community, Gorkha Model Secondary School, managed by the Gorkha Education Group, aims to provide life-changing and 21st-century relevant skills through world-class education. Vision Gorkha Model Secondary School envisions to shape and guide the lives of children towards a successful future.

As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Devdaha Buddha Public English Boarding School has 1813 enrolled students.

name: Green Field English Boarding School
description: Green Field English Boarding School is a private educational institution located in Nagarjun Municipality of Kathmandu district, within Bagmati Province. The school is known for its commitment to delivering quality education in a well-managed and student-centered environment. It offers academic programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12, nurturing learners through every stage of their educational journey. Over the years, the school has established itself as a reliable center of learning, offering strong academic foundations combined with essential life skills. According to the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, the school has an enrollment of 1784 students, reflecting its growing popularity and trust among parents and the local community. Green Field English Boarding School is affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB) and offers Plus Two (Class 11 and 12) programs in Education, Humanities, Management, and Science. These diverse streams allow students to pursue their interests and career goals within a supportive and disciplined academic framework. With experienced teachers, a focus on holistic development, and a balanced mix of curricular and co-curricular activities, the school provides a well-rounded learning environment. Green Field English Boarding School continues to empower its students to achieve academic success while building character, confidence, and skills needed for the future.

name: Birendra Vidya Mandir Secondary School
description: Birendra Vidya Mandir Secondary School is a public academic institution situated in Tikapur Municipality, Kailali district, within Sudurpashchim Province, Nepal. The school was established as the first academic institution in Tikapur to meet the growing educational needs of the newly developed town. It was founded by the then Tikapur Development Committee on 7th Falgun 2031 B.S. Initially named Tikapur Aawasiya Madhyamik Vidyalaya, the school gained its current identity after King Birendra Bir Bikram Shah Dev inaugurated its building, leading to its widespread recognition as Birendra Vidya Mandir.Over the years, the institution has undergone significant changes in its structure and governance. Following amendments to Nepal's education rules and policies in 2059 B.S., it was officially categorized as a Public Educational Trust. Today, it continues to operate as Birendra Vidya Mandir Public Educational Trust, delivering education from pre-primary level up to graduation. However, the graduation-level programs are now managed under a separate administrative system.The academic programs up to Grade 12 are overseen by a management committee chaired by the District Education Officer of Kailali. The school holds the status of a Regional Model School for the Far-Western and Mid-Western Development Regions. It has been part of the Public-Private Partnership Programme launched by the Government of Nepal in 2066 B.S. The +2 (higher secondary) program has been running since 2049 B.S., offering streams in Science, Humanities, Education, Management, and Law. The programs are offered in a well-structured academic setting supported by qualified, supportive, and friendly teachers who emphasize both academic excellence and personal development. With an affordable fee structure and a commitment to inclusivity, Birendra Vidya Mandir Secondary School creates an encouraging environment where students can thrive. As of academic year 2081/82, over 1,000 students are enrolled in classes up to the +2 level.The school features spacious classrooms and expansive grounds, providing an ideal setting for both learning and extracurricular activities. With a strong focus on ECA (Extracurricular Activities), the school ensures students receive holistic development opportunities beyond academics. Birendra Vidya Mandir Secondary School continues to serve as a trusted center of learning, helping shape capable and confident individuals for the future.

name: Janta Namuna Secondary School Simra Bhagwatipur
description: Janta Namuna Secondary School Simra Bhagwatipur is a public school located in Godaita Municipality, Sarlahi district, within Madhesh province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Janta Namuna Secondary School Simra Bhagwatipur has 1804 enrolled students.

name: Discovery English Boarding School
description: Discovery Secondary School, located in Dhangadhi Sub Metropolitan City-8, Kantipur Tole, Sudurpashchim Province, is a fast-growing academic institution committed to providing quality education. Established in 2065 BS and revitalized under new management in 2074 BS, the school has witnessed remarkable progress—from just 48 students to over 1,700 today. Operating as a co-educational day school from Play Group to Grade 10, Discovery Secondary School is built on earthquake-resistant infrastructure across four academic and administrative blocks on a spacious 1 Bigha of land. The school emphasizes holistic development, guided by a collaborative leadership model that actively involves all stakeholders in nurturing each child’s intellectual, emotional, social, and physical growth. With a mission defined by the motto “Education for Discipline and Excellence,” the school blends innovation, discipline, and care to create a nurturing learning environment. Its dedicated team of educators, visionary leadership, and supportive parent community work together to prepare students to become responsible and capable individuals who lead with confidence and compassion. Mission To create excellent learning environment. To provide quality education with skilled and experienced faculty with adequate teaching resources. To focus on overall growth and the all-round development of the students. To make the students aware of the global environment.

name: Siddhartha Academy Awasiya Secondary School
description: Siddhartha Academy Awasiya Secondary School, Dang is a well-established community-based educational institution founded in 1980 AD (2037 BS). It is located in Ghorahi Municipality-11, in the heart of Dang district, Nepal. The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and recognized by the Ministry of Education. It offers academic programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12, with Ten Plus Two (+2) program in the Management stream.Widely known for delivering quality education, Siddhartha Academy Awasiya Secondary School has earned a strong reputation in the region. The school emphasizes students' overall development by combining academics with a high focus on extracurricular activities (ECAs). Students are regularly encouraged to participate in various inter-school competitions, field visits, and educational events, helping them grow socially and intellectually.The institution maintains a moderate fee structure and extends scholarship opportunities to deserving and underprivileged students. It is also known for its friendly and supportive teachers who create a nurturing and student-friendly environment. With its balanced approach to education, Siddhartha Academy continues to foster confident, capable, and socially responsible individuals prepared for future challenges.

name: Benga Sah Secondary School
description: Benga Sah Secondary School is a community-based public institution located in Prasauni, Bara district, within Madhesh Province, Nepal. Affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and recognized by the Ministry of Education, the school is committed to offering inclusive and quality education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. With academic programs in both Management and Education streams at the Plus Two (+2) level, the school provides students with valuable pathways for higher studies and future careers. Benga Sah Secondary School emphasizes student-centered learning supported by experienced, qualified, and friendly teachers who foster a positive and encouraging educational environment. The school also features spacious classrooms and a supportive community that promotes academic excellence, holistic growth, and active participation in extracurricular activities. With its dedication to nurturing young minds and building a strong academic foundation, Benga Sah Secondary School continues to be a trusted educational hub for families in the region.

name: Nepal Model Secondary School
description: Nepal Model Secondary School is listed at Prasauni-1, Bara.

name: Vishwa Adarsha Secondary School
description: Vishwa Adarsha Secondary School (VAAS), established in 2074 BS, is a leading educational institution in Itahari, Sunsari. Founded to meet the demand for a pioneering school, it aims to prepare students to become responsible and confident professionals. Their comprehensive curriculum enhances communication skills, critical thinking, problem-solving, timely decision-making, and ethical behavior. The school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers ten plus two (10+2) programmes in Science and Management streams. At Vishwa Adarsha Secondary School (VASS), the belief is that every student is unique, as is their learning ability. The school emphasizes that true knowledge is defined by understanding, not merely by marks or grades. As an institution nurturing the minds of future generations, VASS takes responsibility for instilling the right competitive spirit in its students. The school ensures that each child receives the same level of attention and care, regardless of academic performance, and respects and values every talent.

name: Janata Secondary School
description: Janata Secondary School is listed at Naya Bazaar, Kirtipur-10, Kathmandu.

name: Harinagara Secondary School
description: Harinagara Secondary School, established in 2009 B.S., is a trusted community-based educational institution located in Harinagar, Sunsari. As a government secondary school, it has been serving the local community for decades with a commitment to accessible, inclusive, and quality education.The school offers academic programs from PG to 10, emphasizing academic excellence and character development. With a team of dedicated teachers, Harinagara Secondary School works to create a supportive learning environment where students are encouraged to think critically, act responsibly, and prepare for higher education or vocational pursuits.Situated in a growing and diverse region of Koshi Province, the school plays a vital role in uplifting the educational standard of the local population. It focuses not only on classroom learning but also on extracurricular activities, ensuring that students receive a well-rounded education.Backed by the support of the local community and guided by the values of discipline, respect, and lifelong learning, Harinagara Secondary School continues to be a dependable institution for families in the area.

name: GEMS School
description: GEMS Institute of Higher Education (GIHE), the higher section of Graded English Medium School (GEMS), is located in Khumaltar, Dhapakhel, Lalitpur. GEMS School has been providing quality education from early grades to higher secondary level and is committed to creating a supportive and engaging learning environment. Established in 2008, GIHE offers higher education from pre-university to A Level and Plus Two programs, with plans to introduce Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses in Management, Biotechnology, and Information Technology in the future.GIHE provides Cambridge Assessment International Education (CAIE) A Level courses, offering both Science and Non-Science streams, as well as Plus Two Science and Management programs affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB), Nepal. Students can choose from a variety of subject combinations that align with their interests and career goals. A dedicated team of professionals manages the academic programs and student development.The institute features classrooms equipped with multimedia facilities, science laboratories for Botany, Zoology, Chemistry, and Physics, a computer lab, and a well-stocked library with updated books, reference materials, journals, and broadband internet access. Additionally, a multimedia room with an interactive board supports teachers in delivering lectures with visual aids. GIHE aims to provide a supportive learning environment that combines academic knowledge with practical skills, preparing students for higher education and professional pathways.

name: Darshaniya Rameshwar Singh Kushwaha Academy
description: Darshaniya Rameshwar Singh Kushwaha Academy, established in 2058 B.S., is a reputed educational institution located in Kshireshwarnath, Dhanusha. The school offers academic programs from Nursery to Grade 12 and runs well-structured +2 programs in Management and Education under the National Examinations Board (NEB) of Nepal. Over the years, the academy has built a strong reputation for academic excellence, with a consistent record of outstanding SEE results that reflect its commitment to quality teaching and student success. The academy is managed by a team of highly qualified and experienced educators who are dedicated to nurturing students in a disciplined and supportive environment. It emphasizes both academic growth and holistic development, offering well-managed science and computer laboratories to enhance practical learning experiences. The school caters to the needs of both full boarders and day boarders, ensuring that each student receives the attention and resources necessary for their personal and academic growth. To further support students, the academy conducts extra tuition and coaching classes, helping learners achieve their full potential. A reliable transportation system ensures safe and convenient access to the school. Established on Magh 10, 2009 B.S., through the efforts of local education advocates led by the late Nimindra Raj Kandel, the school has grown into one of the prominent secondary schools in the southeastern part of the district near the culturally significant Triveni Dham.With a total of 1,319 students enrolled as per the 2081 IEMIS report by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, the school offers education from the primary level up to Grade 12. This community-centric approach has helped foster a strong sense of belonging and purpose among students and parents alike. As it looks ahead, East Horizon English High School remains committed to empowering the next generation of leaders, innovators, and responsible global citizens. name: Bhanubhakta Memorial Secondary School
description: Bhanubhakta Memorial Secondary School is a private institution located in Bhanubhakta Marg, Panipokhari, Kathmandu. With affiliation from National Examination Board, it offers +2 in Science and Management program. It is a co-educational and English medium school, catering for children from Nursery to Plus Two (10+2), as well as college level students. The school was established in 1967 A.D. (2023 B.S.) in the blessed memory of the pioneer poet late Bhanubhakta Acharya – a renowned figure of Nepali literature. In 2016, the school completed 50 years of its establishment. The school is run by a public education trust (Bhanubhakta Memorial Public Education Trust) as a non-profit basis. Bhanubhakta Memorial Higher Secondary school is one of the biggest private schools of Nepal, providing both educational as well as physical facilities to day scholars, day boarders and boarders who come from every corner of the country. The school has two separate playgrounds with basketball, badminton and volleyball courts as well as five table tennis boards. There are separate cricket nets as well. The school follows modern methods of teaching having recently installed smart classes and CCTV cameras.The school has a proven track record of academic success and continues to build on its tradition of imparting quality education to students from diverse social backgrounds. With its unwavering commitment to academic excellence, the school has been able to leave a distinct mark in society. Hence, having no profit motive, the school’s exclusive focus in its planning and use of resources is on quality enhancement. Operating within the legal framework set by the government, Bhanubhakta School has been effectively doing its part in educational development of the country.The school is driven by the aim of producing well-rounded graduates equipped with the necessary knowledge and skills to thrive in the increasingly complex and highly competitive world of today. The school gives special emphasis to the development of essential life skills in students like critical thinking skills, problem solving skills, leaderships skills, etc. While preparing its students to meet the challenges of the modern world, the school also inculcates in their profound reverence for our conventional culture and values.For children, school is the second most important place after home in their life where they gain the most fundamental and crucial knowledge about life and living. Things children learn at school have a profound and lasting impact on their entire life. description: Kavre English Secondary School is situated at the heart of an ancient and historical city Panauti. Panauti is an ancient city of the Newar community, which is also famous for the Makar Mela, a one-month-long religious festival celebrated every twelve years. Panauti is not only culturally riched but also renowned for natural resources and agricultural products. Kavre English Secondary School is a non-profit educational institution with the motto “Education for Peace, Creativity and Excellence.” It is managed by Kavre Education Development Foundation as Private Trust. Its solo vision is to impart need responsive quality education. It was first established as an extension program of Kabhre Secondary School, another educational institution run under the same foundation. It was affiliated to Higher Secondary Education in 2063 B.S. Since then it has been running the classes from Play Group to Grade 12. Vision "Education for Peace, Creativity and Excellence" Mission To run educational activities in a peaceful and harmonious environment. To provide students with knowledge and skills related to various creative research activities and to create a conducive environment for such activities both inside and outside the school. To provide opportunities for students to engage in intellectual exercises spontaneously. To acquaint students with the glorious history of Nepal and inspire them to be loyal patriots, preserving it vigorously. To provide opportunities to understand and recognize the significance of religious and cultural diversity in Nepal and to foster positive attitudes to protect them. To create an environment for students to engage in various competitive activities. To promote a happy, healthy, and supportive child-friendly learning environment. To strive for need-responsive qualitative learning experiences and achievement. Goal To produce and prepare peace-loving and thoughtful citizens. To discourage the creativity gap and provide value by using imagination and critical thinking to encourage originality and creativity. To expose the underlying intellectual potential of the students. To instill in children the spirit of unity, integrity, self-discipline, and patriotism to uplift the renowned glory of Nepal. To inculcate the right values for respecting one's culture and traditions and incorporating cultural values into life. To nurture children to be intelligent and healthy: physically, mentally, and spiritually. To produce citizens of self-esteem and self-worth. To prepare individuals for various vocations and avenues of life.

description: Vishwa Jyoti Higher Secondary School (VJHSS), located in Devchuli Municipality, Nawalpur district, is a reputable educational institution that has been shaping young minds since its establishment in 2051 B.S. (1994 A.D.). Initially operated under the name Nawal English Boarding School (NEBS), which itself dates back to 2039 B.S. The school ensures student well-being with hygienic cafeteria services, clean sanitation facilities, filtered drinking water, and a 25 KVA generator to manage power supply during outages.The school's holistic educational approach is guided by a team of morally driven, professional educators. name: Green Plant Boarding Secondary School
description: Green Plant Boarding Secondary School is a thriving educational institution located in the heart of Devdaha, Rupandehi. Established with the vision of nurturing young minds and shaping responsible citizens, the school has grown into a hub of learning that combines academic excellence with holistic development. With a caring environment and a focus on values, the school inspires students to dream big and reach their fullest potential.Affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB), Green Plant offers classes from Kindergarten to Grade 12, including a diverse range of Plus Two (+2) programs. With spacious classrooms, modern teaching tools, and a strong network of alumni, parents, and well-wishers, Green Plant continues to be a trusted name in education.Backed by over 200+ enrolled students, 90+ qualified staff, and 80+ clubs and activities, the school stands as a symbol of growth, dedication, and opportunity in the region.Mission:At Green Plant, the mission is to unlock the unique potential of every student through a well-rounded, inclusive educational journey. With a strong emphasis on academic excellence, critical thinking, and character development, the school blends innovative teaching methods with a nurturing environment. Grounded in the belief in lifelong learning, students are empowered to become compassionate, confident, and socially responsible individuals prepared to thrive in a rapidly evolving world.Core Values:Innovation, integrity, and excellence form the foundation of everything the school stands for. The learning environment is designed to be both supportive and dynamic—where students are not only encouraged to dream big but also equipped with the tools and mindset to turn those dreams into reality. Every lesson, activity, and initiative is guided by a commitment to help learners think critically, act responsibly, and lead with purpose.Philosophy:Believing that every child is naturally curious and capable, the school embraces a student-centered approach to education. Learning at Green Plant is driven by exploration, creativity, and a genuine love for discovery. By cultivating a safe and thoughtfully designed space, students are inspired to grow into their best selves—academically, socially, and emotionally.Programs Offered: Computer ScienceThe Computer Science program equips students with essential skills in programming, software development, and IT solutions. With hands-on experience and up-to-date curriculum, it opens pathways to careers in Nepal's and the world’s rapidly growing tech industry.ScienceOffering a deep dive into Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, the Science stream is ideal for students aiming for careers in medical, engineering, research, and other scientific sectors. It emphasizes critical thinking, experimentation, and analytical skills.Hotel ManagementThis course prepares students for the vibrant global hospitality industry. With a focus on hotel operations, guest relations, and event planning, students gain both theoretical insights and practical exposure essential for careers in hotels, resorts, and tourism.FinanceTailored for students interested in the world of numbers and strategy, the Finance stream delivers strong foundations in financial management, investment planning, and economic principles. Graduates are well-positioned for roles in banking, investment firms, and corporate finance.MarketingThis program delves into the art and science of promoting products and services. Students explore market research, consumer psychology, branding, and digital marketing strategies—paving the way for exciting careers in advertising, brand management, and sales.Extracurricular Activities (ECA)At Green Plant Boarding Secondary School, learning goes beyond textbooks. The school places a strong emphasis on extracurricular activities to help students discover their passions, develop leadership skills, and grow into well-rounded individuals. From athletics to the arts, students are encouraged to actively participate and thrive in areas that interest them most.AthleticsThe school promotes physical fitness and sportsmanship through a wide range of athletic activities. Students enthusiastically take part in games such as football, volleyball, cricket, and athletics, competing at inter-school, district, state, and even national levels. These opportunities help build teamwork, discipline, and confidence.Indoor GamesGreen Plant also nurtures students’ interests in indoor games such as chess, table tennis, and carrom. These games sharpen focus and strategic thinking. Students often represent the school in various competitions across different levels, proudly showcasing their talents.Performing Arts & MusicThe school provides a creative platform for students passionate about the arts. Under the guidance of experienced instructors, students are trained in music, dance, drama, painting, and other visual arts. Cultural events and talent shows are regularly held to celebrate their artistic growth and expression.Literary Activities & ClubsIn addition to sports and arts, the school fosters a love for reading, writing, and public speaking through debate clubs, essay competitions, and poetry recitations. Students are encouraged to engage in critical discussions and develop their communication skills.Educational Tours & Field TripsTo enrich classroom learning, the school organizes occasional educational tours, field visits, and excursions. These experiences not only deepen students' understanding of academic subjects but also promote social interaction and real-world learning.

description: Established in 2048 B.S. (1991 A.D.), Ramdarsh Sarvodaya Secondary School is a pioneering educational institution located in the remote hilly region of Khotang district, Koshi Province. Founded during a time when access to English-medium and quality education in the region was nearly unattainable for average-income families, the school emerged from the vision and commitment of local intellectuals and retired British Gurkha soldiers. What began as a small initiative to educate their own children has now evolved into one of the model schools in the district.The school was started through community effort with English teachers hired from Darjeeling, and officially began its academic journey in Baisakh 2048 B.S. In 2051 B.S., a new phase of growth was marked by the involvement of scholars from Diktel Multiple Campus, who contributed both to higher education and the boarding school. Their dual commitment significantly uplifted the academic standard of the school.A landmark achievement came in 2057 B.S. when the British government selected the school to receive support for infrastructure development. With significant ownership by ex-Gurkha personnel, the school was awarded a two-storied, six-roomed model building, which was inaugurated on Jestha 19, 2058 B.S. This milestone elevated public trust, leading to a rise in student enrollment, improved facilities, and academic excellence.Over the years, the school has maintained a remarkable track record. With 27 batches of SLC/SEE graduates, it boasts a 100% pass rate, with no student scoring below Second Division or Grade B+. Its alumni have excelled in various fields, including medicine, engineering, civil service, aviation, arts, and military service, both nationally and internationally.Although the school was the first in the district to initiate the +2 Science stream, it currently offers Grades 11 and 12 in the Management stream, which has consistently produced 100% pass rates across 17 batches. The school continues to adapt and expand its offerings based on student needs and regional context.Today, Ramdarsh Sarvodaya Secondary School serves more than 1,400 students from Pre-Nursery to Grade 12, supported by over 70 qualified and dedicated teachers and staff members. With technology-friendly classrooms, a student-centered learning environment, and a strong focus on both academics and values, the school remains committed to providing quality, child-friendly education that fosters holistic development.Features:Library FacilityA well-equipped school library serves as a vital resource center to support students’ learning and overall development.Experienced and Expert TeachersThe school is led by a team of experienced, qualified, and passionate educators committed to delivering quality education.Music and Dance ClassesWeekly music and dance sessions are conducted to encourage creativity and provide joyful learning experiences.Sports and Entertainment ActivitiesStudents regularly participate in sports, games, and entertaining activities for their physical and mental well-being.Simple Admission ProcessA hassle-free admission process ensures a smooth start to a child’s academic journey.Focus on Holistic LearningStudents are engaged in a wide range of activities that help build a strong academic and personal foundation.Vision for Qualified Future CitizensThe school nurtures students with the vision of making them competent, responsible, and qualified individuals for the future.

name: Hilal Public Secondary School
description: Hilal Public Secondary School is situated in a remote area predominantly inhabited by the Muslim community and has established itself as a pioneer in promoting quality education with strong cultural and religious foundations. The school offers classes from Early Childhood Development (ECD) up to Grade 12. According to the 2081 B.S. report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development (CEHRD), the school has a total enrollment of 1,316 students, supported by 45 teaching staff and 6 non-teaching personnel. It also accommodates 90 students in its hostel, which is known for its structured and disciplined environment.Hilal Public Secondary School adopts a unique model of education by integrating religious teachings with the national curriculum. Alongside standard subjects, the school places special emphasis on Quran, Urdu, Arabic, and Deeniyat, and provides opportunities for students to memorize the entire Quran through its Tahfeezul Qur’an program. The school also conducts mathematics and science classes in English to enhance academic quality and prepare students for a competitive future. The learning environment is further strengthened by well-equipped computer and science laboratories, a library, digital classrooms, and specialized AICU classes for students requiring extra academic support.Hilal Public School not only focuses on academic excellence but also promotes life skills through vocational training such as tailoring and sewing. Students are nurtured in a peaceful, Islamic atmosphere that encourages discipline, moral integrity, and community service. The school has achieved notable success in extracurricular activities as well, having secured third place in the 15th President Running Shield and Chairperson Cup school-level sports competition organized by Harinagar Rural Municipality in 2081 B.S. Additionally, students have proudly represented the school in national events such as the All-Nepal Hifz-e-Quran Competition organized by the Muslim Commission. As part of its educational enrichment programs, the school organizes educational tours to places like the Islamic Cultural Center, Nepali Jame Masjid, Kashmiri Jama Masjid, and Tribhuvan University, where students visit key academic and cultural sites, including the TU Library and cricket grounds.With its strong foundation in both secular and religious education, Hilal Public Secondary School continues to serve as a beacon of learning and character development in the region, fulfilling its mission of nurturing knowledgeable, disciplined, and socially responsible individuals.

By 2013, Triyog had also started the 10+2 program in its premises. Additionally, in 2012, Triyog introduced Progressive-Integrated Teaching-Learning from Grade I, which has since extended up to the middle school. This practice emphasizes experiential and hands-on learning, with children at the center and teachers serving as facilitators.VisionTo be the best school in Nepal offering education of international standards for the all-round development of children & preparing them for their futureMissionTriyog aspires to be a centre of excellence that develops children intellectually, emotionally, physically, socially, morally & aesthetically. We seek to give perfect schooling that helps them acquire life-skills, sound character & positive attitude to excel in their lives. We have a shared commitment to have an inspiring teachinglearning environment where children fully engage themselves in learning by doing. We endeavour to provide a competitive setting with top-class facilities nurturing their talents and abilities.

name: Kavya School
description: Located in New Baneshwor, Kavya School is a comprehensive, co-educational day/boarding school for grades I to X. It welcomes and enrolls students of all faiths, races, and backgrounds. The school's small class sizes foster close relationships between staff and students, allowing them to get to know each other and their families well. This creates a strong partnership between teachers and parents, who work together as a team to support the children in our care at every stage of their learning journey. Each child receives full support to ensure their success. Kavya School is committed to offering its students the most exceptional educational experience possible. While academic excellence is an important aspect of life at Kavya, the school recognizes that there is more to it than that. Our students come from diverse socio-political, economic, and cultural backgrounds, yet they are united by their appreciation for learning, mutual respect, and recognition of the skills and knowledge of their teachers and peers. At Kavya School, we hold the belief that each student is a unique individual with both rights and responsibilities. As such, we aim to help our students gradually develop a sense of self-discipline and self-respect, as well as a desire to contribute to their community, cultivate a passion for learning, and strive for excellence. We believe that by empowering our students in this way, they will be well-equipped to take on the challenges of the future. The school offers an environment that reflects society and better prepares students for their future lives as an honest democratic citizen of Nepal who can lead the nation tomorrow. Kavya School places great importance on catering to the individual needs of each student. Alongside their academic coursework, both junior and senior students are offered a diverse range of extracurricular activities, including participation in clubs and inter-scholastic sports. These opportunities allow our students to broaden their horizons, develop new skills, and pursue their interests outside of the classroom. The learning environment also emphasizes the global future that students will one day be a part of. Increasingly, they will interact globally to innovate, solve problems, communicate and collaborate with people from different cultures all over the world. Kavya School is guided by "Parents in school" and "Teachers at Home" principle where staff, teachers, students and parents work together in a safe, caring and tolerant community to provide holistic environment with respect and dignity. This enables the students to achieve emotional, social, physical, moral and spiritual development. A strong emphasis is also placed on integrity, both in the use of technology and in the development of skills and values related to teamwork within a diverse community. The school strives to incorporate the talents of local individuals with global perspectives in order to create a dynamic and inclusive learning environment. All members of the school community are expected to model the behaviors that is expected from the students ensuring that Kavya is a center of excellence in the areas of education, community development, and environmental awareness. The school provides an ordered, structured environment in which discipline is seen to be firm but fair. School rules are based on courtesy, common sense and personal safety. The highest standards of behavior and dress are expected.

name: St. Mary's Secondary School, Pokhara
description: St. Mary Secondary School, Pokhara established in 1983 is an International Institution especially devoted to the education of youth. St. Mary Secondary School welcomes girls from all communities, regardless of their status, caste, creed, or religion. Our commitment extends beyond mere academic instruction; we strive to nurture well-rounded individuals. Our education system focuses on developing strong character, a love for truth, respect, loyalty, a sense of justice, and the determination to work diligently. These qualities aim to honor womanhood and enable our students to be sources of happiness and blessings in their communities.Since 2008, St. Mary Secondary School has expanded its curriculum to include admissions for Class 11 and 12, offering both Science and Management streams. name: Bijayshwori Secondary English Medium Boarding School
description: Located in the tranquil environment of Sundarbasti, Musikot Municipality, Bijayshwori Secondary English Medium Boarding School offers a peaceful and focused learning experience, far removed from the hustle and bustle of the city. Established as the oldest institutional school in Rukum District, Bijayshwori provides school-level education from Nursery to Grade 12, with a strong commitment to excellence. The school’s infrastructure includes an earthquake-resistant building, ensuring safety and stability. With modern facilities such as CCTV surveillance, security guards, and internet access, students are provided with a secure and connected environment. Additionally, the school features an e-library, smart boards, and well-maintained canteen and hostel facilities, all designed to support students' academic and personal growth. Bijayshwori Secondary School offers both Nepali and English Medium programs, with a focus on a low student-to-teacher ratio—only 25 students per group—to ensure individualized attention. The school also organizes an educational tour every academic year, further enhancing students' learning experience. For the Plus Two level, the school offers streams in Computer Science, Science, Management, and Law, all affiliated with the National Examination Board. Emphasizing skill development, culture, and technology, Bijayshwori strives to produce highly skilled and culturally aware professionals who can contribute to society. Bijayshwori has achieved outstanding results, with students consistently securing top marks in district-level and Karnali Province Secondary Examinations. The school’s dedication to quality education has earned it numerous accolades and prizes, solidifying its reputation as a leading institution in the region.

name: St. Xavier's School, Deonia
description: St. Xavier's School, Deonia (SXD), established in 1999, is the first Jesuit School outside the Kathmandu Valley, located in Jhapa district of Nepal. It is an English-medium school under the management of the Nepal Jesuit Society, the Nepal branch of the Society of Jesus, an international Catholic religious order. The Society of Jesus is present in 114 countries and runs more than 2,000 educational institutions of various types and levels.The core aim of Jesuit education is to transform students into global citizens, or "men and women for others," who are intellectually competent, morally upright, emotionally healthy, socially and environmentally responsible, and spiritually grounded, and who are committed to lives of service and social justice. In Nepal, the Jesuits began their work with St. Xavier's Godavari (1951), followed by St. Xavier's Jawalakhel (1954) and St. Xavier's Maitighar (1988), before starting SXD.SXD was established with the vision of holistically educating and nurturing the young generation residing in the far eastern part of Nepal. With its motto of "Live for God and Lead for Nepal," the school aims to transform students into global citizens and the best versions of themselves to make a difference in society. Besides academic excellence, SXD focuses on providing value-based, holistic education, imparting critical thinking skills, fostering a sense of universal brotherhood, and emphasizing social and environmental responsibility.For the last 25 years, SXD has worked to enlighten students about their obligation to be responsible members of society and the nation by living the Xavierian values founded on the philosophy and principles of Jesuit education. Today, many students from the school have made indelible marks in the nation and the world through their achievements and contributions.

name: Dhanush Janata Secondary School
description: Dhanush Janata Secondary School, also known as Shree Dhanush Janata (Technical and Vocational Education) Secondary School, is a reputed public school located in Dhanushadham-3, Dhanusha district, Madhesh Province, Nepal. Established in 2049 BS, it has grown into a well-regarded institution providing comprehensive education from ECD to grade 12.The school stands out for its integration of technical and vocational programs alongside regular academic streams, most notably offering a Diploma in Electrical Engineering as part of its +2 level program. This focus on practical, skill-based learning makes it particularly appealing for students interested in hands-on careers in engineering and related technical fields, aligning with Nepal's emphasis on vocational education in community schools.What sets Dhanush Janata Secondary School apart is its strong commitment to holistic student development. It emphasizes individual growth through interactive and engaging classroom sessions, where learning is made dynamic and student-centered. Practical-based teaching forms a core part of the pedagogy, especially in technical subjects, allowing students to apply theoretical knowledge in real-world scenarios. Experienced teachers guide the process, fostering an environment that encourages curiosity and skill mastery.Beyond academics, the school promotes all-round personal development via group activities, collaborative projects, and a variety of extracurricular activities. These include sports, cultural events, and other co-curricular programs designed to build teamwork, leadership, confidence, and social skills. This balanced approach helps students not only excel in studies but also develop as well-rounded individuals ready for future challenges.Dhanush Janata Secondary School serves as a vital educational hub in the Dhanushadham area, combining accessible government education with specialized vocational training and a nurturing, activity-rich environment that prioritizes both intellectual and personal growth.

description: Prembasti Secondary School is a leading educational institution in Prembasti, Bharatpur, committed to providing quality education from ECD to Grade 12. With a legacy of consistently achieving outstanding results in the SEE (Secondary Education Examination) and SLC (Grade 12), the school has earned a strong reputation for academic excellence. This model-oriented school is now offering free admission to Grade 11 for the academic session 2081/082, making quality education more accessible to deserving students. Key Features of Prembasti Secondary School: Modern and well-equipped classrooms that enhance the learning experience. Qualified and experienced teachers dedicated to the academic success of students. Multimedia, Smart Board, and ICT Lab that integrate technology into teaching. Continuous counseling and interaction to support students' personal and academic growth. Well-equipped assembly hall and playground for various activities. Pure drinking water and a modern library to facilitate a conducive learning environment. Teaching in both English and Nepali mediums to cater to diverse learning preferences. Plus Two programs affiliated with the National Examination Board, offering subjects under Management and Education streams for Grade 11 & 12. Special Facilities: Scholarships for poor and meritorious students, ensuring access to education for all. Free name registration and admission for students within the school's service area. Full scholarship for students with a GPA of 3.6 and above, and partial scholarship for those with a GPA of 3.2 and above. Prembasti Secondary School stands as a pillar of education in the region, providing students with a nurturing environment to thrive academically and socially. Whether it's preparing for national exams or offering extra support to those in need, Prembasti Secondary School remains committed to fostering the next generation of leaders and achievers.

name: NIST: National School of Sciences
description: NIST National School of Sciences, established in 1993, is a top-tier educational institution situated at Lainchour in the Kathmandu valley, and is a constituent of the NIST Foundation. For the past three decades, the school has been offering Upper Secondary classes in both Science and Management, as part of the +2 program, in line with the national curriculum set by the National Examination Board (NEB), Nepal. The school management is currently planning to introduce Law, Arts, and Humanities courses in Grade 11-12 in the near future. The long-term goal is to provide a complete continuum of education from Pre-school to Grade 12 through the NIST National School of Sciences within the next few years.A group of scientists and academics launched the NIST Foundation with the primary objectives of creating academic institutions and offering high-quality education in science and technology to promote science education in the country. Presently, the NIST Foundation oversees nine academic institutions, including the National School of Sciences, which provides education from Pre-school to university level at various locations. The institution prioritizes academic excellence and encourages innovation and collaboration among students, resulting in exceptional board examination results each year. As a result, many alumni are now highly respected professionals and businesspeople both in the country and overseas.Every year, approximately 1,000 students enroll in the Science and Management Stream, representing various provinces and diverse cultures and ethnicities. This allows for an intercultural exchange of ideas and a rich learning experience. The school offers numerous co-curricular and extra-curricular activities that promote the students' overall development, preparing them not only for higher education but also for life beyond. Moreover, the school places great importance on instilling moral values in its students, such as integrity, responsibility, empathy, collaboration, and respect, to help them become well-rounded individuals and reach their full potential.VisionOur vision is to become a highly respected high school in the society where its students, staff and the community feel safe and valued, demonstrate their pride, share a love for learning, and students graduate with academic excellence to succeed in higher education and life.MissionWe provide our students with a holistic education in a caring, safe and supportive environment that fosters positive attitudes to learning and develops the intellectual, social and emotional skills as well as their physical well–being of students. We engage our parents as partners to facilitate students to achieve academic excellence, inspire lifelong learning, and become confident, engaged and responsible global citizens. We help students develop the 21st century skills – creativity, critical–thinking, collaboration, communication and positive attitude that are essential to succeed in life, higher education and beyond.
