name: Karnali Secondary School
description: Karnali Secondary School, Kailali, established in 2045 BS, is a community-owned educational institution located in Tikapur Municipality-1, Satti, Sudurpaschim Province, Nepal. The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT). The Ministry of Education in Nepal also approves it.Karnali Secondary School offers a range of educational programs:General Classes (Montessori to Class 10)Civil Engineering (Class 9-12)TSLC in Agriculture (Plant Science) - 18 monthsAdditionally, the school provides Ten Plus Two (10+2) programs in Science streams. Education is offered from the primary level through 10+2, with minimal fee structures, and the school has scholarship schemes for brilliant, deserving, and economically disadvantaged students.Establishment:Primary Level Approved: 2045Lower Secondary Level Permitted: 2052Secondary Level Permitted: 2057Technical Stream (9-12): 2073Class 11 (Science): 2076Diploma in Agriculture: 2076Selected for Federal Model School Program: 2076Effective Practices at Karnali Secondary SchoolKarnali Secondary School employs a range of effective practices to ensure smooth operation, foster student development, and maintain high educational standards:Shared Leadership: The school distributes administrative responsibilities, assigning roles like Assistant Head and various departmental in-charges to ensure efficient management.Collaborative Planning: Subject-specific subcommittees are established to facilitate discussions and collaboration, effectively addressing academic needs.Dynamic Extracurriculars: Subcommittees manage extracurricular activities, dividing tasks and ensuring a vibrant program for students.Promoting Discipline: A dedicated Discipline Committee encourages adherence to school rules, fostering a respectful and orderly environment.Active Parent Engagement: Regular class-wise discussions between parents and teachers help identify issues and implement solutions collaboratively.Networking with Other Schools: Karnali Secondary School participates in an inter-school network to discuss and exchange best practices with other institutions.Inclusive Decision-Making: The School Management Committee (SMC), Parent-Teacher Association (PTA), teachers, and staff regularly interact and discuss key matters.Learning from Peers: Representatives from the SMC, PTA, teachers, and staff visit other high-performing schools to observe and adopt effective strategies.Targeted Academic Support: Additional classes are offered as needed to support student learning and address specific academic needs.Student Empowerment: Various child clubs, circles, and monitoring groups are established and operated to empower students and foster leadership.Consistent Physical Training: The school provides ongoing Physical Training (PT) following a structured program, drawing on training from institutions such as Kalika Manav Vigyan Secondary School.Classroom Monitoring System: A system is in place for class monitors to prepare and maintain records of teacher time and activities, supporting classroom management.Feedback-Driven Improvement: Qualitative and suggestive feedback received through suggestion boxes is discussed monthly and implemented to enhance school practices.Widespread Sports Participation: Students are encouraged to participate in a range of sports programs, promoting physical health and teamwork.Support for Primary Students: Children enrolling in primary classes receive free school uniforms and textbooks, ensuring access and support from the start.

name: Jalupa Secondary School
description: Jalupa Secondary School is a full-fledged English medium, community-based academic institution located at Tokha Municipality-08, Baniyatar. The school offers education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12, combining academic rigor with personal growth to prepare students for future success.The school emphasizes practical-based learning, encouraging students to apply their knowledge in real-life situations and develop critical thinking skills. Alongside academics, students engage in a variety of extracurricular activities such as drawing competitions, prize distribution ceremonies, Kids’ Holi celebrations, and sports, ensuring their holistic development.Jalupa Secondary School also organizes meaningful awareness programs throughout the year. On Environment Day, students participate in pollution control activities like trash collection, while public awareness campaigns educate them on the dangers of smoking and drinking. Age-appropriate sessions on menstrual hygiene are also conducted to promote early awareness and break stigmas from a young age.For students of Grades 11 and 12, financial literacy programs help build essential money management skills. To support diverse academic interests, the school offers a wide range of optional subjects, including Accountancy, Economics, Business Studies, Computer Science, Hotel Management, Major Nepali, Major English, Sociology, and Rural Development.With its spacious classrooms, supportive environment, and student-centered approach, Jalupa Secondary School ensures that every student receives the attention, care, and opportunities they need to thrive both academically and personally.As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Jalupa Secondary School has 941 enrolled students.

name: Gandaki Boarding School
description: Gandaki Boarding School formerly known as Nepal Adarsha Bidhalaya was established on 11th June 1966 as a result of the initiation of three groups:The United Mission to Nepal.The Shining Hospital andThe Local Community, with a view to imparting quality education of an international standard.Initially, the facilities were primitive with all the thatched-roofed buildings mud, and bamboo. There were only 45 boarding students, who were catered for by 5 teaching staff. It was designated as a co-educational regional school in 1985 with English as the medium of instruction in an agreement between the Nepal government and the United Mission to Nepal.The first batch of 10+2 students was enrolled in 1992. Prior to the commencement of 10+2 education; students were prepared for O-level study for a number of years. It has been running classes from grade four to bachelor's level. It offers plus two programs in Science with the affiliation of NEB. Its sister organization offer B.E. in Computer Engineering (software) with the affiliation of Pokhara University.The facilities and resources of the school for both boys and girls include well-equipped classrooms, a library, labs, a gymnasium, playgrounds, a health center, and ten hostels. Academic performance has been excellent both in SEE and 10+2 exams. It has been awarded the Birendra Regional Education Shield 16 times so far for its best educational accomplishments in the Western Development Region.Moreover, according to the report on the evaluation of the Higher Secondary Education in Nepal made by Himal and Nepal, national journals of Nepal, Gandaki Boarding School has been ranked the best Secondary School in the country on the basis of 10+2 results over several years.GBS graduates pursue their tertiary education mainly in technical fields required in various areas.Many of its ex-students have scattered throughout the country taking up numerous key positions, making a tremendous contribution to its development.

name: Reliance Co Ed. School

The knowledge acquired is of utmost importance and the focus is on developing students’ interest in learning and cultivating the other important aspects including character, attitude and confidence. It aims to produce technically, socially and academically excellent world citizen.Why Reliance Co Ed?Every children are born with a natural sense of wonder, a fertile imagination, and an eagerness to understand the world around them. At Reliance Co-Ed. School, it cultivate those children through a well rounded education based on Values that entices the curious mind and instills the desire to learn more. name: Sarbanam Shikshyalaya
description: Sarbanam Shikshyalaya is located at Jorpati, Gokarneshwor. Sarbanam Shikshyalaya is a updated name for Children’s Liberty English Boarding School (famous as CLEBS). With more than 15 years of dedication in quality and excellent performance in education, Sarbanam Shikshyalaya now extends classes upto 12 (+2). The school is a premier educational institution in the country. Established in 2001, the school has evolved over the years into an institution which provides comprehensive education to students from all cross-sections of society. The education provided by the school is child-eccentric and is tailored to meet the challenges of the new millennium. The school’s motto, which is “INNOVATION IN EDUCATION”, is in tune with the essence in the context and growth of the education system in Nepal.The school runs classes from Nursery to Class X. In keeping with modern trends, the school believes in the principle of learning by doing. By following an eclectic method, the school seeks to draw the best out of students by focusing on their innate qualities. The school believes that education prepares one for the future because education is meant for the future generation.The school provides a wide range of co-curricular activities because it recognizes the fact that education is incomplete without them. With minimum assistance from teachers, the students run clubs such as Social Service, Music club, Students’ Club and various kinds of clubs. The idea is to make students solve their own problems and to shoulder their responsibilities. The project method of teaching is implemented here.The school has made its mark in all spheres of life. Its performance in curricular as well as co-curricular activities has been exemplary. The school has a strong support system that includes the strong management policy, the administrative team, dedicated staff, infra-structure, social bond etc. Sarbanam Shikshyalaya puts a lot of emphasis is given to per-primary and primary education since children are most impressionable at this stage. Skilled teachers ensure that there is an all round development of a child’s personality. Children are encouraged to take part in creative activities. All activities are designed to make children open up. Group activities provide ample scope for interaction as a result of which children become more outspoken and smart.

name: Durbar High School (Bhanu Secondary School)
description: Durbar High School also known as Bhanu Secondary School is established during Rana regime. Established in 1854, Durbar High School is the country’s first school. Located in Ranipokhari, Kathmandu, it previously taught only members of the ruling family, but was opened to private citizens in 1902.The school had to shift constantly from Thapathali Durbar to Charburja Durbar, Seto Durbar and Narayanhiti Durbar before being located in a small shed in Jamal. Finally in 1891, the then prime minister Bir Shumsher Rana had the present long building built on the west side of Rani Pokhari. In 1900, Durbar School was turned into a public school. In 1967, its name was changed to Bhanu Madhyamik Vidyalaya.The school lies next to Rani Pokhari built by king Pratap Malla in 1670. The school was originally an elementary English school. Feeling humiliated by not being able to communicate in English during his visit to Europe, Jung Bahadur Rana set up a school at his residence in 1853 with two teachers imported from England to teach children of the ruling families. The school was later shifted to Thapathali Durbar with an Englishman called Kenning as its first teacher. Named Durbar School (palace school), it marked the beginning of modern education in Nepal, but only the ruling Ranas and their sons could attend it. In 1876, the school began admitting children of high class government officers too.Initially, the school as a feeder institution was affiliated with Calcutta University, and students had to travel to Kolkata for their high school entrance examination until an examination centre affiliated with Patna University was opened in Kathmandu in 1929. In 1933, the government established the School Leaving Certificate Examination Board and students did not have to travel to India for their exams. The historical school building also possesses archaeological importance and is loved by millions of people. Some parts of the school were destroyed in the April 2015 Nepal earthquake. The school is currently being rebuilt under the Chinese Aid. The four-storey school building with more than 40 classrooms will be built in an area of 4,200 square metres.

name: Pathshala Nepal Foundation, Bagdol
description: Pathshala was founded in 2004 AD as a co-educational English Medium School to cater to the need of quality schooling in the context of 21st century learning. Education is an asset of every individual. This fact cannot be ignored in today’s globalized world. For some decades in Nepal, the ultimate goal of education has been to be a doctor or an engineer or a technician or empower students to get a job without placing values in personal integrity. Success at any cost and by any means is misleading the entire Nepalese society. The major focus has been placed on fluency of speech in English, doing homework and securing position in examination. Community assesses school children by marks they obtain in examination rather than their cognitive, social, emotional, psychological, motor and moral development. Parents hardly think of how responsible the child has been after school; how helpful and sociable she/he has been. Pathshala does not believe in providing mere theoretical knowledge: it rather follows practical and behavioral aspects of education. It has realized that the goal should be to become a good citizen along with the content of information. The current need of the nation is education for meaningful life. It believes few educated good people can influence and ignite change among larger mass. The prime goal of education should be profession oriented with humanity and ethics. Students should be responsible and accountable to the world, nation, community and family. Pathshala Nepal is established to address these issues and its activities are conducted to accomplish these goals. Though it is very challenging, innovative and creative; it is not impossible to achieve. The whole child, or whole person focus of learning can bring miraculous changes in students. Pathshala Nepal is an effort of a group of educators who are working for improving traditional instructional approaches. Since its inception, Pathshala is emerging as most sought after 21st Century education center and has been a source of inspiration for many other educational institutions in Nepal. It has been generally observed that many parents have been taking their children abroad seeking better education than from Nepal’s schools whereas Pathshala has many examples of comeback. Pathshala is proud to share that this institution has provided education of global standard with local values. Mission The mission of Pathshala Nepal is to develop all aspects of school life in meaningful situation so that children achieve their full potential both academically and socially. This education takes place within a challenging, stimulating and caring environment in which educational values are central to the ethos of the school and its teaching. ‘Meaningful Education for Meaningful Life’ is the motto of this school. Vision To help students develop full potential with lively and enquiring minds, the ability to question and discuss rationally. To foster a warm and friendly atmosphere within a caring school community in which students’ self-esteem and respect for others can develop. To provide a broad, balanced curriculum which fulfills the requirements of the National Curriculum and which should be appropriate and matched to the development level and needs of individual students, giving due regard to the fundamental importance of maths and language. To help students to acquire knowledge and skills, encouraging them to take pride in their achievements. To promote the good conduct and sense of responsibility To promote respect for local values, tolerance of other races, religions and ways of life. To help students to appreciate human achievements and aspirations. To help students to understand the world in which they live and the interdependence of individuals, groups as well as nations. To provide equal opportunities, responsibilities and rights regardless of race, gender, background and ability to children. To enhance the partnership among students, parents and school in the education of our children. To promote the role of the school within the community, to encourage our students to care about and take responsibility for our environment both locally and globally.

name: St. Capitanio School
description: St. Capitanio School is a prestigious educational institution located in Tansen, Palpa, founded in the year 2000 AD by the Sisters of Charity, a global organization with a deep-rooted tradition of serving humanity. The school’s mission is to provide nurturing environments that foster both academic excellence and personal growth, ensuring that every child’s potential is unlocked in a caring, joyful, and transformative atmosphere. With a strong emphasis on holistic education, St. Capitanio School offers a comprehensive curriculum that not only covers core academic subjects but also encourages the development of concepts, ideas, and essential skills. The school is affiliated with the Nepal Board of Education and provides students with opportunities to explore extracurricular activities, sports, and creative pursuits, making education a truly well-rounded experience. In recognition of its high standards, the school has been honored with the International School Award (ISA) 2021-2024 from the British Council, further validating its commitment to excellence. The Sisters of Charity, who founded the school, are part of a global network with a rich legacy of serving underprivileged communities, dating back to 1832. Their efforts to serve the needy through education, healthcare, and social welfare have influenced the foundation of schools like St. Capitanio, which strives to uplift the lives of students from all walks of life. Over the years, St. Capitanio has faced many challenges, but with the determination and vision of its pioneering team, the school has flourished, growing from humble beginnings with just 120 students to a fully-equipped institution that includes modern classrooms, a science lab, computer lab, library, and expansive facilities. The strong sense of community and commitment to excellence has earned the school a reputation as one of the leading educational institutions in the region. St. Capitanio School continues to be a place where students not only excel academically but also develop strong moral values, preparing them to face the challenges of the world with confidence and compassion. With over 22 years of legacy, the school has produced 12 successful batches of students who have gone on to achieve remarkable success, and the school continues to shine brightly as a beacon of education, service, and hope.

name: World Youth International School
description: World Youth International School it is located in Gorkarna-5. The World Youth International School was opened on September 14, 1999, with the purpose to train local teachers and provide a rich, dynamic education for its students. The school provides children with a quality education through shared cultural teachings and experiences. The World Youth International School was built in the memory of WYI founder, Robert Hoey – a young dedicated man, who encouraged personal challenge in others and promoted the values of self-worth, awareness and understanding through education. Nepal was chosen because at the time, it had the third lowest literacy rate in the world. Approximately 87% of women and 70% of men were illiterate.When the school first opened, there were 24 children enrolled. The school commenced with pre-school, upper and lower kindergarten, grade one and two. At that time it was perfect as it allowed up the opportunity to hire and select teachers, put systems in place and work on the school curriculum.The school now caters for students up to year 10 and currently has 505 students attending the school, 30 of whom live at the Sapana Dreaming Center for Humanity. The current average grade pass is 96% making it of the top-rated schools in Nepal. The School is currently in the process of being extended to include schooling for year 11 and 12 students.

name: Adarsh Vidya Niketan Secondary School
description: Each child is born with a quality. Each a genius in his own right, though not in what we call in conventional norms. Because of lack of proper guidance these geniuses just become 'face in the crowd'. This was one of the challenge we set before ourselves as we went out conceiving and designing the Adarsh 'An Ideal' School to provide an environment where the child can explore and develop every facet of himself, so that he can realize his true potential and his true genius.A challenge we have been true to in every aspect of the school. Right form developing an intensive and exhaustive methodology to inculcating skills and values are essential in this age of Global Competition where only the fittest survive.Adarsh Vidya Niketan (AVN) is an accredited educational institution that came into existence in 2046 B.S. (1989 AD) with the express purpose of imparting high quality Education to the young generation. The school is registered with the Government of Nepal and High Secondary wing is affiliated to the NEB and offers +2 in Management.In a short span of 20 years Adarsh Vidya Niketan has grown up to Higher Secondary level. It has widened its scope, challenge the conventional norms of teaching and brought about a truly integrated system of learning. It has remained true to its core strength-teachers, who inspire students to innovate and adopt in the fast changing world of today. It has thus truly proved and followed its motto 'Expert to crede'.The institution's students have exposure beyond books and academia. Hikes, school excursion, creative activities with work exposure and social awareness are all part of a holistic education that enables students to develop into confident, poised, young adults who are equipped and ready to meet the challenges of a rapidly challenging and demanding world.Table Tennis, Basket Ball, Badminton, Volleyball, Cricket, Football, Athletics are among the sports promoted. Talents in acting, poetry, and painting are encouraged and honed through cultural programs.ADSL networking system enabled computer lab with high-speed connectivity provides students easy access to communication highway for their advanced learning. Educational tours and seminars are conducted to enhance in them more of practical knowledge.

name: Shram Rastriya Secondary School
description: Located in Kumarigal, Ward No. 7 of Kathmandu, Shram Rastriya Secondary School is a well-performing community school known for delivering strong academic results despite limited physical infrastructure. Spread over just one ropani of land, the school operates 13 classrooms and manages a high student population of around 800 by running classes in both morning and afternoon shifts.Established in 2020 BS, the school has made significant progress under the leadership of Principal Narayan Prasad Nepal since 2055 BS. A key academic initiative introduced in 2058 BS, conducting additional classes in English, Mathematics, and Science on Saturdays (except during festivals), has played an important role in improving students’ performance in the Secondary Education Examination (SEE).In recent years, the school has consistently secured outstanding results at the district level, particularly in 2078, 2079, and 2080 BS, earning repeated recognition from the Kathmandu Metropolitan City as a top-performing community school.Despite space constraints and the absence of a proper playground, the school continues to maintain high educational standards through targeted support classes for academically weak students, “Book Free Friday” initiatives, technology-integrated teaching practices, and the strong commitment of its teaching staff. These efforts highlight the school’s ability to provide quality education even with limited resources.

description: Situated on Patan Hospital Road in Lagankhel, Lalitpur, Nepal, Lalitpur Madhyamik Vidyalaya (LMV) has served as a foundation of academic success and character development since it was officially registered in 1982 A.D. name: I.J. Pioneer High School
description: Established in 1985, I.J. Pioneer High School, located in Hattiban, stands as a testament to the visionary dream of its Late Patron Indra Bhakta Shrestha. His unwavering belief that no child should have to seek quality education beyond Nepal laid the foundation for an institution dedicated to academic excellence and national development. A distinguished figure from a reputed business family, Indra Bhakta Shrestha was not only the founding father of the Nepal Chamber of Commerce and FNCCI but also a leader with a deep sense of responsibility towards the country. With the motto “Changing the Nation through Education,” I.J. Pioneer High School has continually evolved to meet the educational needs of the nation. What began as a small initiative with just a few students in Nursery, Kindergarten, and the First Grade has grown into a fully-fledged high school. Over time, the school has created an enriching and dynamic learning environment, expanding its academic offerings to include +2 Science and Management faculties from 2013. Plans are underway to introduce additional streams, aligning with the national education policy and the evolving aspirations of students. At its core, I.J. Pioneer is guided by the noble objective of nurturing students holistically—developing their body, mind, and spirit while instilling a strong work ethic and an appreciation for lifelong learning. The institution remains steadfast in its commitment to providing a scientific, innovative, and student-centered approach to education. Unlike profit-driven institutions, I.J. Pioneer High School aspires to be a platform where students can fulfill the farsighted vision of its late patron, contributing meaningfully to Nepal and the world. Today, with a strong legacy and an ever-growing number of students and institutions recognizing its impact, I.J. Pioneer High School continues to set benchmarks in quality education, shaping future leaders and changemakers.

name: Sudur Pashchimanchal Academy
description: Sudur Pashchimanchal Academy started in 2056 B.S with 57 students and a rented space in Trinagar Secondary School. Similarly, under TU affiliated wing, we offer B.B.S., B.Ed, B.A. and M.Ed. programmes. SPA is proud of all those SPA graduates who are illuminating diverse sectors of Nepali society with their skills in their service. The total number of seats per batch is 44.SOS Hermann Gmeiner School Bharatpur is an English medium co-educational institution established in 2004 AD. Initially the school ran from nursery to Grade Five, however, in the short span of four years the school appeared the first SLC Examination in 2008with its 34 students. The same year brought the extension of higher secondary education in science stream. The number of three hundred students of first year is extended to a number of more than five hundred students at present.Among the colleges in Chitwan district that run science program at 10+2 level, SOS Hermann Gmeiner Secondary School Bharatpur, has emerged with distinct recognition in the district, completely different in the crowd. "Learning may occur everywhere but SOS gives you a good culture with the best learning," we claim.SOS Hermann Gmeiner Higher Secondary School Bharatpur offers scholarship to the need based and merit based candidates. In the need based, twenty to thirty percent of needy, marginalized and disadvantaged children will enjoy the scholarship where as in merit based, students scoring the highest marks in the entrance test will get free-ship in tuition fees until the result of the 1st term examination. Then, the sum of scholarship will be awarded to the one who stands first in each terminal exam.The school has got four different structures- pre primary block, primary block, secondary block and higher secondary block to avoid hurdles for young ones. It has spread in an area of nearly four bighas of land. The school has a well managed IT laboratory, well equipped science laboratory for Chemistry, Biology and Physics, well equipped library with well-stocked wide range of resources, a spacious Auditorium Hall, a big playground, infirmary for treatment of students, and spacious cycleBesides regular academic activities, different extra curricular activities and sports events will be organized to promote and strengthen students' all round development. A wide range of opportunities for students will be provided to inculcate socio- cultural behaviour.The school organizes a regular entrance preparation class for medicine science, engineering and the classes for IELTS and TOEFL for Grade XII.

name: Trungram International Academy Secondary School
description: Trungram International Academy, popularly known as TIA, is located in Hattigauda, Kathmandu. It was established in 1995 by His Eminence Dr Trungram Gyaltrul Rimpoche as one of the many projects of UTBF (United Trungram Buddhist Foundation). His Eminence believes that with a proper foundation, it is possible to build a school comparable to the schools of other foreign countries. The founder wishes to produce students with a genuine feeling of respect and understanding for other people and life in all its forms. An institution should create a lively environment where the students can develop their own unique and noble personalities by discovering their hidden talents and potential. TIA is situated on twelve acres of land in Hattigauda, Bansbari, away from the noise and distractions of Kathmandu City. It provides a relaxed and peaceful environment in which to learn and grow. Learning and teaching are at their best in an environment which is safe and attractive, where all members of the community are valued, where rights and responsibilities are clear, where support and challenge are provided, and where achievements of all kinds are recognized. TIA's key purpose is to provide such an environment that will help establish a school within Nepal with an academic standard comparable to the best schools in Asia. Vision: To foster spirit of brother and sisterhood and tolerance toward all human beings, motivating one and all to dedicate themselves towards the creation of a peaceful, just, happy, and meaningful life on Earth Aims of TIA: To provide a safe environment for the students attending the school. To develop the intellectual qualities of all students to the full, recognizing individual needs and providing equal opportunities. To develop the ability to make appropriate decisions. To foster self-esteem and tolerance. To develop an awareness of the schools role in the community. To develop the ability to work independently or as part of a group. To raise expectations and increase motivation. To assess and monitor students achievement in order to ensure continuity and progression. To prepare students for post-SLC opportunities. To promote Home/School links. To encourage a healthy life style for each student. To develop in students acceptable moral standard.

name: Sainik Awasiya Mahavidyalaya, Chitwan
description: Sainik Awasia Mahavidyalaya Chainpur, is an English medium co-educational institution under the supervision of the Welfare Planning Directorate of Nepalese Army. The school follows a semi-residential model, with male students residing in the school's hostel and female students attending classes as day boarders. On 17th July 2012 (02nd Shrawan, 2069), General Chhatra Man Singh Gurung, the then Chief of the Army Staff, Nepal Army, inaugurated SAM Chitwan in the presence of senior Army officials, teachers, students, parents, and other dignitaries.SAM Chitwan, the representative school of the Mid Division of Nepalese Army, is the sixth Sainik Awasiya Mahavidyalaya (SAM) in the country. SAMs are established with the noble theme of "imparting education is the biggest service" throughout Nepal. SAM Chitwan was established with the same motto and spirit to provide quality education to all children of Army personnel, both on service and ex-servicemen, as well as civilians. Our commitment is to produce multi-talented, disciplined, and patriotic citizens who can lead in various avenues of national society and international horizons.Located in the heart of Chitwan, one of the most facilitated districts in the country, SAM Chitwan has its own premises equipped with all necessary infrastructures for a world-class school. In addition to regular classrooms and other resources, the school boasts spacious playgrounds, swimming pools, assembly areas, hostels, dining halls, conference halls, libraries, laboratories, audio-visual resource rooms, music rooms, infirmaries, and a secured campus. The primary objective of all these facilities is to provide opportunities for students to develop their mental and physical strengths to excel in their fields of specialty.The Mahavidyalaya runs classes from grade 6 to 12 with three sections in each class except in grade 11 and 12. The plus two wing has Science and Management streams .Each class is divided into three sections, which are named after the wildlife respecting the wildlife of Chitwan National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, to implant the feeling of consciousness towards conservation among the students. Being the school running under Nepalese Army Welfare Fund, the school has reserved the seats for the children of Army personnel. 60% of the total seats are reserved for the Army personnel while remaining 40% seats are open for the civil students. The enrolment of new students takes place in grade 6 and 11 once a year on the basis of entrance examination followed by medical examination and interview. New admission opens every March-April (Falgun-Chaitra) and the notice is also published in the national newspapers.

name: Kailash Bodhi Secondary School

Kailash Bodhi School is registered under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of Nepal. It is a secondary (Madhyamik) school, which has successfully promoted many batches of students for S.L.C. examinations with colorful results since 1998. Classes run from Nursery to Ten (X). The medium of instruction is English for all classes except for the preprimary classes and the language subject in proper. Tibetan language is also taught as an optional language. Ven.Lama Gondup and Mr. Sonam Tsering Lama laid the foundation stone of this school in the year 1993 on February 24th. Kailash Bodhi Secondary Boarding School is situated in Suvigaon, which is at distance of 15 minute’s walk to the northwestern direction from Boudha stupa, Kathmandu. It is located at an ideal place with quiet and green surroundings. According to the list of admissions since its establishment, the school has grown with around 2802 students within two decades. And nearly 900 students from different parts of country make the current strength of school.

name: Golden Sungava English Boarding School
description: Located in Duwakot, Changunarayan Municipality-2, Bhaktapur, Sungava School is an educational institution situated approximately 500 meters north of Sallaghari on the Araniko Highway. Locally recognized as a leading school in the region, it has earned a distinguished reputation for its consistent excellence in Secondary Education Examination (S.E.E.) results, active participation in extra-curricular (ECA) and co-curricular activities (CCA), and significant involvement in social initiatives. The school prides itself on providing a "domestic" or homelike environment that distinguishes it from other institutions in the municipality.The school’s academic structure is divided into specialized sections to cater to the developmental needs of its students. The Pre-primary Section utilizes a pedagogy of "learning by doing," blending Montessori methods with traditional teaching systems. Through its Independent Curriculum (IC), the school ensures that children learn in harmony with their local environment, emphasizing natural learning rather than rote instruction.In the Primary and Secondary sections, the school implements a semi-grading system for Grades 1 through 3, allowing teachers to provide individualized care and foster student enthusiasm. For students in Grades 4, 5, and 6, the institution emphasizes the development of a strong reading culture through regular "Book Talk" and "Book Review" programs, believing that establishing reading habits before the age of 12 builds lifelong confidence and engagement.For the senior levels (Grades 7 to 10), Sungava School balances rigorous academic preparation with social psychology and responsibility. Students are encouraged to participate in sports and social campaigns to develop a sense of duty toward their community. To further inspire and motivate the youth, the school frequently invites experts and "think tanks" from various sectors to provide keynote addresses and awareness sessions.Sungava School has maintained a record of academic superiority, consistently ranking at the top of Changunarayan Municipality for S.E.E. results from 2072 B.S. through 2079 B.S. Its competitive edge extends to extracurricular activities, where it frequently wins trophies in municipal-level competitions.The school’s evaluation process is characterized by a unique cluster-based examination system that aligns with the Curriculum Development Centre's specification grids. By collaborating with teachers from different schools to prepare standardized question papers, the institution ensures fair, high-standard assessments. Additionally, students are evaluated through diverse project works that include social campaigns, classroom activities, and household involvement, providing a well-rounded educational experience.

description: Padma Kanya Vidyashram Secondary School, known in Nepali as पद्मकन्या विद्याश्रम माध्यामिक विद्यालय, is a prestigious government school located in Dillibazar, Kathmandu, Nepal. Founded on January 21, 1948 (2004 Magh 8), by the then Rana Prime Minister Padmasamsher Jawara, the school was established to advance women's education, recognizing its crucial role in societal development. Initially operating in the upper floor of the Durbar High School, it later moved to its current location, supported by 13 Ropani of land provided by the founder. The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education, offering programs from Grade One to Ten (SEE) and Plus Two levels in Management, Humanities, and Education streams. Over the years, Padma Kanya Vidyashram has produced notable alumni, including the renowned literary artist Parijat (Bishnukumari Waiba), and has been a pioneer in nurturing thousands of qualified and capable women.Today, Padma Kanya Vidyashram Secondary serves around 9,000 students from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds. It offers classes in both Nepali and English mediums from Grade 6 to 10 and includes additional courses in English, Mathematics, and Computer Science, all without any monthly fees up to the secondary level. The school incorporates technical subjects like civil engineering from Class 9 and provides early childhood education. To support holistic student development, various social organizations such as Scout, Junior Red Cross, EcoClub, and ChildClub are active within the school. Additionally, a 44-room women's dormitory is being constructed to accommodate female students. With a focus on providing quality education at a moderate fee structure and offering scholarship schemes for deserving students, Padma Kanya Vidyashram Secondary School continues to uphold its legacy of empowering women through education and contributing significantly to societal progress.

name: Euro School Chhauni
description: Vision We will provide a platform for students to understand and contribute to a rapidly changing society, thus taking steps towards being Global Citizens and giving equal priority to our native values and beliefs. Mission We will be the preeminent creative center for effective engagement to improve the thoughts and conditions of local and global communities. We will create simple yet smart students to meet their needs; communication being the concern. Curriculum Euro School Chhauni will be the preeminent creative center for effective engagement to improve the thoughts and conditions of local and global communities. We will create simple yet smart students to meet the social needs;communication being the core concern. Approach: Conventionally, teaching and learning processes have been highly guided by the notion of delivering monotonous lectures by teachers. While there are benefits to this, Euro School Chaunni recognizes that an emphasis on integrated learning supersedes traditional methods of lectures. We deliver this integrated learning by following the STEAM Education: STEAM Education: STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics) is an integrated and interdisciplinary approach to learning that encourages students to think more broadly and critically about real-world problems. In this approach, our teachers facilitate students to solve practical problems by incorporating literary, scientific, mathematical, engineering, and technological knowledge in a creative (i.e. artistic) way. Eunoia (The Mindful Curriculum): We proudly announce the launch of our new curriculum ‘Eunoia’ which focuses on three major dimensions of a child: Mind, Body, and Soul. As children progress into a smarter, more responsive generation, their thirst for knowledge and learning increases. We assure you that this updated curriculum will enhance children’s abilities through experiential learning. Philosophy: We Empower Educators: Empowered teachers emotionally engage young minds during the learning process. We enhance the child’s uniqueness: We believe each child is special. We involve parents in our learning process: Because a child’s home is their first school, we include parents towards the holistic growth of the child.

name: Geetanjali SS/College
description: Geetanjali School/College is a well-established educational institution that has been serving the academic needs of students since 2043 B.S. (1986 A.D.). Named after Geetanjali, the Nobel Prize-winning literary masterpiece by Rabindranath Tagore, the institution stands as a symbol of meaningful learning, creativity, and academic excellence.What began as a small school with classes up to Grade Five has now grown into a full-fledged co-educational institution, offering education from Play Group to the Bachelor's level under one academic umbrella. Over the decades, Geetanjali has expanded its academic programs with care and vision, introducing SLC-level education in 2059 B.S., +2 programs in 2062 B.S., and Bachelor's level courses in 2065 B.S., with a focus on Business Studies (BBA).The pre-primary section at Geetanjali is designed with the belief that early childhood is the most important stage for learning and development. Children from ages 0 to 5 engage in playful, meaningful activities that include songs, colors, games, numbers, and storytelling. These early experiences help them build strong foundations in literacy, numeracy, and emotional intelligence. The environment is child-friendly, safe, and nurturing, allowing young learners to explore, express, and grow with confidence.As students move forward, they are supported by structured academics and a wide range of subject options in the +2 level, including Hotel Management, Law, Computer Science, Sociology, Tourism, Mass Communication, and more. These courses are designed to develop both academic knowledge and practical skills, preparing students for further studies and diverse career paths.At the Bachelor's level, Geetanjali offers a focused program in Business Studies, aimed at equipping students with theoretical insight and applied knowledge in commerce, entrepreneurship, and management.Beyond academics, Geetanjali provides a well-rounded learning environment with modern facilities, including a library, science and computer labs, hotel management lab, music lab, auditorium, and digital classrooms. The school also encourages physical well-being and extracurricular growth through a spacious playground, sports courts, and regular ECA/CCA activities. Safety and care are ensured through CCTV surveillance, transportation services, and a warm, supportive community.With a dedicated team of over 30 experienced teachers and a student body of more than 1,000 learners, Geetanjali School/College continues to grow as a trusted institution, committed to academic excellence, holistic development, and a future-ready approach to education.

name: Nisarga Batika School
description: Established in 2012, Nisarga Batika School was born out of a group of dedicated educators' initiative to make a positive impact on the lives of students and teachers, while fostering a dynamic and engaging learning culture in Nepalese schools. Guided by progressive educational values and their own extensive experience in teaching, teacher training, and curriculum development, the school embarked on its journey on May 6, 2013, starting with a modest eight-room facility. In its inaugural year, the school had a humble beginning, welcoming a small cohort of two dozen students and a dozen staff members, offering preschool and junior elementary levels. Presently, Nisarga Batika School comprises four distinct levels: Preschool, Junior Elementary, Senior Elementary, and High School. The school spans an impressive area of approximately 125,000 square feet, with over 40,000 square feet dedicated to activity rooms and classrooms. It boasts two swimming pools, two basketball courts, ample open spaces, and separate infrastructures for the preschool, elementary school, and high school sections. The establishment of the dedicated preschool infrastructure took place in 2017, while the high school wing's infrastructure development concluded in 2021. The continuous development of the school's infrastructure remains an integral aspect of Nisarga Batika School's growth. Over time, the school has gained a reputation as a highly sought-after educational institution in the country. It fosters an environment that emphasizes quality classroom experiences, individualized teacher attention, and a diverse range of enrichment activities, all aligned with the educational vision desired by parents for their children. name: Takshashila Academy
description: Takshashila Academy is an educational institution which provides a platform to its pupils for exploring their potentialities leading to the high quality education. It was established in 1998. Avidit Acharya (PhD, Princeton University, USA) proposed the name Takshashila to remind one of the past glories of education in South Asia. Takshashila University was a citadel of learning even before Lord Buddha. It was the University where Panini wrote the Sanskrit grammar called Ashtadhyayi which is regarded as the best grammar of any language written so far in the world. Takshashila University was the one where Mahayana Buddhism was studied and Kautilya studied, taught and wrote famous book Arthashastra (Economics). Takshashila Academy provides +2 education in Science, Management and Humanities stream with the affiliation from National Examinations Board and Bachelor in Business Studies (BBS) with the affiliation from Tribhuvan University. It aims to to provide best teaching-learning environment which helps to foster best quality education through highly qualified academicians of Nepal and Abroad. Objectives: To develop the virtues of honesty, truthfulness, courage, cleanliness and thrift in students. To develop the virtues of self-discipline, self-reliance and self confidence. To prepare students to be adaptable for the challenges of the 21st century. To promote partnership between pupils, parents, school and community in the education of our students. To teach students the techniques of research that can be utilized in their higher studies.

name: Jay Kisan Secondary School
description: Shree Jay Kisan Secondary School, Dharahari, Rautahat, is located in the central part of the east-west and north-south axes of the former Village Development Committee (VDC) Dharahari. It lies in Ward No. 9 of Devahi Gonahi Municipality, Rautahat district, situated in Madhesh Province of Nepal. The school is accessible to nearby villages such as Dharahari, Dipahi, Pothiyahi, Jaynagar, Prempur Gonahi, and Devahi. In 2006 B.S., a thatched house was purchased for a small amount of money from Prempur Gonahi village, and on land provided mainly by the late Dulam Ray Yadav and the late Saraflal Ray Yadav, the Shree Lower Primary School Dharahari Bazar was established in the then Bara district. During that time, classes from Kindergarten to Grade 3 were conducted. In 2009 B.S. (1952 A.D.), the school was upgraded and renamed as Shree Upper Primary School, expanding to include classes 4 and 5 and in 2011 B.S., the school was further upgraded under the name Shree Middle English School Dharahari, District Bara, and started teaching classes 6 and 7.Realizing the needs of the community, and with the courage of educational leaders along with the tireless efforts and support of farmers, laborers, and youth, in 2026 B.S., the school received approval to conduct classes 8, 9, and 10 under the name Shree Jay Kisan High School, Dharahari, Rautahat. Later, in 2029 B.S., an official recognition was granted by the Zonal Education Office, Birgunj. Since then, this educational institution has brought significant improvements and transformative changes in the economic, educational, and employment opportunities, as well as the lifestyle of the local community.Focusing on the evolving demands and needs of the time, in 2064 B.S., the school received procedural approval from the Higher Secondary Education Board, Sanothimi, Bhaktapur, to operate Grades 11 and 12 (in Education and Commerce streams), and was renamed Shree Jai Kisan Higher Secondary School, Dharahari, Rautahat. Later, in 2068 B.S., the school received approval to run the Science stream, and in 2076 B.S., approval was granted to run classes in the Humanities and Law streams.Moreover, starting from Baisakh 2074 B.S., the school was permitted by the Council for Technical and Vocational Education and Training (CTEVT), Sanothimi, Bhaktapur to operate technical classes in Civil Engineering for Grades 9 and 10. Further approval was obtained on 2076 B.S. to run Civil Engineering classes for Grades 11 and 12 as well.The educational progress and achievements of this school have had a positive impact on the community, and according to various standards and public perception, the school is recognized as a significant contributor to local development in the educational sector.

name: SOS Hermann Gmeiner School Itahari
description: SOS Hermann Gmeiner Secondary School Itahari is a not-for-profit organization established in 1993 A.D. The school is in a space of 3.5 acres of land in Itahari Sub- Metropolitan City, Sunsari, Province No. 1, Nepal. The school is about 3 km away from downtown Itahari. SOS Hermann Gmeiner Secondary School Itahari is one of the ancillary projects run under the supervision of SOS Children’s Village Itahari.The objective of SOS Hermann Gmeiner Secondary School is to offer high quality employable education to the children from SOS Families, Family Strengthening Program (FSP), staff children, children from socially and economically backward strata and community children and ensuring that these children become a responsible citizen and lead financially self- dependent and dignified life. We build academic, vocational and life competencies, focus on reasoning, critical thinking, problem- solving skills, enhance employability and entrepreneurship. At present there are almost 600 students enrolled in the school. SOS Hermann Gmeiner Secondary School is guided by the Formal Education Policy of SOS Kinderdorf International, Millenium Development Goals of the UN, majorly Goal 1 (Eradicate extreme poverty) and Goal 2 (Achieve universal primary education). Our school also works on Goal 4 (Quality Education) and Goal 8 (Decent work and economic growth) as prime targets. The School Management Committee (SMC) of SOS Hermann Gmeiner Secondary School Itahari is chaired by the Village Director of SOS Children’s Village Itahari. Subsequently, the school has also a team named School Operation Team. The SMC delegates its authority to School Operation Team and/ or member secretary. The School Operation Team is focused on the best utilization of resources at school and concerned with discussing and solving problems occurred in day- to day operations of the school ensuring the implementation of plan, policies and programs successfully in order to align school activities with the Vision, Mission, Values and Objectives of the organization.

description: Letang Green Valley Academy, founded in 2052 B.S., is an English‑medium, co‑educational boarding school located in the heart of Letang Municipality, Morang. For over two decades, it has delivered quality education from nursery through Grade 12, including a +2 Management program since 2076 B.S., and its first SLC graduates in 2062 B.S. Under the leadership of a sole proprietor and a dedicated team of trained, experienced teachers, the academy combines academic rigor with practical, hands‑on learning to prepare students for success in both school and life. Set on a large campus, the school boasts two modern three‑story buildings with spacious, well‑furnished classrooms. Facilities include hostel accommodation for out‑of‑town pupils, a school bus service, well‑equipped computer and science labs, and a resource‑rich library. Emphasizing discipline, independence, and collaboration, Letang Green Valley Academy offers a balanced curriculum that integrates classroom lessons with a full range of extracurricular activities, helping students build confidence, creativity, and resilience. Driven by the motto “Work is Worship, Duty is God,” the academy encourages clear goals and lifelong learning. As it approaches its Silver Jubilee in 2077 B.S., the school remains committed to its vision of inspiring curiosity and its mission of delivering dynamic, student‑centered instruction. With an English‑only policy on campus and CCTV surveillance ensuring safety and discipline, Letang Green Valley Academy stands out as a premier choice for families seeking a nurturing, future‑focused education in Morang.

name: SOS Hermann Gmeiner Secondary School Pokhara
description: SOS Hermann Gmeiner School Pokhara is one of the seven SOS Hermann Gmeiner schools across Nepal, and one of the two in Pokhara valley.SOS Hermann Gmeiner School Pokhara was formally inaugurated on June 6, 1987 with 64 students at Chhorepatan. It was an extension of a small existing Day Care Center. In 1995, further extension of the school was added by inaugurating the high school section with hostel facilities at Gharipatan. The school has now grown into a full-fledged K-12 school. SOS Hermann Gmeiner School Pokhara continues to strive by its founding goals of providing an all-round education to the children of the SOS CV Pokhara and the children of Tibetan community in Pokhara valley and in Western Nepal, whereby they could follow the National Curriculum and also learn Tibetan Language and practice their cultural traditions. The school also draws children from the high Himalayan belts of Nepal who share religious, cultural and linguistic affinity. The school also provides educational opportunities to deserving children of the local community in the immediate vicinity; so much so that many have become equally fluent and proficient in Tibetan language. This makes SOS HGS Pokhara a unique educational center, where different communities meet and share same learning environment.At SOS Hermann Gmeiner School Pokhara, the effort has always been about creating a dynamic learning environment - one that is rich in co-curricular activities throughout our academic calendar. It is also the only secondary level school in Pokhara valley maintaining a vibrant Tibetan language curriculum while following Nepal’s National Curriculum and SOS guidelines at the same time to meet the academic goals.

name: Fairyland International School
description: Fairyland International School is located at the pleasant pollution free area of Kapan. It is located in an ideal learning environment within a ten minute northward walking distance from Sukedhara Chowk and a three minute southward walking distance from Baluwakhan Chowk outside ring road. The school is a full –fledged co-educational English medium school aspiring to impart education in line with scientific progress. The greatest aim of Fairyland is to give the most possible attention to the holistic development of students in an environment of self-discipline, mutual respect and friendship. This helps to form complete personality so that they can develop themselves into skilled and responsible citizens. Fairyland International School adopt “Thematic Approach” i.e “learning by doing” and “play way method of teaching” as well as “learn through fun”. It applies the Montessori Method of teaching starting PLE (Practical life exercise), sensorial (for the refinement of sense organs) according to the age of children. It focuses on the absorbent mind of each child and create the environment to help ‘spontaneous learning’. The school runs various curricular and co-curricular activities according to school calendar and socio-cultural setting everyday market situation. The students participate in all types of inter-school competitions regularly. Fairyland International School runs well managed dance, music, sports, martial arts, school, drawing classes regularly in routine to help in the all round development of the student. Objectives: To build strong foundation that supports children all the way to grow responsible and competent citizen. To focus on holistic (physical, mental, social, emotional) development of children. To develop socially responsible, academically sound and mentally alert students. To provide a safe, happy and stimulating environment for the children, where they are recognized as unique beings and given opportunities to explore and be creative. To edify open mind, dignity of conduct and mutual respect to racial, economic, culture, religious and linguistic diversity. To inspire habits of curiosity, reflection, mental flexibility, self-discipline and independence.

name: Pragati Pathshala
description: Established in 2063 BS, Pragati Pathshala offers a comprehensive educational experience from Nursery to Grade 12, with a focus on nurturing both academic excellence and personal development. Guided by the motto "May He (the Lord) Lead our Intellect," the school aims to empower students with knowledge, skills, and values that will help them excel in all aspects of life. The school is renowned for its Montessori-based teaching methodology, which fosters a child-centered learning environment from an early age. With a team of highly qualified teaching staff, Pragati Pathshala provides students with a well-rounded education that includes skill development opportunities, music and dance classes, leadership development, and scouting. In addition to academic rigor, the school places a strong emphasis on extra and co-curricular activities like excursions and sports, ensuring that students develop important life skills. The school boasts well-equipped laboratories, a library, and audio-visual teaching aids that support a dynamic learning experience. Students also benefit from access to the school's own playground. Pragati Pathshala is proud of its excellent results in BLE and SEE, making it one of the best-performing schools in the Ichchhakamana area. With a focus on management and +2 courses such as Computer Science, Accountancy, Economics, Mathematics, and Nepali, the school prepares students for higher education and success in the competitive world.

name: Kathmandu World School
description: The school has world–class infrastructure and state–of–the–art facilities in a calm and peaceful setting that fosters an exceptional learning environment. The school's emphasis is on providing valued–based education in an intellectually stimulating learning environment, imparted by professionals trained in progressive teaching-learning approaches, to transform the young learners into knowledgeable, confident, responsible and proactive individuals with an international-mindedness and a passion for lifelong learning. It aims to prepare individuals who can face the challenges in an uncertain and interconnected global community.

name: Ghataraj Memorial School
description: Ghataraj Memorial School was established in 2062 B.S. in memory of the late Ghataraj Bhattarai, a respected figure in Nepali literature. Known for his powerful writing, Ghataraj Bhattarai dedicated his life to highlighting the struggles, hopes, and stories of the Nepali people. His work, including Pratibhaipratibha ra Nepali Sahitya, remains important in understanding the history of Nepali literature.Born in Okhaldhunga in 1999 B.S., he moved to Kathmandu at the age of 17, facing many challenges. name: Siddhartha Vanasthali Institute Panauti Branch
description: Siddhartha Vanasthali Institute, widely known as Vanasthali, stands as one of Nepal’s most respected educational institutions. Originally established in 1951 AD as Vanasthali Vidyashram by the late Prof. Bhuwan Lal Joshi and late Hon. Vijaynandan Joshi, the school began modestly in a two-storied mud building in Balaju. In a time when less than 1% of Nepal’s population was literate and education was largely restricted, founding a school was a bold and transformative act.Despite political obstacles under the Rana regime and the departure of co-founder Prof. Bhuwan Lal Joshi for academic pursuits in the United States, the school persevered under the dedicated guidance of Hon. Vijaynandan Joshi. However, after both founders passed away, the school faced a critical period of uncertainty and decline. Leadership changed frequently, and student numbers dropped sharply. With limited resources and waning morale, the school's future hung in the balance.In 1973 AD, a turning point came with the merger of Siddhartha English Boarding School and Vanasthali Vidyashram. The institution was renamed Siddhartha Vanasthali Secondary School. Later that same year, Mr. Laxman Rajbanshi took over as principal, inheriting a school in deep crisis—financially burdened and academically weakened. Undeterred, he cleared debts, revived staff morale, and reestablished academic excellence. By 1975, students were once again securing top positions in national SLC exams, restoring the school’s reputation.Through careful management, scholarship initiatives, and improvements to both academic and physical infrastructure, Siddhartha Vanasthali experienced a remarkable transformation. Student numbers surged, and new programs were introduced, including Plus Two (+2) education and a Bachelor's Degree in Business Studies (BBS). These milestones led to the institution’s rebranding as Siddhartha Vanasthali Institute.In recognition of his pivotal role in the school’s revival and in the development of Nepal’s education system, Mr. Laxman Rajbanshi was awarded multiple national honors, including the Gorkha Dakshin Bahu and Trishakti Patta, along with a National Education Award. He has served as Advisor to the Minister of Education and a member of the National Education Commission, leaving behind a legacy that continues to inspire educators and students alike.

description: Nepal Rastriya Secondary School, located in Chaphamandau, Ramaroshan-2, Achham, provides a comprehensive education from Nursery through Grade 12. Affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB), the institution offers both general academic streams and specialized technical education. Since 2076 BS, the school has implemented the Technical and Vocational Education in Agriculture (Plant Science) program for Grades 9-12. This "Learn and Earn" initiative is designed to foster self-employment by equipping students with practical agricultural skills.The institution is currently recognized under the Sudurpashchim Province Model School Program for the fiscal year 081/082. As part of this program, a master plan has been formulated and is being implemented to modernize the school’s infrastructure. To support contemporary teaching methods, classrooms are equipped with interactive smart boards, and high-speed Wi-Fi is accessible throughout the premises alongside a well-stocked library for research.A significant feature of the technical stream is the availability of separate farmland dedicated to agricultural practice. This facility allows Plant Science students to engage in practical On-the-Job Training (OJT) within the school’s own agricultural environment. During the OJT period, students receive a subsistence allowance from the Government of Nepal, which provides financial support as they gain vocational expertise.Beyond the agricultural program, the school maintains well-equipped computer and science laboratories and provides free remedial classes for students who require additional academic support. For those living at a distance, a managed hostel provides safe accommodation. The campus also features a spacious playground to facilitate sports and extra-curricular activities. By organizing regular events and practical programs, the school maintains an environment focused on both academic development and technical proficiency.

description: Eden National Boarding School (Eden School) was founded by Mrs. Lily Sharma in the year 2048 B.S. (1991 A.D.) and Mr. Phadindra Nath Sharma as its Principal. This School is equipped with all infrastructural facilities like library, spacious rooms, playground, and comfortable furniture, peaceful and friendly atmosphere. At Eden, each student's individuality and talents are recognized and their all round development is given high priority. Learners of Eden School are taught and guided by qualified, experienced, energetic, and enthusiastic faculties who are dedicated to promote education and research to foster all round excellence in school programs. The faculties of Eden School have already proved their efficiency and devotion towards their service by producing the landmark in the history of SLC.

name: Sikshya Bikash Secondary School
description: Established in 2034 BS, Sikshya Bikash Secondary School follows a structured academic framework that aligns with national education standards and focuses on developing students' foundational knowledge and learning skills. In addition to regular classroom teaching, the school organizes various academic and co-curricular activities, including competitions, sports programs, and school-based events, all of which contribute to students' overall growth and participation. Through its educational programs and organized activities, the school aims to create a supportive learning environment that fosters academic engagement and personal development. VisionTo establish a fully child-friendly school environment that enables students to achieve the highest possible learning outcomes and positions the school as a model of excellence among community institutions.GoalTo foster the holistic development of students' knowledge, practical skills, and core values through high-quality education.Key ObjectivesEnsure 100% enrollment of eligible children in the school and maintain regular attendance.Continuously improve academic performance and learning achievements.Prioritize the development of life skills essential for personal growth and future success.Core StrategiesA. Educational Approach (Student-Centered Learning, ICT Integration, and Teacher Development)The school adopts a student-centered pedagogy that recognizes each learner's unique abilities, interests, and needs. Teaching methods emphasize active participation, including question-answer sessions, group activities, and project-based learning to make classrooms engaging and interactive.Information and Communication Technology (ICT) plays a vital role in enriching education. Digital content, presentations, audio-visual resources, and online materials are effectively utilized to bring lessons to life. Remedial support classes are provided whenever necessary to ensure no student is left behind.Teacher professional development remains central to ongoing improvement. Regular subject-focused discussions, peer learning, internal training sessions, and classroom observations help teachers enhance their skills and stay updated with modern teaching practices.B. Social Responsibility (Inclusivity and Parent-Community Partnership)As an integral part of the local society, the school upholds inclusivity and social accountability. It creates a safe, respectful, and discrimination-free environment for all students, regardless of caste, gender, language, or economic background.Strong collaboration with parents and the community is actively promoted through regular parent-teacher meetings, home visits, awareness programs, and community service initiatives. These efforts aim to positively influence student attendance, discipline, and overall academic success.C. Forward-Looking Vision (Becoming an Exemplary Community School, Digital Advancement, and Career Preparation) The school aspires to evolve into one of the leading community schools in the region. This includes expanding digital infrastructure — such as strengthened ICT facilities, a digital library, access to online learning resources, and building digital literacy among teachers and students.To prepare students for the future, the school places strong emphasis on career guidance programs, practical life skills training, counseling services, and enriched co-curricular activities. These initiatives help students explore their potential, make informed choices, and develop into responsible, capable individuals ready for higher education and life beyond school.

name: Madan Smarak Secondary School
description: Located in the heart of Pulchowk, Lalitpur, Madan Smarak Secondary School (MSSS) carries a legacy of excellence in education, nurturing young minds from its inception in 2011 BS. The school remains committed to providing a holistic learning experience, blending traditional values with modern pedagogical approaches for students from Montessori to Grade 12. Since 2063 BS, Madan Smarak has fostered a co-educational environment, recognizing the importance of inclusive learning. The school prides itself on its state-of-the-art facilities, including a well-equipped computer lab with internet access, where students from Grades 1 to 10 are introduced to the world of technology. Smart boards enhance the learning process, making education engaging and interactive.Recognizing the importance of early childhood education, Madan Smarak employs the Montessori method in its Playgroup, guided by trained teachers who foster a nurturing and stimulating environment. For the academic year 2079 BS/2080 BS, the school extends a helping hand to parents by offering free education from Nursery to Grade 2.Beyond academics, the school places a strong emphasis on extracurricular activities, recognizing their role in the holistic development of students. A dedicated sports committee organizes various activities, and the school provides ample sports materials to nurture athletic talents. Starting from Grade 9, students have the option to pursue their studies in English or Nepali medium, catering to diverse linguistic preferences. The school also provides free exercise books, diaries, and calendars to Grade 9 students, easing the financial burden on families.Madan Smarak prioritizes the well-being of its students by ensuring access to clean drinking water and conducting regular health checkups. The school also boasts an e-library, providing students with a wealth of digital resources.The safety and security of students are paramount at Madan Smarak. Strict measures are in place to ensure that students remain within the school premises until the end of the school day, with parental permission required for any departure.

name: Jiri Secondary School

This is the first school to launch 10+2 science in Dolakha district.Jiri Higher secondary school is a leading educational institution in Dolakha district. Its history began from 1960 A.D. In 1960 A.D. the school was introduced as a primary school and thereafter in 1966 middle school was introduced, secondary level was introduced in 1967 A.D. and higher secondary level was introduced in 1994 A.D. respectively. This school celebrated its Golden jubilee in 2011 A.D. in the hospitality of Dr. Rambaran Yadav, the first president of Nepal republic.Jiri is also the ending point of La mosanghu- Jiri Highway. Jiri Secondary School lies on the belt of Lamosanghudiri Highway. The school is located in Manedanda Bazar, ward No. 9, covering about 321 companies (about 163000 sq. meters) area. The altitude of this place is about 1950 meter from surface of sea level.Jiri secondary school will be successful to stand as a pioneer model school producing the disciplined, innovative, resourceful, independent and productive man power through competitive education enhancing the educational quality and physical aspects of the school.Different activities are conducted to fulfill the visions and goals. The school will be able to attain the prearranged goals after the effective implementation of the activities.The school has produced about 2200 SLC graduates since its first SLC batch 2025 B.S. The school is always committed and dedicated to achieve its objective of academic excellence so that it can do better in the days to come for the all round developments of its students. Now, there are 559 students in school (1-12). And there are 26 teaching and non-teaching staffs in school.

At the same time, the institution fosters core values such as integrity, empathy, and respect, while nurturing a strong sense of community and responsibility.Samakhushi School aims to provide a supportive and engaging learning atmosphere that helps students grow into confident, capable, and compassionate individuals. name: ​Machhapuchchhre World School
description: Machhapuchchhre School provides a well-rounded curriculum that adheres to the Nepal Government's National Curriculum for high school. The school's team aims to nurture children as "Change Makers" through a progressive education approach that fosters respect and dignity, enabling them to achieve their full potential in life.The curriculum of the school is implemented by trained and skilled hands connecting children's learning with their everyday life experiences. The school respects the diversity of students in the classroom and boosts the children's curiosity. VisionThe Machhapuchchhre team sees the school as “The School for Change Makers”. The school prepares children to become positive change makers in their family, society, country, and, eventually the global world. It helps children become critical and creative thinkers and problem solvers. The school respects the diversity of its community. It inculcates into the children a culture of respecting and having tolerance towards all religions and cultures fostering international mindedness in them so as to create a better and more peaceful world.Guiding PhilosophyIn order to assist the students to develop their full potential and subsequently become responsible citizens who contribute back to society, the school strives to offer a good, safe, and happy learning environment.The school incorporates the following approaches to teaching and learning in its education system.Progressive Approach to Education (PAE)Inquiry-Based ApproachConstructivist ApproachProject-Based Learning ApproachProblem-Based Learning ApproachConcept-Based Learning Approach

name: Kanchan Vidhya Mandir Secondary School
description: Kanchan Vidhya Mandir Secondary School and Kanchan Vidya Mandir Samudayik College, located in Kanchanpur, were founded through the collective efforts of intellectuals, social workers, local people, and government bodies. The school was established in 2036 B.S., and the community college was launched in 2066 B.S. with just 28 students in the BBS program. Since then, the number of students has grown steadily, now exceeding 800 in the BBS stream alone. These institutions are not owned by any individual or the government but are community-based, service-oriented organizations operating under the Guthi Act and Tribhuvan University regulations.The school offers education from LKG to Grade 12, with Plus Two programs in Science, Management, and Humanities under NEB. The college runs Bachelor's and Master's level programs in Business Studies (BBS and MBS), fulfilling the educational needs of students from rural, economically challenged backgrounds—especially in a region where there are no MBS programs affiliated with TU, FU, or other universities.With strong physical infrastructure, including classrooms, a library, computer lab, and playground, the institutions have created a learning-friendly environment. They also run special programs like reader groups and leadership groups to promote reading habits and personal development. KVM provides full and partial scholarships to marginalized students and offers a 20% scholarship on tuition fees to girl students at the higher secondary level.VisionThe vision of Kanchan Vidya Mandir is to become a leading institution of excellence in education and Fine Arts in Nepal. It seeks to promote equality, access, and cultural enrichment through transformative learning, while helping students imagine and build a better future for themselves and their communities.MissionThe mission of the school and college is to deliver inclusive, quality education that empowers students from all backgrounds—particularly the disadvantaged, disabled, and marginalized. It aims to foster critical thinking, leadership, and creativity while preserving and projecting Nepal’s rich cultural heritage through specialized academic programs.GoalThe primary goal of Kanchan Vidya Mandir is to rejuvenate Nepal’s cultural legacy and establish the country as a regional hub for Art, Culture, and Education. KVM also strives to enable community development by producing responsible, skilled, and culturally rooted individuals
