name: Manjughoksha Academy
description: The Manjughoksha Academy was established in 1995 at Baudha in Kathmandu by a group of teachers who saw a pressing need for a school to cater to both Tibetan children, as well as, to children from Nepal’s remote areas who have close cultural, linguistic and religious links with them. Although there were many schools in Nepal at that time, there were few that catered to the needs of the many underprivileged children of Tibetan refugees, and of ethnic Tibetans from the remote areas of Nepal. Indeed, few schools were providing a quality education in tune with a modern globalizing world, that sought to promote and preserve Tibet’s unique culture and language. Those few Tibetan schools where the language and cultural aspects were kept alive were often overcrowded and unable to keep up with demand for admissions. In fact, for many years, parents wanting a quality education for their children felt obliged to send their children to private schools in India. The costs incurred in doing this were high and beyond the means of most parents. Admission policies in India were difficult too. Even then for those children who were schooled in India, the Tibetan language was not a part of their learning. So it was in this context that we, the founders of Manjughoksha Academy saw a need to establish a school for these needy children. We set out to establish a school that not only offered an excellent modern education but also one that preserved and promoted the Tibetan language, culture and religion; and all this, at an affordable cost. His Holiness, the Dalai Lama has always advised us about the importance of keeping Tibet’s language, culture, and Dharma alive. Thus, it was clear that the future of Tibetan culture, language and traditions was our responsibility.

The school commenced with 64 students in Grade Nursery to Four. The first batch of its students sat the SLC Board Examination in 2001 (2057). Nine girls and sixteen boys passed the examination with flying colors maintaining a 100 percent pass result. A 10+2 course on management was introduced in 2005 (2061) and the science program in 2012 (2069) respectively. The Tops Secondary School occupies a unique place in the life of the city of Pokhara through its education and extracurricular activities. It offers a purposeful and active learning environment for all students based on its holistic approach to education. The aim of Tops is to bring the best out of the child. The school is guided by the principles of service. It is committed to giving its students a good character and a sense of value. It seeks to establish a culture of the heart, a culture of true love that links us together as one family. In addition to subjects prescribed by NEB, the Tops conducts short courses on career guidance, effective study skills, living harmoniously, developing interpersonal relationships, personal development, health, and hygiene, etc.

name: Shree Rastriya Secondary School Shosi
description: Shree Rastriya Secondary School, located in Bharatpur-25, Chitwan, was established in 2024 B.S. This institution aims to provide a supportive learning environment for its students.The school offers education primarily in English, focusing on creating a peaceful, child-friendly atmosphere. A Math Lab is also available to help students develop their mathematical skills.For those interested in physical development, voluntary Taekwondo training is offered. The school also provides skilled computer education and organizes activities like Scouts and Red Cross, encouraging community involvement and personal growth. Students have access to additional classroom facilities, and the academic progress is regularly assessed through exams after each period, with comparative results analyzed three times a year.

name: Padampur Shiksha Niketan
description: Located in the heart of Kalika Municipality, Chitwan, Padampur Shiksha Niketan has been a trusted center of learning since its establishment in 2061 B.S. The school offers education from Play Group to Grade 10, with a strong focus on academic excellence, personal growth, and values-based learning. The school consistently produces outstanding results in national examinations like BEE and SEE, thanks to its team of experienced and dedicated faculty members who are committed to nurturing each child's potential. Classrooms are equipped with smart learning tools that blend traditional teaching methods with digital innovation, making learning more engaging and effective. Padampur Shiksha Niketan believes in preparing students for real-life challenges by integrating democratic values into school activities. A recent example is the student monitor election held from Grades 4 to 10, conducted through a democratic voting system to encourage leadership, participation, and civic responsibility. Beyond academics, the school actively promotes extracurricular excellence through sports, music, dance, martial arts, and public speaking. Students regularly participate and succeed in inter-school and district-level competitions, such as the district-level art competition organized by the Nepal Red Cross Society. Clubs like the Junior Red Cross Circle (JRCC) and the Eco Club, as well as a structured house division system, help foster teamwork and environmental awareness. The school operates in a safe, earthquake-resistant building with a hygienic cafeteria and ample playground space, ensuring students enjoy a healthy, secure, and nurturing environment. Regular tests, exams, and assignments are conducted to monitor academic progress, all within an affordable fee structure that makes quality education accessible to all. At Padampur Shiksha Niketan, education goes beyond textbooks it's about shaping confident, capable, and compassionate individuals prepared for the future.

name: Apex Life School
description: Having evolved over the course of thirty years, Apex Life School, previously recognized as Sishu Niketan School, has garnered acclaim as a prestigious educational establishment. During this period, the school has diligently refined its administrative structures, educational policies, academic programs, and teaching approaches, always aiming for advancement and originality.The institution has produced a notable cohort of accomplished graduates who have demonstrated academic excellence, both domestically and internationally. Many alumni have made significant contributions across various sectors, encompassing both governmental and non-governmental spheres, forging successful and dynamic career paths.Demonstrating a strong commitment to community engagement, Apex Life School has maintained active outreach initiatives. Its alumni and staff members have displayed a steadfast dedication to social responsibility, readily engaging in relief efforts during natural disasters, environmental emergencies, and charitable endeavors.VisionOur vision is to create the most prestigious and exemplary learning institution in Nepal. We aim to do this by implementing the best educational philosophies and teaching practices. This will enable us to nurture and hone every child's individual talent and skill, resulting in a well-rounded individual whose actions are guided by the moral and ethical values gained at APEX LIFE SCHOOL.MissionWe aim to develop human beings who will help create a better society and, ultimately, a better world. We strive to empower each student through the right blend of modern education, appropriate skills, and deep-rooted spiritual values, with the help of which our students will develop to be curious and confident risk-takers with compassion towards life.CurriculumOur educational program takes a holistic approach to catering to our students' cognitive, physical, emotional, social, moral, and academic needs by applying an integrated learning approach.We at Apex Kindergarten create a playful, lively, and comforting environment for children to promote their holistic development.For students in grades I to III, we retain a bookless and portfolio-based CAS system, which supplements the government's prescribed national curriculum. In grades IV to VII, we have developed ou own curriculum that aligns with the government curriculum and caters to the needs of 21st-century learners.For grades Vill to X, we follow the national curriculum but enrich it with our project-based and co-curricular learning approaches. Our aim is to provide an engaging and immersive experience for our students. We also emphasize the use of computer-assisted learning to supplement their education.

name: Mount Annapurna English Boarding School
description: Mount Annapurna English Boarding School, located in Bhimad Bazar, Tanahun, is a dynamic educational institution providing education from Nursery to Grade 10. The school follows a government-approved curriculum enriched with practical learning experiences, extracurricular activities, and leadership programs. The school fosters an interactive learning environment where students actively participate in various academic and non-academic initiatives. Events like Saraswati Puja, Teej dance competitions, and morning assemblies enhance cultural awareness, while sports tournaments, including volleyball and athletics, promote physical fitness and teamwork. The school has proudly secured awards in competitions ranging from speech and handwriting contests to open dance championships. In addition to its strong academic foundation, Mount Annapurna focuses on experiential learning. Students engage in scientific experiments, mathematics projects, school elections, and leadership training, fostering analytical thinking, confidence, and social responsibility. A remarkable example is the model school election, where students formed an independent election commission, conducted polling with ballot boxes, and followed federal election procedures—an innovative, hands-on approach to civic education. The school also prioritizes social awareness and community engagement. It organizes programs on drug abuse prevention, gender-based violence awareness, and environmental conservation. Students actively participate in community health surveys, plantation drives, and exhibitions showcasing their handmade educational materials. These experiences help develop responsible, informed citizens who contribute meaningfully to society.

name: Azad Secondary School
description: Azad Secondary School is an autonomous co-educational institution located at a distance of 10-minutes walk from Araniko Highway in Banepa. It was established in 2007 B.S. (19951 A.D.) immediately after the establishment of democracy in Nepal. Though it is near the main market Banepa and The Araniko Highway, it is far from the noise, pollution and the crowd of people. The school is committed to providing skilled-based and job-oriented education with task-based learning (TBL) environment and student-centered teaching approach. The institution helps to groom every talent and potentiality of our students so that they will be able to face new challenges. AZAD has been offering plus two programs in Hotel Management, Computer Science, Science and Education affiliated to Higher Secondary Education Board of Nepal. In a short span of time, it has become successful to be the first choice of the students to study. It is a fully English medium course with more than enough practical classes. Azad, the only open school in the district is conducting the open classes for one year and three year SLC. It has also conducted the Early Childhood Development (ECD), which is totally child-centered and in English medium preparation stage for schooling.

name: Janata Secondary School
description: Janata Secondary School is an autonomous co-educational institution established in 2008 B.S. to enlighten the local people. The school has produced about six thousand SLC graduates since its first SLC batch in 2011 B.S. It has successfully institutionalized itself, imparting quality education to students in a sound academic environment. With the growing demand for guardians and well-wishers, along with the school's interest, the school has extended its educational services to the higher secondary level (10+2) in the Science, Management, Humanities, Computer Science, Hotel Management, and Education streams, and is affiliated with the National Examination Board of Nepal.Janata Higher Secondary School is committed to providing quality education. The institution helps groom students' talents and potential so they can face new challenges. The Higher Secondary Education Board has also selected the school's Higher Secondary (10+2) section as a Model Secondary School for quality education and easy access to higher education, and for developing it into a leading school in the district. Its sister organization, Palpa Multiple Campus, has been conducting Tribhuvan University Programs.Occupied by 8 ropanis of land, the school has eight buildings. There are 140 teaching and 11 administrative staff altogether. Due to the dedicated team of highly experienced and trained teachers, and well-managed science and computer laboratories, library, hostels, and free Wi-Fi, a number of students from surrounding VDCs are being attracted. The school has given emphasis on games and sports, cultural activities, excursions, and co-curricular and extracurricular activities.

name: Ramdhuni Secondary School
description: Ramdhuni Secondary School is a well-established public school located in Lalpur Singiya-4, Ramdhuni Municipality, Sunsari District. Founded in 2029 B.S., it has been serving the local community for over five decades as an accessible government-supported institution. The school introduces English medium instruction from Class 1 to Class 5 for better language foundation, and employs skilled and trained teachers to deliver quality lessons. The school offers a daycare facility integrated with early childhood development up to Class 5, which supports working parents and young learners' holistic growth. The curriculum emphasizes both academic rigor and practical exposure through educational observation tours organized for every class, helping students connect classroom learning with real-world experiences.In terms of facilities and student support, Ramdhuni Secondary School stands out among typical rural public schools by providing dedicated infrastructure such as a computer lab, science laboratory, and a library to facilitate hands-on learning and research. It actively promotes extracurricular activities and sports to ensure balanced development, fostering teamwork, physical fitness, and creativity. The school demonstrates strong inclusivity and social responsibility through scholarship provisions for intelligent, disabled, and economically disadvantaged students.

name: Wings Academy
description: Established in 2012, WINGS Academy is a flourishing academic institution located at Chundevi in the cultural serenity of Bhaktapur. Initially, the school aspired to create a conducive atmosphere for early childhood development through WINGS Montessori School. Since then, the institution has expanded its educational program to Grade IX and is poised to promote its learners to Grade X for the academic session 2080/81.WINGS Academy is determined to equip learners with the knowledge, skills, and abilities to adopt best global practices, bounce back when challenges arise, and adapt effectively in a world of innovation and change. Driven by this determination, the school adopts pedagogical approaches designed to mold learners into versatile individuals, preparing them to contribute to the modern world through their diverse potential.Enthusiasm, quality orientation, a passion for discovery, and persistence define WINGS Academy. Believing that each individual is special and that learning has no boundaries, the school encourages students to learn through their subjective experiences. The academy values each learner's aspiration to understand and sets no limits on learning.WINGS provides its learners with abundant opportunities to engage in co-curricular and extracurricular activities that reinforce their holistic development and encourage success, not only in their academic experiences but also in life. Furthermore, the school prioritizes an atmosphere of appreciation, care, and encouragement. In this environment, learners are inculcated with moral values such as integrity, responsibility, empathy, collaboration, and respect, helping them grow into responsible citizens and good human beings.MissionThe school is dedicated to helping learners develop essential 21st-century skills across three primary domains: life and career skills, learning and innovation skills, and information, media, and technology skills. To foster these competencies, the institution provides students with a safe, supportive, and proactive learning atmosphere that promotes holistic development, including the strengthening of social, psychological, and emotional well-being. Furthermore, in its mission, the school engages parents as partners to facilitate academic excellence, encourage lifelong learning, and mold students into confident, responsible, and empathetic global citizens.VisionThe school envisions itself as a respected high school within the country, fostering a culture of respect, perseverance, integrity, and a love for learning. It foresees an environment where each learner feels safe, valued, and cultivates no hesitation in demonstrating their true identity.

name: Bhawani Secondary School, Gauripur
description: Shree Bhawani Secondary School is a long-standing community-based public school located in Dhangadhi-9, Gauripur, Dhangadhi Sub-Metropolitan City, in the Far-Western Province of Nepal. Established in 2033 B.S. , the school began as a primary-level institution and has gradually expanded through dedicated community efforts. It now offers education from the basic level up to Grade 12 (higher secondary), serving local students in the region with an emphasis on accessible and inclusive education.The school operated solely as a primary school until 2050 B.S. In 2051 B.S., with the initiative of social worker Gagan Singh Parki, headmaster Mr. Bishwambhar Jha, and other community members, it received permission to extend to the basic level. Funding was managed entirely through donations collected from residents.The journey to secondary education faced numerous resource challenges, but under the leadership of headmaster Mr. Nar Bahadur Tamang and teachers such as Hemraj Joshi and Premraj Bhatt, the school management committee successfully proposed and launched secondary-level classes (evening initially) from 2062 B.S., with formal permission granted from 2063 B.S. In 2078 B.S., the school obtained approval to run Classes 11 and 12, further strengthening its role as a higher secondary institution. This growth reflects the strong community spirit, with residents, parents, teachers, and students actively participating in donation drives led by dedicated committees.As a community school, Shree Bhawani Secondary School relies heavily on local support and donations for its operations, especially to sustain higher secondary programs. It embodies a grassroots model of education where the local community takes ownership to provide learning opportunities despite financial constraints. The school continues to face some resource limitations, particularly for running Classes 11 and 12, highlighting the need for greater stakeholder involvement and support.The school aims to deliver quality education from foundational years through higher secondary level in a supportive environment shaped by local needs and collective effort. The involvement of experienced teachers and social workers from its early days underscores a commitment to dedicated and resilient educational service.

name: New Millennium School
description: New Millennium School stands as a beacon of educational excellence, dedicated to nurturing creativity, social responsibility, and independent thinking in every student. The school emphasizes teamwork, critical thinking, and student ownership of learning, aiming to help each student reach their full potential.Committed to providing a transformative learning experience, the institution equips students with the imagination, problem-solving skills, and self-confidence necessary to thrive in an ever-evolving world.New Millennium School fosters a close-knit, family-like community where students, teachers, and administration collaborate to achieve the school's mission of Students’ Outstanding Learning Performance (SOLP).The school emphasizes teamwork, critical thinking, and student ownership of learning, aiming to help each student reach their full potential. Its progressive education philosophy focuses on academic excellence and personal growth, preparing students to navigate the modern world and make a positive impact.Fostering a supportive and collaborative environment, New Millennium School encourages students to take ownership of their learning journey. Its progressive education philosophy emphasizes not only academic achievement but also the development of well-rounded individuals prepared to make a positive impact on their communities and the world.With a strong focus on Students’ Outstanding Learning Performance (SOLP), the school ensures that every student has the opportunity to reach their full potential. By integrating its unique NMS learner profile into comprehensive programs, it offers a challenging and enriching educational experience tailored to the needs of today’s students.More than just a place of learning, New Millennium School is a close-knit community that prepares students to become responsible global citizens. With a deep sense of social responsibility and a commitment to innovation, students are empowered to navigate the complexities of the modern world and contribute meaningfully to society. At New Millennium School, education extends beyond the classroom, shaping the leaders and thinkers of tomorrow.The academic journey at New Millennium School, spanning from Grade One through high school, is marked by significant growth and transformation. During these formative years, students exhibit curiosity, boundless energy, and increasing sophistication both inside and outside the classroom. With each passing day, they take on greater responsibility and independence. The school recognizes these developmental shifts, providing the necessary support and guidance to help students transition smoothly from childhood to adolescence.New Millennium School encourages students to take safe risks, explore their talents, and discover new passions. Its rigorous academic program emphasizes skill development, hands-on learning, and interdisciplinary projects. Meaningful connections between students and educators play a crucial role during adolescence, fostering a supportive environment where students feel comfortable seeking guidance from teachers, advisors, and coaches.Committed to continuous curriculum renewal and program enhancement, the school ensures its educational approach remains dynamic, relevant, and aligned with students' needs in an ever-evolving world.Vision of The New Millennium SchoolThe New Millennium School stands as an institution dedicated to educational excellence. By nurturing creativity, social responsibility, and independent thinking, the school equips students with imaginative, problem-solving skills that remain valuable throughout their lives. A supportive environment is fostered where students develop the self-confidence and discipline needed to compete in the global marketplace. The school prepares its students to become true global citizens with a strong sense of responsibility toward themselves and the wider world.Educational ExcellenceThe New Millennium School is recognized for its commitment to quality education. The institution focuses on developing students' creativity, social responsibility, and individual thinking, which sets it apart from other schools. By emphasizing these key areas, the school provides students with the skills and knowledge necessary for future success.Creative Problem-Solving and Social ResponsibilityThe school's educational approach helps students develop imagination, creative problem-solving abilities, and a strong sense of social responsibility. By nurturing creativity and promoting social awareness, the institution prepares students for a rapidly changing world where innovative thinking and consideration for others are highly valued. The skills learned at The New Millennium School remain useful to students throughout their lives.Global CitizenshipThe New Millennium School fosters a supportive environment that promotes self-confidence and discipline. This education prepares students to become responsible global citizens with a strong sense of obligation to themselves and the world around them. The school's approach helps students become well-rounded individuals who can contribute positively to society and make a meaningful impact on the world.Curriculum FrameworkNew Millennium School adheres to a Standards-Based Curriculum, meticulously designed by the Department of Instruction and Educational Supervision in collaboration with education professionals. This curriculum is structured to ensure a logical progression of learning across all academic levels. The school strictly adheres to the guidelines set by Nepal's Curriculum Development Center (CDC) for instructional planning, while incorporating additional relevant, up-to-date curricular standards to provide a well-rounded education.From Grade VIII to X, students follow a blended curriculum that integrates CDC standards with GCSE guidelines. This combination ensures students are well prepared for both the national academic framework and global competencies, equipping them for success across diverse educational and professional landscapes.STEAM EducationThe STEAM program at New Millennium School integrates Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics into a unified curriculum aimed at preparing students for a technology-driven world. By merging traditional STEM subjects with the arts, the program fosters creativity, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills. This comprehensive approach equips students with the knowledge and experience required for various career paths in technology, engineering, science, and the arts.The school employs several engaging instructional strategies to deliver STEAM education effectively:Project-Based Learning: Students engage in real-world problem-solving using STEAM disciplines, promoting collaboration, innovation, and practical application of knowledge.Hands-On Activities and Experiments: Through experimentation and guided discovery, students develop deeper insights and resilience by learning from mistakes.Interdisciplinary Projects: By integrating multiple STEAM subjects, students gain a broader perspective on how disciplines intersect, enhancing their critical thinking and analytical skills.Through these methodologies, New Millennium School ensures students receive a dynamic, comprehensive STEAM education, equipping them with the skills to thrive in an ever-changing world.

The school is committed in preparing children to become dynamic ethical leaders having multi-lingual knowledge and skills to be fit at local as well as at the global market and society. The school understands that parents expect their children to grow up to become responsible towards their own development and towards the family, society and the world. To achieve this endeavor, both school and family are responsible. This is where school work closely with the family members realizing that this is a shared and joint collaborative work. The school encourage parents to visit school regularly, participate in the classroom if they can contribute to new knowledge and information. Therefore, the school's efforts will be to connect home and school and develop the bonding of a family. The school promote cultural pluralism within school and out of school as it believes that learning is effective in a situation where diversity exists. Keeping this in mind, the school encourages parents to send their children to the school in their ethnic dress at least once a week and share their knowledge and experience about their culture with their friends. The school provides children with every possible latest teaching learning environment; use of smart boards, interactive teaching learning, visits of guest scholars, visits of renowned personalities, outreach programs, physical facilities and extracurricular activities are among many. It engages children in reading, writing, speaking and problem solving skills through practices. Organizing debate programs, writing daily memos with the theme of the day, organizing programs and communications with the children from other schools in Nepal and abroad are some of the examples. The school tries to discover every kind of new skills and techniques of teaching to facilitate the learning experiences of students. Moreover, the school works with an ever-changing and ever-advancing education for 21st century through study and research. It provides individual attention to children regarding their physical, mental and emotional development as we provide child-centered and child friendly environment. In order to achieve school's vision, missions, objectives and commitments, a team of motivated teaching professionals along with the team of management experts to support the teaching learning environment and a team of advisers having broader knowledge and experience in various fields is at work. Mission: Developing Elite Grand School as one of the leading schools through laying foundation of Knowledge, Professionalism and Technology. Children take responsibility for their prospects and their own personal development, with an ability to foresee and tackle the challenges of life in a constructive, creative and positive manner. The school aims to prepare independent and entrepreneurial students having respect for and commitment to life long learning. To prepare competent global citizens. To produce constructive, creative and positive manner. To prepare independent and entrepreneurial students. Aim: The school aims to prepare competent global citizens who are also able to understand the distinct Nepalese socio-cultural tradition and family values.

name: Shree Janakalyan Secondary School
description: Established on April 27, 1953 (2010 AD), Janakalyan Secondary School is a renowned educational institution in the heart of Kathmandu, located in Bouddha-6, Mahankal. For decades, this esteemed school has been shaping the minds of countless students, setting a benchmark for academic excellence.Janakalyan Secondary School offers a robust academic program from nursery through class twelve, ensuring a seamless and comprehensive educational journey. With a vibrant student body of around 1500 students, the school thrives on diversity and youthful energy.As a government school, Janakalyan operates under the Ministry of Education, adhering to and often exceeding national educational standards. For senior secondary students in classes 11 and 12, the school provides Ten Plus Two programs in Management, Humanities, and Education, accredited by the National Examination Board (NEB).VisionJanakalyan Secondary School envisions becoming a leading educational institution that fosters a passion for learning, promotes innovation and critical thinking, and prepares students to be socially responsible and globally competitive.Goals and ObjectivesProvide a comprehensive education from nursery to class twelve.Cultivate a nurturing, inclusive learning environment that enhances student engagement and well-being.Foster a culture of excellence, innovation, and creativity among students.Prepare students for future success through extensive academic and co-curricular programs.Instill values of respect, responsibility, and resilience, equipping students to be well-rounded citizens.Teaching MethodologyJanakalyan Secondary School adopts a student-centered teaching methodology, encouraging active learning. Teachers employ diverse methods, including interactive lectures, group discussions, hands-on activities, and technology integration, catering to various learning styles. Continuous and comprehensive assessments focus on academic progress and skill development.Facilities:Janakalyan Secondary School prides itself on offering a wide range of top-notch facilities designed to enhance the educational experience and overall well-being of its students. Here is a detailed overview of the facilities available:CafeteriaThe school's well-maintained cafeteria provides students and staff with healthy, nutritious meals throughout the day. The menu is designed to cater to diverse dietary needs and preferences, ensuring that everyone has access to balanced and enjoyable meals.LibraryThe library at Janakalyan Secondary School is a hub of intellectual activity. It boasts a diverse collection of books, journals, and digital resources, catering to the academic and recreational reading needs of students. The library environment encourages reading, research, and self-study, fostering a love for lifelong learning.Sports FacilitiesPhysical fitness and team spirit are integral parts of the school's ethos. The school is equipped with various sports facilities, including a playground, basketball court, and other sports equipment. These facilities support a range of sports activities, encouraging students to participate in physical education and team sports.WiFi-Enabled CampusJanakalyan Secondary School is a WiFi-enabled campus, providing seamless internet access to students and staff. This connectivity supports digital learning, research, and the integration of technology into everyday educational activities.Music and Dance RoomsTo promote artistic expression and creativity, the school has dedicated music and dance rooms. These spaces are equipped with musical instruments and sound systems, providing students with the opportunity to explore their talents and participate in various cultural programs.Science and Computer LabsThe school boasts well-equipped science and computer labs, providing students with hands-on experience in practical learning. These labs are essential for conducting experiments, learning coding and programming, and exploring various scientific concepts in depth.Medical FacilitiesThe well-being of students is a top priority at Janakalyan Secondary School. The school has on-campus medical facilities, ensuring that immediate healthcare is available when needed. This includes basic first aid and access to medical professionals for regular health check-ups.Conference and Multimedia FacilitiesThe school is equipped with state-of-the-art conference and multimedia facilities. These are used for interactive learning sessions, seminars, workshops, and presentations, enhancing the educational experience through effective communication and technology integration.Counseling ServicesUnderstanding the importance of mental health, Janakalyan Secondary School offers professional counseling services. These services provide support for students' emotional and psychological well-being, helping them navigate academic and personal challenges.Educational ToursTo complement classroom learning, the school organizes educational tours. These excursions provide experiential learning opportunities, exposing students to new environments, cultures, and real-world applications of their studies.IT InfrastructureThe school's robust IT infrastructure supports digital learning initiatives. With modern computer labs and access to online resources, students are equipped to engage with current educational technologies and digital platforms.Spacious Classrooms and Conference HallClassrooms at Janakalyan Secondary School are spacious, well-ventilated, and designed to create a conducive learning environment. Additionally, the school has a large conference hall for hosting events, meetings, and large gatherings.Extracurricular Activities (ECA)A wide range of extracurricular activities is offered to ensure the holistic development of students. These activities include sports, arts, music, dance, debate, and various clubs, providing students with opportunities to explore their interests and talents beyond academics.

name: Janaki Secondary School
description: Janaki Secondary School, located in Chitikhola-2, Pyuthan, was established in 2034 B.S. As a dedicated secondary education provider, the school offers academic programs from Grades 1 through 10. A significant milestone in its history occurred in 2068 B.S., when the first batch of students appeared for the School Leaving Certificate (SLC) examinations. Since its founding, the institution has remained committed to serving the local community by providing accessible education and fostering student growth.The school is committed to providing a balanced education through its experienced faculty members who employ effective teaching methods to ensure students grasp fundamental concepts. To support the curriculum, the school provides essential facilities, including a library for academic research and a science laboratory for practical experiments. Additionally, a computer lab is available to help students develop necessary digital skills in an increasingly technological world.Beyond the classroom, the school maintains a clean and safe environment that prioritizes student well-being. A spacious playground enables a variety of physical activities and sports, encouraging teamwork and leadership development. The school also emphasizes holistic growth by organizing extra-curricular activities such as dance, cultural events, and educational excursions. By celebrating various festivals and hosting diverse programs, Janaki Secondary School fosters a vibrant community where students can participate in social and cultural traditions alongside their formal education.

description: Founded in 2018 BS, Mahendra Secondary School is one of the reputed public schools in Gorkha district. It is located in Gorkha-11, Kundur, Gorkha district. Spread over 10 ropanis of land, the school has a good playground for extracurricular activities.In light of the ever-growing need for quality education, Mahendra Secondary School has demonstrated its commitment. The school, with a highly committed team of teachers, guarantees academic excellence. It has a dedicated team of experienced and qualified teachers, good science and computer laboratories, a well-stocked library, and well-furnished classrooms. The school has given emphasis on games and sports, cultural activities, excursions, and co-curricular and extracurricular activities.

The school is guided by its fundamental maxim, “Knowledge is Power,” which reflects its focus on empowering students through meaningful and purposeful education.The institution emphasizes the overall development of learners by nurturing intellectual, emotional, and social growth. Suryodaya Secondary Boarding School adopts a technology-driven approach to education, integrating modern teaching tools and methodologies to support effective learning. Its academic framework is designed to provide a unique and satisfying educational experience that supports students’ academic progress while encouraging critical thinking and curiosity.The school is supported by a committed team of faculty members who work in a friendly and congenial learning environment, helping students explore their interests and develop confidence. With a vision of preparing Nepali youth to become responsible global citizens, the school aims to cultivate students who are environmentally aware, technologically informed, and socially responsible. Through structured academic planning, thoughtful execution, and value-based education, Suryodaya Secondary Boarding School continues to support students in building a strong foundation for future academic and personal growth.

name: Shiksha Sadan Secondary School
description: Shiksha Sadan Secondary School is in Ward No. 15 of the Sub-Metropolitan City of Dharan in the beautiful Sunsari District. Established in 2012, this school is one of the leading community schools in the district. It offers education from the nursery level to Class 12, attracting students from various parts of Dharan and from different hilly districts of eastern Nepal. To keep pace with modern teaching methods and the use of technology in education, all classrooms are equipped with internet and digital technology. The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs. Shiksha Sadan Secondary School is recognized for its high educational standards and consistently excellent results in SEE and Class 11 and 12 examinations. The school teaches computer subjects theoretically and practically from Class 4, providing accessible and quality education alongside cultural education. The school's ongoing efforts aim to ensure a bright and happy educational future for the young girls here.

name: Jana Prakash Secondary School
description: Established on 2015 Poush 27 (December 2015), Jana Prakash Secondary School is a public educational institution funded by the Nepal Government. Located in the serene surroundings of Bhandardhik, approximately 12 km east of Pokhara and 3 km south of Begnas Lake, the school offers a refreshing and conducive environment for academic pursuits, with a stunning view of the Himalayas in the background.Spanning an area of 36 ropanees, Jana Prakash Secondary School offers education in two distinct mediums: Nepali Medium classes from Grade 1 to 12 and English Medium classes from Nursery to Grade 12, ensuring that students can choose the language of instruction that best suits their needs and preferences. The school is well-connected with Prithvi Highway, making it easily accessible to students from surrounding areas.The school is not only committed to providing high-quality education but also focuses on fostering athletic awareness among its students, with a stadium located on its eastern side. Additionally, the Dipshika Public Library on campus enhances the learning experience, offering resources that support higher-level education and intellectual growth.Features:Qualified, Experienced, and Highly Dedicated Teaching StaffIntegration of Information Technology in the Teaching-Learning ProcessWell-equipped Science and Computer LabsFacilities including a Library, Science Lab, and a Sufficient Sports GroundWell-facilitated buildings with ventilated classrooms for a comfortable learning environmentAt Jana Prakash Secondary School, the focus is on providing quality education in a nurturing, well-equipped, and inspiring environment. Whether in the classroom or on the sports field, the school strives to equip its students with the skills and knowledge needed for academic and personal success.

name: Shree Jyoti Secondary School
description: Shree Jyoti Secondary School is located in Puranogau, Diktel Rupakot Majhuwagadhi-4, Khotang District. Established in 2044 BS, the school received approval for class 1 in 2046 BS, for the lower secondary level in 2068 BS, and for the secondary level in 2071 BS. As a community school, it is dedicated to providing quality education to local students.To build confidence among students and instill a sense of identity, the school has implemented a special tradition where girls wear Choli Fariya, and boys wear Daura Suruwal every Wednesday, symbolizing their Nepali heritage. This practice encourages students to take pride in their culture. The school offers nursery and kindergarten classes in addition to class 1. A total of 19 teachers and staff members work at Shree Jyoti Secondary School, including 4 government primary teachers, 2 grant-funded secondary teachers, 1 teacher from the Women's Development Office, 10 private teachers, and 2 staff members. With its long history and commitment to the community, the school continues to serve as an important educational institution in Khotang District.Shree Jyoti Secondary School provides a child-friendly and supportive learning environment. Teaching methods are tailored to the children's ages and needs, and provisions are made for young students to rest if they feel sleepy during class. A primary healthcare room is available to offer basic medical support for minor injuries and illnesses during school hours. All classes are conducted in English, helping students build strong language skills for higher education and future careers. The school also offers computer education with hands-on practical learning, allowing students to develop digital skills through direct experience. Smart boards are used to make lessons more interactive and engaging.To make learning more enjoyable, the curriculum includes project work, picnics, and educational tours, allowing students to learn outside the classroom through real-world experiences. A well-stocked library provides a quiet space for reading, research, and self-learning. Guest teachers and subject experts are invited to engage with students, exposing them to new ideas beyond their regular studies. The school offers hostel accommodation for students from distant areas, providing a safe and comfortable living environment. There is also a clean, well-managed canteen where students can enjoy healthy, hygienic food.Shree Jyoti Secondary School believes that student development extends beyond textbooks and classroom learning. To support this belief, various extracurricular activities are organized through different clubs and departments, including Music, Dance, Sports, Literature, Drama, Sanitation, Science and Technology, Mathematics, Painting and Sketching, and Hosting and Anchoring. Teachers are assigned responsibilities in these departments to ensure smooth operations, and these activities are conducted daily during the eighth period as per the scheduled timetable. On Parents' Day, outstanding students are honored in 15 categories, and parents are recognized in 5 categories for their contributions and support. This celebration strengthens the bond between the school and families. Through these efforts, Shree Jyoti Secondary School remains committed to the holistic development of its students.

description: Lotus Academy Bharatpur, established in 2064 B.S., is a private educational institution situated in Bharatpur-11, within Bharatpur Metropolitan City, Chitwan district of Bagmati Province.The school offers academic programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 10, focusing on delivering holistic and quality education under the motto “Empowering Children Through Quality Education.” It emphasizes project-based learning, digitalized classrooms, life skills education, and a progressive curriculum tailored to meet 21st-century learning needs.Lotus Academy nurtures students' growth through a combination of value-based education, co-curricular and extracurricular activities, yoga, hiking, and participation in programs like Green Army Nepal, which includes training in disaster management, first aid, public speaking, and environmental awareness. name: Bal Uddhar Secondary School
description: Located in the serene area of Budhanilkantha Municipality -10, Kapan, Kathmandu, Bal Uddhar Secondary School (BUSS) is a prominent educational institution in the Bagmati Province, established in 1990 (2046 B.S.). With the strong backing of local residents, educationists, intellectuals, politicians, and well-wishers, BUSS has blossomed into a leading community school offering a platform for holistic development for students across Nepal.Since its inception, the school has been dedicated to providing quality education to students from diverse backgrounds, including those from more than fifty-six districts across the country. Serving around 1,600 students from Playgroup to Grade XII, BUSS has become a beacon of educational excellence, overcoming geographical and economic barriers to help shape the careers of aspiring students.The school offers both General Education (Grade I-XII) and Vocational Education (Grade IX-XII) under affiliation with the National Education Board (NEB). Its General Education stream includes classes from Early Childhood Development (ECD) through Grade XII, while the Vocational Education stream specializes in Computer Engineering from Grade IX to XII. Additionally, BUSS offers courses in Science, Computer Engineering, Management, Education, Humanities, and Law in the senior secondary levels (Grade XI and XII).At BUSS, we don't just preach quality education—we live it. We are committed to nurturing students who experience and embody the values of quality learning. With state-of-the-art facilities and a well-rounded academic curriculum, students are encouraged to thrive in a supportive and dynamic environment.In line with modern educational standards, the school is equipped with 24/7 CCTV surveillance, ensuring the safety and monitoring of all school activities. In recognition of its continuous efforts towards excellence, the government honored BUSS as a Model Community School in 2077 B.S.With a dedicated team of 58 highly qualified and experienced teaching faculty members and 3 non-teaching staff, BUSS strives to ensure the overall prosperity of each student. The school is not just an academic institution but a community that fosters growth, responsibility, and leadership, helping every student reach their full potential.

description: Gateway Academy is an academic institution nestled in the center of Town planning, Old Sinamangal, Kathmandu-32, Nepal. It was established in the year 2061 BS (2004 AD). The school is in the forefront of education and one of the choicest institutions in Kathmandu with a team of highly experienced management; humble, dedicated and goal oriented teachers and staff; inquisitive, participatory and research-oriented students; and supportive and caring parents. Gateway Academy strives for the best education while valuing individual differences. The school is proud of having a series of glorifying achievements: be it on national level board exams or at sporting-athletic events. The school students have been achieving excellence with their brain and brawn.Belief:Gateway Academy believes education has a vital role to play in molding, sharpening, shaping and directing a person toward attainment of individual, societal and national goals. Education is not just filling the mind with information but igniting a love for knowledge, and inspiring youths to stride into the goal for bigger challenges and opportunities in life. Gateway Academy believes each leaner is a masterpiece and deserves equal attention, care, and concern, affection, and opportunities to sharpen their minds and widen the wings of imagination for a sparkling future. School learning comprises critical thinking, practicality, and learning by doing. Gateway Academy believes its prime job of students is core acquisition of knowledge. Besides, there are plenty of approaches and techniques to enhance learning.Mission:The mission of Gateway Academy is to meet the national educational goal; make the students realize their fullest potential and prepare them for the best of the possibilities ahead.Vision:To contribute for a successful nation with high spirited, energetic citizens making a difference and hence Gateway Academy aims to produce competent, creative and critical thinkers as well as responsible, job oriented and accountable global citizens.
