name: KMC Lalitpur
description: KMC, Lalitpur started its academic venture in the year 1997 in the name of ‘National Campus’. Rooted in the legacy of unparalleled commitment to excellence in education and recently owned by the team of Kathmandu Model College (KMC) which has continued to make progress during the last fifteen years, National Secondary School continues to flourish and reach out to newer and greater height.With the proactive presence and support of KMC and its qualified, dedicated management team and faculty, Kathmandu Model Secondary School-Balkumari equips its students to excel in the academic arena.KMC-Lalitpur imparts the best available +2 program as per the curriculum and syllabus designed by National Examination Board (NEB) in Management, Science, and Law following a unique methodology that emphasizes periodic assessment incorporating various tests.The +2 program at KMC-Lalitpur is divided into different subject combinations. Students can choose from these combinations: Science, Management, and Law.

name: Kathmandu Pragya Kunja School
description: Established in 2004, Kathmandu Pragya Kunja School (KPKS) is an autonomous private co-educational institution located at Sangam Chowk, Baneshwor. Managed by a team of experienced professionals with extensive national and international exposure, the school provides a structured educational environment for students from Pre-Nursery to Grade 10.The school follows an activity-based learning approach centered on the ‘4Cs’: Communication, Collaboration, Creativity, and Critical Thinking. By integrating these core competencies into the curriculum, KPKS aims to nurture intellectual knowledge, practical skills, and technological expertise. This methodology is designed to prepare students for secondary and post-secondary challenges while fostering global citizenship and social productivity.The institution’s commitment to educational standards is reflected in its numerous accolades. KPKS is a multi-year recipient of the International School Award (ISA) by the British Council, earning this distinction in 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2021. These awards recognize the school’s contributions to quality education and life skills development.To support student growth, KPKS provides a diverse range of facilities that prioritize safety, well-being, and holistic development. The school emphasizes extensive co-curricular activities and regularly organizes programs that encourage practical learning and community engagement, ensuring a balanced educational experience for its students.Vision: Promoting value and skill-based deep-learning where students become responsible for their own growth/learning so as to position themselves distinctively in the dynamic global context.Mission:To provide rich, engaging, activity and value-based experiences through competent faculty and techno-advanced environment for the holistic development of students.Motto:"Vidhwan sarwatra pujyate" (a scholar is adored all over the world)Goals:To use advanced technology and modern teaching/learning pedagogy for academic and personal growth.To provide hands-on, child-focused education for all-around development.To instill leadership, values, and integrity.To strengthen soft skills, language, and life skills.To encourage collaboration for positive change locally and globally.

name: Kathmandu Shikshalaya
description: Kathmandu Shikshalaya (KS) is a co-educational school located in a safe and secure area in the heart of the Kathmandu Valley, specifically at Balbhadra Marg, Mid-Baneshwor (Kathmandu Metropolitan-31). The school provides a nurturing environment where every child is valued, guided, and inspired to grow. A team of professional educators runs the school, dedicated to its motto, “Learning Excellence.” They are committed to preparing children for life by helping them become responsible, capable, and compassionate individuals while nurturing future leaders who possess self-confidence, responsibility, sensitivity, and a lifelong passion for learning.At Kathmandu Shikshalaya, children engage in meaningful play and interact with their peers, teachers, materials, and their environment. This interaction allows them to construct knowledge and meaning from each experience, fostering the development of social, emotional, physical, and cognitive skills. The curriculum is thoughtfully designed to accommodate different developmental stages. For children aged two to four years, the focus is on developing physical, social, cognitive, spiritual, and creative skills while igniting curiosity. For four to six-year-olds, the curriculum shifts toward personal and interpersonal growth, helping them handle challenging situations and become more independent. For first- and second-graders, the school provides an active learning environment featuring multisensory experiences that emphasize cognitive and behavioral strategies.The school places great importance on unlocking every child's potential and fostering a supportive environment. Teachers continually enhance their skills through training and shared learning, emphasizing both academic growth and social-emotional well-being as integral components of a child's development. Recognizing parents as the primary educators, KS works collaboratively with them through regular interactions, school events, and open communication about shared concerns. This collaboration fosters a supportive, trusted partnership between parents and teachers, recognizing that choosing the right school is one of the most crucial decisions families make.Guided by the motto "Learning Excellence," Kathmandu Shikshalaya offers a balanced blend of strong academics, character building, and practical learning experiences. Dedicated educators ensure that each child receives personal attention, fostering confidence, creativity, and a lifelong love for learning in an environment where every child is seen, every voice is valued, and every dream is shaped into a possibility.VISION and MISSIONTo fulfill its vision, Kathmandu Shikshalaya fosters an environment where students discover and maximize their full potential. The school seeks to attract the most talented students, teachers, and facilitators globally, promoting inclusivity without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, caste, or social status. KS supports students in pursuing knowledge and skills, ensuring they achieve the highest academic standards.Kathmandu Shikshalaya aspires to be an institution of excellence, dedicated to producing future leaders through top-quality education from Pre-primary to high school levels.Programmes at Kathmandu ShikshalayaPlay Group (PG) – 18 months to 2.5 yearsA World of Discovery Through PlayThe Play Group program at Kathmandu Shikshalaya is designed to help toddlers begin exploring the world around them through sensory-rich play and nature-based activities. At this stage, children are just beginning to engage with their environment and peers, and the program provides a safe space to do so. Guided by experienced educators, children enjoy tactile experiences such as handling natural materials, engaging in water play, and observing the wonders of nature firsthand. This class encourages early social skills, language development, and motor skill growth in a nurturing, outdoor-oriented environment.Nursery – 3+ yearsCuriosity and Learning in NatureIn the Nursery class at Kathmandu Shikshalaya, children begin to build upon their early learning experiences, exploring more structured activities while continuing to immerse themselves in the natural world. At this stage, children's curiosity blossoms, and the curriculum incorporates early literacy and numeracy skills, as well as nature-based exploration. Nursery students are introduced to more purposeful nature walks, where they observe the changing seasons, plant growth, and the animals in their environment. The program is designed to foster independent learning and provide opportunities for creativity, from crafting with natural materials to exploring rhythm and movement in music and dance classes.Pre-Primary and Primary at Kathmandu ShikshalayaKathmandu Shikshalaya welcomes children to the Pre-Primary and Primary School, where each child's development is nurtured emotionally, academically, physically, socially, and artistically every day. During these formative years, the school believes it is essential that children build a strong foundation in basic skills, a deep sense of self, and the ability to contribute to a group, while capitalizing on their innate curiosity about the world around them. Within a challenging curriculum, children are encouraged to take risks and allowed to make mistakes in a supportive environment, all under the care of committed teachers.The ultimate goal of Kathmandu Shikshalaya is to instill and sustain a sense of wonder and excitement about learning in all its children. The school achieves this through a truly child-centered approach, in which teaching and learning are driven by each student's needs and interests. Led by well-qualified, Montessori-trained teachers, the classroom becomes a space for learning through active involvement rather than passive reception.Beyond academics, the school environment is filled with motherly care from both teachers and helper didis, ensuring that every child feels safe, loved, and valued. Special attention is given to health and hygiene, creating healthy habits that last a lifetime. Learning extends beyond the classroom through nature excursions that provide hands-on science learning, while creative expression is encouraged daily through music, dance, and art projects. Students also develop leadership and responsibility by participating in group activities and class projects. By the time children leave the Pre-Primary and Primary sections, they transition to formal schooling with a strong academic foundation rooted in nature-based learning, full of eager anticipation for what lies ahead.Lower Secondary and Secondary at Kathmandu ShikshalayaKathmandu Shikshalaya nurtures the growth of the whole child academically, socially, physically, and emotionally during what is typically the most difficult years of one's school life. During this stage of development, students encounter puberty, pre-adolescence, changes in brain chemistry, and huge spurts of physical growth and maturation. The school recognizes that this phase of tremendous growth affords children boundless opportunities for self-discovery and facilitates this growth by helping them become stronger self-advocates, doers, and thinkers in the community at large.At Kathmandu Shikshalaya, long-term projects and research are integral elements of the curriculum. Study skills, information literacy, technology, and critical and creative thinking skills are incorporated throughout instruction. Students are exposed not only to core academic subjects such as language arts, math, science, social science, and foreign languages, but also to music, art, theater, technology, and physical education. A Learning Specialist works closely with faculty and students to integrate enrichment and reinforcement activities, provide guidance on addressing diverse learning styles, and monitor student progress. Teachers guide students in setting goals and monitoring their progress toward those goals.Middle School at Kathmandu Shikshalaya is a time to push boundaries on all fronts and maximize student potential. Students are challenged and may struggle every now and then, but the school believes in allowing them to stumble so that the next time they will grow wings. The school encourages parents to stand back and watch them learn to fly, knowing that sometimes they will fall, but they can and will try again.

name: Cambridge Public High School
description: Cambridge School, established in 2057 B.S. (2001 A.D.), is located at Rohini Marga, Purano Baneshwor, Kathmandu. The school offers education from Play Group to Grade 10 and follows the motto “Education for Humankind,” aiming to impart quality education.From its inception, Cambridge School has been committed to becoming an integral part of the community by addressing the educational needs of children. With over two decades of service in education, the school has established itself as a well-known A-Graded institution in Kathmandu.Kathmandu’s diverse social environment allows students to interact daily with people from different backgrounds. At Cambridge School, values such as tolerance, understanding, and respect for all human beings are not only taught but also experienced. The school nurtures these values to help students position themselves confidently and responsibly as they grow into adulthood.Believing that education should make children responsible and accountable to their family, community, and nation, Cambridge School conducts various activities to support its educational goals and to serve as a source of inspiration for its students.VisionTo deliver high-quality education that prepares every student to become confident, independent, and responsible individuals who contribute positively to the nation.MissionTo nurture independent, lifelong learners who grow into capable and responsible members of society.To foster creativity, confidence, and determination in children while encouraging high expectations, self-belief, and mutual respect.To ensure every child receives the guidance and opportunities needed for moral, social, intellectual, and physical development.ValuesThe values of CPS are central to all aspects of its work. Every member of the school community is expected to understand, support, and uphold these shared values, which guide behaviour and decision-making.CuriosityCommunity ServiceCreativityTeamworkRespectCPS StrengthsCPS offers a safe and stimulating learning environment where mutual respect is woven into a strong ethos of care, support, and guidance. In preparing students for life beyond school, the school emphasizes high standards of values and attitudes. Good manners, tolerance, and understanding underpin all aspects of teaching, learning, and interaction.School Hours and CalendarOperational Hours: 9:30 AM to 2:45 PM (applicable for both Summer and Winter).School Week: Operations run 6 days per week.Calendar: The school follows a structured annual holiday and vacation plan.

name: Global College International: A Levels
description: Global College International is a registered associate school for Cambridge. Cambridge Assessment International Education offers international courses, examinations, and qualifications to students worldwide. A-levels are advanced international qualifications designed for academically inclined students; their courses prepare them for higher education in any global setting. Global College International (GCI) was established in 2009 A.D. with a vision to serve the nation with world-class, benchmark education. GCI institutes academic programs of truly international nature. The best-fit programs are set into state-of-the-art quality, leading to academic excellence as contextualized within student-centered educational models. The select professional educators, faculty, and management teams of GCI work beyond the call of duty in facilitating young generations not only to be exposed to an innovative academic environment but also to understand and enhance learning by using and creating the environment on their own. The promising academic setup offers students at GCI a globally aligned education conducive to generating knowledge and skills that enable young people to explore real-life careers while educating themselves to live and thrive in today's and tomorrow's fast-changing global contexts. GCI undertakes considerable responsibilities in running different educational programs in streams, e.g., Science and Technology, Computer Science, and Management Administration, in addition to Cambridge A-Level, delivered to offer an opportunity for scholars to acquire formally accredited, academically confident, and professionally competent standing in the course of time to transform themselves as ethically, socially, and culturally sound citizens. The core academic framework of GCI A-Level is collaborative and provides an integrated educational experience instrumental in developing students with self-learning interest and team-leading acumen for pursuing a high-academic-profile career in the future. Why Cambridge A-Level?Flexibility: The structure of the A Level course allows students considerable flexibility in designing a stimulating programme of study. Students have the option of choosing either A (Advanced) Level or AS (Advanced Subsidiary) Level courses in order to fulfill the Level requirements. Students choose the length and depth of study, which match their interests.Rigour: Demanding courses stretchable students, who can also take a heavy course load for an additional challenge.International standards: The programme sets a standard for education worldwide.Recognition: A Level degree is recognized by countries worldwide as meeting their requirements for entry into higher education.Student-friendly evaluation: CIE examiners do not believe in negative marking; students can be sure of scoring marks for a sincere and relevant attempt in the exams.International relevanceCambridge International A Level syllabuses have been created specifically for an international audience. The content of the International Level is carefully devised to suit the wide variety of Cambridge schools worldwide and avoid any cultural bias.International recognitionCambridge International A Level has widespread international recognition as an educational qualification. This recognition is because:Cambridge International A-Level qualifications are recognized by universities as equivalent in value to UK A-Level.Meritorious grades at A-Level can result in one full year of advanced standing or credit at universities in the USA and Canada.It is accepted as a prioritized qualification for entrance by universities of the European Union, on a par with the French Baccalaureate, the German Abitur, etc.commendable A-Level grades are vital for admission to all the world’s major English-speaking universities;A-levels are rigorous programmes that encourage high academic standards; and,A Level has a high profile among English-medium international schools worldwide.Vision:Global College International aims to be a pioneer of world-class global education and a center of academic excellence. The institution is dedicated to benchmarking teaching and learning through innovative pedagogy that integrates research and explorative learning.Mission:Global College International is dedicated to delivering flexible, market-driven academic programs that develop skilled professionals and responsible global citizens. The institution aims to equip students with the knowledge and abilities to seize opportunities and drive socio-economic progress.Over the years, Global College International has successfully served a diverse group of students, guiding them to excel academically and pursue their dreams in higher education. The alumni of Global College International have gone on to achieve success in various fields around the world.Core Values​Innovation and CreativityFostering problem-solving, critical thinking, and student-centered learning that nurtures creativity and prepares learners for dynamic global challenges.Academic ExcellenceGlobal College International strives for high standards in teaching, learning, and curriculum innovation to prepare students for success at top global universities and beyond.InclusivityGlobal College International embraces diversity and is dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every student feels valued and supported in their educational journey.ObjectivesThe main objective of GCI is to impart quality education that instills in aspirant learners sound professional skills and values who would therefore be prepared as competent and self-inventing scientists, managers, entrepreneurs, and social leaders handling invariably changing science and technology sectors, businesses, services, and sociocultural sectors locally and also in global environments.Therefore, the specific objectives are as follows:To develop an understanding and appreciation of the global dimension of our world and of the skills, values, and mindset needed to practice responsible global citizenship.To provide a local and global dimension in curriculum and pedagogy by offering a blend of nationally and internationally acclaimed, challenging educational programmes, which serve as the best preparation for further studies in the world's finest universities.To foster global-mindedness through interactions with organizations, institutions, and universities from around the world.To encourage exchange programmes in learning, sports, culture, and service to the community so as to promote internationalism, peace, and friendship.To build a community of competent and caring educators, with rich experience and multi-cultural perspectives, and reinvigorate them with new methods of teaching through continued professional development opportunities and faculty exchange programmes.To continuously improve the curriculum through regular review and implementation of new technology and pedagogy.To encourage and facilitate adolescents to engage with many social causes for the benefit of the local community, as well as extend support through institutional initiatives.To develop learners as intellectually sound, knowledgeable, and skilled leaders.To motivate students in a caring and conducive learning environment to bring the best out of them.To instill creativity and innovativeness in students through contemporary approaches of personalized nurturing guidance.To make learning a wonderfully pleasant experience.To establish institutional relations with the universities, management institutions, and the corporate world.

name: Viswa Niketan Secondary School
description: Viswa Niketan Secondary School is a well-established, non-profit educational institution with a proud and distinguished academic legacy. Founded in 2003 B.S., the school began offering its +2 programs in 2052 B.S. under the affiliation of the then Higher Secondary Education Board (HSEB), Nepal. The institution currently provides 10+2 education in Science, Management, Humanities, Education, Law, and Electrical Engineering streams, guided by experienced educators and a team of dedicated teaching professionals.The school is committed to delivering quality education at an affordable cost. Its mission is to nurture capable and responsible individuals who can contribute to national development while remaining competitive in the global arena. Viswa Niketan strives to build a strong academic foundation for students who aspire to pursue higher studies in fields such as Medicine, Engineering, Computer Science, Environmental Studies, Management, Chartered Accountancy, and Public Administration. To accommodate students’ needs, the +2 programs are conducted in both morning and day shifts.In recognition of its outstanding academic performance, Viswa Niketan Secondary School has received the Higher Secondary Regional Awards in 2062 and 2065 B.S. Additionally, the Higher Secondary Education Board, Nepal, honored the school with the title of Model Higher Secondary School in 2064 B.S., acknowledging its consistent academic excellence and well-developed infrastructure. The institution has also been awarded the National Education Award for two consecutive years in 2074 and 2075 B.S., and once again in 2081 B.S., highlighting its continued contribution to quality education.

name: Adarsha Secondary School
description: Adarsha Secondary School, Morang, is a respected community-based school in Biratnagar, Morang, Nepal. Established in 1930 AD (1986 BS), it has provided quality education for over nine decades, impacting many lives.The school has a long history of educating many professionals who have contributed significantly to Nepal. Its graduates include industrialists, politicians, administrators, and literary figures, all of whom help shape the nation's future.Located in Biratnagar, Adarsha Secondary School is a public, coeducational institution known for its high-quality education. It offers a full curriculum from Play group to Grade 12, offering Education, Management, and Science, recognized by the National Examination Board (NEB). Additionally, the school offers Diploma courses in Civil and Computer Engineering and Pre-Diploma courses in Computer Engineering, all affiliated with CTEVT.Adarsha Secondary School focuses on the holistic development of students. The school has a team of skilled teachers, clean classrooms, and a large playground that supports both learning and other activities. Students can participate in various co-curricular activities that help them develop creativity, leadership, and teamwork.To make it easy for all students to attend, the school provides reliable transportation, ensuring students from different areas can reach the school safely and on time.With its long tradition of strong academics, practical skill development, and good moral values, Adarsha Secondary School continues to shape capable, confident, and caring individuals. These students are well prepared for further study and successful careers.Core ValuesAdarsha Secondary School's operations are guided by a set of strong core values:Excellence: The school strives for academic and personal excellence in all its endeavors, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and achievement among its students.Innovation: It embraces modern teaching methods, leverages advanced technology, and applies progressive educational practices to enhance student learning.Inclusivity: Adarsha Secondary School provides high-quality education accessible to all, offering scholarships to deserving students facing financial challenges.Character Building: The school focuses on developing well-rounded individuals who possess strong moral values, effective leadership skills, and a sense of social responsibility.Achievement: It celebrates success while maintaining high standards and expectations for every member of its school community.Community Service: Adarsha Secondary School aims to contribute positively to society through education and community engagement, and to develop responsible citizens for the future.Commitment to Accessibility and QualityThe dedication to quality education is reinforced by an experienced leadership team, ongoing training for teachers, and sustained investments in physical facilities and learning materials. The school consistently works to improve its educational standards while upholding its core values and community focus. Through this comprehensive approach to education, Adarsha Secondary School prepares students not only for academic success but also to make meaningful contributions to society. Its graduates carry forward the values and knowledge gained at Adarsha, becoming leaders and agents of positive change in their fields while staying connected to their community roots.

name: Phidim Secondary School
description: Phidim Secondary School, located in the heart of the beautiful town of Phidim within Phidim Municipality, Panchthar District, stands as a leading community school that has consistently set benchmarks in academic, infrastructural, economic, and managerial excellence. Over the years, the school has established a rich and progressive legacy, remaining relevant and dynamic with the changing times.The school was initially established in 2006 B.S. as Prasad Primary School through the initiative of the late Prasad Singh Nembang. It evolved into Prasad Middle School in 2016 B.S., Prasad High School in 2021 B.S., Phidim High School in 2025 B.S., and Phidim Vocational Secondary School in 2030 B.S.. It is now known as Phidim Secondary School, offering classes from Early Childhood Development (ECD) up to Grade 12, with instruction available in both Nepali and English mediums.Phidim Secondary School has become a center of attraction due to its all-round development. In this age of information, technology, and global competition, producing capable human resources who can thrive in the international market is a crucial challenge. The school is committed to addressing this by ensuring equitable access for all, promoting responsible management, good governance, and integrating modern teaching methods with the latest technology. These efforts aim to enhance students' learning outcomes and improve both the physical and academic aspects of the school.The school is recognized as a model institution striving to play a leading role in the development of society through the enhancement of quality education. It is the preferred choice of students not only from all parts of Panchthar District but also from neighboring districts.In addition to regular academic programs, the school also offers:Two years of pre-primary classes before Grade 1,Technical and vocational streams starting from Grade 9 with a focus on Civil Engineering,andGrade 11 and 12 programs in Education, Humanities, Management, Science, and Engineering.As the scope of services expands, so does the school's impact area, extending its reach beyond Panchthar to neighboring districts as well.

name: Shree Nawajeewan Vidhyashram Secondary School
description: Shree Nawajeewan Vidhyashram Secondary School was established in 2037 BS by the late Prem Dayal Pradhan in Lalbandi, Sarlahi. It was founded to provide free education, food, and accommodation to poor, helpless, and orphaned children in the region.To ensure long-term sustainability, the school began operating Nawalpur Bazaar to generate its own financial resources. In 2044 BS, when students elsewhere studied science as an optional subject, this school made science compulsory for its students, setting an exemplary precedent in the education sector.The school received significant support from the District Education Office, which sent government head teachers to contribute to its development. Over the years, the school has produced professors, politicians, lawyers, doctors, engineers, and high-ranking government administrators. This proud legacy continues to inspire the institution today.Location and InfrastructureShree Nawajeewan Vidhyashram Secondary School is located in Lalbandi Municipality, Ward No. 2, Sarlahi District, Madhesh Province. The school is situated 2 kilometers south of Nawalpur Chowk, which connects to the road leading from Nepal's East-West Mahendra Highway to Malangwa, the district headquarters of Sarlahi.The school is located within a total compound area of 3 bighas. The main building is two stories tall, with 24 rooms, and is shaped like the English letter 'C', facing east. The school has its own drinking water system, toilets, laboratories, library, and other physical infrastructure. In addition to the school compound, the institution owns approximately 20 bighas of land, including the Nawalpur market area and some open plots.Academic Programs and Student LifeThe school runs classes from Nursery to Grade 12. Due to the hard work and tireless efforts of the teachers, education from Nursery, LKG, and UKG through Grade 10 is conducted in English, following the English school curriculum. The school charges minimal fees to keep education accessible.Approximately 1,500 students are currently studying at this school. Students also participate in school-level extracurricular activities and have successfully developed their talents.

name: Janajagriti Secondary School
description: Janajagriti Secondary School is a public school located in Thakre-6, Mahadev Beshi, Dhading district. It was established in 2057 BS to provide quality education to children of the local community. Today, the school offers programs from Nursery to Grade 12, with Ten Plus Two programs in Management and Civil Engineering from Grade 9 to Grade 12. A special feature of this school is that Civil Engineering education is completely free, so students from all backgrounds can learn technical skills without worrying about fees.The teachers at this school are skilled, experienced, and well-trained. They guide students in both theory and practical work. The school focuses on hands-on learning, where students get to practice what they learn in real-life situations. Classrooms are equipped with modern technology like ICT tools, projectors, and smart boards, which make lessons more interesting and easy to understand through pictures and videos. The school also has modern labs for Engineering, ICT, Physics, Chemistry, and Computer Workshop. Students can do experiments and learn practical skills in these labs.Every year, students receive On-the-Job Training as per NEB guidelines. This helps them gain real work experience and prepares them for future jobs. After finishing grades 9 to 12, the school also helps students find job opportunities by connecting them with employers. A school bus service is available for safe transportation, and educational field trips are organized every year so students can learn outside the classroom through real experiences. Janajagriti Secondary School continues to serve the local community by providing quality education and preparing students for higher studies and careers.

name: Beni Community Secondary School
description: Beni Community Secondary School, located in Beni-7, Myagdi, is a community-managed institution with a history spanning seven decades. The school began as an informal educational initiative in the pre-democracy era of 2007 BS, conducted in rest houses and under trees. It was formally established in 2011 BS as "Shree Anibarya Pathshala" through the dedicated efforts of local intellectuals and education enthusiasts.Over the years, the institution has undergone several significant transformations. In 2033 BS, it was renamed Shree Beni Primary School. A landmark moment in its history occurred in 2060 BS when it became the first school in the Myagdi district to transition to community management. This change allowed parents and local stakeholders to play a direct role in the school's administration, ensuring the institution remained responsive to the community's needs.Beni Community Secondary School offers a comprehensive curriculum ranging from Nursery to Grade 12. For students at the higher secondary level (Grades 11 and 12), the school offers specialized streams in Management and Education. Since participating in its first School Leaving Certificate (SLC) examination in 2063 BS, the school has consistently achieved high success rates, often ranking prominently within the Dhaulagiri Zone. In addition to traditional academics, the school places a strong emphasis on practical skills and modern technology. By providing quality education supported by government grants and community contributions, Beni Community Secondary School continues to serve students from diverse backgrounds, including low-income and marginalized communities, ensuring they are well-prepared for higher education and the modern workforce.

name: Om Shanti Basic School
description: Om Shanti Basic School is a public school located in Gulariya Municipality, Bardiya district, within Lumbini province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 5. name: Shree Adarsha Secondary School
description: Established in 2033 B.S., Shree Adarsha Model Secondary School is a well-established academic institution offering diverse educational pathways in Science, Management, Humanities, and Education streams. The school also provides a Diploma in Civil Engineering, reflecting its commitment to both academic and technical education.The school emphasizes a balanced approach to learning that integrates theoretical knowledge with practical application. Students actively participate in laboratory work, project-based learning, and field visits, helping them develop critical thinking and real-world skills. From biology practicals such as blood group testing to engineering field analysis like truss structure studies, the institution ensures hands-on learning experiences.Beyond academics, the school fosters holistic development through cultural programs, sports, and creative activities. Events such as musical chair competitions, Tharu cultural festivals, and student performances provide a vibrant platform for expression and engagement. The school also encourages participation in municipal-level competitions, where students have demonstrated strong performance, including securing top positions in events like the President Running Shield.In addition, the institution remains committed to inclusivity and student support by facilitating scholarship programs for underprivileged students, including the distribution of uniforms, school bags, and essential learning materials.

name: Mahendra Secondary School
description: Mahendra Secondary School is a dedicated educational institution located in Gaheli, Biratnagar, Morang. Established in 2012, the school operates under the guidance and support of the district coordination team, united by the core mission of building a golden future for the children. The school caters to students from Early Childhood Development (ECD) up to Grade 12, providing a continuous and comprehensive educational journey within a truly peaceful environment. The school's commitment to the academic sector is supported by excellent infrastructure, including well-equipped computer and science laboratories that provide essential practical learning opportunities for its students. The physical environment of the school is designed to foster both learning and well-being. Students benefit from well-furnished and spacious classrooms that create a comfortable and productive setting for daily instruction. The school has well-motivated teaching faculties who are dedicated to inspiring and guiding every child. Beyond the classroom, the school has a wide and well-equipped playground, encouraging physical activity and teamwork. To enrich the student experience, the school regularly organizes practical and engaging co-curricular activities such as the annual Science Exhibition, educational excursions, and community-minded events like the plantation program, all of which contribute to the holistic development of the students.

name: Udaya Secondary School
description: Udaya Secondary School is a public educational institution located in Chandrakot Rural Municipality–4, Shantipur, Gulmi. Established in 2014 BS through the significant efforts of Late Mathura Prasad Shrestha and other local social contributors, the school has been serving the educational needs of students from nearly a dozen villages in the Chandrakot valley.Initially recognized as a primary school, Udaya Secondary School gradually expanded its academic levels—upgrading to lower secondary in 2017 BS, secondary in 2026 BS, and higher secondary in 2054 BS. Since 2070 BS, the school has been offering a technical stream in Plant Science from Grades 9 to 12, alongside the general stream. Students can choose between these streams from Grade 9 based on their interests and career goals.At the higher secondary level, the school provides a wide range of subject options under the general stream, including Accountancy, Economics, English, Nepali, Education, Mathematics, Business Mathematics, Business Studies, Marketing, and Sociology. The school is supported by a team of experienced and qualified teachers dedicated to delivering quality education.Recently, Udaya Secondary School has been recognized as a Model School by the Ministry of Social Development, Province 5. The institution remains committed to equipping students with practical knowledge and career-oriented skills, preparing them to meet the demands and challenges of the 21st century.
