name: Shree Nepal Rastriya Namuna Secondary School
description: Shree Nepal Rastriya Namuna Secondary School is located in Ward No. 4 of Madhuwan Municipality in Bardiya District. The school was established in 2025 BS as Nepal Rastriya Primary School, initiated by local teachers and social workers at that time, starting with class 1. In 2032 BS, the school received approval from the Government of Nepal to operate at the lower secondary level, expanding up to class 4. By 2042 BS, the school introduced secondary education, ultimately offering classes up to class 8, and sent its first batch of students for the SLC examination in 2045 BS.In 2058 BS, the school began offering special classes for hearing-impaired students. It received approval to operate as a class 11 school in 2064 BS and transitioned to a secondary school. In 2070 BS, the school organized a Mahayagya, a significant religious gathering, to support the operations of its technical stream. Building on this foundation, the school introduced technical streams in Civil Engineering and Electrical Engineering in 2073 BS and has been operating in its current form since then.On Asar 25, 2074 BS, the Government of Nepal declared the school a model school. Consequently, starting in 2076 BS, the school began offering a Science stream and is now recognized as one of the leading community schools in Bardiya District.Classes from Grade 1 to Grade 5 are conducted in English medium. From Grade 6 to Grade 10, classes are offered in both English and Nepali mediums. At the higher secondary level (Grades 11 and 12), the school runs programs in Education, Science, and Management faculties. Under the technical stream, the school offers Diploma-level programs in Civil Engineering and Electrical Engineering. Additionally, under the Pre-Diploma level, a 24-month Electrical program is conducted as part of the Industrial Trainee program.

name: Bhaleshwor Secondary School
description: Bhaleshwor Secondary School is a public educational institution located in Malpi, Panauti Municipality-8, Kavrepalanchok District. It is located approximately 12 km southwest of Dhulikhel. The school was initiated by the local community in 2011 B.S. and was officially established as Shree Bhaleshwor National Primary School in 2014 B.S. Over the years, it has expanded to include lower secondary and secondary levels, currently offering classes from Nursery to Grade 12. The school is affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB) and provides Ten Plus Two (+2) in management in the morning shift.With ongoing support from the local community, the school focuses on providing accessible educational opportunities for students in the surrounding areas. To create a lively learning environment, it organizes a variety of academic and co-curricular activities, including dance, music, and sports, which encourage active student participation. These activities are designed to promote overall development alongside academic learning.A Child Club has been established for students in Grades 6 to 9 to foster a child-friendly, disciplined school environment. Coordinated by a teacher, the club holds regular meetings, maintains activity records, publishes wall magazines, and encourages students to participate in school programs. Through the Child Club and other school initiatives, students are encouraged to develop social awareness, teamwork, leadership, and a sense of responsibility to their community.MissionTo serve the community by offering quality education and adopt innovative teaching techniques to produce technically equipped entrepreneurial human resource availing broad access of education to the regional community.VisionThe School has a vision of establishing the school as a center of technical education to prepare competitive, competent, capable, skillful, and genuine manpower to compete in the global market.Goal To produce outstanding manpower using ultra-modern technologies providing quality education as per the demand of modern age.ObjectivesTo increase the admission rate at the basic level.To eliminate the rate of dropouts.To increase the average learning outcome.To make the school completely techno-friendly.To make the school environment child friendly.To make the school a Green, Clean, Peaceful, and Safe Place.

name: Shree Bir Balbhadra Model Secondary School
description: Shree Bir Balbhadra Model Secondary School, located in Thabang, Rolpa, is a community-based educational institution with a history that dates back to its establishment in 2015 BS. Originally founded as Shree Panchaksha Himalaya Bal Prathmik Pathshala through the collective efforts of local social workers and residents, the institution has expanded its reach over the decades.The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and provides a comprehensive academic structure from Nursery to Grade 12. In Grades 11 and 12, students can pursue programs in Science and Education. Additionally, the school offers a specialized technical stream in Plant Science for students in Grades 9 through 12.To support practical learning, the institution is equipped with modern facilities, including dedicated Computer and Science laboratories and classrooms with interactive smart boards. A Career Lab is available to help students explore various professional paths, while an "Earn While Learning" initiative allows students to gain real-world experience and financial independence through vocational projects, such as house wiring. For the safety and well-being of the school community, the premises are monitored by CCTV, and a well-managed hostel is provided for students who live far from campus.Beyond academics, the school emphasizes holistic development through a variety of extracurricular activities. Students can participate in specialized training sessions in Karate, Taekwondo, singing, and handwriting. The campus also features a spacious playground and a dedicated Children’s Park for younger learners. To support every student's success, the school offers extra classes for academic reinforcement and provides scholarships for those in need. Various educational events and programs are organized regularly to promote student engagement and growth.

name: Shree Janahit Nandalal Secondary School
description: Janahit Nandalal Secondary School initiated secondary level in 2068 BS, offering Computer Science, Management, Education and 3 years Diploma in Civil Engineering affiliated with CTEVT. This program is designed to bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and industrial requirements.The school is deeply rooted in community values, offering a peaceful, child-friendly, and technology-integrated learning environment. The school is recognized for its inclusive policies, providing scholarship opportunities for local, Dalit, and underprivileged students. Furthermore, it fosters a culture of meritocracy by awarding Full Scholarships to semester toppers. This dedication to excellence was also highlighted in the school's achievement in producing the best academic results in Madhesh Province in the year 2081 BS, a testament to the hard work of both its faculty and its high-achieving student body.The school’s reputation for excellence is driven by a faculty of highly qualified academicians and dedicated staff who bring industry-leading expertise to the classroom, ensuring students are equipped with the modern skills necessary to thrive in their chosen disciplines.

name: Laxmi Secondary School
description: Laxmi Secondary School is located in Madui, Rapti Sonari-2, Banke, and has a rich history dating back to its establishment in 2017 B.S. The school offers a comprehensive academic structure from Nursery to Grade 12 and is affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB). For students in Grades 11 and 12, it provides various streams including Science, Management, and Education. Additionally, a specialized technical program in Plant Science is available to students in Grades 9 to 12.As an ISO certified institution, Laxmi Secondary School adheres to international standards for educational management, ensuring a structured, quality-oriented learning environment. The school's physical infrastructure includes classrooms equipped with smart boards and projectors, promoting an interactive and visual learning experience. Students also have access to well-maintained computer and science laboratories, as well as a library filled with academic resources to support their research and self-study.The school offers essential support services, including residential hostel facilities and reliable transportation for commuting students. It prioritizes student well-being with an on-campus nurse's room, strategic CCTV surveillance, and the availability of sanitary pad vending machines. To support personal growth and academic success, the institution conducts regular counseling sessions and organizes a range of extracurricular events and programs, fostering a balanced environment for holistic development.

name: Hanumanteshwor Secondary School
description: Hanumanteshwor Secondary School , established in 2016 B.S., is located in Jyamire, Mainapokhari, Baiteshwor-4, Dolakha. In affiliation with the National Examinations Board (NEB), the school provides education from Nursery through Grade 12. In Grades 11 and 12, the school offers Science, Education, and Management streams, as well as a specialized Civil Engineering program for students in Grades 9 to 12, with a focus on technical skill development. Serving as a central educational hub for several surrounding municipalities, the institution is committed to preserving its historical legacy while meeting modern academic standards. The school prioritizes a technology-driven learning environment through initiatives like the "One Teacher, One Laptop" program. This allows teachers to integrate digital curriculum, lesson plans, and the Continuous Assessment System (CAS) into their daily teaching. The infrastructure includes a computer laboratory, separate laboratories for Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, and classrooms equipped with interactive smart boards, smart TVs, and audiovisual tools to enhance learning. To support students' well-being and growth, Hanumanteshwor Secondary School offers a range of support services and facilities. These include separate hostels for male and female students, a school bus service for those traveling from a distance, and a canteen providing hygienic food. Students have access to a library and an e-library for study, as well as extra classes for academic reinforcement. The school also emphasizes personal development, career growth, and personality development training alongside a range of sports and extracurricular activities. This approach helps students build leadership skills and confidence, preparing them for their future professional and personal lives.

name: Shree Saraswoti Secondary School
description: Shree Saraswoti Secondary School is located in Aahale Gorkha, Ward No. 8 of Gorkha Municipality. Established in 2029 BS, the school has a rich history of providing quality education to the local community. It began as a lower secondary school and has evolved into a comprehensive institution offering classes from nursery through grade 12.The school has achieved several significant milestones over the years. In 2060 BS, it introduced English medium education to address the changing needs of students. That same year, Shree Saraswoti also began offering classes for visually impaired students, demonstrating its commitment to inclusive education. In 2068 BS, the school expanded further by introducing 10+2 programs in the Science, Management, and Education streams. These advancements have allowed the school to serve a broader range of students, preparing them for higher education and various careers.Today, Shree Saraswoti Secondary School stands as an important educational institution in the region, dedicated to developing skilled, motivated, and creative students. It prepares its students for success both in Nepal and abroad. A team of experienced, dedicated teachers from diverse fields works tirelessly to ensure that academic programs are effective and run smoothly. The school emphasizes innovation, inclusivity, and academic excellence, striving to shape students into cultured, capable individuals who can contribute positively to society. With its enduring legacy and commitment to quality, Shree Saraswoti Secondary School continues to meet the educational needs of the community.Shree Saraswoti Secondary School is proud to provide special education classes tailored to the unique needs of visually impaired students. Initiated in 2060 B.S., this program is a testament to the school’s commitment to inclusivity and equal educational opportunities. The program is designed to empower visually impaired students by equipping them with the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to excel academically and contribute positively to society.With specialized resources, assistive technologies, and trained educators, the program offers a supportive and adaptive learning environment. In addition to core academics, students are guided to develop life skills, explore their talents, and overcome challenges, fostering independence and self-reliance.VisionTo position Shree Saraswoti Secondary School as a model institution, dedicated to fostering academic excellence, holistic development, and inclusivity, while equipping students with the skills and mindset to thrive in a competitive global landscape.MissionDeliver quality education that fosters intellectual, emotional, and social development in every student.To cultivate a lifelong love for learning while enhancing critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.To ensure inclusivity by providing equal educational opportunities for all learners.To strengthen the professional expertise and capacity of educators and staff.To empower students to become responsible, ethical citizens who contribute positively to society.To nurture students with cultured values, ensuring the preservation of our rich culture, traditions, and heritage.To raise awareness among students about the importance of environmental protection and inspire them to take actionable steps to combat global warming.

name: Shree Narayan Secondary School, Rumalgaun
description: Shree Narayan Secondary School is located in the scenic Kumakh Rural Municipality, Ward No. 2, Rumalgaun, Salyan District. Established in 2032 B.S., the school was founded with the vision of providing quality education to young children in the local community and surrounding areas, aiming to develop skilled, responsible, and capable citizens who can contribute meaningfully to national development.The school offers programs from Nursery through Grade 12, ensuring holistic academic and personal development. In Grades 11 and 12, the school offers education to prepare students for higher education and professional opportunities.The academic journey at Shree Narayan Secondary School began with Grades 1 to 3, receiving formal approval from the District Education Office, Salyan, in 2032 B.S. Gradually, the school expanded to Grade 4 in 2038 B.S., Grade 5 in 2045 B.S., and Grades 6, 7, and 8 in 2064, 2065, and 2066 B.S., respectively. The school was upgraded to the secondary level, offering Grades 9 and 10, with permission granted in 2068 and 2069 B.S., and later expanded to Grades 11 and 12, with approval granted in 2077 B.S. for Grade 11 and 2078 B.S. for Grade 12.In 2079 B.S., the school introduced English-medium instruction for students from Nursery to Grade 5. This initiative aims to create parity in parents’ perceptions of public and private schools and to equip students with strong proficiency in English, narrowing the gap between government and private education systems.The school emphasizes holistic development and maintains a leadership position in academics, sports, discipline, and extracurricular activities. Between 2077 and 2079 B.S., the school won the Presidential Running Shield consecutively at the Kumakh rural municipality. In 2079 B.S., the school ranked third nationwide among community schools in the Secondary Education Examination (SEE) by achieving the highest number of students passing with excellent GPAs, earning national recognition, awards, and a prestigious shield, and establishing its name prominently at the national level.

name: Shree Moti Secondary School
description: Moti Secondary School, established in 1965 (2022 BS), is a renowned public academic institution located in Baraula, Airawati Rural Municipality, Ward No. 2, in the Pyuthan district of Nepal. Recognized as a model school by the central government, Moti Secondary School has built a distinguished reputation for its commitment to providing quality education from Nursery to Grade 12.The school offers a wide range of academic programs designed to meet the diverse interests and career aspirations of its students. At the secondary level, Moti Secondary School offers three specialized faculties affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB): Science, which provides a strong foundation in physical and biological sciences; Education, which focuses on developing teaching skills and educational methodologies; and Commerce, which emphasizes business studies and practical knowledge of commercial practices. In addition, the school offers a Diploma in Computer Engineering program, affiliated with CTEVT, that integrates computer science and electronics engineering to equip students with both hardware and software skills.As a key educational institution in the region, Moti Secondary School has consistently maintained high academic standards and remains dedicated to nurturing well-rounded, skilled, and confident individuals. The school's comprehensive academic offerings and strong ties to the local community make it a cornerstone of education in the Pyuthan district.MissionThe mission of the school is to provide high-quality education that empowers students to become lifelong learners and responsible citizens. The school is committed to nurturing curiosity, encouraging creativity, and promoting a culture of respect and kindness. The dedicated staff works tirelessly to ensure that every student receives a well-rounded education that prepares them for future challenges and opportunities.

name: Bhanu Secondary School
description: Bhanu Secondary School is a community-based educational institution located in Makranchuli-3, Makawanpurgadhi, Makwanpur. The school offers comprehensive educational programs from Playgroup through Grade 12 and is dedicated to supporting students' academic growth through structured learning and a range of support activities. To accommodate diverse learning needs and backgrounds, the school provides instruction in both English and Nepali.The school fosters a "learning through play" environment, where young students engage in interactive, playful activities that enhance creativity, critical thinking, and social skills, making learning enjoyable and meaningful. This approach is complemented by a balanced academic experience that combines classroom instruction with a variety of co-curricular and extracurricular activities. By regularly organizing events that encourage students to engage actively in school life, the school helps them develop confidence, communication skills, and teamwork.Sports also play a significant role in the school’s curriculum, with regular sports meets and physical activities that promote fitness, discipline, and healthy competition. In addition, Bhanu Secondary School conducts various educational and cultural programs throughout the academic year to enhance student engagement and extend learning beyond the classroom. These activities encourage students to develop social awareness, creativity, and leadership skills, ensuring a well-rounded and structured environment for their overall development.

name: Shree Sita Model Secondary School
description: Shree Sita Model Secondary School is located in Chhipra, Kharpunath-04, in the Humla district. It is a public school and operates as a model school, offering classes from Nursery through Grade 12. The school follows the curriculum set by the National Examinations Board (NEB). At the higher secondary level, it offers two main programs: Ten Plus Two (+2) in Computer Engineering (Grades 9 to 12) under the technical stream, and Ten Plus Two (+2) in Education.Shree Sita Model Secondary School is an important educational institution in the Humla district. It provides quality education to local students and plays a key role in their intellectual, moral, and social development. Along with regular academic classes, the school also organizes sports, cultural programs, and extracurricular activities. These activities help students grow in all areas and build confidence and teamwork skills.The teachers at the school are hardworking and dedicated. They guide students with care and teach them values like discipline, hard work, and responsibility. With their support, students are encouraged to work hard and aim for a bright future. Over the years, the school has made a meaningful contribution to improving education in the village and across the Humla district.The School focuses on providing quality education through effective teaching methods and regular assessments. Smart classrooms have been set up to make learning more engaging using audio-visual tools and interactive content. The school is also technology-friendly, integrating digital tools into both teaching and daily operations. Students are encouraged to develop computer skills from an early age.

name: Vidya Jyoti Secondary School
description: Vidya Jyoti Secondary School, located in Tarku, Khahare, Sundarbazar-5, Lamjung, was established in 2015 B.S. with significant contributions and initiatives from the local community. The institution offers a comprehensive education from Nursery through Grade 12. In affiliation with the National Examinations Board (NEB), the school provides specialized streams in Management and Education at the higher secondary level to cater to the diverse academic interests of its students.The school incorporates modern technology into its curriculum by using Smart Boards in classrooms, which enable an interactive, multimedia-driven learning experience. This digital infrastructure is supported by a team of qualified and well-trained educators who employ contemporary teaching methods to ensure academic clarity. To help students, the school offers extra support classes with personalized guidance to address individual learning gaps. The institution offers an On-the-Job Training (OJT) program for students, providing hands-on experience through partnerships with local businesses to ensure they are job-ready. The school environment is designed to promote well-rounded development through various student-led clubs and annual programs, such as Sports Week, which includes Karate and various team sports. The school offers essential facilities, including a well-stocked library for independent study, a hygienic canteen, and secure hostel accommodations for residential students. By maintaining a clean, healthy environment and hosting regular extracurricular events, the school fosters a structured, supportive atmosphere that encourages students' overall growth.

name: Shree Prabuddha Secondary School
description: Shree Prabuddha Secondary School is located in Sunkoshi-7, Chyanam, Okhaldhunga. Established in 2017 BS, the school is recognized as a model institution and offers classes from Nursery through Grade 12.The school consists of a team of experienced and qualified teachers who employ practical, engaging methods to ensure that students clearly understand the lessons. The emphasis is on practical, skills-based teaching rather than purely theoretical learning, providing students with hands-on experiences that prepare them for real-life situations.Facilities at the school include well-equipped science and agriculture laboratories, a well-stocked library, and ICT resources that support research, digital learning, and practical experiments. Additionally, a computer lab with internet access is available to students.Shree Prabuddha Secondary School maintains a calm, disciplined, and safe environment, featuring modern classrooms and a playground for physical activities. It also has an agricultural field where seasonal and off-season vegetables are cultivated, along with a modern agricultural lab for practical farming experience. Students in Grade 9 and above receive technical education and field training, enabling them to earn up to 50 percent of their income through a "learn while earning" approach. This initiative fosters financial independence and prepares them for employment or self-employment after graduation.For younger children in early childhood classes, the school provides play materials and creative activities, making learning enjoyable and engaging. Scholarships and support are offered to underprivileged and deserving students, ensuring they can continue their education without financial burden.Every Friday, special activities such as art, music, and sports are organized to help students explore their talents. The school also arranges educational tours and practical study sessions, allowing students to learn beyond the classroom through real-world experiences. Regular discussions and collaborations among teachers, parents, and students are held to address concerns and enhance the learning environment.The school publishes a monthly wall magazine called "Prabuddha," giving students the opportunity to showcase their writing, art, and creative work. Regular unit and monthly tests are conducted, and test results are shared with parents to keep them informed about their child's progress.Students from outside the school are encouraged to join the technical stream, helping to attract more learners to technical education and skill development. Prabuddha Secondary School uses modern teaching materials, digital resources, and class-specific lesson plans to make lessons more engaging and effective.

name: Bhuwaneshwori Secondary School
description: Bhuwaneshwori Secondary School is located in Khaira, Pyuthan . Bhuwaneshwori Secondary School is offering Grade 1 to Grade 12 program.With affiliation from National Examination Board (NEB) this school offers plus two (10+2) programs in Humanities, Education and Management stream.

name: Shree Sharada Secondary School
description: Shree Sharada Secondary School is situated in Bhageshwor Rural Municipality-5, Dadeldhura. Established in 2014 BS, the school has a strong history of meeting the educational needs of the local community. It offers classes from Nursery through Grade 10 and is committed to providing quality education to students from all backgrounds. The school received approval for the primary level in 2014 BS, the lower secondary level in 2033 BS, and the secondary level in 2053 BS. In 2068 BS, Early Childhood Development (ECD) classes were introduced, demonstrating the school's steady growth over the years.The school effectively utilizes Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in its teaching and learning processes. Tools such as projectors, smart boards, and digital content make lessons more interactive, engaging, and easier for students to understand. A well-equipped computer laboratory with adequate computers and internet access helps students develop essential digital skills and practical knowledge of computer applications.Additionally, the school features a well-managed library that offers a variety of books, reference materials, and journals, encouraging reading habits, self-learning, and research skills among students. Safe, clean drinking water is provided to maintain students' health and prevent waterborne diseases. Classrooms are well-furnished with desks, benches, adequate lighting, and ventilation, creating a comfortable learning environment. A spacious playground is available for sports and physical activities, promoting students' physical development, teamwork, and overall well-being. The school premises are securely fenced to ensure safety and prevent unauthorized entry, creating a protected environment for students.The faculty consists of qualified, trained, and experienced teachers who employ effective teaching methods and guide students in both their academic and personal development. With its long-standing legacy and commitment to quality education, Shree Sharada Secondary School continues to fulfill the educational needs of the community.

name: Shanti Namuna Secondary School
description: Shanti Namuna Secondary School was established in 2003 B.S. by a committed group of local academicians, social workers, and donors. The school began in a modest thatched-roof hut and has steadily grown into a well-recognized educational institution in Tilottama Municipality, Rupandehi, Western Nepal. It received official recognition in 2016 B.S. and currently offers education from Montessori to +2 levels in both English and Nepali mediums.The school provides a supportive learning environment with spacious and well-ventilated classrooms, a multipurpose playground, and a modern school building. In 2067 B.S., Shanti Namuna introduced an English Medium program, and in 2067 B.S., it was selected as a Model School by the Ministry of Education, reflecting its commitment to quality education.Every year, more than 500 students appear in the SEE examinations. The school has consistently achieved strong academic results and has earned recognition at both district and national levels, particularly among community schools. As of 2082, the school has a total of 6855 students.To enhance teaching and learning, the school uses modern educational tools such as smart boards and multimedia systems. Alongside academics, equal importance is given to discipline, moral values, and students’ overall development through various co-curricular activities.Shanti Namuna Secondary School follows an inclusive approach to education. It offers hostel facilities for visually impaired students and runs a TSLC program affiliated with CTEVT, ensuring access to technical and vocational education,learning cetre for differently abled students like: blind,blind-deaf students and aurtism.With the combined support of dedicated teachers, cooperative parents, and the local community, the school continues to progress as a center of educational excellence. Shanti Namuna Secondary School remains committed to nurturing responsible, skilled, and confident individuals for the future.VisionThe vision aligns with shifts in the global Creativity, innovation, and a desire to challenge the status quo, both in what and how we teach and in the intellectual ambitions of the school itselfMissionLead in generating practical and theoretical knowledge that enables people to better understand the world and improve conditions for local and global communities.ObjectivesTo apply teaching /learning through enthusiasm and amusement, but not pressure. To promote the essence of self-dependence, problem-solving, moral behavior, and dedication.

name: Little Angels' School
description: Little Angels’ School is a highly esteemed institution that has established itself as a leader in the field of education with a commitment to inspiring and transforming young minds. From its humble beginnings in 1981 as a small school with 65 day scholars in a rented house, it has grown to become the largest private school spread across 350 ropanis of land in a peaceful setting, equipped with exceptional facilities and experienced faculty who foster academic excellence. The school has expanded over the years and has touched the lives of numerous students, encouraging personal and academic growth through collaborative and student-centered methods in a dynamic environment.The school's reputation for providing quality education and a personal touch has led to a rapid expansion in demand. In 1990, the first batch of SLC students excelled in academics, and each passing year brought more accolades and rewarding moments. The 1990s saw the school embark on an ambitious program to build one of the largest and most sophisticated school premises with modern amenities for premium education. The construction of the sprawling campus in the serene and idyllic Hattiban location began in 1995, providing an ideal environment for a truly fulfilling learning experience.The school's infrastructure, innovative approach to education, child-centered mode of teaching, modern teaching aids, hi-tech computer labs, student support services, and assimilation of extracurricular activities as an integral part of daily activities are among the features that place it on par with global institutions. The school is committed to ensuring that its students are equipped with the skills and knowledge to succeed on a global level.

name: Sukuna Secondary School
description: Known for its highly qualified and dedicated staff, Sukuna Secondary School emphasizes student-centered learning, ensuring active participation and consistent academic excellence. The school offers a comprehensive education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. In 2015 AD, the school expanded its curriculum by introducing the Ten Plus Two program in Civil Engineering, following NEB approval, which has further enhanced its educational offerings.The school provides education in both English and Nepali mediums, accommodating a diverse student body. Its Higher Secondary (+2) wing is particularly diverse, offering specialized streams in Science, Management (including Hotel Management), Law, and Civil Engineering. This technical focus ensures that students are not just degree-holders but are equipped with practical, career-ready skills.The school classrooms are fully digitalized, incorporating the latest technology to facilitate interactive and engaging learning experiences. The campus is equipped with CCTV surveillance to maintain a safe and secure environment for all students and staff. With its modern facilities, dedicated educators, and a robust curriculum, Sukuna Secondary School remains a leading community school in Nepal, committed to preparing students for academic success and future career opportunities.A standout aspect of Sukuna Secondary School is its emphasis on a calm and focused learning atmosphere, particularly highlighted through its well-equipped library with dedicated quiet study areas. These silence-oriented spaces provide students with serene environments ideal for deep concentration, self-study, reflection, and individual academic pursuits.

name: Shree Janata Secondary School
description: Shree Janata Secondary School is a public school located in Katahariya Municipality, Rautahat district, within Madhesh province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Shree Janata Secondary School has 3917 enrolled students.

name: Bal Kalyan Vidya Mandir School
description: Established in 1984 AD (2040 BS), Bal Kalyan Vidya Mandir (BKVM) has built a legacy of over four decades of academic excellence. The school offers comprehensive education from Nursery to Class 12, focusing not only on academics but also on the holistic development of every student. BKVM believes that learning goes beyond memorization—it’s about developing critical thinking, exploring ideas, and preparing students for real-world success.VisionBKVM envisions becoming one of Nepal’s leading educational institutions, renowned for fostering academic brilliance, personal growth, and global awareness. The school strives to create an environment that sparks curiosity, nurtures creativity, and shapes future leaders equipped to thrive in today’s rapidly changing world.GoalThe primary goal of BKVM is to provide a well-rounded education that balances strong academics with a focus on the arts, sports, and character development. By empowering students to reach their fullest potential, the school aims to develop responsible, compassionate global citizens prepared for the challenges of the future.Empowering Active LearnersBKVM emphasizes active learning, critical thinking, and responsible citizenship. Its approach integrates cultural awareness into the curriculum, giving students opportunities to explore different cultures, celebrate diverse festivals, and develop empathy for various communities. Through extracurricular activities, students are encouraged to engage in experiences that complement their academic journey—ranging from sports and music to field trips and community service.World-Class Facilities for a Nurturing EnvironmentBKVM is committed to providing a modern, well-equipped learning environment that supports creativity, collaboration, and personal growth. Key facilities include:Library: A spacious, quiet center filled with a wide range of books to support reading, research, and study.Computer Labs: Outfitted with the latest technology to help students build essential digital skills.Science Laboratories: Dedicated Physics, Chemistry, and Biology labs offering practical, hands-on learning.Sports Facilities: Promoting fitness, teamwork, and discipline through various athletic activities.Art and Music Rooms: Dedicated spaces for students to explore their artistic and musical talents.Cafeteria: A clean, comfortable area providing nutritious, diverse meals.Health and Wellness Services: Regular health checkups, health camps, and timely medical attention ensure student well-being.Transportation: Safe, reliable transport services with a fleet of buses operating on multiple routes.Green Spaces: Beautiful gardens and outdoor areas for relaxation and a connection with nature.Why Choose BKVM?Holistic Education: Focused on nurturing students’ academic, emotional, and physical well-being.Commitment to Excellence: Experienced faculty and innovative teaching methods ensure students are well-prepared for future success.Modern Infrastructure: Advanced classrooms and specialized labs make learning engaging and effective.Vibrant Extracurricular Activities: A broad range of programs helps students discover and pursue their passions.Global Perspective: The school fosters values of cultural diversity, empathy, and global citizenship.

name: Dhulabari Secondary School
description: Dhulabari Secondary School provides a diverse curriculum that caters to students from Early Childhood Development (ECD) through to the Secondary level. Following the National Examination Board (NEB) framework, it offers specialized "Plus Two" (+2) programs in Science, Management, and Humanities. Distinguishing itself from many traditional schools, Dhulabari Secondary also hosts a specialized Technical Stream in Animal Science, equipping students with practical vocational skills that are essential for the agricultural and veterinary sectors of Nepal.The school is equipped with dedicated Science and Computer laboratories that allow students to bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application. Additionally, the school maintains a well-stocked library and incorporates digital learning tools into its classrooms, ensuring that students are well-prepared for the technological demands of the 21st century.Beyond the classroom, the school emphasizes the physical and social development of its students. With large playgrounds and a strong focus on sports, students frequently participate in regional football, volleyball, and athletics competitions. The school culture encourages discipline, leadership, and community service, fostering an environment where students are not just taught to pass exams, but are molded into responsible, ethical citizens capable of contributing to society.

name: Devi Secondary School
description: Devi Secondary School Birtamod is a well-established government school located in Birtamod-5, Jhapa district, in the Koshi Province of eastern Nepal. Founded in 2019, BS, the school operates as classes from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. It offers ten plus two (10+2) programs in Science, Management, Humanities, and Education stream under NEB affiliation while it offers a Pre-Diploma in Computer Science under CTEVT. Devi Secondary School also offers scholarships to deserving students as financial aid.The school was built to produce qualified and proficient students capable of facing the challenges of the modern era, where science and technology dominate every field of life. With a large student body of around 3,000–3,100 students and a dedicated team of approximately 150 teachers and staff, the school provides accessible, quality education to children from diverse backgrounds in the region.The school follows the national curriculum while emphasizing holistic development, discipline, and preparation for the modern world driven by science and technology. It aims to nurture qualified, proficient, and responsible students equipped with both academic knowledge and practical skills. Devi Secondary School maintains balanced, structured learning with co-curricular engagement, helping students build values such as excellence, integrity, respect, responsibility, teamwork, creativity, and social awareness.

name: Baylor International Academy
description: Baylor International Academy (BIA) is situated in the delicate and beautiful lap of Banepa, Kavre which is about 26 Kilometers away from Kathmandu. BIA was established in 2063 B.S with a Mission statement of “Quality Education for Affluent Life & Social Development” and Vision “To serve Kavre valley and the neighboring districts by fulfilling the need of quality education of the community”.Signature features of BIA includes quality education, experienced teacher, sustained trust of parents, students & alumni, affordable fee structure, inclusion of Extra Curricular Activities (ECA) & Co-Curricular Activities (CCA), teachers and students exchange program, and so on.As an academia, it is bestowing an excellent opportunity for students to uplift their standard through outstanding schemes. BIA has proudly offered different programs in school, high school and campus level. In High School (also referred to as +2) it offers different courses on Science and Management which includes Biology, Computer Science, Physics, Hotel Management, Business Studies, Travel and Mountaineering Studies. In Bachelor level, however, it offers two courses: Bachelor in Professional Hospitality (BPH) and Bachelor in Business Studies (BBS). BPH is Kathmandu University's New Program in Hospitality Management and this program is run by Kathmandu University - Glacier wing of BIA. Whereas BBS is a 4 years Tribhuvan University (TU) affiliated program. Likewise, Baylor Montessori Kids Castle is additional program of Baylor International Academy to the parents who are having great interest in Montessori based learning.BIA has been able to achieve quite remarkable results in all its programs since its establishment including +2 with significant number of students passing with distinction and able to get the entrance in highly reputed colleges and the universities in national and international level.

name: Shree Juddha Model Secondary School
description: Shree Juddha Model Secondary School, established in 1996 B.S., is a well-established public institution located in Gaur Municipality, Rautahat, under Madhesh Province. The school provides education from Play Group (PG) to Grade 10 and is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) for its +2 (10+2) programs, extending academic opportunities for higher secondary learners.In addition to general education, the school is affiliated with CTEVT and offers a Junior Computer Technician program aimed at producing skilled manpower in computer science and information technology. This program supports the school’s broader vision to develop middle-level human resources for the nation and to equip students with practical, job-oriented skills.With a student body of over 2,350 learners, Shree Juddha Model Secondary School is committed to its goal of contributing to poverty alleviation through quality education, vocational training, and community service. It strives to nurture well-rounded, responsible citizens equipped to meet the challenges of a modern, digital world.The school remains a cornerstone of academic excellence and technical empowerment in the Rautahat district, actively supporting the development of the region and the country at large.

name: Jana Namuna Secondary School
description: Jana Namuna Secondary School is a publicly owned academic institution committed to delivering quality education to students. The school has successfully bridged the gap between public and private education, becoming a source of pride for local parents who value its disciplined academic environment and stellar reputation over expensive private alternatives.The school is affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB) and offers Ten Plus Two (10+2) programs in Science, Management, Education, and Law, catering to a diverse range of academic interests and career aspirations. In addition to its strong general education programs, the school is also affiliated with the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT) and offers skill-oriented course such as Diploma in Civil Engineering. These technical programs are designed to equip students with hands-on skills and practical knowledge required for the job market, especially in the field of infrastructure development.Jana Namuna Secondary School emphasizes both academic excellence and holistic development. The learning environment is enhanced through spacious classrooms, a large and well-utilized compound, and a curriculum that encourages participation in extra-curricular activities (ECAs). Early learners benefit from a Montessori-based approach, ensuring a strong foundation in their formative years. With a team of friendly and supportive teachers, the school fosters both personal and academic growth, creating a nurturing and motivating atmosphere for students.The school’s reputation for quality has led to an overwhelming demand for enrollment. To maintain its high standards, the school has implemented a rigorous entrance examination system since 2016. The pressure for admission is so high that school authorities often face immense public and telephonic pressure during the enrollment season, prompting plans to expand infrastructure to accommodate up to 5,000 students by 2028 AD.Known for its affordable fee structure and commitment to accessibility, Jana Namuna Secondary School also provides scholarship opportunities to deserving and underprivileged students, as determined by the school management committee.As of 2026, the school serves a massive student body of 3,175, comprising 1,600 students in Grades 1 to 10 and 1,575 in the+2 programs.

name: Uniglobe School
description: Uniglobe School is located in Kamaladi, Ganeshthan, Kathmandu, Nepal. The school campus is in a landmark location with abundant outdoor green space. Uniglobe School has three wings: Junior, Middle, and Senior. Although teaching approaches will slightly differ, the approach to learning is the same for all the wings.

name: Shikshadeep Secondary Boarding School
description: Shikshadeep Boarding Secondary School, located in the heart of Biratnagar Metropolitan City, is a co-educational institution dedicated to shaping future-ready citizens through quality education. Founded and operated by a team of seasoned professionals with years of experience in teaching and school management, Shikshadeep stands out for its commitment to academic excellence and career-oriented learning. The school offers comprehensive academic programs from primary levels to +2 Science and +2 Management, each housed in separate, fully equipped blocks tailored to the unique needs of their respective streams. Whether students choose the rigor of Science or the versatility of Management, they benefit from modern facilities, updated curriculum, and expert faculties who are passionate about mentoring the next generation. The school focused on developing character, confidence, and capability among their students. With a student-centered approach, Shikshyadeep Boarding Secondary School fosters critical thinking, innovation, and leadership—skills essential for thriving in today's world.

name: Saraswati Secondary School
description: Saraswati Secondary School is a public school located in Gadhimai Municipality, Rautahat district, within Madhesh province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Saraswati Secondary School has 2869 enrolled students.

name: Mount Everest Secondary English Boarding School
description: Mount Everest Secondary English Boarding School, located in Golbazar-4, Siraha, is known for providing quality education from Playground (PG) to Grade 12. Established in 2059 BS, the school focuses on both academic excellence and student development, offering a supportive and engaging learning environment. It provides a wide range of academic programs, including +2 courses in Science, Management, Humanities, and Education, ensuring that students can succeed in their chosen fields. The school uses modern teaching methods and has a dedicated faculty to help students grow. It also offers many extracurricular activities that allow students to develop skills beyond academics. Whether it’s through learning, personal growth, or community involvement, Mount Everest Secondary English Boarding School prepares students for success in all areas of life

name: LRI School
description: The Learning Realm International (LRI) Secondary School is an English-medium co-educational institution, which operates as a residential-cum-day school and is registered as a TRUST. It was founded on February 24, 1988 A.D. (Falgun 12, 2044 B.S.) in Kalankisthan, Kathmandu by Shiv Raj Pant, who worked tirelessly to establish it. The school is authorized by the Government of Nepal to offer classes up to Grade 12.The school embodies a pursuit of academic excellence in Nepal, utilizing the finest educational methodologies to redefine international standards and prepare students for global citizenship. The L.R.I. ethos encourages students to explore their individuality and distinctiveness by embracing the rich educational legacy of the institution.At the heart of Learning Realm International Secondary School's vision and mission is the goal of nurturing children who can lead and thrive in a constantly evolving global community. The school places great emphasis on developing both intelligence quotient (IQ) and emotional quotient (EQ) in successive generations, with the aim of creating well-rounded individuals.It imparts context-friendly value-based education from Pre-school to Secondary levels. The school is pioneered by a team of promising educators pursuing the following goals through quality education.Goals:To provide 'world-class education' to become a proactive globalized citizenTo offer a stimulated environs for the inherent talents get explored for holistic developmentTo develop competent human capital capable of carving out their own special 'space' at national and international levelsTo transform each pupil to be a noble citizen imbibing universal human culture for a healthy social lifeTo empower every student rise beyond the average level of performance and 'strive for excellence'

name: United School
description: Since its inception in April 2000 AD, United School has adopted an innovative curriculum aimed at nurturing the holistic development of students in their formative years. Employing a variety of student-centered activities, United School employs contemporary teaching methodologies, experienced educators, and state-of-the-art resources to educate children in accordance with societal needs.Mission and Purpose of United SchoolUnited School, established in April 2000, has adopted a creative curriculum to ensure the overall development of students in their formative years. It employs up-to-date teaching methods, trained educators and modern tools to educate children as per the demand of the society through various student-centered activities. The school is guided by a long-term mission of equipping students with the preliminary skills and knowledge they need to cope with the challenges of higher education and real-life situations.Moreover, United school has given a lot of emphasis not only on modern methods of education but also on traditional ways which enables the students to enjoy their rights, bear their rights, bear their responsibilities and be aware of the sense of social obligations.Besides, United School wants its students to be familiar without the unique nature of hospitality and the age-old Nepali culture and civilization which have made our identity distinct from others. The extracurricular activities are geared towards this end.Values of United SchoolProvide an environment where the students genuinely realize and utilize their abilities.Encourage students to take responsibility for their learning in the academic and actual world.Cultivate an appreciation for our heritage and unique global environment.Nurture self-confidence and risk-taking in our students as they take steps to shape their future.Encourage students to apply a scientific approach in handling and dealing with real-life situations.

name: ​Nightingale International Secondary School
description: Nightingale International Secondary School/College was established in 2057 B.S. with the mission of providing world-class education within Nepal. With over 24 years of consistent academic excellence, the institution has established a strong reputation for delivering high-quality teaching, accompanied by outstanding achievements in both academic and extracurricular fields. Initially, the college offered +2 programs in Science and Management. Currently, it has expanded to include Law, providing students with a wider range of academic options under one institution.The school/college believes every student brings unique talents and perspectives. It aims to nurture these strengths, foster curiosity, and unlock their full potential. Students from Nightingale have consistently excelled not only within the school but also in national and international arenas.Nightingale takes pride in the exceptional results its students have achieved in HSEB/NEB examinations and their success in securing scholarships at reputed national and international universities. Guided by the motto “Labore et Honore” (By Work and Honor), the institution remains committed to offering quality education at an affordable cost.VisionNightingale International Secondary School/College envisions becoming a reputable academic institution that produces capable, competitive, and globally recognized graduates through quality education aligned with international standards.The college provides a supportive and growth-oriented environment that promotes personal development, academic achievement, and career direction. With a strong focus on curricular enrichment and research opportunities, Nightingale prepares students to contribute to a knowledge-based economy and meet the evolving demands of the global workforce.Core ValuesStudent SuccessEnhance student support systems that promote retention and achievementDevelop innovative academic processesRecruit and retain highly qualified faculty, staff, and studentsIncorporate technology to improve learning outcomesServiceDeliver exemplary services to all stakeholdersFoster a professional environment that supports staff developmentStrengthen financial
