national recognition for excellence in teaching, research, and extracurricular activitiesPromote interdisciplinary collaboration and curricular flexibilitySupport student well-being and holistic developmentIncrease enrollment, retention, and job placement ratesUpgrade infrastructure to meet evolving academic and technological needsContribute to national development by producing competent and responsible graduatesGoals and ObjectivesDeliver world-class education that meets global standardsLead advancements in the national education landscapePrepare competent graduates in Science, Management, and Law by effectively utilizing expert faculty and modern infrastructureCultivate future doctors, engineers, scientists, IT professionals, entrepreneurs, politicians, and thought leaders through creative, research-based academic practicesFoster a positive and inspiring learning environment that nurtures each student’s individual strengths and potentialSupport the development of nationally and internationally recognized athletes through structured training and exposure opportunitiesAdditional PreparationsPreparing students for tomorrow requires more than traditional classroom instruction. In a world that is rapidly changing and evolving, our students need to develop the skills necessary to thrive, adapt, and lead. At Nightingale College, we believe that the role of education goes beyond knowledge acquisition. Our students and educators share equally high expectations of one another.To meet these evolving needs, we adopt academic approaches that are collaborative, self-directed, and driven by self-initiative. In addition to regular classroom instruction, we integrate the following instructional strategies into our teaching-learning process:Guest LecturesTutorialsEducational ToursField VisitsPresentationsProject WorkUse of Smart BoardsResearch ActivitiesSocial Work EngagementsVideo-Based LearningTalk Shows and Interactive SessionsTeaching TechniquesThe institution emphasizes the importance of implementing well-planned and effective teaching strategies that engage students, enhance learning outcomes, and contribute to academic excellence.With a strong commitment to student achievement, Nightingale College employs a range of teaching techniques that enable students to perform at their best, both within the country and on international platforms. These strategies are carefully designed to cater to diverse learning needs, making the learning process more interactive and practical.The college incorporates the following teaching methods as part of its regular academic practices:Multimedia PresentationsExtra Tutorial ClassesUse of Audio-Visual AidsLearning by DoingOrientation Sessions on the Course of StudyPractice with Model QuestionsHandout Distribution SystemRegular Home AssignmentsInternet Access to Course MaterialsInteraction with Parents and GuardiansStructured Note PreparationAnnual ActivitiesThe college conducts a wide range of events and programs throughout the academic year, combining academic enrichment with experiential learning.Academic Enrichment ProgramsEntrance Preparation ClassesRegular classes every Saturday (7:00–9:00 a.m.) for entrance exams such as Medical, Engineering, and B.Sc. CSIT, B.Sc. Nursing, B.Sc. Agriculture, CA, and BBA.Monthly Model TestsModel tests for Medical, Engineering, B.Sc. Nursing, and B.Sc. Agriculture is conducted on the last Saturday of each month.Guest LecturesRenowned professors from national and international universities lead sessions.Career CounselingGuidance from experts, including doctors, engineers, Ph.D. holders, bankers, government officials, and entrepreneurs.Extra ClassesSpecial support classes are available for students who require additional academic assistance.Student Development & EngagementMotivational & E-ClassesRegular motivational sessions, digital classrooms, and audio-visual learning experiences for all students.Guardians’ MeetingsHeld every three months to provide performance feedback and strengthen the home–school partnership.Field & Industry VisitsFactory, industry, hotel, and firm visits for Management students based on curriculum requirements.Frequent court visits for Law students to gain practical insights.Co-Curricular & Extracurricular ActivitiesInter-College ParticipationMandatory involvement in inter-college events such as sports, quiz contests, cultural programs, exhibitions, debates, singing, dance, public speaking, program hosting, and magazine/wall magazine publication.Sports & GamesRegular tournaments and practice in futsal, cricket, badminton, volleyball, basketball, and other indoor/outdoor games.Annual Excursion & ToursOrganized national and international educational tours and excursions.Special ActivitiesActivities include summer swimming, yoga sessions, routine health check-ups, camping, trekking, rafting, rock climbing, night stays, and rural society visits.

name: Prativa Secondary School
description: Prativa Secondary School is situated in Palikhe Chowk in Pokhara City. It offers plus two (+2) courses in Science and Management faculty and runs under the affiliation of the National Examination Board.It also has a separate school branch located at Gyanmarga, Nadipur where it offers education till grade 10.

name: Jana Jyoti Secondary School
description: Jana Jyoti Secondary School Rautahat is located in Chandranighapur, Rautahat . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.

name: Mahendra Model Secondary School, Khalanga
description: Located in the remote geography of Far-Western Nepal, in Khalanga of Mahakali Municipality, Darchula, Mahendra Secondary School stands as a leading, prestigious, and model educational institution in the region, carrying historical significance as a tri-border area. Established on Shrawan 27, 2017 B.S., on the auspicious occasion of Janai Purnima as a middle school, the institution has continued its journey of spreading education to this day.Following its establishment, the school gradually expanded and began operating secondary-level classes in 2025 B.S., achieving the historic milestone of sending students to participate in the SLC examination for the first time. Since 2028 B.S., it has been functioning as an official SLC examination center, consistently maintaining its academic credibility.Adapting to changing times, the school introduced Grades 11 and 12 in 2050/051 B.S. In 2062 B.S., it was honored with the title of “Model School” by the then Higher Secondary Education Council, marking a significant achievement. In 2073 B.S., it was merged with Khalanga Primary School, and from 2074 B.S., English-medium instruction was introduced, further enhancing the quality of education.The school has also taken strides in technical and vocational education. Since 2075 B.S., it has been offering a Diploma in Civil Engineering, and since 2077 B.S., a Pre-Diploma program, guiding students toward practical and skill-based learning.Currently, the school has a dedicated team of over 70 teachers and 25 staff members, ensuring effective teaching and learning. With a comprehensive academic structure ranging from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12, along with technical streams, the school continues to provide inclusive, quality, and practical education.Additionally, the school operates hostel facilities to support students who are orphaned or come from distant areas. Notably, free hostel services are provided for students without guardians, significantly contributing to their educational continuity and overall development.Recognized as one of the largest and finest schools in the Far-Western Province, Shree Mahendra Secondary School, Darchula, continues to set an example in academic excellence, discipline, innovation, and student-centered education.

name: Gadhi Mai Mahendra Secondary School
description: Gadhi Mai Mahendra Secondary School is a community-based educational institution located in Bariyarpur, Bara, Nepal. Established with the vision of making quality education accessible to the local community, the school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and recognized by the Ministry of Education.The school offers comprehensive academic programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 10, along with Ten Plus Two (+2) programs in the streams of Management and Education.With a mission to nurture young minds and prepare them for future challenges, Gadhi Mai Mahendra Secondary School combines structured learning with value-based education. The institution maintains a moderate fee structure, ensuring affordability for a broader section of the community, and also runs a scholarship scheme to support deserving and underprivileged students.

name: Shree Maisthan Vidyapeeth Madhyamik Vidhyalaya
description: Shree Maisthan Vidyapeeth Madhyamik Vidhyalay Birgunj Parsa is a public school located in Birgunj Metropolitan City, Parsa district, within Madhesh province.The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 11. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Shree Maisthan Vidyapeeth Madhyamik Vidhyalay Birgunj Parsa has 2533 enrolled students.

name: Secondary School
description: Secondary School is a public school located in Garuda Municipality, Rautahat district, within Madhesh province.The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Secondary School has 2134 enrolled students.

name: Tribhuvan Secondary School
description: Tribhuvan Secondary School Banke is located in Kohalapur, Banke . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.CTEVT has given affiliation to this college to run Diploma in Computer Engineering program and Junior Computer Technician program. VisionProvide Skill education to the rural people.MissionDevelop manpower to do self based work.Goal/ Objectives• Self employment• Service to the future• Increase the self skill

name: St. Xaviers Secondary School Lalitpur
description: Established in 1951, St. Xavier's School was the inaugural academic institution founded by the Society of Jesus (Jesuits) in Nepal. Currently, it offers education at 12 levels, from Grade 1 to Grade 12, and its administration oversees an elementary school, a middle school, and a high school as a unified entity.As one of the earliest private schools in Nepal, St. Xavier's has maintained a reputation for being an inclusive institution, welcoming students from all backgrounds. Graduates of this esteemed institution have traditionally attained prominent positions in government, the bureaucracy, the military, and other distinguished professions nationwide. Renowned for its quality education, the school is a preferred choice for parents seeking to enroll their children. St. Xavier School is on par with international schools in terms of its educational standards.VisionInspired by the vision of St. Ignatius of Loyola and the inspirational documents of the Society of Jesus, we aim at creating a just world by educating our students to be Conscientious, Competent, Committed and Compassionate individuals who are people for and with othersMissionWe, the staff of St.Xavier's School Jawlakhel, are a community of persons who devote ourselves to human excellence, spiritual growth, and social justice for the active service of God, Nepal, and the human community.Motto"Live for God, Lead for Nepal"

name: Mahendra Ratna Jagarnath Laxminiya Secondary School
description: Mahendra Ratna Jagarnath Laxminiya Secondary School (MRJL) is a co-educational, non-profit academic institution located on the outskirts of Barahathawa Bazaar, Sarlahi. Established in 2018 B.S. under the Ministry of Education, Government of Nepal, the school was founded to provide accessible education to the communities of Sitapur-Gangapur. Today, MRJL offers comprehensive academic programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12.Affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB), the school runs Ten Plus Two programs in Science, Management, Education, and Technical Education. With around 1,400 enrolled students, MRJL is dedicated to providing child-centered, holistic education that promotes academic achievement, personal development, and social responsibility.Guided by the motto “Dream, Believe, Achieve – Together”, the school emphasizes moral values, character building, and a supportive environment where every student can realize their full potential.VisionTo establish the school as a model institution where students from diverse communities receive quality education, knowledge, and skills that prepare them for a peaceful and successful life in a globally competitive world.MissionMRJL aims to provide education of national standard that nurtures students’ intellectual, physical, and emotional growth. Through modern teaching methodologies and an updated curriculum, the school cultivates discipline, moral values, and personal integrity while encouraging lifelong learning.GoalsTo develop and deliver innovative education through a rigorous academic and extracurricular curriculum.To encourage the cognitive, social, physical, and emotional development of every student.To bring together qualified teachers and staff supported by modern technology and systems.To foster a safe, inclusive, and stimulating learning environment.To recognize the diverse abilities and growth potentials of students.To promote fellowship, self-confidence, and a pursuit of excellence.FacilitiesMRJL Secondary School provides a wide range of facilities to enhance the overall learning experience:School Clubs: Students actively participate in various clubs that promote leadership, teamwork, and creativity beyond classroom learning.Cafeteria: The school cafeteria serves fresh, hygienic, and nutritious meals and snacks, ensuring students' health and well-being.Health Care: A dedicated first-aid room is available on campus to provide immediate medical attention to students as needed.Multimedia Hall: A vibrant and flexible space used for academic presentations, cultural events, seminars, and more.Computer Labs: Equipped with two modern labs featuring updated systems to strengthen digital literacy and ICT skills.Science Labs: The school houses three fully equipped science labs for Physics, Chemistry, and Biology to encourage hands-on learning.Library: A well-furnished library with a rich collection of textbooks, reference materials, and literary works to support self-study and research.Hostel: The school offers residential facilities that provide a structured and nurturing environment for students living away from home.Scholarship Scheme: The school supports deserving and underprivileged students through a dedicated scholarship program to ensure equitable access to education.

name: Bal Kalyan Secondary School
description: Bal Kalyan Secondary School, located in the town of Liwang in Rolpa district, is a long-standing community-based educational institution dedicated to providing inclusive and quality education to students of the region. Established in 1966 AD (2023 BS), the school has been a cornerstone of academic development in Rolpa, nurturing generations of learners with a vision to empower youth through accessible, skill-oriented, and value-based education.Affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and recognized by the Ministry of Education, Bal Kalyan Secondary School offers comprehensive academic programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 10, along with Plus Two (Class 11 and 12) programs in Management, Science, Humanities, and Education streams. These courses are designed to align with national curriculum standards and equip students with the knowledge and skills necessary for both higher education and practical life challenges.In addition to its general academic programs, the school also provides technical education through its affiliation with the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT). It offers a Pre-Diploma in Civil Engineering (Civil Sub-Overseer) with 40 seats, and a Diploma in Civil Engineering with 48 seats. These technical programs aim to prepare students for immediate employment in engineering and infrastructure sectors, enhancing their prospects in Nepal’s growing technical workforce.Bal Kalyan Secondary School is committed to maintaining a balanced and supportive learning environment. It features dedicated teaching staff, student-friendly classrooms, and a culture of academic integrity and community engagement. As a public school, it follows a moderate fee structure, ensuring that education remains within reach for families from diverse backgrounds. Furthermore, the school implements a scholarship program for deserving and underprivileged students, reaffirming its mission of equitable education for all.

name: Kankai Secondary School
description: Established in 1958 AD (2015 BS), Kankai Secondary School is a community-based educational institution located in Surunga, Jhapa, Nepal. The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education. Kankai Secondary School offers comprehensive educational programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to grade 10 and Plus Two programs in Management, Science, and Education streams.Kankai Secondary School is committed to providing quality education with moderate fee structures. Additionally, the school offers scholarship schemes for deserving students to ensure accessibility and support for academic excellence.Kankai Secondary School is dedicated to fostering a holistic educational experience, ensuring students develop academically, socially, and personally.

name: Radhika Secondary School
description: Established in 2025 B.S., Shree Radhika Secondary School is a long-standing community-based educational institution in Urlabari, Morang, Nepal. With a legacy of academic excellence and community support, the school has evolved into a full-fledged secondary school offering education from Grade 1 to Grade 12. Over the years, it has built a strong foundation in both infrastructure and academics, thanks to the dedication of educators, social contributors, and local supporters.Recognized as a model science school by the Government of Nepal, Shree Radhika Secondary School conducts English medium instruction from Grades 6 to 8. It provides specialized programs in Science, Commerce, Education, and Technical streams in Grades 11 and 12. The school is known for its strong academic performance, modern learning facilities, and a holistic approach to student development, continuing to set a benchmark in educational excellence in the eastern region of Nepal.

name: Bhola Secondary School Ganjbhawanipur
description: Bhola Secondary School, located in Ganjabhawanipur, Bara, was established in 2013 BS (1956 AD) as a community-based school with a mission to make quality education accessible to all. The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education. It offers classes from Early Childhood Development (ECD) up to Grade 12, with Plus Two programs available in Management and Education streams. Known for its friendly and supportive learning environment, the school is led by experienced teachers who are dedicated to helping students succeed. Lessons are made more interactive and effective with the use of smart boards and updated teaching methods. The classrooms are clean, calm, and designed to help students stay focused. Alongside studies, the school encourages students to take part in extracurricular and cultural programs, helping them grow in confidence and creativity. A well-equipped library adds to the learning experience with useful books and resources. Bhola Secondary School also offers scholarships to deserving students and maintains a moderate fee structure—making it a great option for families seeking both quality and affordability.

name: Gandhi Adarsha Secondary School
description: Gandhi Adarsha Secondary School, established in 2010 BS (1953 AD) by renowned social reformer Tulsi Meher Shrestha, is a distinguished community-based institution located in Kadaghari, Kageshwari Manohara Municipality, Kathmandu. Inspired by Mahatma Gandhi’s philosophy of peace, empowerment, and education, the school was initially founded to provide education and vocational training for marginalized women, laying a foundation for social change and upliftment. In affiliation with the National Examination Board (NEB), it offers ten plus two programs in Management, Education and Humanities. The school was approved for secondary-level education in 2018 BS (1961 AD) and has produced academically capable and socially responsible graduates since 2019 BS (1962 AD). In 2060 BS (2004 AD), the institution proudly celebrated its Golden Jubilee, marking over five decades of commitment to excellence and community service.Strategically located just 9 km east of Ratnapark and accessible via the Koteshwar-Jadibuti route, the school sits in the peaceful plains of the Kathmandu Valley, close to the Manohara River and near the Nepal Charkha Pracharak Gandhi Smarak Mahaguthi, a center named after its visionary founder. The school’s student-friendly environment and modern infrastructure make it a prime choice for holistic education in the region.Today, Gandhi Adarsha Secondary School offers a broad academic curriculum in a well-maintained campus and continues to stand as a beacon of empowerment, learning, and legacy. With a clear focus on quality education, skill development, and inclusive growth, the school remains at the forefront of educational innovation and social transformation in Nepal. VisionGandhi Adarsha Secondary School aspires to create an educational environment where all students are equipped with the skills and knowledge necessary to succeed in life. Its vision is to provide a foundation of excellence that prepares individuals to contribute meaningfully to society, fostering creativity, critical thinking, and a commitment to social responsibility.MissionThe school aims to deliver quality education that emphasizes both academic excellence and personal growth. By fostering a culture of inclusivity and respect, we aim to equip students with the tools needed to thrive in a competitive world. Gandhi Adarsha Secondary School is dedicated to promoting holistic development through a balanced curriculum and an environment that nurtures confidence, leadership, and social awareness.

name: Bherukhi Secondary School
description: Bheruki Secondary School, located in Loharpatti Municipality, Mahottari District, is a forward-thinking and inclusive educational institution. The school is particularly known for its dedication to inclusive education. It operates a hostel specifically for visually impaired students, ensuring that quality education is accessible to all. Recent infrastructure developments include constructing new school buildings and a spacious playground and encouraging physical activity and sports participation. The school also places high importance on student health, providing safe drinking water through a dedicated water treatment plant on campus. Adding to its unique strengths, the school owns a pond leased out as a source of income. This revenue is used for school development, reflecting a sustainable and community-driven approach to growth. With its inclusive values, improved facilities, and innovative practices, Bheruki Secondary School provides a strong foundation for students’ academic and personal development in Mahottari.

name: The Old Capital Secondary School
description: The Old Capital Secondary School, is a full-fledged English medium boarding school, located at the central part of Gorkha district headquarter. It was established in 2052 BS by a strong team of energetic educationists and lovers of education under the Old Capital Educational Institute Pvt. Ltd. The area where it is located is really clean, green, peaceful, and serene, which provides a quite sustainable environment for the teaching and learning process. The school aims at enabling students to cope with the challenges they encounter at the time of knocking on opportunities for career development, both inside and outside national boundaries.Ever since the commencement of +2 program in 2064 BS, The Old Capital Secondary School has been imparting education in both medium; English and Nepali with its highly qualified, experienced, dynamic, dedicated and professional faculties following the trend of ‘LOVE AND CARE’ policy to make them morally and socially fit in the society and highly competitive product that meets the need of the national and international markets. The Old Capital Secondary School provides from ECD to secondary level education with moderate and affordable fees structures. It also offers scholarships schemes for deserving, hardworking and the underprivileged students of the society. It provides Classrooms, Extra-curricular Activities (ECA), Sports, Conference, Excursion Educational tours, Multimedia, Computer Labs, Workshop and clubs, scholarships facilities.

name: Rupandehi Lilaram Neupane Secondary School
description: Rupandehi Lilaram Neupane Secondary School is located in Siddharthanagar, Rupandehi . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.

name: Narayan Secondary School
description: Narayan Secondary School is a public school located in Bayalbas, Sarlahi district, within Madhesh Province. The school offers education from Grade 1 to Grade 12, serving as a key educational hub for the surrounding community and contributing to the academic empowerment of students in the region.As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Narayan Secondary School has a total enrollment of 2,098 students. The school is dedicated to ensuring access to quality education for all children, regardless of background, and emphasizes the importance of holistic development.Academically, the school follows the national curriculum, aiming to build a strong foundation in core subjects such as science, mathematics, language, and social studies. Teachers focus on interactive and student-centered teaching methods to encourage critical thinking, problem-solving, and active learning in the classroom.Beyond academics, Narayan Secondary School also values extracurricular activities. Students are encouraged to participate in sports, arts, cultural programs, debates, and other co-curricular engagements that promote creativity, teamwork, leadership, and personal growth. These opportunities help foster a well-rounded education, allowing students to explore their interests and talents beyond textbooks.Through a blend of curricular rigor and extracurricular vibrancy, Narayan Secondary School strives to nurture capable, confident, and socially responsible individuals prepared to face future challenges.

name: Motherland Secondary School
description: Motherland Secondary School, established in 2051 B.S. (1995 A.D.), has grown from a primary institution to become a leading center of academic excellence in Nepal. Guided by its motto "Quality Education For Everyone," the school is committed to nurturing a generation of intellectually empowered, socially responsible, and forward-thinking individuals. Over the years, it has made a significant mark in academia, now offering +2 programs in Science and Management which is integrated with the latest Information and Communication Technology (ICT) tools and modern teaching methodologies.Rooted in a mission to respect the trust of its well-wishers, the school aims to produce capable and rational citizens who can contribute meaningfully to the creation of a New Nepal. Its vision is to adopt an activity-based participatory approach, establish ties with international academic institutions, and become both globally recognized and socially responsible.At the core of the school life experience at Motherland Secondary School is intellectual growth. The school challenges students to think critically across disciplines, supported by caring faculty and a curriculum that prioritizes depth, engagement, and real-world relevance. From transportation and hostel services to well-equipped science labs, a comprehensive library, and a peaceful campus, every facility has been designed to ensure students thrive academically and personally.The school encourages holistic development through excursions, foreign scholar interactions, and the formation of various student clubs aimed at fostering leadership and personality growth. The school proudly participates in international exchange programs with institutions in Australia, the USA, the UK, Bangladesh, France, and India, enriching student perspectives and multiplying opportunities for scholarships and global exposure. With state-of-the-art instructional technology and a commitment to treating every student as an individual, Motherland Secondary School remains a distinguished educational institution preparing youth to adapt and lead in the global landscape.

name: Janata Secondary School, Gadahiya
description: Janata Secondary School, Gadahiya-Dumariya, is a public educational institution located in Balara Municipality of Sarlahi district, within Madhesh Province. Established in 1962 AD (2018 BS) as a community-based school, it has been serving the local community for decades with a strong focus on academic growth and accessible education. The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education. It offers educational programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 10, along with Plus Two (Class 11 and 12) in the Education stream.According to the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, the school has a total enrollment of 1790 students. This highlights its role as a key learning center in the region, providing educational access to a large number of students from diverse backgrounds. The school operates with a moderate fee structure and also provides scholarships to deserving and underprivileged students, ensuring that financial challenges do not hinder a child's right to learn.Janata Secondary School is committed to delivering quality education through experienced teachers and a student-focused environment. Over the years, it has earned a strong reputation for its dedication to academic excellence and holistic development. With its community roots and growing impact, the school continues to shape the future of education in the Sarlahi district.

name: Triveni Secondary School
description: Tribeni Secondary School is located in Katari, Udayapur . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.

name: South Asian Scholars Academy Tatapani
description: South Asian Scholars Academy Tatapani is a private school located in Birendranagar Municipality, Surkhet district, within Karnali province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, South Asian Scholars Academy Tatapani has 2140 enrolled students.

name: Nemdhari Basu Dev Secondary School
description: Established in 2017, Shree Nemdhari Basudev Namuna Secondary School, located in Mudwalwa, Rajdevi Municipality, Rautahat, Nepal, offers a blend of technical and general academic programs. The school offers general academic programs from play group to grade 12. Notably, it also offers a Civil Engineering program affiliated with the CTEVT, from grade 9 to 12, alongside other academic streams in Science and Management, under the NEB (National Examinations Board) in +2 programs.

name: Chhorepatan Secondary School
description: Established in 2021 BS, Chhorepatan Secondary School is one of the leading community schools in and around the valley. It is located in the southwestern part of Pokhara Valley. In more than a decade-long journey, Chhorepatan has been able to prove itself as a milestone in the academic identity of Pokhara. It has been running classes from Nursery to Grade XII. This is the first school in the Western Region to introduce the computer science as a subject in school. Currently, about 2050 students are studying here. In order to meet the need of quality of education in higher secondary education, Chhorepatan was upgraded to +2 level in 2055 BS with Humanities and Social Sciences streams. Later, Management and Education streams were launched in 2056 and 2061 BS, respectively in response to the cordial demands of the parents and students. The successful expansion of the school has been further marked by the addition of Science stream in 2066 BS. The quality of science stream is evidenced by 90+ pass percentage in 2070, final exam of grade XI and XII. Stretched in an area of 13 ropanies, the school has its own purpose built structures within spacious premises. Highly facilitated library, sophisticated computer lab, up-do-date science laboratories and well-equipped conference hall provide ideal learning opportunities for its students. Under the mentorship of a team of highly committed faculty members, students can enjoy the full prospect of curricular, co-curricular achievements.

name: Rastriya Secondary School
description: Rastriya Secondary School, located in Kantibazar, Mahottari, is a community-based educational institution dedicated to delivering quality education to students from diverse backgrounds. Affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education, the school offers academic programs from ECD to Grade 10, along with Ten Plus Two (10+2) programs in Management and Education.With a mission to make education inclusive and impactful, Rastriya Secondary School maintains moderate fee structures and provides scholarship opportunities for hardworking and deserving students. The school emphasizes not just academic excellence but also personal growth, leadership, and lifelong learning.By offering both general and stream-based higher secondary education, the school plays an important role in preparing students for further studies and future careers. With a student-friendly environment and dedicated staff, Rastriya Secondary School continues to serve as a trusted academic institution in the Mahottari district.

name: Adarsha Saula Yubak Secondary School
description: Adarsha Saula Yubak Secondary School, located in Bungmati, Sainbu (Lalitpur Sub-Metropolitan City-22), is a community-based institution that has been serving the educational needs of the region since its establishment in 1969 A.D. The school is affiliated with the National Examinations Board (NEB) and is recognized by the Ministry of Education, maintaining a consistent academic excellence and inclusive learning standard. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 10, and extends its offerings to the +2 level in Science, Management, Education, and Humanities streams. Since 2074 B.S., it has also been running a technical education program in Computer Engineering for Grades 9 to 12, giving students both academic and career-oriented pathways. Adarsha Saula Yubak strongly emphasizes holistic student development. Beyond academics, the school fosters its students' physical, emotional, and social well-being through a wide array of facilities and co-curricular programs. Key infrastructure includes a modern cafeteria offering healthy meals, a well-stocked library promoting reading habits, and ample sports facilities encouraging physical fitness and team spirit. The school is also equipped with advanced science and computer labs for hands-on learning and music and dance rooms to support students’ creative expression. Students benefit from a dedicated counseling program and access to scholarships, ensuring financial constraints do not hinder academic progress. The school also provides spacious parking, multimedia-enabled classrooms, and a conference hall for leadership development and public speaking activities. In addition to regular academics, the school organizes field trips and various extracurricular activities (ECA) to broaden students’ horizons and inspire exploration beyond the classroom.

name: Public Secondary School
description: Public Secondary School is located in Krishnapur, Rupandehi . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs. The school also offers Diploma in Civil Engineering program with the affiliation from CTEVT.

name: Shree Secondary School Bairiya
description: Shree Secondary School Bairiya is a community-based public institution located in Rajpur Rural Municipality of Rautahat district, within Madhesh Province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12 and plays a vital role in the academic development of students in the region. According to the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, the school has an enrollment of 1796 students, reflecting its significance in the local educational landscape.The school is committed to delivering high-quality education through a team of qualified and experienced teachers. With a student-centered teaching approach, educators at Shree Secondary School Bairiya ensure that each learner receives personalized guidance and support, helping them excel both academically and personally. The school maintains a disciplined and encouraging environment that promotes intellectual growth and character development.In addition to academics, the school gives strong importance to extracurricular activities, recognizing their role in shaping well-rounded individuals. A spacious playground offers abundant space for games and interactive events such as musical chairs, providing students with opportunities to build teamwork, creativity, and physical fitness. Through its balanced focus on quality education and holistic development, Shree Secondary School Bairiya continues to empower students and contribute meaningfully to the community.

name: Durga Secondary School
description: Durga Secondary School Mahottari is located in Manara, Mahottari . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.

name: Ne Ra Secondary School Piparpati
description: Ne Ra Secondary School Piparpati is a public school located in Pacharauta Municipality, Bara district, within Madhesh province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Ne Ra Secondary School Piparpati has 1998 enrolled students.

name: Nepal Police School, Sanga
description: Nepal Police School, popularly known as “Police School,” was established in 2040 B.S. with the primary objective of providing quality education to the children of Nepal Police personnel. Operated under the welfare program of the Nepal Police Organization, it functions as a non-profit, community-focused academic institution dedicated to fostering disciplined, value-based education. This exclusive co-educational residential school is affiliated with the Secondary Education Examination (SEE) Board and the National Examination Board (NEB) of Nepal.The central school is strategically located at Sanga, Kavre, just 21 kilometers east of the Kathmandu city center, on the northern side of the Araniko Highway. In addition to the central campus, there are seven regional Nepal Police Schools established across the country, all operating under a unified institutional structure, ensuring consistent academic standards and student development nationwide.The school offers a wide range of facilities that support both learning and well-being. It is equipped with earthquake-resistant buildings, a large playground, and modern infrastructure suited for academic and extracurricular activities. The peaceful and pollution-free environment promotes a safe and healthy residential experience for students. Nepal Police School is known for its highly qualified teachers, a strong emphasis on discipline, well-managed hostels, and a structured environment that supports comprehensive growth. These features collectively make NPS a trusted name in quality education across Nepal.Aim and objectives:The main objective is to impart quality boarding school education to children of police personnel and selected children of civilians [upto40%] as well. These schools explore students’potential for all round development, keeping discipline at its core. The motto of school is “Better Schooling for Ideal Citizens”. NPS is committed to transforming the students into globally competent citizens or leaders who can lead tomorrow’s world. NP specifically aim at producing skilled and efficient human resources by grooming students in a homely and warm atmosphere. The Central School bagged ‘Birendra Vidhya Rastiyra Shield’of the academic years 2051/052 and 2055/2056. The school was also felicitated by the Birendra Shield Regional Award in 2048 B.S. and Regional Award for 2061 as well.

name: Kanchanjunga English Secondary School
description: Kanchanjunga English Secondary School (KESS), established in 2049 B.S., is a leading English-medium school situated in Gulariya, Kanchanpur, in the Far-Western Region of Nepal. Founded by a group of dedicated academicians, professionals, and national visionaries, the school was created with a mission to provide high-quality education grounded in modern teaching methods and 21st-century learning principles.KESS is widely recognized for its commitment to fostering independent, confident learners who are prepared to navigate the challenges of an ever-evolving world. By blending Nepal’s national education standards with internationally informed academic programs, KESS ensures that students receive a balanced, relevant, and forward-thinking education. The school focuses on developing core competencies such as critical thinking, communication, collaboration, and creativity—skills that are vital for success in today’s global landscape.The school is built on a spacious and well-planned campus, offering state-of-the-art facilities designed to support holistic student development. These include a well-equipped library with a vast collection of books and e-resources, a science laboratory for hands-on experimentation, and a modern computer lab with high-speed internet access. In addition, students actively participate in readers’ clubs, performing arts programs, and sports activities, with access to dedicated football grounds, cricket pitches, and other outdoor spaces.KESS is powered by a team of professionally trained and highly qualified teachers who are passionate about education. With innovative teaching strategies like Learning Reinforcement Practice Application (LRPA), the school delivers personalized learning experiences that help every student reach their full potential. The faculty's consistent effort to guide students academically, socially, and emotionally has earned KESS a strong reputation for excellence.Through its vision of creating global citizens equipped with local values and modern skills, Kanchanjunga English Secondary School continues to be a beacon of quality education in the Far West. It remains a top choice for families seeking a progressive, student-centered learning environment in a peaceful and accessible setting.

name: Sa Ra Secondary School Gaida Bhetpur
description: Sa Ra Secondary School Gaida Bhetpur is a public school located in Samsi Rural Municipality, Mahottari district, within Madhesh province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 10. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Sa Ra Secondary School Gaida Bhetpur has 1965 enrolled students.

name: Ram Secondary School
description: Ram Secondary School Mahottari is located in Matihani, Mahottari . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.

name: Shree Secondary School Madhopur
description: Shree Secondary School Madhopur is a public school located in Madhav Narayan Municipality, Rautahat district, within Madhesh province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Shree Secondary School Madhopur has 1946 enrolled students.

name: Yamuna Mai Secondary School
description: Yamuna Mai Secondary School, Rautahat is a community-based educational institution located in Jhunakhunma, Rautahat, Nepal. Established with the goal of delivering accessible and inclusive education, the school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and recognized by the Ministry of Education. It serves students from the Early Childhood Development (ECD) level up to Grade 12, offering academic programs designed to promote holistic development. The school currently offers Ten Plus Two (Class 11 and 12) programs in two major streams: Management and Education. These programs are tailored to equip students with foundational knowledge and practical skills necessary for higher studies or direct entry into the workforce. The Management stream focuses on business, economics, and administrative principles, while the Education stream prepares students for future roles in teaching and pedagogy. Yamuna Mai Secondary School maintains a moderate fee structure, ensuring affordability for families in the surrounding community. In addition, the school provides scholarship opportunities to deserving and underprivileged students, reinforcing its commitment to educational equity and social upliftment. Through dedicated faculty, a supportive learning environment, and a focus on both academic and personal growth, Yamuna Mai Secondary School continues to play a crucial role in shaping the future of young learners in the Rautahat district.

name: Tribhuvan Secondary School
description: Tribhuvan Secondary School is located in Gaushala, Mahottari. It is an academic institution committed to providing structured and accessible education to its students. The school delivers instruction through the English medium, supporting learners in developing both subject knowledge and language proficiency. To enhance the teaching and learning process, the school has introduced smart classes, particularly for students above Grade 8, enabling the use of digital tools and interactive methods in the classroom. The school offers education from Nursery till +2, there are programs such as Science, management and education in +2. This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB).In addition to general academic programs, the school has initiated Civil studies, offering students an opportunity to engage with technical and practical knowledge in this field. The institution also maintains essential academic facilities, including a laboratory for practical experiments and a library to support reading and research activities.The daily schedule is organized into two sessions, morning and evening, allowing flexibility in attendance and classroom management. Through its academic offerings and supportive learning environment, Tribhuvan Secondary School continues to focus on the overall educational development of its students while adapting to evolving teaching practices.

name: Secondary School Basbitti
description: Secondary School Basbitti is a public school located in Ramgopalpur Municipality, Mahottari district, within Madhesh province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Secondary School Basbitti has 1914 enrolled students.

name: Ramcharitra Bhagat Secondary School
description: Ramcharitra Bhagat Secondary School is located in Pakaha Mainpur Parsa . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.

name: Fluorescent Secondary School
description: Fluorescent Secondary School (FSS), founded and promoted by the joint endeavor of a team of dedicated professional teachers and academicians in 1997 initially with 219 students and 18 staff, is a co educational English medium private school. It is situated at Tokha Municipality Ward No 8, Baniyatar, Gongabu, Kathmandu, Nepal. After a long and rigorous academic journey, now, it has been transformed as one of the largest schools in the valley. The school caters to the educational requirements of learners from Grade Nursery to Twelve. This school has successfully completed its twenty first springs creating its own recognition in the domain of school education at local and national level. It comprises basic physical infrastructures required for teaching and learning processes. The aim of this school is to impart an all round quality education in which students are prepared to encounter any sort of challenges in their life with full power, patience and perseverance. This understanding is reflected in the school motto: EDUCATION FOR EMPOWERMENT. The school wants to prepare a student, not merely to pass examinations, but also aim at creating an independent and balanced person with decent attitude in mind and inner spirit to assist others. To empower each individual with skills and knowledge for the holistic development of personality for their won benefit and that of society as a whole is the core objective of this school. Vision: Fluorescent Secondary School (FSS) envisions becoming a model and leading school within a decade, offering value based quality education from Early Child Centre (ECC) to Secondary Level. Mission: Fluorescent Secondary School (FSS) mission is to provide an excellent standard of education to the students, focusing on developing their full potential of their body, mind and spirit. The team of school management and entire faculty work with their complete motivation, enthusiasm and energy not only to prepare students for the examinations but also to inculcate in them a sense of self-esteem, social and moral values in order to raise them as responsible citizens of the nation. The emphasis is given for developing students into self- confident, insightful and innovative individuals by engaging them beyond the classroom setting.

name: Chandannath Model Secondary School
description: Founded in 1963 ( 2020 BS), Chandannath Secondary School is a public institution situated in Khalanga Bazar, Jumla, Nepal.It is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and recognized by the Ministry of Education (MoE). The school offers educational programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) through grade 12, including Ten Plus Two (10+2) courses in the Education stream. Additionally, it also provides a three-year diploma program in Agriculture (Plant Science) and Forestry, accredited by the Council for Technical Education and Vocational Training (CTEVT).

name: Tribhuvan Secondary School, Bhurigaun
description: Tribhuvan Secondary School is located in Bhurigau, Bardiya. In 2015, Tribhuvan Secondary School got approval from NEB to run Ten Plus two in Animal Science.

name: Ramapur Secondary School
description: Established in 2021 B.S., Ramapur Secondary School is a distinguished academic institution located in Sainamaina, Rupandehi. Renowned as one of the nation's outstanding educational institutions, the school has maintained a legacy of academic excellence and student success for decades. The comprehensive educational framework of the school offers classes from Nursery to Grade 12.Ramapur Secondary School prides itself on a team of experienced and professionally trained teachers dedicated to nurturing students through innovative and effective teaching methods. The school embraces modern technology in education, offering virtual classes, online learning options, and projector-based classroom instruction, ensuring students are prepared for a digital future.The school provides a safe, clean, and peaceful environment under constant CCTV surveillance, promoting a secure and focused learning atmosphere. For younger students, Montessori-based teaching is implemented in Nursery classes to foster early development in an engaging and age-appropriate way.To support student well-being and nutrition, midday snacks are provided up to Grade 5, and a hygienic school canteen serves healthy meals. The school also emphasizes co-curricular and extracurricular activities, with dedicated sports teachers who help students explore and develop their talents in various athletic and creative fields.The school features a well-equipped computer lab and science laboratory, offering students hands-on learning experiences that deepen their understanding of core subjects. In addition, transportation facilities are available for convenient access from surrounding areas. Ramapur Secondary School provides scholarships for economically disadvantaged and high-performing students, as a commitment to inclusivity in education.

name: Kathmandu BernHardt SS/College
description: Kathmandu BernHardt Secondary School, with a remarkable 25-year history, stands as a leading educational institution in Kathmandu, renowned for delivering quality education. Its success in shaping numerous successful individuals naturally led to the establishment of Kathmandu BernHardt College.Many students who have been trained within its walls have been leading their successful lives in different walks of life. Drawing inspiration from the school's remarkable success in its management, the institution is naturally prompted to establish its own college, Kathmandu BernHardt College.The environment at BernHardt helps students learn better. It is located in a calm spot away from the noisy city, at Balkhu Chowk inside the ring road, right opposite the TU Exams Controller Office. This location is easy to reach from main parts of Kathmandu. Being peaceful, safe, having its own cafeteria, a large sports field, and a welcoming academic setting are the main things that make BernHardt an excellent place for studying.. Considering education as a lifetime investment, Kathmandu BernHardt Secondary School is dedicated to providing management, humanities, and science & technology education with its pedagogy of mixing university syllabus with modern technology to budding professionals. From its inception, together with furnished and comfortable classrooms, a fully equipped library with books and journals and ample learning opportunities, and suitable academic programs in its own corporate building, the college enjoys full support and patronage of the parents, well-wishers, and students.Kathmandu BernHardt Secondary School is well aware of the fact that true education must not limit itself to completion of syllabus or acquisition of a Degree. It should, instead, aim at the development of the complete individual, who can lead humanity on a road of continuous achievement. The college believes that each student possesses a unique combination of multiple intelligence and qualities. Students differ in their preference for individual learning styles so, at Kathmandu BernHardt Secondary School, the delivery methodology is student-centered and includes active, experiential, supportive, and participatory learning activities.Together with faculty members having substantial academic and industry experiences with a flair for teaching, students at the Kathmandu BernHardt Secondary School are provided with the best possible enabling environment for teaching-learning processes that must be expected from a contemporary Business and IT colleges.To ensure the all-around development of students and extend job-oriented practical education Kathmandu BernHardt Secondary School orients students' personalities to suit the desired job profile through sustained exposure to extra-curricular and Personality Development programs. Kathmandu BernHardt Secondary School always gives top priority to a safe and positive learning environment with enthusiasm to support each student. This has been proven as the incomparable culture of BernHardt since its inception. Similarly, it highly gives importance to its partnership with the families of students and keeps consistent communication between home and school so as to let them know what is happening while at school.MissionBernHardt's mission is to educate people to:enhance their knowledgethink criticallycommunicate effectivelyuse knowledge respectively and creatively

name: Bhanubhakta Memorial Secondary English School
description: Bhanubhakta Memorial Secondary English School is a well-established private educational institution located in Gaushala, Ramnagar, Mahottari, Nepal. Founded in 2001 AD (2058 BS), the school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education. It offers academic programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 10, along with Plus Two (Class 11 and 12) courses in Management and Education. The school is committed to delivering quality education in a structured and disciplined environment. It focuses on curriculum-based learning supported by a dedicated team of professionals. Alongside academics, the school also emphasizes behavioral education and life skill development to help students grow into responsible and capable individuals. Learning is encouraged through mutual interaction and active participation. Bhanubhakta Memorial Secondary English School maintains a moderate fee structure and provides scholarship opportunities for deserving students, making education more accessible to all. With a balanced approach to academics and personal development, it stands out as a reliable choice for students and parents in the Mahottari region.

name: Ramdev Janata Secondary School
description: Ramdev Janata Secondary School is a prominent educational institution located in Loharpatti Municipality-7, Mahottari district, within Madhesh Province. Established in 2007 B.S., the school has steadily grown into a respected center of learning, offering education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, the school currently enrolls 2,089 students. This strong enrollment reflects the local community's trust in the school’s commitment to quality education and holistic student development. Ramdev Janata Secondary School emphasizes extensive practical training and career-focused education, particularly for students pursuing science and technical streams. With a mission to foster the growth of future engineers and professionals, the school is equipped with modern classrooms and laboratories, ensuring hands-on learning and real-world application of academic knowledge. The school boasts a team of expert instructors who are passionate about student-centered teaching. These educators guide students academically and mentor them in skill development and character building. To support educational accessibility, the school offers scholarships and discounts to deserving and underprivileged students. In addition, career support and job placement assistance are also available for graduates, helping them confidently transition into higher education and the professional world. At Ramdev Janata Secondary School, the emphasis on academic excellence and practical skills prepares students to thrive in a competitive and ever-evolving global environment.

name: Koshi Saint James Residential Secondary School
description: Established in 2053 B.S., Koshi Saint James Secondary School, located in Itahari, Koshi Province, is a leading co-educational institution known for its strong commitment to academic excellence and character development. The school is run by a dynamic team of young and enthusiastic scholars dedicated to delivering outstanding educational opportunities that shape well-rounded, future-ready individuals. The comprehensive education curriculum of the school offers classes from Playgroup (PG) to Grade 12. In affiliation with the National Examination Board (NEB), it offers plus two programs in Science and Management. Koshi Saint James Secondary School offers a rich learning environment with spacious classrooms, a well-stocked library, fully equipped science laboratories, and ample sports facilities, ensuring students receive a balanced and comprehensive education. The institution fosters a cooperative and supportive culture that encourages active teaching and learning, where students and teachers work together with shared purpose and dedication. Rooted in its mission to be a “seat of disciplined learning and human culture,” the school provides education that not only sharpens intellect but also nurtures values, emotional stability, physical well-being, and spiritual awareness. The vision of the school is to evolve into an academic institution that delivers a unique, distinguished educational experience that students are proud to be a part of. Koshi Saint James focuses on co-curricular and extracurricular activities to unlock the full potential of each student. Its core objective is to prepare young minds to be intellectually cultured, physically fit and emotionally balanced, spiritually aware and socially responsible and productive citizens. With continued focus towards dedication, discipline, and holistic development, Koshi Saint James Secondary School continues to be a trusted destination for quality education in the region.

name: Saraswati Janata Secondary School
description: Saraswati Janata Secondary School, located in Sonama Tarhari, Mahottari, is a community-based educational institution dedicated to providing accessible and quality education. The school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education, offering academic programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 10, along with Ten Plus Two (10+2) in Education.With a commitment to inclusive and value-based learning, the school maintains moderate fee structures and supports students through scholarship schemes designed for deserving and underprivileged learners. Saraswati Janata Secondary School emphasizes positive development by integrating academics with practical learning and extracurricular engagement.The school is equipped with essential facilities for students to explore their talents in sports, music, dance, and educational tours. It also offers a conference hall and actively promotes extra-curricular activities (ECA) to foster creativity and leadership among students.Saraswati Janata Secondary School continues to serve the Mahottari community by empowering students through dedicated teaching and a supportive environment.

name: Siddhartha English Boarding School
description: Located in Sundarharaicha, Morang, Siddhartha English Boarding School is a co-educational institution, prominent in academic excellence since its establishment in 2051 B.S. Renowned for its commitment to quality education and holistic student development, the school offers a dynamic environment that supports learning, creativity, and character-building. With a strong focus on both academics and extracurricular activities, Siddhartha English Boarding School empowers students to thrive intellectually, emotionally, and socially. The school has earned accolades at the national, district, and municipal levels, including winning the National Folk Dance Competition and numerous public speaking, painting, sports, and music awards. These achievements reflect its dedication to nurturing talent beyond the classroom. The school’s mission is to provide a holistic education that fosters intellectual, emotional, and physical growth in students. By blending academic rigor with creative and cultural development, we aim to nurture lifelong learners who are ready to face the challenges of the 21st century with confidence, resilience, and integrity. Its vision is to create a dynamic learning environment where students are encouraged to explore, innovate, and excel in both academics and extracurricular activities. The school aims to produce responsible, confident, and compassionate individuals who contribute positively to society and the world.

name: Shree Sonphi Dashain Secondary School
description: Shree Sonphi Dashain Secondary School is located in Shreepur 3, Mahottari . This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs. The school has recently received affiliation from CTEVT to run Diploma in Civil Engineering Program.

name: Capital College and Research Center (CCRC)
description: Since its establishment in 2001, CCRC has emerged as one of Nepal's leading colleges. Their exceptional students, impressive academic achievements, and successful placements, both nationally and internationally, reflect their commitment to excellence. CCRC recognizes that choosing the right college profoundly shapes an individual's character, influencing their thoughts and abilities to tackle important tasks. At CCRC, they take great pride in nurturing some of Nepal's brightest minds. Their students have made significant contributions across various fields worldwide, ranging from engineering, medicine, and finance to arts, sports, research, law, social work, and policymaking. Their accomplishments highlight the quality of education and support they receive at CCRC.CCRC remains steadfast in its dedication to providing a high-quality learning environment that encourages individuals to explore their full potential. They have carefully crafted a pathway for the students, offering ample opportunities, personalized support, and guidance to help them achieve their aspirations. As a preferred choice for top-performing students, CCRC continuously strives to raise the bar. The collaborative and growth-oriented mindset fostered within the CCRC family has resulted in impressive results from the NEB board exams and numerous scholarships in medicine and engineering. Equally remarkable are their students' placements in prestigious national and international colleges and universities.At CCRC, they have thoroughly considered the best course of action to ensure their students' prosperous futures and their development into empowered decision-makers for themselves, their loved ones, and society at large. CCRC presents a realm of opportunities, allowing you to explore your passions and talents during a transformative period of study. Their dedicated faculty, state-of-the-art facilities, and specialized expertise will guide you along your journey toward achieving your goals, creating unforgettable memories during your time at CCRC.

name: Ram Dulari Secondary School
description: Ram Dulari Secondary School is a community-based educational institution located in Kalyanpur, Siraha District, Madhesh Province. Established to serve the local community, the school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education. It offers a comprehensive education program from Early Childhood Development (ECD) through Grade 10, along with Plus Two (+2) programs in Management and Education streams. The school is committed to providing quality education with a moderate fee structure that makes learning accessible to many families in the area. Additionally, Ram Dulari Secondary School supports deserving students through its scholarship scheme, encouraging academic growth and equal opportunities for all. With a focus on holistic development and student success, the school continues to play an important role in the educational landscape of Siraha.

name: New Divine Light Secondary English Boarding School
description: Situated in the heart of Garuda, Rautahat, New Divine Light Secondary English Boarding School is a vibrant and forward-thinking institution committed to nurturing young minds through academic excellence, character development, and a holistic approach to learning. With classes running from Playgroup (PG) to Grade 10, the school provides a strong foundation for children in their early and formative years. Driven by the vision to cultivate responsible, skilled, and knowledgeable citizens, the school offers a knowledge-based curriculum that emphasizes both theoretical and practical learning. Alongside core academics, it actively promotes a variety of co-curricular and extracurricular activities, including sports, music, dance, educational excursions, and creative workshops. These experiences help develop well-rounded individuals who are confident, collaborative, and prepared to face real-world challenges. New Divine Light School is equipped with modern classrooms, science and computer laboratories, multimedia facilities, and a safe, supportive environment for learners of all backgrounds. The school places a strong emphasis on discipline, communication skills, and ethical values, ensuring that students not only perform well academically but also grow as respectful and responsible members of society. Understanding the financial realities of many families, the school operates with moderate fee structures and proudly offers scholarship opportunities to hardworking and underprivileged students. It is guided by a team of dedicated educators and administrators who are passionate about student success and committed to continuous improvement.The school invites parents and guardians to be part of its growing educational community that blends care, creativity, and academic strength.

name: Mangal Secondary School
description: Established in 1962 (2019 B.S.), Mangal Secondary School, formerly known as Mangal Madhyamik Vidyalaya, has a rich history rooted in the cultural and educational landscape of Kirtipur. The school initially operated under humble conditions in a public meeting shade (“Paati”) at Wahi Bahal before relocating to Chilancho Bihar. Despite facing challenges from environmental conditions and religious activities, the school's journey of growth and resilience continued.A significant milestone came when the then head of the local village Panchayat, Mr. Dwarika Maharjan, provided 26 ropanies of land in Kirtipur-3, laying the foundation for the school's development. Over the years, various organizations, including Plan International Nepal and the Rotary Club of Kathmandu Midtown, contributed to building the school's infrastructure. Today, Mangal Secondary School boasts well-equipped classrooms, a playground with volleyball and basketball courts, and modern facilities, ensuring a conducive learning environment for students.Located in Kirtipur-3, Naya Bazar, Kathmandu, Mangal Secondary School remains committed to providing quality education while fostering community engagement and holistic development.

name: N.R.B Janta Secondary School
description: Shree Nepal Rastriya Baiju Janta Secondary School is a community-based educational institution located in Sangrampur-2, Sarlahi, within Madhesh Province, Nepal. Affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and approved by the Ministry of Education, the school is committed to providing accessible and inclusive education to students from diverse backgrounds in the local community.The school offers academic programs ranging from Early Childhood Development (ECD) up to Grade 10, along with Plus Two (Grades 11 and 12) in the Management stream. With a balanced approach to academic and personal development, the institution emphasizes both scholastic achievement and character-building.Shree Nepal Rastriya Baiju Janta Secondary School maintains a moderate fee structure, making quality education affordable for many families. Additionally, it offers scholarship opportunities for academically deserving students, ensuring that financial barriers do not hinder educational progress.The school features spacious classrooms, a supportive and experienced teaching staff, and a strong focus on quality education in a community-friendly environment. It also promotes extracurricular activities, encouraging students to participate in various programs that enhance creativity, leadership, and teamwork.

name: Tenuhawa Community Secondary School
description: The school’s primary mission is to provide quality, affordable, and inclusive education to students from all socio-economic backgrounds, ensuring that no child in the Tenuhawa area is left behind due to financial constraints. Its vision is to develop as a "Center of Excellence" for community-based learning, focusing not just on academic literacy but on producing skilled, self-reliant, and socially responsible citizens. By integrating technical vocational subjects alongside traditional academics, the school aims to bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and the practical needs of the local agricultural economy.The pedagogy at the school is a blend of the National Curriculum of Nepal and practical, field-based learning. In the primary levels, the school emphasizes child-friendly teaching environments (ECD). For secondary and higher secondary levels, particularly in the technical streams, the teaching methodology shifts toward hands-on training, where students participate in field-based agricultural projects and laboratory experiments. Teachers use a mix of traditional classroom lectures and modern instructional aids. The school also prioritizes extracurricular development, frequently organizing sports, cultural programs (like Saraswati Puja and local festivals), and competitive events to ensure the holistic growth of its students.The institution distinguishes itself as a leader in technical education within the Lumbini region, specifically as a hub for Plant Science (Agriculture). Students in the technical stream from Grade 9 to Grade 12 engage in specialized subjects such as Agronomy, Horticulture, Plant Protection, and Floriculture, and the school also provides a Pre-Diploma program for Agriculture (Plant Science). To support this practical curriculum, the school maintains a well-organized farm for agricultural work and offers On-the-Job Training (OJT) opportunities where students can receive payment for their labor, ultimately aiming to guarantee full employment following the completion of their studies.As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Tenuhawa Community Secondary School has 1757 enrolled students.

name: Adarsha Secondary School
description: Adarsha Secondary School Sanothimi is a public school located in Madhyapur Thimi Municipality, Bhaktapur district, within Bagmati province.The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Adarsha Secondary School Sanothimi has 1749 enrolled students.

name: Janata Secondary School Auraiya
description: Janata Secondary School Auraiya is a public school located in Ishanath Municipality, Rautahat district, within Madhesh province.
