As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Janata Secondary School Auraiya has 1746 enrolled students.

name: Shree Janata Secondary School
description: Janata Secondary School is located in Bharatpurkhor, Mahottari District. Established in 2014 B.S., the school is a well-established educational institution offering academic programs from Kindergarten to Grade 12.The school provides both English and Nepali medium instruction, helping students develop strong communication skills along with a solid academic foundation. It follows a well-structured timetable and organized academic system, ensuring consistency in teaching and learning throughout all grade levels.In addition to general education, Janata Secondary School is affiliated with CTEVT and offers a Diploma in Computer Engineering program. This technical course provides students with practical and career-oriented skills in the field of information technology.The institution emphasizes a continuous learning pathway from early childhood education to higher secondary level, allowing students to grow in a stable and familiar academic environment. Teaching is focused on curriculum-based learning, with encouragement for active student participation and engagement in classroom activities.The school is supported by a green and peaceful environment, which contributes to a healthy and productive learning atmosphere. With its structured approach to education and commitment to academic development, Janata Secondary School continues to play an important role in the educational progress of the Bharatpurkhor region, supporting students in both academic and technical education pathways.

name: Keshwar Garib Janta Secondary School
description: Keshwar Garib Janta Secondary School is located in Haripurwa, Sarlahi. This secondary school is affiliated with National Examination Board (NEB) and offers plus two (10+2) programs.

name: Saraswati Secondary School
description: Saraswati Secondary School is a public school located in Brindaban Municipality, Rautahat district, within Madhesh province.The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Saraswati Secondary School has 1726 enrolled students.

name: Udayasi English Secondary School
description: Udayasi English Secondary School (UESS) was established on Mangsir 1, 2051 B.S., within the premises of Udayapur Cement Factory in Jaljale, Udayapur. The school was founded with the aim of providing practical, cost-effective, and quality education—initially to the children of factory employees and nearby residents. Since then, it has grown into a reputable community-based institution serving students from pre-primary to secondary level. The school is managed by Shree Udayasi Samaj Sikshya Sewa (SUSSS), a non-governmental, non-profit, and socially driven organization. SUSSS comprises mainly employees of the cement factory and local residents who are committed to uplifting the educational and social standards of the region. The factory continues to support the school’s infrastructure and resources, while the organization ensures transparency through regular audits and reporting of donations and income. From the beginning, UESS has emphasized both academic excellence and social responsibility. The school encourages students to actively participate in environmental conservation, awareness campaigns, and community engagement activities, fostering both intellectual and moral development. Mission and Vision UESS aims to improve the educational, environmental, and cultural conditions of the local community. Recognizing the challenges faced in these areas, the school works with local resources, volunteers, and organizations to bring about meaningful change. Students are engaged in environmental education, field surveys, and problem-solving initiatives that help them better understand their surroundings and contribute to societal development. With a long-term goal of offering higher secondary (+2) education, UESS is working on strategic plans to upgrade its academic offerings and establish itself as a model school in the region. Facilities and Services Udayasi English Secondary School is dedicated to providing a supportive and resource-rich learning environment. Key facilities and services include: Eco-friendly and well-ventilated classrooms designed for effective learning Computer lab with up-to-date equipment to foster digital literacy Spacious and resourceful library with books relevant to Nepali society, culture, and environment Well-equipped science laboratories for hands-on experiments and scientific exploration Regular extracurricular activities including debates, essay writing, storytelling, acting, dance, and sports Daily physical fitness and self-defense classes to promote student well-being Provision of clean and safe drinking water throughout the school Publication of a fortnightly child magazine, Bal Dhwani (Voice of the Children), to encourage creativity and communication Qualified and experienced teachers committed to student success Scholarships for Dalit, disabled, and hardworking students, as well as 12–16% merit-based scholarships each year Scholarships supported by donors are allocated to economically disadvantaged students Affordable tuition and low-fee academic programs to ensure education for all Well-maintained auditorium hall for events, programs, and large gatherings Sufficient resources and space for extracurricular and co-curricular development Regularly organized parent meetings to support students’ academic and personal growth Special initiatives to encourage school attendance among primary-level students Strong emphasis on girls’ education and women empowerment

name: Arunodaya Secondary School
description: Arunodaya Secondary School is a public school located in Gokarneshwar Municipality, Kathmandu district, within Bagmati province.The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Arunodaya Secondary School has 1702 enrolled students.

name: Sai Global Academy
description: Sai Global Secondary School is an academic institution located in Busdiliya, Bhairahawa. Established in 2038 B.S., the school has been providing educational services with a focus on academic excellence and overall student development. It is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and offers Plus Two (10+2) programs in a structured learning environment.In addition to secondary level education, the school is also affiliated with Tribhuvan University (TU) and offers the Bachelor's in Business Studies (BBS) program, supporting students who wish to pursue higher education in the field of management. The institution aims to prepare students for academic and professional growth through a balanced and student-centered approach to learning.Sai Global Secondary School emphasizes the holistic development of students by addressing physical, intellectual, and spiritual aspects of education. Alongside regular classroom instruction, the school encourages interaction with professionals, educators, and members of the wider community to enhance practical understanding and real-world exposure.The school promotes values such as honesty, discipline, confidence, and social responsibility while fostering an environment that supports interactive learning, innovation, and critical thinking. Through its academic programs and supportive atmosphere, Sai Global Secondary School continues to contribute to the educational development of students in the Bhairahawa region.

name: Budilal Vidya Munar Model Secondary School
description: Buddhilal Vidya Munar Model Secondary School is a respected community-based educational institution located in Bhagawatpur, Badahary, within the Saptari district of Madhesh Province, Nepal. Established with the aim of uplifting educational opportunities in the region, the school is affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB) and officially approved by the Ministry of Education.The school offers academic programs from Early Childhood Development (ECD) up to Grade 10, along with Ten Plus Two (+2) programs in the streams of Management, Science, and Education. These programs are designed to provide students with a strong academic foundation while also preparing them for higher education and professional pathways.Dedicated to educational equity, Buddhilal Vidya Munar Model Secondary School operates with a moderate fee structure and extends scholarship schemes to support meritorious and underprivileged students. The school has consistently focused on maintaining a student-centered learning environment that encourages both academic excellence and personal development.With a growing reputation in the region, the school continues to serve as a reliable center for quality education, empowering students from diverse backgrounds to pursue their academic goals and contribute meaningfully to society.

name: Shanti Bhagawati Secondary School
description: Established in 2009 BS, Shree Shanti Bhagawati Secondary School (SSBSS) is a government institution located in Letang Municipality Ward No. 4, Morang district. With over 70 years of educational legacy, it serves more than 1,600 students and offers comprehensive education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. It provides affordable, quality learning in a supportive environment, with moderate fees and merit-based scholarship schemes for deserving students.The school is particularly distinguished as the only government-approved technical stream institution in the Letang area offering Computer Engineering alongside traditional streams including Management, Science, and Education at the higher secondary level. This unique focus equips students with practical technical skills, preparing them for modern careers in IT and engineering.The school features a modern, welcoming environment, spacious playgrounds for sports and events, well-equipped science and computer laboratories, and dedicated spaces for hands-on learning. It emphasizes holistic development through extracurricular activities, moral education, personality building, sports, quizzes, scouting, and community events. It fosters a disciplined, safe, motivating, and joyful atmosphere with experienced teachers, counseling support, transportation arrangements, and emerging facilities like libraries, multimedia classes, and unlimited internet in labs.SSBSS has been undergoing rapid development, featuring state-of-the-art buildings, an updated library, science and computer labs with unlimited internet access, and a playground. The school is also progressing towards implementing multimedia e-classes.​

name: Pragati Model Secondary School
description: Pragati Model Secondary School is also an ISO 9001:2015 International Quality Certified institution, reflecting its commitment to global educational benchmarks. The school aims to empower students with strong academic foundations and essential life skills. By blending a supportive learning environment with high-quality teaching, the school prepares its graduates to become responsible, skilled, and socially conscious citizens of the nation.The school has a long history of achieving outstanding results. Its curriculum is designed to balance traditional academic rigor with modern, student-centred learning methodologies. It has been offering quality education to over a thousand students from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. It offers different programs, including Hotel Management and Finance. Computer Science under the Management streams and a separate Education stream in +2 level.With an enrollment exceeding 1,000 students, the institution fosters an inclusive and dynamic environment supported by a committed team of teachers and staff. The school emphasises discipline, creativity, and community involvement for students. The school includes a broad array of activities such as regular academic assessments, orientation programs for new higher secondary batches, certificate distributions for academic excellence, scout initiatives, cultural performances, speech and debate competitions, student talent highlights, parent orientation workshops, annual anniversaries combined with Parents' Day events, and practical excursions tied to local studies.The school also maintains strong connections with the local community through frequent involvement of parents, management committees, and regional representatives in ceremonies and programs. It promotes holistic development, aiming to build capable, disciplined, and talented individuals ready for future challenges.

name: Janapath Secondary School
description: Established in 2020 BS, the school offers academic programs from the early grades up to the secondary and higher secondary (+2) level, following the curriculum prescribed by the National Examination Board (NEB). Janapath Secondary School focuses on building a strong academic foundation while also encouraging students’ overall personal and social development.Along with regular classroom teaching, the school promotes co-curricular and extracurricular activities to enhance students’ skills, discipline, and confidence. Basic educational facilities, supportive teachers, and a learning-friendly environment contribute to the school’s commitment to student growth.It also offers a technical education pathway, specifically catering to students who have completed TSLC in Civil Engineering, a Pre-Diploma in Civil Engineering, or Technical SEE (grade 9–12) in the same field. With a focus on practical, learning by doing methodologies, the school ensures that students are well-prepared for the industry through extensive hands-on experience and specialized training.The school offers an impressive array of facilities designed to bridge the gap between classroom theory and real-world application. Students have access to well-equipped Civil Engineering, Physics, and Chemistry laboratories, and benefit from the mentorship of well-experienced and qualified engineers. Beyond the classroom, the curriculum includes essential practical experiences such as On the Job Training (OJT), survey camps, field and site visits, and educational tours. Additionally, the school supports its students' future careers by offering job replacement services, making it a comprehensive choice for aspiring engineers in the region.

description: Secondary School Biswanathpur is a public school located in Bishnu Rural Municipality, Sarlahi district, within Madhesh province. The school provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 12. As per the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, Secondary School Biswanathpur has 1628 enrolled students.

name: Gorkha United Public School
description: Gorkha United Public School (GUPS), established in 2000 AD (2057 BS), is a leading academic institution located in Kohalpur Municipality-02, Banke, in the peaceful heart of Nepal’s Mid-Western region. Spanning across 1.6 hectares of serene land, GUPS boasts well-developed academic and residential infrastructure, including modern classrooms, dedicated administrative and academic buildings, fully equipped science and computer labs, a rich library with a study hall, an auditorium, and a cafeteria. With its calm and pollution-free environment, the school provides an ideal setting for focused learning and all-round development. Since its inception, GUPS has been committed to academic excellence, driven by a dedicated team of highly qualified and experienced educators. The school embraces innovative teaching methodologies and a student-centered approach, aiming to prepare students for the demands of a dynamic 21st-century world. In 2065 BS, GUPS expanded its academic offerings to include Plus Two (10+2) programs in Science and Management, under the affiliation of the National Examinations Board (NEB). In 2075 BS, the school took a significant leap forward by launching a Bachelor of Science in Agriculture program affiliated with the Agriculture and Forestry University (AFU), Rampur, Chitwan. This program is conducted under the banner of Gorkha Polytechnic College & Research Centre, a sister project situated on 4.5 hectares of land in Baijanath Village Municipality-4. With this addition, GUPS has solidified its role as a pioneer in technical and agricultural education in the region. Vision Gorkha United Public School is dedicated to educating students to the highest academic standards, driven by the motto, "Positive Thinking for Quality Education." The school envisions empowering each student to reach and exceed their potential, preparing them to become productive, responsible, ethical, creative, and compassionate members of society. Facilities Science Lab Students are active learners, not just passive recipients of knowledge. Labs provide students with various opportunities to learn and experiment, which plays a crucial role in the ongoing intellectual development of students at any academic level. GUPS has extended its Science Labs to facilitate the students with all sorts of materials and equipment. It owns separate labs for Physics, Chemistry and Biology experiments to develop scientific reasoning abilities, discover the world around them, and ask challenging questions to gather the evidence needed for the most complete answer. Library and e-library GUPS has expanded its Library with separate study room with inclusion of thousands of world class books on Science & technology, Mathematics, Nepali & English literatur and Encyclopedia along with relevant text-books. GUPS library also acquires thousands of magazines (Daily/ Weekly/Monthly). Along with this library possesses connection of e-Library through internet. Co-Curricular Activities Study gets no completion without the involvement of Co-curricular activities. Hence throughout the year the school conducts different activities/competitions on weekly basis as house wise competition according to School’s Academic calendar. Besides, the school organizes Mini Running Shield, Annual Sports/Parents’ Day and GUPS Talent Hunt every year with the active participation of all level students. Audio/Visual Classes To provide visual understanding of different theories & hypothesis, the school possesses Audio/Visual aids like separate Laptops, LCD projectors for juniors and senior students with e-classes on variety of subject topics. Computer Lab Traditionally, computer labs have been configured to support teaching and learning by providing rows of computers in a lecture-style classroom set-up. Lab computers and software allowed students to complete course assignments or learn new programs. Children Park Kids pay more attention to academic tasks when they are given frequent, brief opportunities for free play. Recess can also have a calming effect helping with disciplinary issues and impulse control. Unstructured physical activity on the playground helps kids become smarter, healthier and stronger.

name: Bright Future Secondary School
description: Bright Future Secondary School (BFSS), an educational institution, was established in 2044 B.S. with the goal of offering high-quality and inclusive education, guided by the principle that 'Education is the fundamental necessity for all individuals.' The core ethos of BFSS revolves around education as a catalyst for a promising future and the holistic development of students, integrated with practical education grounded in values. Registered with the Government of Nepal, Bright Future School is committed to creating an optimal teaching-learning environment. It aims to foster the development of capable, self-reliant Nepalese citizens and nurture students to be globally competitive. BFSS also offers +2 programs in Science and Management streams, affiliated with the National Examination Board, Nepal, since 2019. The +2 programs are designed to provide the highest quality education, fostering a highly motivated and competent workforce capable of contributing to the nation's development.The +2 programs at BFSS provide students ample opportunities for intellectual and academic growth, while also helping them mature into responsible individuals capable of navigating the challenges of a competitive, globalized economy.Mission and Vision of BFSSTo be the center of academic excellence by providing quality education within the framework and direction of Ministry of Education, Government of Nepal creating efficient human resources is our mission. We have a vision to be a professionally reputed learning center, known for academic excellence in this region. To develop socially, culturally and professionally capable citizens is the main mission.Objective of BFSSBFSS creates and emphasis a learning culture where all learners are fully engaged in holistic, meaningful and innovative learning; in a caring and sharing collaborative learning environment following the participatory approach supported by our parents/guardians. We aim to prepare individuals who can face the challenges and opportunities of 21st century being a successful member of global community. We motivate our student in a caring and creative learning to bring out the best of them. Every student are different and differently able persons, our main objective is to enhance their knowledge, thinking critically and communicating effectively being socially responsible person. We follow innovative teaching techniques to make learning more enjoyable, effective and practical. We stress and promote the essence of self-dependence moral behavior and dedication to duty and responsibility. We prefer creative teaching learning methodology.

name: Bagmati Boarding Secondary School
description: Bagmati Boarding Higher Secondary School (BBS) is truly an institution on the move, and the school's initiatives in secondary and higher secondary education place us among the leaders in preparing individuals for school-level education in the 21st century. BBS is committed to excellence and supported by technology and resources to help reach the highest educational goals. BBS invites aspiring youngsters to join this vital and challenging community. The school has its own sprawling complex amidst 20 Ropanis of land.The school is located at Sukedhara, New Colony, one of the most popular VIP residential areas. Yet it is not purely or primarily an urban school. It is insulated from the hustle and bustle of city life by spacious grounds, greenery, and fields around it. As the main route centre, the BBS is accessible by bus, car, and other means of public transport from all parts of the Kathmandu valley.ObjectiveThe aim is to provide an all-round education that prepares children to face any crisis in life with moral dignity and to become useful and loyal citizens of their country. To achieve the set goals, Bagmati has highly qualified staff committed to service and professional standards. Staff come from various backgrounds, both from Nepal and abroad.Educational PlansThe school's educational plan is designed to meet the demands of the international curriculum. Presently, Bagmati offers classes from Playgroup through class XII. School will start 'A' level classes (affiliated to Cambridge University, U.K.) in the near future.Learning ExperienceSchools typically follow a structured curriculum that covers subjects such as mathematics, science, language arts, social studies, and more. The curriculum is often aligned with educational standards set by the government or educational boards.Academic StructureBagmati Boarding Secondary School provides a well-structured curriculum catering to students from early childhood to higher secondary education:Primary Section (Grades I–V): Focuses on foundational learning across subjects such as First and Second Languages, Mathematics, Science, Social Studies, Art & Craft, Value Education, General Knowledge, Physical Education, and Moral Science. Individual care and attention are emphasized.Secondary Section (Grades VI–X): Encourages critical thinking, language proficiency, literature appreciation, and public speaking through debates, discussions, and interactive learning. Class sizes are maintained at an optimal level to ensure personalized attention.(+2) Wing – Bagmati Modern College: Offers Science, Commerce, and Humanities streams, providing students with a strong academic foundation for future studies and career opportunities.

description: Chelsea World School offers a comprehensive educational program spanning from Nursery to Grade 12, following the curriculum sanctioned by the National Curriculum Board of the Nepal Government. Additionally, the school provides a separate play station, a baby pool, and playing materials tailored for young children, enhancing their learning through play.Basic SchoolThe elementary school spans from Grade 1 to Grade 8, catering to children from around six to early adolescence. Chelsea World School endeavors to equip students to reach their utmost potential through an innovative, rigorous academic program. Students are encouraged to explore, create, make responsible decisions, and actively engage in their learning journey. As students acquire foundational skills and advance through the grades, the curriculum presents them with increasing challenges focused on problem-solving and higher-level critical thinking skills.Secondary SchoolThis academic segment spans from Grade 9 to Grade 12. The courses offered within these grades are meticulously crafted to align with the curriculum standards set forth by the National Examinations Board, under the auspices of the Ministry of Education, Nepal. Within the array of courses outlined by the Curriculum Development Centre, Chelsea World School provides a selection of highly competitive courses tailored to meet the diverse needs and interests of learners.Employing contemporary and scientific teaching methodologies rooted in practical curriculum, the school boasts well-equipped classrooms aimed at empowering students to adeptly navigate the challenges of higher education. A dedicated team of academic professionals is poised to mentor students in cultivating essential qualities such as knowledge, skills, and habits of mind, preparing them to excel in our increasingly intricate and interconnected global landscape. With an emphasis on efficient classroom management and interactive teaching-learning approaches within standard-sized classrooms, students are encouraged to recognize their individuality and assured of successful academic attainment.Mission of Chelsea World SchoolChelsea World School has been following the motto “Vision through Virtue” sincerely since its inception. It has focused on inculcating high moral and ethical values amongst the students to ensure they become responsible citizens and good human beings. The institution emphasizes the practical aspects of course materials to ensure meaningful and interesting learning experiences, leading to academic excellence. Collaboration with industries, communities, and fellow institutions both domestically and internationally is actively encouraged with the aim of grooming professionals who embody the spirit of scientific thinking and serve as valuable resources for industry and society at large.In an ever-changing world, it is essential that young people are equipped with the necessary skills to navigate challenges effectively. Students at Chelsea World School develop essential life skills through practical, hands-on experiences. Additionally, the institution offers the internationally recognized Cambridge GCE A-Level program.

name: Kanjirowa National Secondary School
description: Kanjirowa National Secondary School (KNSS) is an independent co-educational institution that provides education in a resourceful, friendly, and caring environment. The school was established in 1998 as Kathmandu Don Bosco H. S. School in New Baneshwar. It is run by a team of professionals with extensive national and international experience in education.Currently located in Koteshwar, the school is widely recognized for its institutional growth, dynamic curriculum, innovative teaching methods, learner-friendly environment, and enriched co-curricular activities.The learning process is the most distinctive feature at Kanjirowa. New teaching approaches and programs are regularly introduced to keep education fresh and effective. Students are involved in various Project-Based Learning Activities designed for their all-around development. In all these activities, teachers serve as facilitators, guiding students rather than simply instructing them.The school aims to make students autonomous, lifelong learners who excel not only in academics but in all aspects of life. The goal is to help students grow up as good human beings and responsible citizens. Kanjirowa promotes the importance of ethical values and moral character alongside academic achievement.VisionTo provide life skills in the global context..MissionTo enhance students’ learning, enlighten their minds, and mold their personalities so that they become responsible global citizens.Main FeaturesA wide variety of teaching and learning methods in a motivational learningenvironment to enhance confidence, self-esteem, independence and human dignityAcknowledge the unique potentials of each child and prepare a work plan in response to his/her needsUse of a variety of modern educational resources, technologies andmethodologiesBalanced co-curricular activitiesParticipatory, Project-Based, and Experiential Learning environmentRich in reading culture, research, and innovationBoard-based dynamic curriculumTeam spirit of qualified, well-trained, and innovative teachersSpecialised individual care and a safe school environmentInclusion of students from diverse cultural and geographical locationsCurriculum and PedagogyThe school firmly believes that no real learning takes place unless the learner desires to learn. Therefore, the curriculum is designed to help students explore and exploit their own learning process and create deep desires to learn. At the conceptual level, the school follows the Experiential Learning Model based on Constructionism. Our curriculum and pedagogy incorporate many PROJECTS to provide an environment for 'learn through reflection on doing' as a continuous activity across every subject.Instead of learning being a teacher-led delivery of knowledge, the teacher and students construct knowledge together; learners can question, critique, and contribute creatively, making the learning experience a way of life. KNSS emphasizes the learning process so that our children enjoy participating in it and learn by building on their prior knowledge of the subjects. Our dynamic curriculum and pedagogy help them to be physically, spiritually, and morally sound.Alongside this, opportunities for interaction with experts from different fields are provided to enhance students' confidence and knowledge of various national and international issues. The students work individually and in a team. Both situations are important for the learning process. They are encouraged to work with every other student in class to ensure they contribute to the learning process and develop a habit of co-operation and the value of democratic exercises.

It is in fact, a large education network that runs various Montessori schools, secondary and secondary schools and other academic institutions all over Nepal. It aims to create academic platforms where individuals can grow both practically and rationally and can deliver what the global world demands.Mission:The mission of Bridgewater International College is to deliver optimum quality education to accelerate the pace of educational sector. BWIC strongly believes in the notion of 'creating new dimension in education'.Vision:Bridgewater International College envisions to introduce the largest, the most practical, innovative and productive educational network in the country with collective involvement of national and international collaboration.Belief:The belief of Bridgewater International College is that every mind is a separate knife made up of the same steel. The difference among them is derived from their sharpness, not merely being measured by the dissemination of bookish knowledge but by life experience as well. We are not convinced by only helping every pupil become successful, but in making them capable, so that they can handle even defeat of life gracefully: learn from it and strive to win at the end.Objectives: To achieve academic brillianceTo reflect intellectual beauty, creativity and novelty in the performance of the studentsTo establish a scientific and empirical based educationTo provide better opportunities to help students set a goal and offer them necessary means and measures to achieve itTo encourage students to act with free will and exhibit what they feel without any skepticism

name: Galaxy Public School
description: Galaxy Public School constitutes an educational community where individuals from diverse nationalities and backgrounds, including students and staff, coexist, study, and collaborate within a harmonious environment.Established in 1986 by its founder Principal, Mrs. Geeta Rana, Galaxy operates as a co-educational institution, serving the academic requirements of both boys and girls from Nursery to Class 10.Originally established within a modest tenement house with only nine students and two teachers, Galaxy has since undergone remarkable expansion. Presently, it stands as one of the largest educational establishments in the valley, boasting an enrollment of over 2000 students and a proficient staff of 250.The institution's objective is to furnish a comprehensive education that equips students with the moral integrity to confront life's challenges and cultivates them into productive and loyal citizens. This ethos is encapsulated in the school motto, "LOVE and SERVICE."Galaxy endeavors not only to prepare students for academic success and professional pursuits but also aims to foster tolerant, well-balanced, and independent individuals who are inclined towards aiding others. Its distinguishing feature lies in the diverse range of activities it offers, intended to nurture students' holistic development and showcase their talents for the betterment of society.At Galaxy, every student is afforded the opportunity to engage in various activities, a privilege not commonly found in other educational institutions.Galaxy Public School remains steadfast in its commitment, as it was in 1986, to the belief that the future of humanity relies on individuals who embrace responsibility for themselves and others in an increasingly diverse society. This commitment is realized through a comprehensive educational experience that nurtures students' skills, perspectives, and ethics, preparing them to contribute positively to society.The school actively fosters an academic environment that values diverse viewpoints and expressions, empowering students to discern ways in which they can contribute meaningfully to the greater good through love and service. It maintains a stance of political neutrality and discourages political activities within its premises.In line with Nepalese culture and traditions, the school imparts value-based education without promoting any specific religion, advocating instead for respect towards all positive religious beliefs and encouraging students to glean wisdom from various faiths.Galaxy firmly believes that a child's proper education can only be achieved when the school, home, and society collaborate harmoniously, each respecting the integrity of the others. Any distrust or discord among these three pillars of education has the potential to disrupt the delicate relationship essential for the holistic development of children.Vision of Galaxy Public SchoolProviding Innovative Education for DecadesAccredition of Galaxy Public SchoolThe school follows the National Curriculum, preparing students for the SEE Examination administered by HMG, Nepal, at the Class 10 stage. English, Nepali, Maths, Science, Social Studies, Environment, Population & Health (EPH), and Optional Maths are mandatory subjects for all students. Additionally, students must select either Computer Studies or Accountancy as their Optional Subject.Students at the institution have achieved notable success in board examinations. In the SEE Board Examinations of 2051 BS, students from the school secured top positions at the national level. The Ministry of Education, HMG, Nepal, recognized the school's outstanding performance by awarding it the Birendra Vidya Shield and flag. In 2052, the school once again received the shield, this time for its regional achievements.Annually, over 300 students sit for the SEE exams, boasting an almost 100% success rate with 99% achieving first division. The Higher Secondary Wing of the school is affiliated with the Higher Secondary Education Council, Sanothimi, Bhaktapur, Nepal. At this level, students can choose from two streams: Science and Management. English and Nepali are compulsory subjects, with the Science group offering Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Maths, while the Commerce group provides Economics, Business Organization & Office Management, and Accountancy. In higher education, the school aims to maintain a top-notch, cost-effective system that meets societal needs and offers students opportunities for knowledge enhancement.

name: Sanjiwani Model Secondary School
description: Sanjiwani Secondary School was established as Sanjiwani Middle English School in 1949 AD to enlighten the local people and free them from ignorance. The school was upgraded to High School in 1957 on the basis of the standard of education, physical facilities and setting and sound educational environment as well as the extension of its catchment area.The school was modified as Multi- purpose School in 1976, as Vocational Secondary School in 1971, as Model School in 1977 and finally as General School in 1981 after the amendment of National Education System Plan which abolished the categorization of secondary schools. In 1991, the school was upgraded to Secondary School affiliated to Higher Education Board with 10+2 Management Stream.In 1999, 10+2 Education Stream was added and in 2003, 10+2 Science Stream was launched with the academic support of Kathmandu University. Besides these wings, the school has been running separate English Medium School from Grade nursery to Ten since 1982 and Integrated Education Program for the Blind since 1986.

name: Bijeshwori Gyan Mandir Sainik Mahavidyalaya
description: Bijeshwori Gyan Mandir Sainik Mahavidyalaya (BGMSM) is a secondary school, which is run by Nepal army as a model girl's academy. This Mahavidyalaya is entirely looked after by Nepal Army Welfare Fund (NAWF).To proffer the best available higher learning approaches and all-round opportunities to all the students, to aspire their personal hidden talents and to expand scholastic and co- scholastic abilities, the Mahavidyalaya, specifically concentrates, first and foremost, upon academics co-related and extra- curricular activities, highly emphasizing individual counselling , closely associated to course of studies and career guidelines for future prosperities.Bijeshwori Gyan Mandir Sainik Mahavidyalaya is a holy place of whizz-kids where each individual is catered, cared and canalized effectively and efficiently for their successful life. To assimilate these norms and resolutions, to create its heightened and widened access to reach the summit of academic excellence, the foundation stone was laid down by Nepal Army Wives Association(NAWA) on 23rd Kartik, 2054 B.S.(9th November, 1997 A.D.) on the lap of Swoyambhu, coined after Goddess Bijeshwori.Besides academics, the Mahavidyalaya also equally displays its excellence in extra-curricular activities to develop all round development of an individual. The Mahavidyalaya is, therefore committed to maintain academic ethos in bringing out the potentialities of Nepalese girls to shoulder the process of nation building, to meet the nation’s requirements and to compete globally in diverse arenas. The Mahavidyalaya solemnly promises to meet all the requirements and self-sustainable foundation.Objectives:To boost up the institution as a model girls’ educational academy providing quality education to all the daughters of the army staff and public of each and every nook of the nation at affordable fees.To impart practical, innovative, scientific, vocational education system and advanced pedagogical techniques meeting international standards to compete in global arena.To yield well-disciplined, self-reliant, qualified, inquisitive, research oriented citizens by nurturing positive attitudes towards modern trends of people, life and vision.To offer solid foundation of higher education providing access of excellent communicating and shared learning skills to delve into the globe.To carve kinetic potentialities of the vibrant individuals infusing extra-curricular activities feeling the sustainable necessity and exposing their inherent latent to undergo a worthy life.

name: Manohar Secondary School
description: Manohar Secondary School is located in Gongabu, Kathmandu and with affiliation from NEB it offers plus two program in Management and Education. Manohar Higher secondary School is only the community educational institution for providing better education for all. It is located at Madevtar ,Gongabu -7,Kathmandu five minutes walk to the north of Samakhusi Chwok of the ring road. This school has supported the students of economically middle and lower class family from different parts of the country for better education.This school was established in 2019 B.S. At the beginning ,with the effort of some dedicated local people this school was run in a public place called Calcatte Pati for few months. Then it was shifted to the Mahendreswor Temple at Gongabu -7, Baniyatar and in the building of Kanji house in Gongabu in 2028. In this way this school was running like a mobile school until permanent place was not managed.Finally , this school was shifted to the public house ( sarbajanik pati) in Gongabu 7, where school is running at present, in 2034 B.S. In order to name the school, there held discussion for a long time among the local people and was finally decided "Manohar" after the name of a holy place " Manohar Tirtha" at the confluence of two rivers Bishnumati and Sangla of Gongabu V.D.C .Still there lay a lot of things to do for the stability of the school. The school had not its own land and building to run classes. But the intellectuals, social workers and devoted people didn't gave up their hope and effort. After the hard work they obtained 2 ropanies and 7 anas land for the school by the recommendation of then V.D.C. chairman.After the land had been obtained, with the recommendations of Fr. EL Watrine Moderator of G.A.A. a non-government organization, a Canadian educational project had built the first tow story building.After that with the aid of government, INGOs and by the own resources of the school , other buildings had been built. The school now owns four buildings with sufficient rooms to run classes nursery to 12 with sections.This school was recognized as secondary school by the government in 2052 B.S. and permitted +2 program on management, humanities and education by HSEB in 2066.

Students at Paragon enjoy a curriculum of stimulating, exciting and challenging learning experiences carefully differentiated to meet the needs of all our students. The progressive and well-balanced pedagogy, maintained by the dedicated mentors of Paragon, help children to identify, realize and apply their innate abilities in the daily learning and co-curricular activities. The institute has undergone rapid growth and changes since it was established in the year 1994. In less than two decades, paragon has emerged as one of the leading school in the nation. Many of the students of the school have received distinguished results in the school leaving certificate (SLC) examinations and acquired honorable career both nationally and globally. Vision Paragon Public School's vision is to provide a congenial learning environment by focusing on developing the emotional, social, physical, creative and spiritual potential of every child, who will contribute in the development of the nation, in future.The faculty members at Paragon School, make efforts to impact education through different innovative methods combined with modern techniques and expertise. description: Established in 2017 BS on Baishakh 14 as a primary school, this Sri Mahendra Secondary School has been adding grades every year. name: Divya Jyoti Secondary School
description: Divya Jyoti Secondary School is a community-based public educational institution located in the rural setting of Kaseni, Sarai, Mathagadhi-3, Palpa district. Established in 2025 BS , the school has been serving the local community for over five decades as an accessible center for learning. It operates from Play Group (PG) to Grade 12, offering a full spectrum of education from early childhood through higher secondary level (10+2), affiliated with the National Examination Board (NEB). According to the IEMIS report 2081/82, it provides comprehensive schooling that caters to students in a semi-rural hilly area of Palpa, blending foundational education with advanced secondary programs.The school functions primarily as a public/community school, making quality education available to local families without the high fees often associated with fully private institutions. It emphasizes a balanced approach that combines academic rigor with practical facilities and extracurricular engagement. With a focus on creating a supportive atmosphere, Divya Jyoti Secondary School aims to prepare students not only for national examinations but also for holistic personal development in a safe and disciplined environment.Divya Jyoti Secondary School stands out for several modern and student-friendly facilities rarely found uniformly in rural public schools. It maintains an Advanced Computer Lab and Science Lab equipped with Smart TV Classes to enhance interactive learning. The school provides dedicated Recreation and Health Care support, including on-site Nursing Staff. Transportation is facilitated through a School Bus, while a School Canteen offers convenient meals.The school adopts a progressive language policy tailored to different levels. From PG to Class 5, teaching and learning occur fully in English medium, laying a strong foundation in the global language from an early age. From Class 6 to 10, it follows a dual-medium approach (English and Nepali), allowing flexibility while ensuring accessibility for all students. The school prioritizes competent and well-trained teachers who deliver engaging lessons. A notable practice is the arrangement of Proxy Classes during a teacher's absence, minimizing disruption to the academic calendar and maintaining continuity in learning. Overall, the pedagogy leans toward activity-based, interactive, and technology-supported methods (through labs and smart classes), fostering curiosity, discipline, and practical skills in a structured yet caring environment.

In 2018, Nepal Rastriya Chandraganga Secondary School received the International School Award under the Connecting Classrooms Program of the British Council, acknowledging its commitment to global learning standards. Shree Nepal Rastriya Chandraganga Madhyamik Vidhyalaya proudly serves students from diverse racial, religious, and linguistic communities across Surkhet and neighboring districts such as Dailekh, Jajarkot, Jumla, Humla, and Kalikot. Since 2010, the school has adopted English as the medium of instruction, making it the only public school in Karnali Province to do so. With a mission to develop skilled, ethical, and globally competent citizens, the school emphasizes academic excellence over profit-making. Its team of qualified teachers, visionary educators, and dedicated administrative staff work collaboratively to nurture students' talents and aspirations. The school aims to become a model community school in Karnali Province, providing equal learning opportunities for students from marginalized, disadvantaged, and low-income families. Plans are also underway to introduce technical education in Agriculture starting next academic year. Despite challenges in academic, administrative, and infrastructural development, Nepal Rastriya Chandraganga Secondary School continues to grow as a beacon of hope and opportunity for the region’s youth

name: Pathshala Nepal Foundation, Baneshwor
description: Pathshala was founded in 2004 AD as a co-educational English Medium School to cater to the need of quality schooling in the context of 21st century learning. Education is an asset of every individual. This fact cannot be ignored in today’s globalized world. For some decades in Nepal, the ultimate goal of education has been to be a doctor or an engineer or a technician or empower students to get a job without placing values in personal integrity. Success at any cost and by any means is misleading the entire Nepalese society. The major focus has been placed on fluency of speech in English, doing homework and securing position in examination. Community assesses school children by marks they obtain in examination rather than their cognitive, social, emotional, psychological, motor and moral development. Parents hardly think of how responsible the child has been after school; how helpful and sociable she/he has been. Pathshala does not believe in providing mere theoretical knowledge: it rather follows practical and behavioral aspects of education. It has realized that the goal should be to become a good citizen along with the content of information. The current need of the nation is education for meaningful life. It believes few educated good people can influence and ignite change among larger mass. The prime goal of education should be profession oriented with humanity and ethics. Students should be responsible and accountable to the world, nation, community and family. Pathshala Nepal is established to address these issues and its activities are conducted to accomplish these goals. Though it is very challenging, innovative and creative; it is not impossible to achieve. The whole child, or whole person focus of learning can bring miraculous changes in students. Pathshala Nepal is an effort of a group of educators who are working for improving traditional instructional approaches. Since its inception, Pathshala is emerging as most sought after 21st Century education center and has been a source of inspiration for many other educational institutions in Nepal. It has been generally observed that many parents have been taking their children abroad seeking better education than from Nepal’s schools whereas Pathshala has many examples of comeback. Pathshala is proud to share that this institution has provided education of global standard with local values. Mission The mission of Pathshala Nepal is to develop all aspects of school life in meaningful situation so that children achieve their full potential both academically and socially. This education takes place within a challenging, stimulating and caring environment in which educational values are central to the ethos of the school and its teaching. ‘Meaningful Education for Meaningful Life’ is the motto of this school. Vision To help students develop full potential with lively and enquiring minds, the ability to question and discuss rationally. To foster a warm and friendly atmosphere within a caring school community in which students’ self-esteem and respect for others can develop. To provide a broad, balanced curriculum which fulfills the requirements of the National Curriculum and which should be appropriate and matched to the development level and needs of individual students, giving due regard to the fundamental importance of maths and language. To help students to acquire knowledge and skills, encouraging them to take pride in their achievements. To promote the good conduct and sense of responsibility To promote respect for local values, tolerance of other races, religions and ways of life. To help students to appreciate human achievements and aspirations. To help students to understand the world in which they live and the interdependence of individuals, groups as well as nations. To provide equal opportunities, responsibilities and rights regardless of race, gender, background and ability to children. To enhance the partnership among students, parents and school in the education of our children. name: Badimalika Secondary School
description: Established as the oldest educational institution in the district, Badimalika Secondary School has a rich history of fostering literacy in the region. Originally starting as a Gurukul in Gautukot prior to 1956 (2013 BS), the school evolved through various stages, including operating as Shambhunath Middle School, before being officially recognized as a secondary school in 1975 (2032 BS). The school was built on the foundation of community spirit, established through land donations from local philanthropists like Dharmadatta Upadhyay and sustained by the labor and "Muthidan" (grain donations) of the local population.In response to the growing demand for modern education, Badimalika Secondary School has successfully implemented an English-medium curriculum alongside traditional tracks. Since 2011 (2068 BS), the institution has also been affiliated with CTEVT to provide specialized agricultural education. To further support academic excellence, the school conducts dedicated residential classes for students preparing for the Secondary Education Examination (SEE).With an enrollment of 960 students, including a high representation of female students and children from marginalized communities, Badimalika Secondary School, stands as the largest school in the district by student volume as of 2026 . The school’s commitment to quality education has had a significant socio-economic impact, successfully curbing local migration as parents now find urban-standard education within their own municipality.The school operates strictly under the "School as a Zone of Peace" concept, ensuring that the academic environment remains free from political activities. Under the leadership of the Raskot Municipality and the School Management Committee, Badimalika Secondary School continues to lead the district in academic performance, consistently outperforming neighboring institutions in SEE results.VisionProduce humanresource for the nation in the field of Agriculture.Goal/ ObjectivesTo provide services and help to eliminate poverty in the country.

name: Euro School
description: Teachers are one of the most valuable partners in the school's mission and vision as they are the caretakers and facilitators The real strength of Euro School lies in the collective talent of exceptionally well-trained and dedicated faculty. Teachers in this school use new ideas, new systems and new approaches for the enhancing knowledge and betterment of the children. They are extremely empathetic, enthusiastic and open to change as well.The Euro School curriculum discourages rote learning. The curriculum encourages students to take active part in the learning process through a unique LRPA model that makes learning stress free and enjoyable. This 4 pronged approach denotes how each concept, be it mathematical, scientific or linguistic, gets rooted in the students.Learning of the concept in the classroom followed byReinforcement of the concept through Audio-Visual media,followed byPractice through projects and experiments and most important, followed byApplications of the given concept in real lifeThe latest teaching methodologies and pedagogies are followed to effectively address the curriculum and create an ideal environment for learning. Euro School encourages and focuses on individual's aptitudes and strengths. Students are encouraged to focus on their interest and skills for a better future. It follows the system of continuous assessment, a unique methodology for evaluating students' performance. It comprises of one or all of the following:Observation: Using specific criteria to record the presence or absence of knowledge, co-operative learning skills, extent of participation, interest in the topic and material, psychomotor skills and levels of motivation.Assessment: On-going assessment of an activity in class on a day-to-day basis Appropriate assessment of the given task that would involve manipulation of words, materials, ideas or concepts.Written Assignments: Anecdotal records on the development of specific skills related to instructional objectives or the attitude expressed or demonstrated by a pupil towards learning.At Euro School, they strives to achieve a balance between academics and co-curricular activities, between theoretical and practical learning, between national curriculum and new generation teaching aids and more importantly shaping a child to be a responsible global citizen while retaining the rich Nepali ethos. The school is a center, a laboratory, where students develop ideas and understanding pursuit, passion and dreams and hold themselves and their classmates accountable for shared and individual work.MissionIts endeavor is to provide learning experiences through the provision of -Differentiated, in-depth and cohesive learning programs which stimulate and develop each child’s abilities to his or her highest potential.Highly motivated and dedicated teachers who are result oriented through their commitment to ongoing professional development, quality teaching, coaching, mentoring and collaboration.A learning environment that is responsive to students’ voices. Enriching and engaging resources.Opportunities for parents and guardians to take an active part in learning and decision making policies.VisionThe school has a vision is to be a premier global educational institution by providing a broader, bolder, holistic and more meaningful education. It strives to cultivate all round qualities in a student through excellence in education that shall foster academic understanding, brilliance, spiritual well being, psychological strengths, resourcefulness and creative skills, social responsibility and concern for one’s environment.

name: Himalayan Academy
description: Himalayan Academy was established in the year 1995 with a view to provide the internationally standard education in the Nepalese soul which is located at the heart of the Kathmandu Metropolis, Kapurdhara, Kathmandu. It is promoted by the staunch and veteran educationist, social worker and business entrepreneur Mr. Krishna Simkhada, who has been in the field of education for more than two scores of years. The school is affiliated with District Education Office and National Education Board DEO/National Education Board NEB respectively and provides Ten Plus Two in Management and Humanities. The School has graduated thousands of students since its establishment and they have gone to the higher studies and professional works around the globe. It has got the consortium and the arrays of professional, psychologically motivated and dedicated teachers who groom up and train the young scholars to be an accountable member for a family; a society and the ambassadors of peace and love to the entire humanity. The school has produced the requirement of the efficient human resources at various fields and at large in different rated universities at national and international levels. Mission & Vision: The school works on imparting globally competent education and student-friendly environment where students are treated as those having inquisitive minds. The team of teachers and administrative staff principally target at involving students in all academic activities carried out in the school. The students are provided with sufficient reference study materials, practical field trips, lab activities, etc. With an aim to promote them to successfully stand against all possible shortcomings in their future career. Besides, the school conducts a number of counselling classes/workshops/seminars, etc in order to orient students to enhance their academic performances at all levels. The school principally focuses on imparting globally competent high-quality education students equipped with high moral and humanitarian sensibilities through the application of all possible means. Similarly, producing efficient future manpower for the all-round development of the country is another focus of the school. Goal: Himalayan Academy envisages if a man/woman changes into the human being, the world can be a better place to live in. Himalayan Academy products will come up with uncanny possibilities of problem-solving skills and analytical minds through which they shall be able to live a beautiful life and make this blue planet to be unique and safe at the corner of the vastness of the universe. it is well-known fact that a country’s development is measured by how technical and applied education the citizens have been provided with. our experience and the demand of the time the school intends to introduce unique educational programs with both theoretical and practical knowledge simultaneously. quality education is not merely a buzzword; rather the skills are required to be a competitive global citizen which will certainly be the milestone for the nation-building process can be acquired at Himalayan.

name: Nawa Jagriti Secondary School
description: Shree Nawa Jagriti Secondary School is a community-based public school located in Kathmandu Metropolitan City–6, Ramhiti, Kathmandu district, Bagmati Province. Established in 2055 B.S. (1999 A.D.), the school was founded through the initiative of the Ramhiti Bajranagar Area Reform Committee with the aim of expanding access to affordable and quality education for children from the local community.The history of the school is closely tied to strong community participation and social commitment. In 2054 B.S., the foundation of the school was laid with financial support of NRs. 22,000 provided by a Nepali-origin Canadian citizen named Tina, which was donated to the Ramhiti Women’s Group. At a time when government schools had limited seats and private education was unaffordable for many families, the women’s group collectively decided to utilize this support to establish a school for local children. Through the voluntary labor (janashramdaan) of more than 40 women, a six-room school building was successfully constructed, marking the beginning of Nawa Jagriti Secondary School.Teaching and learning activities formally began in 2055 B.S. In the years that followed, the school continued to grow with the support of various government and non-government organizations, education enthusiasts, industrialists, teachers, parents, education experts, and the media. This collective effort eventually led to the construction of the present permanent school building. The school currently occupies approximately one acre (one ropani) of land, including 0-07-02-02 land donated by industrialist Mr. Shambhu Bikram Thapa and Mrs. Menuka Devi Thapa.Today, Shree Nawa Jagriti Secondary School provides education from Early Childhood Development (ECD) to Grade 10, serving as an important educational institution for the Ramhiti area. According to the 2081 IEMIS report published by the Center for Education and Human Resource Development, the school has 574 enrolled students, reflecting its continued trust and relevance within the community.

name: Holy Vision English Secondary Boarding School
description: Located in Rolpa Municipality-4, Libang, Holy Vision English Secondary Boarding School is a premier institution renowned for its academic rigor, inclusive values, and holistic development programs. As the chosen school in Rolpa for educating children of Nepali Army personnel on scholarships, we combine affordability with world-class education to shape tomorrow’s leaders. Why Holy Vision? Proven Academic Success: Consistently top results in municipal-level SEE (Grade 10) and Grade 8 exams. Holistic Growth: Training in NCC, Taekwondo, painting, singing, and weekly intellectual/cultural/sports activities. Inclusive Scholarships: Support for martyrs’ families, Dalits, underprivileged students, and President’s Running Shield medalists. Modern Learning: Multimedia-based teaching, compulsory computer education (Grade 3+), and OPT Math (Grade 7+). Key Features: Affordable Excellence: Transparent fees with discounts for siblings (50% off for two children, free tuition for the 3rd). Academic Support: Free 3-month coaching during exams, monthly/weekly tests, and a full scholarship for SEE municipal toppers. Flexible Options: Day-boarding, boarding, and coaching facilities tailored to student needs. Admission Details (Nursery): Admission Fee: NPR 800/- (Free for former students) Boarding Fee: NPR 4000/- Special Incentives: Free education for school toppers, 50% fee discount for class toppers. Join a Legacy of Achievers From district-level competition winners to nurturing future innovators, Holy Vision empowers students through compulsory spoken English, educational tours, and a culture of excellence. Secure Your Child’s Future Today!

name: Shree Ganesh Secondary School
description: Established in 2037 B.S. in Changunarayan-5, Chhaling, Bhaktapur, Shree Ganesh Secondary School is a community-driven institution founded by local intellectuals and social workers to build a civilized society. Over the decades, the school has evolved from a primary level to a full-fledged secondary school, receiving official recognition for its secondary program in 2063 B.S. Committed to producing disciplined and honest citizens, the school utilizes a creative, achievement-oriented teaching methodology that has resulted in a consistent 100% pass rate in SEE/SLC and BLE examinations in recent years.The educational experience at Shree Ganesh is modern and student-centered, with lessons conducted in English from Nursery to Grade 10. To support this, the school integrates technology through Internet access, multimedia tools, and smartboards, while providing well-equipped laboratories for Computer, Mathematics, and Science. Safety and health are top priorities, as the school operates within earthquake-resistant buildings monitored by CCTV and offers regular health checkups through an on-site school nurse. Additionally, the school ensures a high level of care for its youngest learners in ECD and Nursery by maintaining a 20:2 teacher-to-student ratio, with one helper.One of the school’s most significant contributions is its extensive scholarship and support system. It offers special financial aid to children of parents with chronic illnesses, full scholarships for all students from Class 1 to 8, and targeted support for Dalit students, orphans, and those from low-income families. Merit-based scholarships are also available for top performers coming from other schools. Beyond tuition support, the school provides free notebooks and pens for students from Nursery to Class 5, along with healthy midday meals to support student well-being.Holistic development is encouraged through clubs such as the Scout Troop, ECO Club, and Junior Red Cross, as well as activities such as speech competitions, sports, and educational tours. The school also maintains a strong partnership with families, regularly monitoring students' progress and honoring involved parents with the "Exemplary Parent Award." By blending modern facilities with deep community roots, Shree Ganesh Secondary School continues to prepare its students to become skilled professionals like doctors, engineers, and teachers who contribute meaningfully to society.

name: DAV School, Biratnagar
description: DAV School, Biratnagar is a reputed co-educational institution located in Biratnagar-17, Morang, Nepal. Established under the DAV educational philosophy inspired by the Arya Samaj movement, the school has been providing quality education with a blend of modern learning and value-based education. The school offers academic programs from Play Group (PG) to Grade 12 in a student-friendly and well-ventilated environment designed to support holistic growth. It is affiliated with the NEB and CBSE framework and is recognized for integrating advanced teaching techniques, digital learning practices, and disciplined academic culture.The school operates under the philosophy of the DAV movement, which was founded to promote a balanced combination of modern education and Vedic values. DAV School Biratnagar aims to look beyond traditional classroom learning and encourage students to become creative thinkers, responsible citizens, and future-ready individuals. The institution emphasizes academic excellence, moral values, patriotism, environmental awareness, and global citizenship. Its motto, “Tamso Ma Jyotirgamaya”, meaning “from darkness to light” , reflects its commitment to enlightening students through knowledge, discipline, spirituality, and technology-based educationAcademic Environment and CurriculumDAV School Biratnagar follows a comprehensive and student-centered curriculum that promotes intellectual, emotional, physical, and creative development. The school focuses on creating a “fear-free and tear-free” learning environment where students can explore their full potential. The curriculum combines academic learning with experiential, environmental, entrepreneurial, and creative arts education.The academic framework of the school is divided into three major dimensions:Integral Frame: Encourages thematic and interdisciplinary learning that nurtures students physically, emotionally, intellectually, and spiritually.Instructional Frame: Focuses on core academic skills through cooperative learning, multiple intelligence theory, and multi-level teaching approaches.Experiential Frame: Connects students with real-world learning opportunities through practical education, entrepreneurship, technology, arts, crafts, and physical education.Pedagogy and Teaching MethodologyThe teaching methodology at DAV School Biratnagar is learner-centered and interactive. The school believes that every child possesses unique abilities and therefore encourages students to become active participants in their own learning process. name: Shree Shanti Secondary School
description: The legacy of Shree Shanti Secondary School is deeply rooted in the spiritual and communal history of Kalikot. Its name, "Shanti" (Peace), was inspired by the renowned Yogi Naraharinath, who performed a sacred Kotihom ritual for peace at the confluence of the Ghattegad and Rupsa rivers. Later, while upgrading the school's level, it was found that the geographical area was too small. Considering a central location for the service area and based on the advice of village elders, intellectuals, and social workers, the school was relocated from Dhanchu to Ratimata in Ward No. 5, the central part of Malkot VDC, on Mangsir 15, 2054 BS. At that time, the school granted permission for Grade 6 and began operating as a lower secondary school.Driven by the expectations, needs, contributions, and cooperation of the general community, the school continued to grow. The school received permission to run Grade 9 (secondary level) on Jestha 1, 2065 BS, and later on Kartik 7, 2068 BS, it received permission for Higher Secondary level (+2). Currently, the school operates from ECD (Early Childhood Development) to Grade 12. At present, there are a total of 19 teacher-staff members and 416 students engaged in teaching and learning at this school.Currently located at an elevation of 1,674 meters (5,524 feet) and spanning an area of 3,100 square meters in the heart of the Himalayas, Shree Shanti Secondary School plays a vital role in the growth of the Narharinath community. Operating on hilly terrain, the school continues to meet the evolving needs of its students, providing a structured pathway from early learning to university readiness for the youth of Kalikot.

name: Palpa Awasiya Secondary School
description: Palpa Awasiya Secondary School, established in 2036 BS, is the seniormost boarding school in Palpa and a renowned institution for academic excellence. The school, originally known as Palpali Kindergarten Institute and later as Don Bosco, has been serving the educational needs of the region for over four decades. With the leadership of dedicated individuals such as Mr. Ganesh Man Singh, Ms. Elizabeth Barret, and currently Mr. Anjalip Prasad Shrestha, the school has flourished and continues to uphold a tradition of quality education. Located in the picturesque ShreeNagar Hill, Palpa Awasiya School offers a Montessori-based education for its pre-school students, fostering a homely and caring environment where learning is enhanced through the "learning by doing" method. The school provides classes from Play Group (PG) to Grade 10, with a focus on nurturing students with a loving and motherly approach. For +2 programs, Palpa Awasiya offers Science and Management streams, affiliated with the National Examination Board. With around 500 students enrolled, the school is a beacon of educational progress in the region, ensuring that its graduates excel both locally and globally. Recognized with the prestigious International School Award by the British Council and the Nepal Government, Palpa Awasiya continues to set high standards in education while fostering a positive, nurturing atmosphere for every student.

It features modern physical infrastructure, child-friendly and ICT-equipped classrooms, and CCTV surveillance to ensure the security and well-being of students. Teaching is delivered by skilled, experienced educators, with additional support for academically weak students through focused coaching programs. The school also offers counseling services, the availability of focal teachers, and karate training, along with free uniforms, to promote discipline and holistic development.Ravi Basic School further supports students by providing free school bags and educational materials, ensuring equitable access to learning resources. Through its comprehensive academic and co-curricular initiatives, the school continues to foster a safe, supportive, and engaging environment for student growth.

name: Lumbini World School
description: Located between the two large cities of Butwal and Bhairahawa in the Lumbini Province, Lumbini World School (LWS) is an activity-based learning centre established in 2021 A.D. It offers life-changing education with a unique teaching style and world-class educational facilities. The school’s motto focuses on transforming teaching and learning methods to achieve academic innovations that challenge traditional educational practices. This includes moving away from rote memorization, textbook-driven instruction, conventional teaching techniques, and insufficient student evaluation and feedback.Serving students from Pre-School to Grade 10, LWS adapts the 5E (Engagement, Explore, Explain, Elaborate, Evaluate) Teaching and Learning Model, offering multi-dimensional skill-building opportunities to the students who require support from skilled teachers and mentors to acquire post-secondary education prospects, career opportunities, and lead an independent life. With access to small class sizes, specialized instruction, and individualized academic support, the school aims to be a pioneering educational institution in Nepal and a globally acclaimed learning centre through educational services. LWS employs a modern teaching-learning approach that merges traditional principles with a contemporary understanding of our roles as global citizens. The teaching methodologies include: Field trips, outdoor sessions, and workshops are organized, providing opportunities for children to reach their full potential.Group-based extracurricular activities are conducted based on individual students’ strengths and interests. English literature classes for grades 4 to 10 are conducted by instructors who speak English at a native-like level.Innovative Home Learning Activities are designed to encourage quality time between parents and children while also promoting active engagement in learningTFW (Talk for Writing), an interactive method for teaching English literature, is implemented in the English classes.The EAL (English as an Additional Language) team diligently works with grades 1, 2, and 3 to establish a solid foundation in the English language.Each class is supported by a full-time teacher and a teaching assistant throughout the lesson.A variety of indoor and outdoor resources are utilized as teaching aids to meet the diverse needs of every student in each lesson.A range of supplementary materials is employed to comprehensively address all aspects of the lesson to the students. Each lesson is crafted to promote inquiry-based learning, accompanied by rubrics for each topic. In grades 1, 2, and 3, core subjects are taught by a dedicated specialized teacher.Students at LWS are provided with clear guidance on social-emotional learning, self-regulation, and executive functioning skills beyond a rigorous academic programme. They are encouraged to participate in a variety of stimulating co-curricular and extracurricular activities, allowing them to flourish in their educational pursuits and ultimately secure rewarding careers.LWS aims to inspire and enable every student to achieve their fullest potential through its innovative and values-driven educational approach within a safe and nurturing environment. It maintains a mutual commitment to excellence among the school staff, parents, and students through tangible actions. LWS aims to identify and support the unique strengths and needs of each student to promote their social uprightness, emotional well-being, and academic development. All in all, the school is dedicated to collaborating with families and local organizations to create a cohesive community focused on their students' success.

name: Secondary School Tinghare
description: Secondary School Tinghare is a community school located in Tinghare, Lalbandi-16, Sarlahi. The school is committed to providing quality education to students from the local area. From Grade 1 to Grade 5, the school follows a full English medium system of instruction. For the lower classes, the Montessori method is used to make learning fun and activity-based, and a child-friendly environment is maintained to help young students feel safe and happy. Remedial classes are also conducted for students who need extra support in their studies, ensuring that every child can keep up with the lessons and no one is left behind.Computer education is compulsory for students from Grade 1 to Grade 8, helping them develop essential digital skills from an early age. The school has a consistent record of 100% success in the SEE examinations and is the only community school in the municipality to achieve this result regularly. In higher classes, teaching is done subject-wise by grouping students according to their learning needs, which helps teachers focus better and makes learning more effective. Counseling services are provided for both students and parents to support the overall well-being of the child.For students in Grades 8, 9, and 10, the school offers day residential classes, where they stay in school for longer hours under teacher guidance to study better and use their time productively. A day meal program, including snacks or lunch, is also available to ensure students receive proper nutrition during school hours. The school has a well-stocked library, a computer lab, and a science lab to support practical learning. There are three spacious assembly halls used for morning gatherings, events, and cultural programs.Safety is given importance at the school, with CCTV cameras installed in all classrooms and around the premises. Special girl-friendly toilet facilities have been built to ensure cleanliness and comfort for female students. In higher classes, teachers use multimedia tools to make lessons more interesting, and educational materials are used as much as possible to explain concepts clearly. All academic and extra-curricular activities are carried out according to a set academic calendar, bringing regularity to school life. The school keeps individual academic records for every student based on unit tests and terminal exams, helping teachers and parents track progress closely. Located in a peaceful and scenic area, Secondary School Tinghare provides a calm environment where students can focus on their studies and grow in a positive way.
